announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Eicher Motors Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition - Investment in Volvo Financial Services (India) Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Eicher Motors Limited (EML), at its meeting held on May 21, 2026, approved an investment of up to Rs. 750 Crore. This investment will be made as cash consideration for the subscription of 50% of the equity share capital of Volvo Financial Services (India) Private Limited ("VFS India"). VFS India, incorporated on January 13, 2015, is a Middle Layer Non-Deposit taking Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India, currently engaged in providing financing, leasing, and other financial services. The transaction also includes the formation of a joint venture for undertaking financial services business in India. This investment and joint venture formation are subject to the approval of the Reserve Bank of India. The board meeting commenced at 3:45 p.m. and concluded at 4:50 p.m.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: IIFL Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding additional information required under Industry Standards Note on Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
announcements.ai_summary: IIFL Finance Limited has provided additional information as required under the Industry Standards Note on Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. This follows an email communication from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited dated May 20, 2026. The enclosed annexure details that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), by an order dated May 11, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹3,10,000/- on IIFL Finance Limited for non-compliance with certain provisions of the ‘Master Direction- Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Company – Scale Ba’. The company has declared that the information provided is true, correct, and complete to the best of its knowledge.

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: Man Industries (India) Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Man Industries (India) Limited, at their meeting held on Thursday, May 21, 2026, noted the completion of a significant acquisition. Man International Steel Industries Company (“MISIC”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the company incorporated in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, acquired 100% equity stake in National Pipe Company Limited (“NPC”), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The total cost of this acquisition was approximately USD 102 Million, which is equivalent to approximately INR 1,000 Crores. NPC is an established API manufacturer of HSAW and LSAW pipes, serving major clients like Saudi Aramco and Qatar Petroleum. This acquisition aligns with Man Industries' international expansion strategy, aiming to strengthen its global presence and access infrastructure and energy opportunities in Saudi Arabia. NPC has an installed manufacturing capacity of approximately 430,000 MT per annum and plans to add a Coating Mill with External & Internal Coating Plant.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Magellanic Cloud Limited has informed the Exchange about Incorporation of Subsidiary
announcements.ai_summary: Magellanic Cloud Limited, formerly South India Projects Limited, has incorporated a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) named MCRAY XTEND INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED ("MCRAY") in collaboration with Rayonix Tech Private Limited. This SPV is established to pursue activities related to unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology, defence technology solutions, manufacturing, and deployment. Magellanic Cloud Limited will acquire a 60% shareholding in MCRAY, making it a subsidiary. This move aligns with the company's strategic expansion into the UAV and defence technology sectors and aims to bolster its involvement in indigenous technology development. The incorporation and proposed investment were approved by the board, and no promoters or promoter group companies have direct interest in MCRAY, other than their shareholding in Magellanic Cloud Limited.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: PAKKA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Pakka Limited has provided an update on its Jagriti Project and clarified resolutions from its EGM held on May 05, 2026. The estimated project cost for the Jagriti Project has been revised to INR 744.00 Crores, with INR 583.45 Crores already incurred as of March 31, 2026. The remaining funding will be met through the proceeds of a preferential issue and internal accruals. The company also clarified post-issue shareholding percentages for proposed allottees Neo Special Credit Opportunities Fund II A at 0.35% and Neo Credit Opportunities Fund I at 0.13%. The company is seeking in-principle approval for the preferential issue of 27,20,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- each and 90,90,000 fully convertible warrants.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited received permission from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization, Directorate General of Health Services, Government of India, on May 20, 2026. This permission allows the company to import for sale and distribution of Acalabrutinib maleate tablets 100 mg (Brand name: Calquence®) for an additional indication. Specifically, Acalabrutinib in combination with Bendamustine and Rituximab (BR) is now indicated for the treatment of adult patients with previously untreated mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) who are not eligible for autologous stem cell transplant (ASCT). This approval paves the way for marketing Calquence® in India for this specified additional indication, subject to any further statutory approvals.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: NIBE Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 21, 2026, titled "Successful completion of technical trial against RFP of Indian Army 100 Km Range at Pokhran & Joshimath (Malari) Uttarakhand.".
announcements.ai_summary: NIBE Limited issued a press release on May 21, 2026, announcing the successful completion of technical trials for its "Vayu Astra-1 Loitering Munition" against an Indian Army RFP. During an Anti-Personal strike trial at Pokhran Range, Rajasthan, the munition, equipped with a 10 kg warhead, struck a target 100 km away with a CEP under 1 meter, demonstrating abort, attack, and re-attack capabilities. An Anti-Armor night strike successfully hit a target within a 2-meter CEP using an IR camera, also demonstrating control handover from GCS to a Forward Control Station 70 km away. announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sakar Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange about Sakar enters it s 40th agreement signed with Zydus Lifesciences to cater oncology products to GCC and other emerging markets, in parallel to building momentum on strong execution and expanding Business Opportunities
announcements.ai_summary: Sakar Healthcare Limited has announced a significant business development with the signing of its 40th agreement with Zydus Lifesciences. This new agreement will focus on supplying oncology products to the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council) and other emerging markets. This strategic move aligns with the company's ongoing efforts to strengthen its execution capabilities and expand its business opportunities. In parallel, Sakar Healthcare has made substantial progress in its regulatory filings, with 23 Marketing Authorization (MA) filings in the European Union (EU), securing 5 MAs and applying for 13 own MAs. The company has also progressed in regulatory filings with 33 site variations submitted across the EU, with 5 site variation approvals already obtained. On the API front, Sakar has developed 21 APIs in-house, with 16 having Written Confirmation and 2 CEP approvals secured, indicating a growing integration strategy. These developments signal a transition towards a more integrated, regulatory-led business model, enhancing supply chain control and margin visibility.

announcements.subject: Amalgamation/Merger

announcements.subject: Press Release

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Shyam Metalics And Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 21, 2026, titled "Shyam Metalics Expands Pakuria Operations with Addition of Two Annealing Furnaces (25 MT & 30 MT) and Commissioning of 2300 mm Vertical Foil Separator (LGSS)".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited has expanded its Pakuria operations by commissioning two new Annealing Furnaces with capacities of 25 MT per annum and 30 MT per annum, respectively. These furnaces are expected to streamline the annealing process, improve production efficiency, and enhance overall product quality. Additionally, the company has commissioned a 2300 mm Vertical Foil Separator (LGSS), which enables accurate separation of Ultra-Light Gauge (ULG) and Light Gauge (LG) foil, catering to specialized customer requirements with thicknesses ranging from 6 to 15 microns. These upgrades, announced on April 21, 2026, aim to strengthen manufacturing capabilities and expand the company's value-added product offerings.

announcements.subject: Product launch
announcements.detail: Shadowfax Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Launch of Shadowfax 360
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Shadowfax Technologies Limited is launching "Shadowfax 360," a proprietary unified digital shipping portal aimed at Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) and Direct to Consumer (D2C) brands. This platform will allow businesses to register and commence shipping within minutes, providing access to a network covering over 15,000 pincodes across 2,500 cities. Key features include a transparent flat-rate billing model, one-click integrations with platforms like Shopify and WooCommerce, and an AI-driven RTO Predictor. The platform also offers fast Cash on Delivery (COD) remittance cycles to support SME liquidity. Shadowfax 360 imposes no minimum order requirements, making enterprise-grade logistics accessible to smaller businesses. The launch was announced on April 21, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates

announcements.ai_summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has announced a significant operational milestone, becoming India's first listed flex space provider to cross a 10 million sq. ft. operational portfolio. This achievement was marked by the operationalisation of the Tata Intellion Park centre in Mumbai. The company highlights this milestone as a reflection of the structural shift in India's office market towards managed, campus-led solutions for enterprises. Smartworks positions itself as a national-scale enterprise workspace infrastructure platform, enabling multi-city expansion with standardized delivery and consistent experience. This expansion supports the growing steel demand in India and strengthens long-term linkages within the steel value chain.

announcements.subject: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd - 524715 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd has announced that it will present pivotal long-term follow-up data on UNLOXCYT™ (cosibelimab-ipdl) at the ASCO® 2026 Annual Meeting on May 31, 2026. The press release details that in the investigator-reviewed data from the locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (laCSCC) expansion cohort of the pivotal CK-301-101 trial, 64 patients received UNLOXCYT. The median age of these patients was 77 years, with 66% being male. Patients received a median of 29 doses over a median treatment duration of 60 weeks. The objective response rate was 50%, comprising 17 (27%) complete responses and 15 (23%) partial responses. With a median follow-up of 31 months, responses were durable, and the median duration of response had not yet been reached. Importantly, only one patient experienced a Grade >3 immune-related adverse event.

announcements.subject: Astal Laboratories Ltd - 512600 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR)- Lapse Of Convertible Warrants.
announcements.detail: Intimation of Lapse and forfeiture of Convertible Warrants allotted on 27th November, 2024.
announcements.ai_summary: Astal Laboratories Ltd announced on May 26, 2026, the lapse and forfeiture of 1,86,700 Convertible Warrants that were allotted to non-promoters on November 27, 2024, on a preferential basis. These warrants had a face value of Rs. 10/- each and were issued at a premium of Rs. 30/- each. As per Regulation 162 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations, 25% of the issue price was received upfront at the time of allotment, with the balance 75% due within 18 months from the allotment date, which was on or before May 26, 2026. Since the company did not receive the balance 75% consideration for these 1,86,700 warrants by the stipulated deadline, they lapsed upon expiry of the exercise period on May 26, 2026. Consequently, the upfront subscription amount of Rs. 18,67,000/- (18.67 Lakhs) stands forfeited, effective May 27, 2026, in line with Regulation 169(3) of the SEBI ICDR Regulations. This lapse will not result in any change to the company's paid-up share capital, and the forfeited amount will be retained by the company and accounted for as per applicable accounting standards; this matter will be taken up at a forthcoming Board Meeting.

announcements.subject:
La Tim Metal & Industries Ltd - 505693 - Under Regulation 30 Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, As Amended Read With Applicable
Circulars Issued Thereto, ("SEBI LODR Regulations") - Withdrawal Of In-Principle Application Filed For Proposed Preferential Issue
announcements.detail: Under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing obligation and disclosure requirements) regulation 2015, as amended read with applicable circular issued thereto,("SEBI LODR Regulations")- withdrawal of in-Principal application filed for proposed preferential issue
announcements.ai_summary: La Tim Metal & Industries Ltd announced on May 26, 2026, the withdrawal of its In-Principle Application for a proposed Preferential Issue, which was originally filed with the Exchange on October 24, 2025. The proposed issue included 3,50,00,000 Convertible Warrants of Rs. 10/- each and 1,58,60,000 equity shares of face value Re. 1/- each, to be issued for cash consideration at a price of Rs. 10/- per share. The withdrawal occurred because many proposed investors expressed unwillingness to participate, primarily due to the substantial time taken to obtain In-Principle approval. Consequently, the company will not proceed with the issue and allotment of these equity shares and convertible warrants as initially planned. announcements.subject: Tata Chemicals Ltd - 500770 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Chemicals Ltd. has received an order from the Hon’ble High Court of Gujarat concerning a writ petition challenging a Collector’s Order dated April 10, 2006. The petition related to the company's pre-existing rights over land used for legacy open wastewater channels at Mithapur, Gujarat. The High Court, in its order dated May 25, 2026, rejected the company's claim of pre-existing rights over these channels, which were established before 1987. The Court has directed the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) to engage experts to assess the environmental impact and determine appropriate remediation and compensation within three months. Tata Chemicals is currently examining the order and evaluating its next steps, while reaffirming its commitment to environmental standards.

announcements.subject: JSW Steel Ltd - 500228 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: JSW Steel, Bhartaia and Carbon Iceland International sign strategic MOU.
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Steel Limited, Bharatia, and Carbon Iceland International have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to explore the development of a large-scale green methanol (eMethanol) project in India. This agreement was finalized during the 3rd India–Nordic Summit in Oslo, Norway, and was witnessed by the Prime Minister of Iceland and the Icelandic Ambassador to India. The proposed project aims to produce 300 KTPA of eMethanol by utilizing carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions from JSW Steel's operations in Raigad, Maharashtra, and converting them into eMethanol using green hydrogen derived from renewable energy sources. This collaboration seeks to establish a scalable carbon capture and utilization (CCU) pathway for the steel sector and support India's energy transition and industrial decarbonisation goals. The initiative will initially assess the use of an existing high-purity CO₂ stream from JSW Steel's facility and explore further capture opportunities.

The company, a significant player in India's cable and wire industry, reported that its FY26 metal throughput was 29,664 MTPA, a 12% year-on-year increase. Paramount Communications is noted as the largest LV cable exporter from India to the US in CY2025 and serves critical sectors including Power, Telecom, Railways, and Renewables. The company has a strong pan-India presence with expanding exports and operates two state-of-the-art plants. The Indian wires and cables market is estimated at approximately USD 20 billion (Rs 1.7 lakh Cr) with a forecast CAGR of 12-14% from FY25-FY30.

we submit herewith details of order passed by the Principal Commissioner of Customs ( Import), Air Cargo Complex, Andheri ( East ), Mumbai on 22nd May, 2026 in favour of the Company.   

A demand of customs duty of Rs. 3.53 Cr. ( approx.) against the Company, has been entirely dropped vide aforesaid order.
announcements.ai_summary: Rashi Peripherals Limited announced on May 23, 2026, the receipt of an order dated May 22, 2026, from the Principal Commissioner of Customs (Import), Air Cargo Complex, Andheri (East), Mumbai. announcements.subject: City Union Bank Ltd - 532210 - Intimation U/R 30 Of SEBI Listing Regulations , 2015 As Amended
announcements.detail: Imposition of Monetary Penalty by Reserve Bank of India
announcements.ai_summary: City Union Bank Limited has received a monetary penalty totaling ₹10.10 lakhs (Rupees Ten Lakhs and Ten Thousand only) from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). The penalty was imposed via a speaking order dated May 20, 2026, and received by the bank on May 22, 2026. The violations were identified during the Statutory Inspection for Supervisory Evaluation of the bank as of March 31, 2025. Specifically, the bank levied loan-related charges on certain agriculture priority sector loans up to ₹25,000/- and failed to report Self Help Group member level data to Credit Information Companies. The RBI imposed a penalty of ₹10 lacs for the first violation and ₹0.10 lakh for the second, resulting in a quantifiable financial impact of ₹10,10,000/- on the bank.

The company maintained its revenue at Rs. 807.88 crores, a slight decrease from Rs. 809.08 crores in the previous year, by increasing paper tonnage by 1675 MT and reducing the average net sales realization per MT to pass on cost benefits to customers. The EBITDA margin remained steady at 18% for both periods. Pudumjee Paper Products Ltd has successfully completed a capex program exceeding Rs. 110 crores, which includes the operationalization of a 15.4 MW Solar Power Plant in December 2025 at Bhalwani, near Solapur. This solar plant is expected to meet approximately 35% of the company's annual power requirements, reducing costs and carbon footprint by about 27,000 MT. The company is also pursuing environmental clearance for a project in Mahad due to regulatory changes and continues to focus on biodegradable and compostable specialty papers for sustainable packaging solutions.

The proposed capacity addition includes Phase-1 of 60,000 CBM per year for Plywood and 240,000 CBM per year for Particle Board, with Phase-2 adding another 60,000 CBM per year for Plywood. The investment for Phase-1 is approximately Rs. 230 Crores, Phase-2 is approximately Rs. 140 Crores, and the Particle Board unit requires approximately Rs. 500 Crores. The financing for the project will be through a mix of debt and equity. The rationale behind this expansion includes increasing demand, proximity to raw material sources, availability of manpower, and closeness to a large customer base.

announcements.subject: Lupin Ltd - 500257 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Lupin Receives China Approval for Oseltamivir Phosphate Oral Suspension.
announcements.ai_summary: Lupin Limited has received approval from China's National Medical Products Administration for its Oseltamivir Phosphate Oral Suspension. This marks Lupin's first product entry into the Chinese market, achieved in partnership with Yabao Pharmaceuticals. The Oseltamivir Phosphate for oral suspension, at a strength of 6 mg/mL, is indicated for the treatment and prevention of influenza in patients aged 2 weeks and older. This approval is a strategic step for Lupin to expand its global footprint and commitment to providing affordable medicines, particularly for paediatric use. The company aims to build a stronger presence in China through this partnership.

announcements.detail: LETTER ATTACHED
announcements.ai_summary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL) has informed the stock exchanges regarding its non-funding of the 7th semi-annual interest payment for its 7.87% MTNL Bond Series VII-B (ISIN: INE153A08113), which is due on June 1, 2026. Despite the bonds being Sovereign Guaranteed by the Government of India, MTNL could not fund the required amount into the escrow account maintained with Bank of India due to insufficient funds. announcements.subject: Venus Remedies Ltd - 526953 - Venus Remedies Receives Saudi FDA Approval For Plerixafor - Its First Maketing Authorization For The Specialty Oncology Therapy Globally
announcements.detail: As per the pdf enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Venus Remedies Limited has received Marketing Authorization from the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) for its specialty oncology therapy, Plerixafor. This marks the first global marketing authorization for Plerixafor for Venus Remedies and signifies a strategic shift towards higher-value specialty injectables in regulated markets. Plerixafor is a stem cell mobilization therapy used in autologous transplantation for patients with multiple myeloma and non-Hodgkin lymphoma. The company aims to replace reliance on commodity injectables with differentiated therapies.

announcements.subject: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 533573 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited receives USFDA Final Approval for Levothyroxine Sodium Tablets USP.
announcements.ai_summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has received final approval from the US Food & Drug Administration (USFDA) for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) for Levothyroxine Sodium Tablets USP. The approved strengths include 25 mcg, 50 mcg, 75 mcg, 88 mcg, 100 mcg, 112 mcg, 125 mcg, 137 mcg, 150 mcg, 175 mcg, 200 mcg, and 300 mcg. These tablets are therapeutically equivalent to Synthroid Tablets, the reference listed drug product from AbbVie, Inc. Levothyroxine sodium tablets are indicated for hypothyroidism and as an adjunct in managing certain thyroid cancers. The estimated market size for these tablets was US$ 1,869 million for the twelve months ending March 2026. This approval adds to Alembic's portfolio of 239 ANDA approvals from the USFDA.

This order contributes to Suzlon's orderbook in Karnataka, which now exceeds 2 GW, making it a key market for the company. The announcement was made on May 22, 2026.

announcements.subject: Mphasis Ltd - 526299 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Mphasis Limited has announced a partnership with the Indian School of Business (ISB) to establish an 'AI Hub'. The Mphasis F1 Foundation will invest approximately INR 20 crore over the next four years to support this initiative. The AI Hub will focus on accelerating AI-led research, innovation, and capacity building, initially targeting the healthcare and finance sectors with plans for future expansion. The hub, located at ISB, will serve as a platform for interdisciplinary research and collaboration, aiming to advance responsible AI innovation, enable the adoption and evaluation of AI solutions, strengthen digital literacy, and foster knowledge sharing. The initiative will also focus on building frameworks to assess the business value and sustainability of AI deployments, generate policy insights, and create AI learning resources.

announcements.detail: We hereby submit the declaration w.r.t. non applicability of regulation 23(9) of SEBI LODR
announcements.ai_summary: iSERA Lifesciences Limited (formerly Covidh Technologies Limited) has submitted a declaration regarding the non-applicability of Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This exemption is due to the company's Paid-up Equity Share Capital and Net Worth as of March 31, 2026, being less than ₹10 Crore and ₹25 Crore, respectively. Consequently, the company falls under the exemption criteria provided in Regulation 15(2) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, and is therefore not required to comply with Regulation 23(9).

announcements.subject: Welspun Corp Ltd - 532144 - Update On Intra-Group Transaction: Transfer Of 100% Equity Stake Of Welspun Pipes Company, KSA From Welspun Mauritius Holdings Limited To Welspun Global Holdings Limited Both Wholly-Owned Subsidiaries Of The Company.
announcements.detail: Update on intra group transaction- Transfer of 100% equity stake of Welspun Pipes Company, KSA from Welspun Mauritius Holdings Limited to Welspun Global Holdings Limited both wholly owned subsidiaries of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Welspun Corp Limited has announced the successful completion of an intra-group transaction involving the transfer of 100% equity stake of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Welspun Pipes Company, KSA. This stake has been transferred from another wholly-owned subsidiary, Welspun Mauritius Holdings Limited, to Welspun Global Holdings Limited. This internal restructuring, completed on May 21, 2026, means Welspun Pipes Company is now a direct wholly-owned subsidiary of Welspun Global Holdings Limited, rather than Welspun Mauritius Holdings Limited. The company stated that this transaction is not expected to materially impact its operations, financial position, or profitability as it does not alter the ultimate ownership structure.

announcements.subject: Varun Beverages Ltd - 540180 - Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Update
announcements.detail: Revision of Exclusive Bottling Appointment and Trademark License Agreement with Pepsico Inc. as per details enclosed.
announcements.ai_summary: Varun Beverages Limited (VBL) has revised its Exclusive Bottling Appointment and Trademark License Agreement with PepsiCo Inc. The agreement, originally set to expire on April 30, 2039, has been extended to April 30, 2049. A significant change in the revised agreement is the deletion of a clause that previously restricted VBL to only acting as a Special Purpose Vehicle for PepsiCo's business. This revision was made on May 21, 2026. The company has also updated its website with this information.

announcements.subject: Jigar Cables Ltd - 540651 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 - Expansion/Diversification Of Business Activities By Wholly Owned Subsidiary
announcements.detail: Enclosed herewith the intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR, pursuant to Expansion of business activity by the Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Jigar Cables Limited has announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Jigar Polymers Limited, has received Board approval to expand and diversify its business activities. The subsidiary will now enter the business of manufacturing and dealing in wooden and plywood cable drums used in the electric wires and cable industry. This expansion also requires an alteration to the Object Clause of the Memorandum of Association of Jigar Polymers Limited, subject to shareholder and other necessary approvals. This strategic move aligns with the group's growth plans and forward integration in the cable and allied industry segment.

announcements.subject: Samhi Hotels Ltd - 543984 - Execution Of Deed Of Guarantee(S) And Undertaking By The Company In Favour Of Lenders For The Loan Facility Availed/ To Be Availed By SAMHI Hotels (Ahmedabad) Private Limited, Company'S 100% Subsidiary
announcements.detail: The Company will be executing a Deed of Guarantee(s) & Undertaking in favour of Citibank N.A. India ("Lender") (or the Security Trustee acting on behalf of Lenders) in relation to the loan facility availed/ to be availed by SAMHI Hotels (Ahmedabad) Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company ("Borrower"). The relevant details as required under regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations are enclosed as an Annexure.
announcements.ai_summary: Samhi Hotels Limited (SHL) will be executing a Deed of Guarantee(s) and Undertaking in favor of Citibank N.A., India, or the Security Trustee, for a loan facility of up to INR 4,53,10,00,000/-. This facility is being availed by SAMHI Hotels (Ahmedabad) Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of SHL. The guarantee and undertaking will cover Borrower's obligations and guarantee the repayment of amounts due under the Facilities. The transaction is on an arm's length basis and complies with relevant regulations. The company holds 100% of the paid-up share capital of the subsidiary, and the promoters/promoter group have no interest in this transaction.

announcements.subject: Cineline India Ltd - 532807 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation Under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Cineline India Limited has reported a fire incident at Pacific Mall, Kaushambi, Ghaziabad, on May 21, 2026, which impacted the company's cinema premises located within the mall. The fire-fighting system brought the fire under control, preventing further spread. The company has adequate insurance coverage for its assets, including a loss of profit policy. There were no human casualties in the incident. The assessment of the expected quantum of loss or damage is currently in process. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: RPSG Ventures Ltd - 542333 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Attached is the announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: RPSG Ventures Limited has announced the sale of its entire investment in M/s. Incnut Digital Private Limited. This transaction is in accordance with a Share Purchase Agreement dated May 7, 2026, entered into with M/s. Veerendra Shivhare, M/s. Sangram Simha Datla, and M/s. Chaitanya Chakravartin Nallan. The company sold its Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) in Incnut Digital Private Limited, which were converted into Equity Shares in a 1:1 ratio before the sale. The total consideration for the sale of 5810 CCPS in Incnut Digital Private Limited was Rs11.76 Crores, with Rs3.92 Crores from each of the three buyers. This announcement is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd - 543965 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited has been allotted equity shares by the Board of FIT 3PL Warehousing Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited (TVS SCS) has announced an update on its acquisition activities. The Board of FIT 3PL Warehousing Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of TVS SCS, has allotted equity shares to TVS SCS. This follows the Board's approval on December 09, 2025, for additional funding in its wholly owned subsidiaries for business expansion. FIT 3PL Warehousing Private Limited is engaged in the logistics industry, and its turnover as of March 31, 2025, was Rs133.18 Crores. TVS SCS acquired 2,20,609 equity shares at a price of Rs2700 each, representing 100% of the shareholding, for a cash consideration of Rs59.56 Crores. The acquisition is intended to facilitate business growth and is expected to lead to revenue and profit growth. FIT 3PL will continue to be a wholly owned subsidiary of TVS SCS. The completion of this acquisition is anticipated by September 2027.

announcements.subject: Jio Financial Services Ltd - 543940 - Update On Institutional Investors'' Meeting
announcements.detail: This is further to the disclosure dated May 13, 2026 made by the Company. We wish to inform you that the Company executives participated in the Institutional Investors Meeting
announcements.ai_summary: Jio Financial Services Limited executives participated in an Institutional Investors' Meeting, specifically a Non-Deal Roadshow, held in-person in Hong Kong on May 20-21, 2026. This meeting, organized by a third party, involved One-on-One and Group sessions with institutional investors. The company explicitly stated that no unpublished price sensitive information was shared or discussed during these interactions. Only information already available in the public domain was presented and reviewed. This update is a follow-up to the company's previous disclosure regarding investor meetings dated May 13, 2026.

announcements.subject: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd - 532500 - Advance Intimation Regarding Price Increase
announcements.detail: Advance intimation regarding price increase
announcements.ai_summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited announced an advance intimation regarding a price increase across its model portfolio, effective from June 2026. The company stated that this decision is a direct result of sustained increases in input costs and elevated inflationary pressures. Prices will be increased by up to Rs. 30,000/- per model. Maruti Suzuki has been implementing cost reduction measures to mitigate the impact, but the adverse cost environment necessitates passing on a portion of these increased costs to the market. The exact quantum of the price change will vary for each specific model.

announcements.subject: Ganesha Ecosphere Ltd - 514167 - Capacity Addition In Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of The Company
announcements.detail: Capacity addition in wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Ganesha Ecosphere Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Ganesha Eco Pet Private Limited (Ganesha Ecopet), has decided to drop its previously announced greenfield project in Odisha, which aimed for a 67,500 TPA capacity for rPET Chips/Granules, as intimated on February 3, 2025. Instead, the Board of Directors of Ganesha Ecopet, at its meeting held on May 20, 2026, approved an expansion of its existing rPET granules capacity at the Warangal unit by an additional 22,500 TPA. This expansion will increase the total installed capacity at the Warangal unit to 87,000 TPA, up from the current 64,500 TPA (which includes 22,500 TPA already commissioned but not yet in commercial production). The proposed capacity addition is estimated to require an investment of Rs. 125 Crore and is expected to be completed by March 2027, financed through a mix of debt, equity, and internal accruals.

announcements.subject: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd - 500655 - Incorporation Of Wholly Owned Subsidiary
announcements.detail: Incorporation of Wholly Owned Subsidiary
announcements.ai_summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited announced the incorporation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, "Garware Hi Tech Global Trading FZCO" (GHGT), in the Dubai Airport Free Zone Authority, Dubai, UAE. The company received the Certificate of Formation/Incorporation and Trading license via email on May 21, 2026, with both documents dated April 27, 2026. GHGT is a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited and operates in the Films, Ceramic Coatings, and PPF industry. This incorporation follows a previous intimation made by the company on January 22, 2026.

announcements.subject: RailTel Corporation of India Ltd - 543265 - Cancellation Of Work Order
announcements.detail: Cancellation of Work Order
announcements.ai_summary: RailTel Corporation of India Ltd has informed about the cancellation of a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) awarded by South East Central Railway for the supply, transportation, and laying of OFC, among other related works. The estimated order value was ₹26,72,60,140/-. The cancellation is due to the prevailing war situation, which has led to a steep increase in the prices of OFC, HDPE pipes, and other materials, making the project unviable. Consequently, RailTel has decided not to execute the work, and the customer has terminated the contract awarded to RailTel. This cancellation follows RailTel's earlier intimation on March 7, 2026, regarding securing this major order.

announcements.subject: IVP Ltd - 507580 - Update W.R.T. Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015 -  Fraud By Employee Of The Company
announcements.detail: Please find update as per the attached disclosure
announcements.ai_summary: IVP Limited provided an update on May 21, 2026, regarding a fraud by an employee, following initial intimations on January 13, 2026, January 22, 2026, and January 29, 2026. A detailed investigation has determined the total amount involved in the matter to be Rs. 613 lakhs, which is also the actual financial impact on the company. An FIR has been filed before the Byculla Police Station (Mumbai 400027, Maharashtra) against Mr. Ravi Ranjan Jha, the employee involved in the fraud. As a corrective measure, the company has made its customer onboarding process more robust. IVP Limited will timely intimate the Exchange of any further material developments in this matter.

announcements.subject: Goodricke Group Ltd - 500166 - Execution Of Agreement For Sale
announcements.detail: Execution of Agreement for Sale
announcements.ai_summary: Goodricke Group Ltd has executed an Agreement for Sale with M/s Chalouni Plantation Pvt. Ltd. on May 21, 2026, for the transfer of Estates, Bearer Plants, and Specified Assets comprising in Chalouni Tea Estate. This follows a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding intimated on April 6, 2026, and a completed due diligence process by the buyer. Upon execution of this agreement, possession of the aforesaid assets has been duly transferred to M/s Chalouni Plantation Pvt. Ltd., which is represented by Mr. Ashok Kumar Goyal, Director. The buyer's registered office is at H/19/1 SEVOKE ROAD, ANAND VIHAR COMPLEX, Sevoke Road, Darjiling, Siliguri, West Bengal, India, 734001. The transfer of leasehold rights over the land remains subject to the approval of the Competent Authority of the Government of West Bengal. Detailed information regarding the transaction was previously intimated to the Exchange on April 6, 2026.

announcements.subject: Kirloskar Electric Company Ltd - 533193 - Certified True Copy Of The Merger Order Passed.
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed certified true copy of the merger order passed by Hon''ble National Company Law Tribunal, Bengaluru Bench.
announcements.ai_summary: Kirloskar Electric Company Ltd has received the Certified True Copy of the merger order from the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Bengaluru Bench, on May 21, 2026. The NCLT order, dated April 30, 2026, approves the merger by absorption of four wholly owned subsidiary companies – KELBUZZ Trading Private Limited, Luxquisite Parkland Private Limited, SLPKG Estate Holdings Private Limited, and SKG Terra Promenade Private Limited – with the holding company, Kirloskar Electric Company Limited. This follows the company's earlier intimation on May 15, 2026, regarding the proposed merger.

announcements.subject: Laurus Labs Ltd - 540222 - Inclusion Of Laurus Labs In Dow Jones Best-In-Class (DJ BIC) Indices
announcements.detail: Please see annexed enclosure.
announcements.ai_summary: Laurus Labs Ltd has been featured for the first time in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class (DJ BIC) Indices, specifically included in the DJBIC World Index. This inclusion recognizes the company's strong commitment to sustainable and ethical corporate governance practices and its high ESG performance. Previously, Laurus Labs was recognized in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook 2026, achieving an S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA) score of 81 out of 100 in the pharmaceutical category. The DJ BIC Indices identify companies with exceptional ESG performance based on leading S&P Global CSA scores, reinforcing Laurus Labs' credibility with global investors.

announcements.subject: Suraj Industries Ltd - 526211 - Intimation Pursuant To Regulation 30 Read With Regulation 31A Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Receipt Of Request For Reclassification From 'Promoter Group' Category To 'Public' Category.
announcements.detail: Receipt of request for reclassification from "Promoter Group " Category to "Public Category".
announcements.ai_summary: Suraj Industries Ltd received a request letter dated May 21, 2026, from Mr. Rajesh Gupta, seeking reclassification from the 'Promoter Group' category to the 'Public' category. Mr. Gupta currently holds 10 Equity shares of Rs. 10/- each in Suraj Industries Ltd. In his request, Mr. Gupta stated that he is no longer connected to the company's business, does not participate in day-to-day activities, and lacks the ability to appoint directors or control management/policy decisions. The company will present this reclassification request to its Board of Directors in the upcoming Board Meeting for consideration and approval. The reclassification is subject to compliance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and obtaining requisite approvals.

announcements.subject: Cranex Ltd - 522001 - Intimation Of Loan Agreement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Please find the attached Intimation of the Loan Agreement entered with M/s. Kalyan Capitals Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Cranex Limited has entered into a Loan Agreement with M/s. Kalyan Capitals Limited, acting as the borrower, as intimated on May 21, 2026. Under this agreement, Cranex Limited, as the lender, is granting an inter-corporate loan up to a maximum amount of Rs. 3,00,00,000 (Rupees Three Crore Only). The loan is structured as a demand loan and carries an interest rate of 9% per annum. While the loan amount is repayable on demand, Kalyan Capitals Limited retains the discretion to repay the loan in full or in parts at intervals of its choosing. This transaction was disclosed under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd - 544044 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 - Updates
announcements.detail: Receipt of NOC for promoter and promoter group re-classification from Stock exchanges
announcements.ai_summary: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd has received approval from both NSE and BSE for the reclassification of certain members from the 'Promoter & Promoter Group' to the 'Public' category, as per Regulation 31A of the Listing Regulations. This approval follows the company's application submitted on February 10, 2026. The reclassified entities include Mr. Anil Mehta, who held 1.44% shareholding as of March 31, 2026, and several other promoter group members and entities, whose post-reclassification category is now 'Public' with NIL shareholding. The stock exchanges communicated their approval via letters dated May 21, 2026.

announcements.subject: NIIT Ltd - 500304 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed Press Release on "NIIT launches six GenAI Programs to build AI -first skills"
announcements.ai_summary: NIIT Limited announced the launch of six new programs under its GenAI & Artificial Intelligence (AI) portfolio on May 21, 2026. This initiative is in response to the increasing demand for AI-led skills, with enrolments in NIIT’s Agentic AI program growing by 88% over the past four months and overall AI program enrolments increasing by 40% year-on-year. The new programs cater to diverse learner segments, including students, educators, and professionals. The offerings include the GenAI Spark Program for Students, GenAI Spark Program for Educators, GenAI Spark Essentials, GenAI Spark Program on Marketing, GenAI Applied Program for No-Code Apps, and the advanced GenAI Applied Program for Practitioners. These programs emphasize structured, hands-on learning and real-world application to equip learners with practical AI skills.

announcements.subject: Unifinz Capital India Ltd - 541358 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Meeting Updates
announcements.detail: Outcome of the meeting held on 21st May,2026.
announcements.ai_summary: The Finance Committee of Unifinz Capital India Limited, in a meeting held on May 21, 2026, approved the issuance of up to 20,000 listed, rated, senior, secured, taxable, transferable, redeemable, non-convertible debentures (NCDs) on a private placement basis. These NCDs will have a face value of INR 10,000 each, aggregating to a nominal value of INR 20,00,00,000. The issuance includes a green shoe option of up to 10,000 NCDs, with an aggregate nominal value of INR 10,00,00,000. The issue price per Debenture is fixed at INR 10,032.06, which includes accrued interest of INR 32.06 per Debenture. This issuance will utilize the existing International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) INE926R07035.

announcements.subject: Le Travenues Technology Ltd - 544192 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Grant Of Options Under Employees Stock Option Schemes Of The Company
announcements.detail: Outcome of Nomination and Remuneration Committee meeting held on May 21, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Le Travenues Technology Ltd announced that its Nomination and Remuneration Committee, in a meeting held on May 21, 2026, approved the grant of 32,708 stock options under its Employees Stock Option Schemes 2016 and 2021. These options are exercisable at ₹93 per option. The granted options will vest over four years in equal annual installments of 25% each. The exercise period for these options is five years from the respective vesting date, after which they would lapse. The company has provided these disclosures in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Juniper Hotels Ltd - 544129 - Board Comments On Fine Levied By The Exchange
announcements.detail: Please find attached letter
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Juniper Hotels Ltd has commented on a fine of ₹4,60,200 (including GST) levied by both NSE and BSE for non-compliance with Regulation 17 of SEBI Listing Regulations concerning the Board's composition between October 01, 2025, and December 17, 2025. The Board noted the delay in compliance but highlighted that their composition includes a balanced mix of experienced Executive and Non-Executive Directors, with a higher representation of Non-Executive Directors, benefiting from diverse guidance. Mr. Mayur Chokshi was appointed as an Independent Director effective December 18, 2025, bringing the company into compliance. Juniper Hotels Ltd has paid the levied fines within the prescribed timeline and emphasized the importance of adhering to regulatory timelines to prevent future non-compliance.

announcements.subject: GEE Ltd - 504028 - Clarification / Continuation To Our Outcome Of Board Meeting Letter Dated 15Th May, 2026 - Inadvertent Omission Of Certificate From Statutory Auditor
announcements.detail: Certificate from Statutory Auditors - End use of proceeds raised through issue of preferential  warrants
announcements.ai_summary: GEE Ltd has submitted a clarification regarding its Board Meeting outcome letter dated May 15, 2026. Due to an inadvertent oversight, the Certificate from the Statutory Auditor regarding the end-use of proceeds raised through the issue of preferential warrants was not attached to the previous submission. The company has now enclosed this certificate to rectify the omission and has assured that utmost caution will be exercised in future filings.

announcements.subject: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd - 544149 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd has dispatched letters to shareholders whose email addresses are not registered, providing a web-link to the company's website where the Postal Ballot Notice can be accessed. This action is in compliance with Regulation 36(1)(b) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The Postal Ballot Notice, which seeks shareholder approval for special businesses through e-voting, is also available on the company's website. The remote e-voting period is scheduled to commence on Saturday, May 23, 2026, at 09:00 a.m.

announcements.subject: Onward Technologies Ltd - 517536 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Onward Technologies Ltd has received an Order-in-Original from the Office of the Joint Development Commissioner, SEEPZ-SEZ, Mumbai, imposing a monetary penalty of ₹10,00,000 on the company. This penalty is in connection with procedural delays in filing 270 SOFTEX Forms related to export transactions. The authority has condoned the delay and closed the issue, confirming that export proceeds have been duly realized and there are no allegations of fund diversion or loss of foreign exchange. The order was received by the company on May 20, 2026.

announcements.subject: Ultramarine & Pigments Ltd-$ - 506685 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR)- Project
announcements.detail: The Board of Directors at its meeting held on 20th May, 2026 has approved the greenfield project for manufacture of inorganic pigments at SIPCOT industrial park, Manapparai, TN.
announcements.ai_summary: Ultramarine & Pigments Ltd's Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 20, 2026, approved a greenfield project for manufacturing inorganic pigments. The new facility will be located at SIPCOT Industrial Park, Manapparai, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, and is designed to add a proposed capacity of 2500 MT. The total investment required for this expansion is ₹250 Crores, which will be financed through a combination of internal accruals and a term loan. The company plans to add this capacity in a phased manner over the course of FY 202

announcements.subject: Adani Power Ltd - 533096 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Updated Disclosure For Acquisition Of Certain Power Assets And Investments Of Jaiprakash Associates Limited
announcements.detail: Adani Power Limited has informed the Exchange about updated disclosure for acquisition of certain power assets and investments of Jaiprakash Associates Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Power Limited has provided an updated disclosure regarding its acquisition of certain power assets and investments from Jaiprakash Associates Limited (JAL). Following their earlier intimation of in-principle interest, Adani Power has entered into definitive agreements with JAL. These agreements include a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 24% of Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited's shares held by JAL, and a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire JAL's 180 MW thermal power plant in Churk and related assets, including 11.49% of Prayagraj Power Generation Company Limited. These acquisitions are part of the NCLT-approved resolution plan for JAL and are expected to be consummated on the 'Effective Date' of the plan.

announcements.subject: Tata Capital Ltd - 544574 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment
announcements.detail: Tata Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of Non - Convertible Debentures
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Capital Limited has successfully allotted Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) on a private placement basis on May 21, 2026. A total of 2,95,000 NCDs were issued with an issue size of Rs. 2,950 crore. The NCDs carry a floating coupon rate, which is benchmarked against the 3-month Treasury Bill Rate plus a fixed spread of 210 bps per annum. The initial coupon rate was set at 7.42% p.a. (5.32% + 210 bps). The coupon rate will be reset quarterly, with the spread remaining fixed at 210 bps throughout the tenor of the instrument.

announcements.subject: Carysil Ltd - 524091 - General Update
announcements.detail: Update
announcements.ai_summary: Carysil Ltd has announced that its subsidiary, Carysilnox Limited (formerly Carysil Steel Limited), has commenced commercial production of an additional 70,000 stainless steel kitchen sinks per annum, effective May 21, 2026. This expansion increases the total annual manufacturing capacity for stainless steel kitchen sinks from 1,80,000 units to 2,50,000 units. The investment for this expansion is Rs. 6.7 crores, funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt. The rationale behind this capacity addition is to meet growing domestic and export demand, strengthen in-house manufacturing, and enhance supply chain efficiency.

announcements.subject: Platinum Industries Ltd - 544134 - Announcement Under Reg 30 Of SEBI (LODR) For The Commencement Of Commercial Production
announcements.detail: Announcement under Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR) for the Commencement of Commercial Production for the manufacturing facility located at Palghar.
announcements.ai_summary: Platinum Industries Ltd has announced the commencement of commercial production for the remaining manufacturing facility located at Palghar, Maharashtra, effective May 21, 2026. This facility is a key objective of the company's Initial Public Offer. Partial commercial production at this site had already begun on August 8, 2025. With the full operationalization of these remaining facilities, the manufacturing unit is now fully functional. This development is a significant step in the company's expansion strategy, and they anticipate continued growth from this new capacity. The company will make this information available on their website.

announcements.subject: Regency Fincorp Ltd - 540175 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Submission of outcome of Board Meeting

announcements.subject: HCL Technologies Ltd - 532281 - Release - 'Hcltech Named Citrix GSI Of The Year'
announcements.detail: Enclosed please find a release on the captioned subject being issued by the Company today.
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies Ltd announced on May 21, 2026, that it has been named Citrix GSI (Global System Integrator) of the Year. This award recognizes HCLTech's close collaboration with Citrix in supporting enterprise digital workplace transformation and cloud adoption utilizing Citrix technologies. The partnership spans early-stage product co-development, solution validation, and enterprise-wide transformation programs. HCLTech's unified virtual workspace solution, combined with Citrix virtualization technologies, enables enterprises to modernize end-user environments, enhance employee experience, and support hybrid and cloud-first operating models. Ravi Yeddanapudi, EVP, Digital Foundation Services, HCLTech, highlighted the deep strategic alignment and shared vision for the modern digital workplace with Citrix.

announcements.subject: Wires & Fabriks SA Ltd - 507817 - Intimation Of Receipt Of Request For Reclassification From 'Promoter Group' Category To 'Public' Category Under Regulation 31A Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations')
announcements.detail:

announcements.subject: Aurum PropTech Ltd - 539289 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Media Release - Aurum PropTech Becomes Debt-Free, Doubles Down on Building India''s First AI- Native PropTech Ecosystem
announcements.ai_summary: Aurum PropTech Limited has successfully completed the sale of Buildings Q5 and Q6 located at MIDC, MBP-1, Plot Nos. P-136 & 136/1, TTC Industrial Area, Mahape, Navi Mumbai, for a total consideration of ₹112 Crores on May 21, 2026. This transaction, which was for a consideration approximately 15% above independent valuation, has enabled the company to fully prepay its Lease Rental Discounting (LRD) facility. Consequently, Aurum PropTech Limited is now debt-free, significantly strengthening its balance sheet and financial position. The company intends to utilize the surplus capital to build advanced AI capabilities, aiming to become India's leading AI-first PropTech company by integrating artificial intelligence across its rental, distribution, and capital segments.

The MoU was signed in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Maharashtra and the Hon’ble Minister of IT, Government of Maharashtra. MahaIT, a key agency for the state's ICT initiatives, will work with Tejas Networks to skill and certify students in advanced telecom and digital technologies via online and instructor-led programs. This initiative is expected to foster industry-academia engagement and technology-led capacity building, aligning with the vision of a "Digital Maharashtra" and supporting the state's economic growth.

This AI-enabled solution aims to facilitate a safe and predictable shift to Offer, Order, Settlement, and Delivery (OOSD) operations without disrupting revenue or day-to-day performance. announcements.ai_summary: L&T Technology Services Limited (LTTS) has announced the inauguration of its first Engineering Intelligence Center of Excellence (EI CoE) in Europe, located in Munich, Germany, on May 20, 2026. This new center aims to accelerate the adoption of applied AI and foster innovation in Engineering Intelligence for products, platforms, and manufacturing. By integrating deep-tech expertise with technologies such as GenAI, Agentic AI, and Physical AI, LTTS intends to help global enterprises transition from AI experimentation to scalable industrial transformation. The company highlighted its leadership in AI patent filings, with over 237 patents filed in AI & GenAI in FY26. The EI CoE will serve LTTS' clients in the mobility, industrial products, and sustainability segments, acting as a collaborative innovation hub within a key European industrial and technology ecosystem.

announcements.subject: Qualitek Labs Ltd - 544091 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: The enclosed Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) provides an overview of the company''s consolidated and standalone financial and key operational highlights,  and the future outlook following the Integration of Intersteller Testing Centre Private Limited and expension of Multi Location TIC Capabilities.
announcements.ai_summary: The Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) for H2 FY26 and the full year FY26 has been submitted by Qualitek Labs Ltd. For FY26, the company achieved consolidated revenue of ₹124.52 Crore, a significant fourfold increase from ₹29.18 Crore in FY24 and a 77% rise from ₹70.23 Crore in FY25. This performance was driven by the integration of Interstellar Testing Centre Private Limited and the expansion of multi-location TIC capabilities, including new labs in Mumbai and Bengaluru, and capacity expansion in Bhubaneshwar, Panchkula, and Chennai. Consolidated revenue from operations in H2 FY26 was ₹70.27 Crore, a 56% year-on-year increase. EBITDA for H2 FY26 was ₹18.05 Crore, more than double the ₹8.90 Crore in H2 FY25, and full-year EBITDA grew 80% to ₹29.28 Crore. The company aims to double its revenue every two years. The MD&A will be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: HCL Technologies Ltd - 532281 - Release - 'Hcltech Report Warns 43% Of Enterprise AI Initiatives May Fail As Leaders Face Shrinking Timelines For Impact'
announcements.detail: Enclosed please find a release on the captioned subject being issued by the Company today.
announcements.ai_summary: HCL Technologies has released findings from its Enterprise AI Market Report, "The AI Impact Imperatives, 2026," indicating that 43% of enterprise AI initiatives may fail. This risk stems from shrinking timelines for delivering impact, with nearly half of leaders expecting measurable value within 18 months. The report surveyed 467 senior executives from enterprises with over $1 billion in annual revenue. It highlights that AI adoption is widespread, but translating ambition into consistent, enterprise-wide outcomes is a significant challenge. The study also points to hidden constraints in application estates, data environments, and operating models that are not designed for autonomous AI systems. The findings underscore the growing execution gap as organizations balance rapid AI deployment with necessary structural changes.

This initiative aims to have a social impact by uplifting the lifestyle of 24 families. The company informed the exchange about this development on May 20, 2026.

announcements.subject: RateGain Travel Technologies Ltd - 543417 - Grant Of Stock Appreciation Rights
announcements.detail: Grant of Stock Appreciation Rights
announcements.ai_summary: On May 20, 2026, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of RateGain Travel Technologies Ltd approved the grant of 116,631 Stock Appreciation Rights (SARs) under the "RateGain - Stock Appreciation Rights Scheme – 2022". These SARs are divided into three tranches with different SAR prices: 82,939 SARs at Rs. 466.75 per unit, 5,269 SARs at Rs. 493.75 per unit, and 28,423 SARs at Rs. 592.5 per unit. For all grants, the vesting period is four years from the date of grant, with a vesting schedule of 10% in Year 1, 20% in Year 2, 30% in Year 3, and 40% in Year 4. The SARs can be exercised within three years from the date of their vesting. These grants are made in accordance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021.

announcements.subject: Grasim Industries Ltd - 500300 - Proposed Subscription To The Equity Shares Of Aditya Birla Capital Limited, Subsidiary Of The Company
announcements.detail: Proposed subscription to the equity shares of Aditya Birla Capital Limited, subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: On May 20, 2026, the Board of Directors of Grasim Industries Limited approved an investment of up to ₹2,880 crore in the preferential issue of equity shares by its subsidiary, Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL). This investment is part of ABCL's plan to raise up to ₹4,000 crore to strengthen its capital base and fund future growth. The preferential issuance will be undertaken at a price of ₹356.02 per equity share, in compliance with SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018. Following this investment, Grasim Industries Limited's shareholding in ABCL is expected to increase from 52.27% to 53.08%. The press release from ABCL indicates that the total equity raised will be ₹4,000 crore, with ₹2,880 crore from Grasim Industries Limited, ₹200 crore from Suryaja Investment Pte Limited, and ₹920 crore from International Finance Corporation. Necessary approvals are pending.

announcements.subject: Allcargo Terminals Ltd - 543954 - Amendment In Vesting Schedule Of ATL CEO Employee Stock Option Plan 2025.
announcements.detail: Amendment in Vesting Schedule of ATL CEO Employee Stock Option Plan 2025
announcements.ai_summary: The Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Allcargo Terminals Ltd, on May 20, 2026, approved an amendment to the vesting schedule of the ATL CEO Employee Stock Option Plan, 2025. This plan, initially approved by the Board on August 11, 2025, and shareholders on September 26, 2025, grants 44,66,335 stock options to the CEO, Mr. Ashish Chandna. The revised vesting schedule now stipulates that 80% of the options will vest at the end of one year from the grant date (May 2027), and the remaining 20% will vest at the end of three years from the grant date (May 2029). No options will vest at the end of two years from the grant date (May 2028). This amendment is described as a one-time rationalization and is not detrimental to the grantee's interests. The changes are in compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, and SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021.

announcements.company: KRN Heat Exchanger And Refrigeration Ltd
announcements.subject: KRN Heat Exchanger And Refrigeration Ltd - 544263 - Revised Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Approval Under Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS-2024)
announcements.detail: Revised intimation for RIPS Approval
announcements.ai_summary: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited has received revised approval under the Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS-2024) for its Neemrana Plant, through its subsidiary KRN HVAC Products Private Limited. The approval, issued on May 20, 2026, entitles the company to a Turnover Linked Incentive of 1.54% of Net Sales/Turnover. The Total Eligible Fixed Capital Investment (EFCI) approved by the State Level Screening Committee (SLSC) is ₹182.95 Crore. This approval is anticipated to provide fiscal benefits, enhance operational efficiency, improve cost competitiveness, and contribute positively to the company's profitability. This filing supersedes an earlier intimation submitted on the same day.

announcements.subject: Hester Biosciences Ltd - 524669 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of Listing Regulations - Disclosure On Amendments In Loan Agreement Of Hester Africa
announcements.detail: Announcement under Regulation 30 of Listing Regulation - Amendments in Loan agreement of Hester Africa
announcements.ai_summary: Hester Biosciences Limited has announced amendments to the Loan Agreement between its wholly-owned subsidiary, Hester Biosciences Africa Limited (Borrower), and the Gates Foundation (Lender). The original loan facility, executed in 2018, had an outstanding amount of USD 12 million, with Hester India providing a corporate guarantee. Under the revised terms, the outstanding loan has been reduced to USD 5 million, accrued interest amounts have been waived, and there will be no interest on the further loan amount. The loan repayment schedule has also been revised, and the tenor has been extended. Hester India's corporate guarantee continues under the modified agreement. These amendments are expected to improve the subsidiary's liquidity and debt servicing position.

announcements.subject: Royal Sense Ltd - 544143 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith the submission regarding the launch of the latest products by the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Royal Sense Ltd announced the launch of seven new products, available for sale from May 20, 2026. These products are in the Pharmaceuticals category and cater to the domestic market. The new product lineup includes STERGICLAV 625, SMARTYCALV 625, STERPRAX-0.25/ 0.5/ 1.0- (Alprazolam Tablets IP), STERGIPAM MD -0.25 & 0.5- (Clonazepam Mouth Dissolving Tablets), STERGICET- (Paracetamol + Tramadol Hydrochloride Tablets), STERPIDEM MD -5 & 10- (Zolpidem Tablets / Mouth Dissolving Tablets), and STERGIC BLOOD PRESSURE MONITOR (UPPER ARM). STERGICLAV 625, for example, is a tablet with a strength of 625 mg, composed of Amoxicillin 500 mg and Clavulanic Acid 125 mg, designed for broad-spectrum antibacterial activity.

announcements.subject: Aditya Birla Capital Ltd - 540691 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Preferential Issue

announcements.subject: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd - 590003 - Revision in Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates (MCLR)
announcements.detail:
Karur Vysya Bank Ltd has informed BSE regarding "Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 -
Revision in Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates (MCLR)".
announcements.ai_summary: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd announced on May 20, 2026, a revision in its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates (MCLR), effective from May 22, 2026. The Overnight MCLR was revised downwards from 8.85% to 8.65%, and the One-month MCLR decreased from 9.00% to 8.55%. The Three-month MCLR was adjusted from 9.00% to 8.85%, while the Six-month MCLR saw a reduction from 9.15% to 9.00%. The One-year MCLR, however, remained unchanged at 9.15%.

announcements.subject: Shaily Engineering Plastics Ltd - 501423 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Submission of Press Release titled "Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited Announces Regulatory Approval & Launch of Customer Combination Product Incorporating its ShailyPen Neo Device Technology"
announcements.ai_summary: Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited announced on May 20, 2026, the regulatory approval and launch of a customer combination product incorporating its proprietary ShailyPen Neo™ device technology. This product is a generic version of Semaglutide injection, launched in Canada by Shaily's strategic partner Orbicular Pharmaceutical Technologies in partnership with its Customer. The combination product has already been commercially available in India since March 2026 and has received USFDA Tentative Approval, Health Canada Notice of Compliance, and Indian Regulatory Approval (CDSCO). Shaily's role involved the full design, development, manufacturing, and supply of the device components for this approved product. The ShailyPen Neo™ is a spring-driven, variable and fixed dose pen injector platform, compatible with ISO-standard 3 mL cartridges (3 mL and 1.5 mL fill), positioning it among a rare class of commercially available spring-driven pen injectors globally.

announcements.subject: Nucleus Software Exports Ltd - 531209 - INTIMATION OF GRANT OF Rsus UNDER NUCLEUS SOFTWARE RSU SCHEME -2026

The RSUs are subject to vesting conditions, and after vesting, they can be exercised within a maximum period of two years from the respective vesting date or a shorter period determined by the committee.

Renfra Energy India Limited (Renfra) For Expansion Of Installed Capacity By Setting Up Of 2 (Two) Wind Turbine Generators (Wtgs) Of 3.3 MW Each, Aggregating To 6.6 MW As Required Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

announcements.subject: Brightcom Group Ltd - 532368 - Update

announcements.subject: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd - 500040 - Update Regarding Birla Taranya Project At Thane Of Birla Estates Private Limited, A Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of The Company.

announcements.subject: KFin Technologies Ltd - 543720 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached Press Release titled "KFin Technologies Launches AEGIX, India''s First AI-native Integrated Investor Relations Intelligence Platform"
announcements.ai_summary: KFin Technologies Limited has launched AEGIX, an AI-native integrated investor relations intelligence platform designed for listed companies in India and globally. This platform aims to help investor relations teams gain deeper ownership visibility, market insights, and structured stakeholder engagement capabilities. AEGIX combines ownership intelligence, AI-powered workflows, market intelligence tools, and integrated investor relations functions to enable faster decision-making. The platform is currently available for companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited, as well as those preparing to go public. The launch is intended to strengthen the position of Indian listed companies in their market interactions.

announcements.subject: State Bank of India - 500112 - Gazette Publication Regarding Elected Directors
announcements.detail: Gazette Publication dated 19.05.2026
announcements.ai_summary: State Bank of India has submitted a copy of a Gazette publication dated May 19, 2026, regarding elected Directors to the Central Board of the Bank. This follows a previous letter dated May 16, 2026. The elected Directors will serve for a term of three years, effective from June 26, 2026, to June 25, 2029. announcements.subject: Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd - 544227 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Unicommerce eSolutions Limited has informed the exchange about the press release titled "The Bear House Partners with Unicommerce to drive Omnichannel Growth"
announcements.ai_summary: Unicommerce eSolutions Limited has announced a strategic partnership with The Bear House, a contemporary menswear brand. This collaboration aims to drive omnichannel growth for The Bear House by leveraging Unicommerce's technology platform. Unicommerce's Uniware platform will centralize order management, warehouse operations, and inventory tracking across all of The Bear House's sales channels, including marketplaces and its direct-to-consumer (D2C) website. The Bear House will also utilize UniCapture, Unicommerce's video-based solution for forward logistics. This partnership is intended to enhance operational control, improve inventory visibility, and ensure a smoother shopping experience for customers.

announcements.subject: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd - 543220 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

announcements.ai_summary: Sambhv Steel Tubes Ltd announced the receipt of an amendment in its Consent to Operate (CTO) from the Chhattisgarh Environment Conservation Board, approved on May 14, 2026. This approval, issued by the Government of India, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, IA Division, permits the enhancement of the Cold Rolling Mill (CRM) production capacity. announcements.subject: HFCL Ltd - 500183 - Issuance Of Corporate Guarantee On Behalf Of HTL Limited, A Subsidiary Of The Company     ("HTL") To The Extent Of ?265 Crores In Substitution Of Earlier Corporate Guarantee Of Rs.295 Crores
announcements.detail: The Company has extended a Corporate Guarantee by execution of a Second Amended & Restated Deed of Corporate Guarantee in favour of SBICAP Trustee Company Limited [acting for the benefits of the Working Capital Lenders of HTL Limited, a subsidiary of the Company  ('HTL')], a 'Security Trustee', to secure the various fund based and non-fund based facilities availed/to be availed by HTL, to the extent of Rs.265 Crores in substitution  of earlier Corporate ....
announcements.ai_summary: HFCL Ltd. announced on May 19, 2026, that it has extended a Corporate Guarantee of ₹265 Crores on behalf of its subsidiary, HTL Limited. This new guarantee, executed via a Second Amended & Restated Deed of Corporate Guarantee, substitutes an earlier corporate guarantee of ₹295 Crores. The guarantee is provided in favour of SBICAP Trustee Company Limited, acting as Security Trustee for the Working Capital Lenders of HTL Limited, to secure various fund-based and non-fund-based facilities availed or to be availed by HTL. HFCL holds 74% of HTL's paid-up share capital, with the remaining 26% held by the Government of India. HTL is engaged in manufacturing Optical Fiber Cables (OFC), providing passive connectivity solutions, and producing key OFC raw materials like Aramid Rods, Fiber Reinforced Plastic Rods, and Impregnated Glass Fiber Reinforcement, alongside electrical wiring interconnect solutions for Aerospace & Defence and Automotive & Industrial sectors.

announcements.subject: Zim Laboratories Ltd - 541400 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached a press release dated 19th May 2026 titled "ZIM Laboratories Limited announces grant of Marketing Authorization (MA) for Dabigatran Etexilate (75 mg, 110 mg &150 mg) Capsules in Italy, Europe
announcements.ai_summary: Zim Laboratories Ltd has announced the grant of Marketing Authorization (MA) for its Dabigatran Etexilate (75 mg, 110 mg & 150 mg) Capsules in Italy, Europe. The Italian Medicines Agency (AIFA) granted this authorization via DCP to SIA ZIM Laboratories Limited, Latvia, the company's wholly owned European subsidiary. This MA is for an anticoagulant product indicated for the prevention and treatment of thromboembolic disorders. The product was developed using Zim Laboratories' proprietary non-tartaric acid-based formulation and has demonstrated bioequivalence with the innovator product. This authorization is expected to facilitate faster approvals in other European Union countries, the UK, and global markets, leading to enhanced commercialization opportunities.
