announcements.subject:
Apollo Ingredients Ltd - 503639 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Appeal Dismissed As Withdrawn By Securities Appellate Tribunal.

Pursuant To Regulation 30 Read With Para A Of Part A Of Schedule III Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI LODR Regulations'), We Hereby Inform That The Hon'Ble Securities Appellate Tribunal, Mumbai ('SAT'), Vide Its Order Dated May 07, 2026 In Appeal No. 39 Of 2026 (Along With Miscellaneous Application Nos. 152 & 153 Of 2026), Has Passed A Final Order In The Matter Of Apollo Ingredients Limited (Formerly Known As Indsoya Limited) Versus BSE Limited.
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, We hereby inform that the Hon''ble Securities Appellate Tribunal, Mumbai (SAT), vide its order date May 7, 2026 in Appeal No. 39 of 2026 (along with Miscellaneous Application Nos. 152 & 153 of 2026), has passed a final order in the matter of Apollo Ingredients Limited (formerly known as Indsoya Ltd) Verses BSE Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Ingredients Ltd (formerly Indsoya Limited) has informed the exchange about a final order passed by the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT), Mumbai, on May 07, 2026, in Appeal No. 39 of 2026. The appeal was filed by the company challenging a communication from BSE Limited dated November 01, 2025, regarding the rejection of a waiver application for fines imposed by the exchange. The SAT permitted the withdrawal of the appeal, dismissing it as withdrawn. BSE Limited is allowed to collect Rs. 2,06,000 along with accrued interest, which had been deposited in an interest-bearing account. The company has no objection to BSE Limited collecting this amount. This order is not expected to have a material impact on the company's financial position or operations, other than the deposit amount.

announcements.subject: Surana Telecom and Power Ltd - 517530 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Restructuring
announcements.detail: Disinvestment of 49%  equity stake held in Bhagyanagar Solar Private Limited a Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company consequent to which it will remain a subsidiary company and cease to be a wholly owned subsidiary.

This transaction will result in Bhagyanagar Solar Private Limited ceasing to be a wholly owned subsidiary, though it will remain a subsidiary of Surana Telecom and Power Ltd. The sale agreement was entered into on May 19, 2026, with an expected completion date of June 20, 2026. The consideration for this sale is Rs. 1,14,17,000. The buyer is Lakhanlal Anand Kumar Trade Private Limited, and they do not belong to the promoter or promoter group of Surana Telecom and Power Ltd. Bhagyanagar Solar Private Limited has not yet commenced operations, thus contributing no turnover, revenue, income, or net worth to the listed entity in the last financial year.

announcements.subject: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd - 543530 - Update On Material Litigation
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed the disclosure under Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Paradeep Phosphates Limited has received an unfavorable order from the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) on May 18, 2026, which was published on May 18, 2026. The NCLAT rejected the company's appeal concerning exemption from Entry Tax in Odisha under a BIFR-sanctioned rehabilitation scheme. The litigation pertains to the company's claim for exemption from 2007 to 2014. Paradeep Phosphates Limited had previously provided for the liability and deposited ₹26 crore against a total demand of ₹76 crore. The company maintains its eligibility for remission for the period 2007-2011, as it was classified as a sick industrial company. While the company expects no material financial impact currently, any additional impact from interest on the unpaid amount is also not anticipated to be material.

announcements.subject: Emrock Corporation Ltd - 531676 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of  SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of  SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Emrock Energy Private Limited, a subsidiary of Emrock Corporation Limited where the company holds a 50.49% stake, has approved the installation of a new Bio-CNG project. This project, approved by the subsidiary's Board of Directors on May 19, 2026, aims for a yearly production capacity of 1600 Tons of Bio-CNG, 8652.80 Tons of Fermented Organic Manure (FOM), and 14732.80 Tons of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM). The initial estimated cost for this project is between ₹30 Crores and ₹33 Crores, which will be funded through new capital infusion and financial assistance from banks or financial institutions. The project is targeted for completion by June 30, 2026, subject to necessary approvals. This initiative signifies Emrock Corporation's strategic move into the renewable energy sector.

announcements.subject: JSW Energy Ltd - 533148 - Acquisition Of Additional Equity Shares Of Toshiba JSW Power Systems Private Limited From Toshiba Corporation

announcements.ai_summary: JSW Energy Limited has entered into definitive agreements to acquire an additional equity stake in Toshiba JSW Power Systems Private Limited (TJPS) from Toshiba Corporation, Japan. This secondary purchase will increase JSW Energy's shareholding in TJPS to 20.7% on a non-diluted basis and 10.7% on a fully diluted basis. TJPS, incorporated in 2008, is involved in the engineering, manufacturing, marketing, and maintenance of supercritical steam turbines and generators for thermal power generation. For FY 2025-26, TJPS reported revenue from operations of Rs. 339.3 crores. The acquisition is part of JSW Energy's strategy to enhance its position in the power sector.

announcements.ai_summary: Info Edge (India) Ltd has filed an appeal before the Hon'ble National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) against an order dated April 07, 2026, passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), New Delhi. This appeal pertains to the Scheme of Amalgamation involving Allcheckdeals India Private Limited, Axilly Labs Private Limited, Diphda Internet Services Limited, Zwayam Digital Private Limited as Transferor Companies and Info Edge (India) Limited as the Transferee Company. announcements.subject: Anuh Pharma Ltd - 506260 - Intimation Of Requests Received For Reclassification By Promoter Group To Public Under Regulation 31A Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Intimation for requests received from Persons belonging to Promoter Group seeking reclassification from Promoter Group to Public.
announcements.ai_summary: Anuh Pharma Ltd has received requests from its promoter group seeking reclassification to public shareholders under Regulation 31A of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. A total of 9,49,988 equity shares, representing 0.95% of the total shareholding, are involved in these requests from eight individuals, including Madhurika Narendra Shah (12,000 shares, 0.01%), Hemant Babubhai Choksi (24,000 shares, 0.02%), and Kinjal Siddharth Jhaveri (8,16,160 shares, 0.81%). announcements.subject: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd - 512068 - Discovery Of Nickel - Copper - PGE Mineralization Through Drilling In Bhalukona, Chhattisgarh
announcements.detail: Please refer the attached letter.
announcements.ai_summary: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd has announced the discovery of Nickel-Copper-PGE mineralization through drilling in Bhalukona, Chhattisgarh. The drilling program has confirmed a layered mafic complex with wide zones of disseminated sulphides and occasional heavy-massive sulphide lenses. The first drill hole intersected three mineralized layers of gabbro with a combined width of over 60m, and potentially economic sulphide mineralization averaging 0.4% Ni_Eq. The highest-grade intersection was 2.6m at 1.01% Ni, 0.29% Cu, 0.2g/t Pd, and 1.25% Ni_Eq. The company is accelerating its drilling program to define a mineable resource and is hopeful Bhalukona can become India's first nickel-copper-PGE mine.

announcements.subject: United Spirits Ltd - 532432 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulation, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: United Spirits Limited (USL) has provided a disclosure regarding ongoing litigation with various entities of the Government of Maharashtra, including the State of Maharashtra, Maharashtra Water Resources Regulatory Authority (MWRRA), and the Water Resources Department (WRD). This matter pertains to a demand of INR 441.95 crore towards water charges for the period November 2018 to February 2026, which was issued by WRD on 20th March 2026, following directions from the Bombay High Court. USL has challenged this demand before the Bombay High Court, arguing that it was made without adhering to the principles of natural justice and without considering the material provided by the company. The Bombay High Court issued notices to the respondents on 5th May 2026, but no interim protection was granted. Subsequently, USL filed a Special Leave Petition (SLP) before the Supreme Court of India. By an order dated 12th May 2026, the Supreme Court has directed USL to deposit INR 50 Crores with the Court within four weeks as an interim measure, during which WRD is restrained from taking any coercive action against USL. The writ petition remains pending adjudication.

The transaction will be undertaken through a preferential issue of the company's securities for consideration other than cash, subject to applicable statutory, regulatory, and shareholder approvals. The Board reviewed the draft Share Subscription and Share Purchase Agreement (SSPA) to be entered into among Hari Govind International Ltd, Popees Baby Care India Ltd, PBCPL, and the existing shareholders/investors of PBCPL. Notably, some promoter/promoter group members of Hari Govind International Ltd are also existing shareholders/promoters of PBCPL. An indicative share swap ratio of approximately 1.3:1 has been discussed, subject to final valuation reports, fairness opinions, and due diligence findings.

announcements.subject: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 544222 - Update On Disruption In Operations At Some Of The Manufacturing Sites At Haridwar
announcements.detail: Update on Disruption in Operations at some of the manufacturing sites at Haridwar
announcements.ai_summary: The company, Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd, is providing an update on the disruption of operations at some of its manufacturing sites in Haridwar. This disruption was an industry-wide issue, primarily caused by a review of minimum wages by state authorities, affecting various sectors in Uttarakhand. Manufacturing operations at the affected sites have now resumed at over 70% capacity as of May 16, 2026, with expectations of progressive improvement in productivity. Local authorities are actively collaborating with industries to restore normalcy. The company has confirmed no damage to its property, and the loss of production due to labor unrest is covered under an industrial insurance policy. The exact amount of insurance claim and realized amount will be ascertained and claimed in due course.

announcements.subject: Insecticides (India) Ltd - 532851 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Product Launch
announcements.ai_summary: Insecticides (India) Limited (IIL) has announced the launch of GRANUVIATM, a new insecticide for paddy crops, on May 16, 2026. This product is designed to offer long-duration control of brown plant hopper (BPH) for up to 60 days and protection against stem borer for up to two weeks. The launch addresses significant pest challenges in India's rice cultivation, where BPH can cause yield losses of 20% to 60% and stem borer can lead to 10% to 30% crop damage. GRANUVIATM is positioned as a future-ready solution for consistent and long-term pest control, aiming to improve crop health and productivity. The press release detailing the product launch will be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd - 532898 - Investment Approval By 'Committee Of Directors On Investment On Projects' Of POWERGRID
announcements.detail: Investment approval by ''Committee of Directors on Investment on Projects'' of POWERGRID
announcements.ai_summary: The 'Committee of Directors on Investment on Projects' of Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd (POWERGRID) convened on May 15, 2026, and granted investment approval for three key proposals. The first project involves the augmentation of 1x500MVA, 400/230kV ICT (7th) at Tuticorin-II GIS Sub Station, estimated at ₹132.06 crore, with commissioning scheduled by February 17, 2028. Secondly, the committee approved the installation of OPGW and associated communication systems on existing ISTS lines in the WR Region, at an estimated cost of ₹308.49 Crore, to be commissioned within 30 months by September 18, 2028. Lastly, a similar scheme for OPGW and communication systems on existing ISTS lines in the ER Region was approved, costing ₹143.58 Crore, also slated for commissioning within 30 months by September 18, 2028.

announcements.subject: General Insurance Corporation of India - 540755 - In Principle Approval For Infusion Of Funds Into The Corporation'S Labuan (Malaysia) Branch
announcements.detail: Intimation is enclosed.

This approval is for infusing USD 49 million, approximately equivalent to Rs 469 crore, into the Corporation's Labuan (Malaysia) Branch. The purpose of this capital injection is for solvency restoration, aligning with the guidelines on Insurance Capital Adequacy Framework issued by the Labuan Financial Services Authority (LFSA). announcements.subject: Hindustan Copper Ltd - 513599 - Progress W.R.T. Agreement For Cooperation And Exchange Of Information With CODELCO And Hindustan Copper Limited
announcements.detail: Progress w.r.t Agreement for cooperation and exchange of information with CODELCO and Hindustan Copper Limited is submitted

The work in this regard is currently in progress.

announcements.subject: Primo Chemicals Ltd - 506852 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Primo Chemicals Limited has formally executed transaction documents for its investment in TPCS Private Limited, a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) established to own and operate a 49.998 MW AC Solar Power Plant. This follows previous disclosures where the company announced its intention to subscribe to 26% of TPCS Private Limited's equity capital. The executed documents include a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with TPCS Private Limited and a Share Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement (SSSHA) with TPCS Private Limited, along with its promoters, Arpa Infrastructure Developers Private Limited and Sun Photonics Private Limited. The purpose of these agreements is to develop, own, operate, and maintain the solar power plant under a captive mode on an OPEX model.

announcements.subject: Essex Marine Ltd - 544475 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release on Operational and financial performance for the half and year ended March 31, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Essex Marine Ltd has announced its operational and financial performance for the half-year and year ended March 31, 2026. The company successfully expanded its peeling capacity from 10.8 tons per day to 21.6 tons per day and installed advanced blanching and cooking machinery for Ready-to-Cook segments with a capacity of 4.8 MT per day. Furthermore, Essex Marine Ltd has diversified into integrated cold chain logistics services, deploying its own refrigerated truck fleet to ensure reliable temperature-controlled logistics. Total revenue from operations increased by 61.72% to Rs. 6,470.90 Lakhs in FY2026 from Rs. 4,001.19 Lakhs in FY2025. Total quantity exported also rose from 550MT in FY2025 to 972MT in FY2026. Profit After Tax (PAT) saw a significant increase of 59.23% to Rs. 637.34 Lakhs in FY2026 from Rs. 400.26 Lakhs in FY2025.

announcements.subject: SRF Ltd - 503806 - Commissioning And Capitalisation Of Capital Expenditure Proposal Approved By The Board
announcements.detail: Commissioning and Capitalisation of Capital Expenditure proposal approved by the Board

announcements.subject: Cello World Ltd - 544012 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement

This arrangement involves Wim Plast Limited ("WPL"), Cello Consumer Products Private Limited ("CCPPL"), and Cello World Limited ("CWL"), along with their respective shareholders and creditors. The scheme was sanctioned under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. Cello World Limited will provide further updates on developments regarding this scheme.

announcements.subject: Pokarna Ltd - 532486 - The Company Has Received Demand Notice From Department Of Mines And Geology Government Of Andhra Pradesh.
announcements.detail: The Company has received Demand Notice from Department of Mines and Geology Government of Andhra Pradesh.
announcements.ai_summary: On May 15, 2026, Pokarna Ltd received a Demand Notice from the Department of Mines and Geology, Government of Andhra Pradesh. The notice alleges misuse of dispatch permits and unlawful excavation/transportation of colour granite under the APMMC Rules, 1966. The authorities have raised a demand aggregating to Rs. 33,39,58,289, which includes normal seigniorage fee of Rs. 4,66,56,900, penalty of Rs. 27,96,03,000, DMF of Rs. 58,32,113, Merit of Rs. 9,33,138, and IT at 2% of Rs. 9,33,138. The company is seeking legal advice regarding the impact of this demand on its financial, operational, or other activities.

announcements.subject: Ethos Ltd - 543532 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange regarding press release dated May 15, 2026, titled ''Ethos Limited Marks a Golden Milestone as it Opens 100th Boutique in India.''
announcements.ai_summary: Ethos Limited issued a press release on May 15, 2026, announcing the opening of its 100th boutique in India, located in Indore. This milestone reinforces the company's commitment to providing luxury timepieces and service excellence across the country. The new boutique features a range of prestigious international watch brands. The opening signifies Ethos' continued expansion and its dedication to catering to watch enthusiasts and collectors nationwide. The company has grown from a single boutique to a pan-India network over two decades, enhancing its retail experience through various formats, including mono boutiques, Summits, and Haute Horology boutiques.

announcements.subject: Container Corporation of India Ltd - 531344 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release regarding signing of MOU with PSA Mumbai
announcements.ai_summary: Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Bharat Mumbai Container Terminals Pvt. Ltd. (PSA Mumbai) on May 15, 2026. This MOU aims for strategic collaboration in rail-based movement of domestic/cabotage and customs-cleared EXIM cargo. The agreement will leverage the infrastructure and operational strengths of both organizations to enhance connectivity between PSA Mumbai and CONCOR's network of Inland Container Depots (ICDs) and domestic terminals across India. Key objectives include facilitating rail movement of cargo and optimizing the utilization of yard space and rail handling infrastructure at PSA Mumbai.

announcements.detail: This is to formally inform you that our Company has experienced a cybersecurity incident. On 15th May 2026, at approximately 09:00 AM, our data server was subjected to a ransomware attack. Immediately upon detection, we implemented emergency measures to secure our systems, isolate the affected infrastructure, and prevent any further unauthorized access. The Company has initiated a detailed investigation with the support of internal IT teams and external ....
announcements.ai_summary: Shri Balaji Valve Components Ltd experienced a cybersecurity incident on May 15, 2026, at approximately 09:00 AM, when its data server was subjected to a ransomware attack. Emergency measures were immediately implemented to secure systems and isolate affected infrastructure. The company has initiated a detailed investigation with internal IT teams and external cybersecurity experts to assess the incident's extent and mitigate potential impacts. Necessary steps are being taken to restore systems and ensure operational continuity.

announcements.subject: Coal India Ltd - 533278 - Alternative Mechanism(AM) Approval For Listing Of Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL) Through Fresh Issue Of Equity Shares And Disinvestment Of Coal India Limited' (CIL) Equity In MCL, Through Public Offering To The Extent Of 25% Of CIL'S Stake In MCL In The Domestic Market As Per SEBI Rules And Regulation
announcements.detail: AM approval for listing of MCL
announcements.ai_summary: Coal India Limited (CIL) has received Alternative Mechanism (AM) approval for the listing of its subsidiary, Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), and the disinvestment of CIL's equity in MCL. CIL is authorized to disinvest its stake in MCL through an Offer for Sale (OFS) of existing shares as part of MCL's Initial Public Offering (IPO), and subsequently in one or more tranches. MCL is also approved to raise capital through a fresh issue of equity shares as part of its IPO, and/or through subsequent FPOs, QIPs, or other SEBI-approved methods. The disinvestment and capital raising can be undertaken simultaneously or separately, in one or more tranches, with the overall extent of disinvestment/capital raising limited to reducing CIL’s shareholding in MCL by up to 25%. The proposed listing remains subject to prevailing market conditions and completion of all necessary statutory and regulatory formalities.

announcements.ai_summary: Senco Gold Ltd issued a clarification regarding a burglary incident at its franchisee showroom in Dhuliyan, Murshidabad, West Bengal, on May 14, 2026. The concerned franchisee has lodged an FIR with local police authorities and has informed the insurance company for necessary action, while all employees at the store are reported safe and unharmed.

announcements.subject: GMR Airports Ltd - 532754 - Monthly Traffic Updates
announcements.detail: Monthly Traffic Updates
announcements.ai_summary: GMR Airports Limited released its monthly traffic data for April 2026 on May 15, 2026, reporting approximately 10 million passengers served across its portfolio airports, a decrease of 0.5 million or 5.0% year-over-year. Domestic traffic stood at 7.6 million (down 0.3 million or 3.7% YoY), while international traffic was 2.3 million (down 0.2 million or 8.9% YoY), though monthly traffic has remained sustainably around 10.0 million passengers since October 2025. For the full FY26, the company achieved a record 121.6 million passengers, including 92 million domestic (up 0.6% YoY) and 30 million international (up 1.7% YoY). Operational performance records were set in FY26 at Delhi (highest ATMs, cargo volumes over 1 million metric tonnes), Hyderabad (highest Pax, ATMs, cargo volumes), and Goa (highest Pax, ATMs). The April 2026 decline and muted FY26 growth were attributed to temporary disruptions from changed airspace conditions due to geopolitical events and the Runway 10/28 upgradation at Delhi Airport, which re-opened on September 16, 2025.

announcements.subject: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd - 533326 - Clarification To Institutional Investor Advisory Services (Iias) Voting Recommendation - Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd. - Postal Ballot

announcements.ai_summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd. issued a clarification on May 15, 2026, in response to voting recommendations from Institutional Investor Advisory Services (IiAS) concerning a postal ballot dated March 31, 2026. The resolution in question pertains to the approval of the Texmaco Rail Long Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) Scheme, 2026. The company clarified that its LTI framework is firmly anchored in performance-based vesting, aligning leadership incentives with long-term shareholder value creation. Performance metrics for vesting include EBITDA margin (30%), EPS (25%), ROCE (30%), and Operating Cash Flow (15%) annually, with final vesting after 3 years based on average performance. No vesting will occur if 85% of the stated targets are not achieved, and while actual target thresholds are not disclosed to avoid revealing commercially sensitive information, they are defined, measurable, and approved by the Nomination & Remuneration Committee.

announcements.subject: JSW Energy Ltd - 533148 - JSW Energy Commissions ~250 MW RE Capacity Since April'26
announcements.detail: JSW Energy Commissions ~250 MW RE Capacity since April'26
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Energy Limited announced on May 15, 2026, that it has successfully commissioned approximately 250 MW of renewable energy capacity since April 2026. This includes 130 MW of Wind, 69.4 MW of Solar, and the 50 MW Tidong Hydro Plant Unit-I, which was acquired in January 2026 and commissioned in a record turnaround time. The company's total installed capacity now stands at 13.7 GW, with renewables comprising 59% of this. The remaining two units of the Tidong Hydro Plant are expected to be commissioned by June 2026. JSW Energy has a total locked-in generation capacity of 32.1 GW, with 13.7 GW operational and 13.8 GW under construction. The company plans to add approximately 3 GW of renewable capacity in FY27 and expects to incur a total capital expenditure of approximately ₹20,000 crores in FY27. Furthermore, JSW Energy has 29.6 GWh of locked-in energy storage capacity and aims to reach 30 GW of generation capacity and 40 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2030, with a goal of achieving carbon neutrality by 2050.

announcements.subject: Honasa Consumer Ltd - 544014 - Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Honasa Consumer Limited provided an update on its dispute with RSM M General Trading LLC regarding the termination of an Authorised Distributor Agreement dated 30th July 2020, amended on 27th May 2021. Initially, on 17th May 2024, the Court of First Instance, Dubai, ordered Honasa to pay RSM AED 25,071,991 as compensation, plus 5% annual interest. The Delhi High Court, on 20th August 2024, granted an anti-enforcement order against Dubai proceedings, directing RSM to deposit INR 57,17,65,947 (equivalent to the decree value) with its registry. On 15th October 2024, the Court of Appeal, Dubai, upheld the initial judgment, which Honasa subsequently challenged before the Cassation Court. The Supreme Court of India, on 17th February 2025, appointed Justice (Retd.) Hrishikesh Roy as Sole Arbitrator, commencing arbitration proceedings. Subsequently, on 26th March 2025, the Cassation Court, Dubai, overturned the Court of Appeal judgment as flawed and remanded the matter for a fresh rehearing, rendering the Court of First Instance judgment inoperative. Most recently, on 11th February 2026, the Court of Appeal, Dubai, significantly reduced the compensation payable by Honasa from approximately AED 25 million to AED 1.7 million.

announcements.subject: Carborundum Universal Ltd - 513375 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30(9) Of SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015

announcements.ai_summary: Carborundum Universal Ltd (CUMI) has disclosed that its subsidiary, Foskor Zirconia Pty Limited (FZL), is not in a position to continue its operations. FZL has not achieved sustained profitability since FY 2013, and escalating costs in South Africa, coupled with global competition and foreign exchange fluctuations, have made the business commercially unviable. The Board of FZL has concluded that there is no realistic alternative and will be seeking requisite approvals. Consequently, FZL's financial statements have been prepared on a non-going concern basis and consolidated on a realizable basis in CUMI's Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended March 31, 2026. This includes a write-down of assets to their realizable value amounting to Rs. 16 Crores. FZL is not a material subsidiary, and this development does not impact CUMI's standalone operations.

1.  To raise funds by issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs), and Compulsorily Convertible Debentures (CCDs) aggregating upto an amount of Rs.660.00 Crores (Rupees Six Hundred and Sixty Crores only) to repay the outstanding term loans and related liabilities.

announcements.subject: Atlanta Electricals Ltd - 544527 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 Regarding Receipt Of Debarment Order From South Bihar Power Distribution Company Limited (SBPDCL)
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Atlanta Electricals Limited has received a Debarment Order from South Bihar Power Distribution Company Limited (SBPDCL), effective for two years. This order pertains to a purchase order executed during FY2023-24 for 4 Nos. 10 MVA, 33/11 kV ONAN Power Transformers, with a value of less than ₹3 Crores. The debarment is related to observations made during post-delivery short-circuit testing at CPRI, Bhopal, concerning the displacement of insulating components, despite the transformer successfully clearing all critical test parameters and showing no operational abnormalities. Atlanta Electricals Limited submitted detailed technical replies and representations to SBPDCL on multiple occasions, including August 27, 2024, October 30, 2024, and January 8, 2025, and has been in technical discussions for resolution. The Debarment Order, dated April 24, 2026, was received by the company on May 13, 2026.

announcements.subject: Embassy Developments Ltd - 532832 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release dated May 14, 2026, titled "Embassy Developments secures favourable Karnataka High Court Order; KIADB Resumption Order set aside".
announcements.ai_summary: Embassy Developments Limited has announced a significant legal victory as the Hon’ble High Court of Karnataka has set aside the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board's (KIADB) order for the resumption of approximately 78 acres of land at Kadugodi Industrial Area in Bengaluru. This land is held by Embassy East Business Park Limited (EEBPL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Embassy Developments. As a result of this order, EEBPL retains lawful possession of the land, which is crucial for the company's long-term development plans in the East Bengaluru corridor. This favourable outcome follows a recent order dated May 4, 2026, by the Hon’ble National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) that quashed insolvency proceedings against Embassy Developments. The formal signed copy of the Karnataka High Court order is awaited.

announcements.subject: Swiggy Ltd - 544285 - Clarification On Postal Ballot
announcements.detail: Clarification on Postal Ballot
announcements.ai_summary: Swiggy Limited issued a clarification on May 13, 2026, regarding its Postal Ballot Notice dated April 10, 2026, concerning proposed amendments to its Articles of Association. Institutional investors had raised queries about the board nomination framework and its role in the company's ambition to become an Indian Owned and Controlled Company (IOCC). Swiggy clarified that the Proposed Amendment aims to rationalize legacy nomination rights and ensure management continuity and board-level representation. Furthermore, these amendments are part of a broader effort to achieve IOCC status under Indian foreign exchange laws, which requires resident shareholding to exceed 50% and control to be vested in resident Indian citizens or entities. Given the absence of an identifiable promoter group, the company emphasizes the need for a governance architecture supporting domestic control. The Proposed Amendments alone do not confer IOCC status and will necessitate shareholder approval and additional corporate actions.

announcements.subject: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd - 544408 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

announcements.detail: Please find the attached disclosure

announcements.subject: Embassy Developments Ltd - 532832 - Update Regarding Proceedings Relating To Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board ('KIADB') In Respect Of Land Held By A Subsidiary Of The Company
announcements.detail:
The Hon''ble High Court of Karnataka has on May 12, 2026, pronounced an order in favour of Embassy East Business Park Limited (EEBPL), a subsidiary of the Company, by allowing the writ petition filed by EEBPL and setting aside the order dated March 16, 2026, passed by KIADB.

For more details, please refer the attachment
announcements.ai_summary: Embassy Developments Ltd has announced a favorable outcome from the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka on May 12, 2026. The court allowed a writ petition filed by Embassy East Business Park Limited (EEBPL), a subsidiary of the company, and set aside a previous order from the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (KIADB) dated March 16, 2026. This KIADB order had directed the resumption of approximately 78 acres of land in the Kadugodi Industrial Area, Bengaluru, held by EEBPL. Consequently, EEBPL will continue to hold and retain possession of this land, and the KIADB order is now quashed and ineffective. This development is considered material and favorable for the company and its stakeholders. The formal signed copy of the court order is still awaited.

announcements.company: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd

The hospital is strategically positioned in Central Gurugram to cater to a dense and high-income catchment area. announcements.subject: Le Travenues Technology Ltd - 544192 - Media Release - Ixigo Reimagines Travel With A Fully AI-Native App; Reinvents TARA As A Multimodal AI Assistant And Introduces Agentic Travel Flows
announcements.detail: Media Release titled ''ixigo Reimagines Travel With a Fully AI-Native App; Reinvents TARA as a Multimodal AI Assistant and Introduces Agentic Travel Flows''
announcements.ai_summary: Le Travenues Technology Ltd has announced the launch of its fully AI-native app, which reimagines travel experiences. The app introduces TARA, a multimodal AI assistant that will plan, book, and act on behalf of users, moving beyond traditional booking functionalities. Key features include "Trip Mode" for consolidated post-booking information and real-time alerts, and "Agentic Travel Flows" where AI agents proactively assist travelers. This redesign integrates AI from the ground up, aiming to make travel planning more conversational, intuitive, and personalized for users seeking flights and hotels. The company unveiled these advancements at its flagship tech launch event, ixigo NEXT.

announcements.subject: Atul Ltd - 500027 - Product Launch
announcements.detail: Letter attached
announcements.ai_summary: Atul Ltd has launched three new proprietary crop protection products for the Indian domestic market: Mylonis, Salix Gold, and Tikadis. Mylonis is a patented fungicide designed to combat challenging diseases in rice, such as sheath blight and blast, while also strengthening plant health and improving grain quality. Salix Gold is a 2,4-D sodium salt-based water-dispersible granule formulation offering post-emergence weed control for broadleaf weeds and sedges in rice cultivation. Tikadis is a premium technical-grade herbicide for rice. These launches aim to enhance crop productivity and promote sustainable farming practices by addressing critical needs in disease, pest, and weed management for key crops. The company is focused on the domestic market for these products, with a launch date of May 13, 2026.

announcements.subject: Ceigall India Ltd - 544223 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: In accordance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that Ceigall India Limited ('CIL') has received an email dated May 13, 2026, intimating that the Company has been selected for setting up of 50 MW Standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) in Punjab under Tariff-Based Global Competitive Bidding through E-Reverse Auction from Punjab State Power Corporation ....
announcements.ai_summary: Ceigall India Limited (CIL) has been selected to set up 50 MW Standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) in Punjab. The selection was made through a Tariff-Based Global Competitive Bidding process via E-Reverse Auction by Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL). The contract includes a 12-year Battery Energy Storage Purchase Agreement (BESPA) with a tariff of Rs. 2.99/KWh. The project cost is estimated at Rs. 125 Cr, and the execution period for setting up the plant is 18 months, followed by 12 years of operation and maintenance.

announcements.subject: Desco Infratech Ltd - 544387 - Announcement Under Reg 30 Of SEBI LODR - Intimation Regarding L1 Bidder For ONGC Pipeline Replacement Project
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding emergence as L1 Bidder for ONGC Pipeline Replacement Project
announcements.ai_summary: Desco Infratech Limited has emerged as the L1 (Lowest Bidder) for the ONGC Pipeline Replacement Project. This project involves the replacement and strengthening of critical 24-inch crude oil transfer pipelines from the ONGC Trombay Terminal to BPCL and HPCL Refineries at Uran Plant. The project is strategically important for ensuring safe and efficient crude oil transportation within India's energy infrastructure. The company's selection as L1 bidder highlights its technical and execution capabilities in the oil & gas and hydrocarbon infrastructure sector. This development is expected to further strengthen Desco Infratech Limited's order pipeline.

announcements.subject: Bajaj Auto Ltd - 532977 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Intimation of ad hoc announcement and press release issued by Bajaj Mobility AG (formerly PIERER Mobility AG), a step-down subsidiary of Bajaj Auto Limited, titled Quarterly Report: 1st Quarter 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Bajaj Auto Limited has announced that its step-down subsidiary, Bajaj Mobility AG (formerly PIERER Mobility AG), has released its Quarterly Report for the 1st Quarter of 2026. The report indicates significant operational improvements, with consolidated revenue increasing by 70.2% to EUR 331.3 million. Motorcycle unit sales surged by 125.1% to 40,332 units, driving motorcycle revenue up by 151.6% to EUR 272.4 million. Bajaj Mobility AG achieved a positive EBITDA of EUR 5.5 million, a substantial improvement from EUR -55.8 million in Q1 2025. EBIT also improved by 71.5% to EUR -26.1 million. The company's equity stood at EUR 350.7 million with an equity ratio of 22.2%. A key development was the successful refinancing of KTM AG for EUR 550 million in February 2026, which facilitated the repayment of a restructuring loan from Bajaj Auto International Holdings B.V. and strengthened the group's financial position. Worldwide inventories have also been reduced.

announcements.subject: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd - 539682 - Mobavenue Launches Prsmx And AI-Powered Full-Funnel Advertising Platforms In The Philippines

This expansion is a strategic move to foster deeper engagement with advertisers, agencies, and enterprise customers, including those in Southeast Asia and Singapore. It forms a crucial part of Mobavenue AI Tech Limited's international growth strategy to deploy its AI-powered platforms in high-growth digital markets like Southeast Asia.

announcements.subject: Tata Motors Ltd - 544569 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition

announcements.subject: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd - 543657 - Execution Of Fiscal Support Agreement By Sicsem Private Limited (Subsidiary Of Archean Chemical Industries Limited) With The India Semiconductor Mission ("ISM")
announcements.detail: Execution of Fiscal Support Agreement by SiCSem Private Limited (Subsidiary of Archean Chemical Industries Limited) with the Indian Semiconductor Mission ("ISM")
announcements.ai_summary: Archean Chemical Industries Limited's step-down subsidiary, SiCSem Private Limited, along with wholly-owned subsidiary Neun Infra Private Limited, executed a Fiscal Support Agreement (FSA) with the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) on May 11, 2026. This FSA, following ISM approval on August 12, 2025, formalises the fiscal incentive framework under the Semicon India Programme. The agreement supports the establishment of India's first approved Silicon Carbide (SiC) based Compound Semiconductor Fab and ATMP facility at Info Valley, Bhubaneswar, Odisha. The project involves an investment of approximately Rs. 2,067 crore, aiming for an annual capacity of ~60,000 SiC wafers and ~96 million SiC MOSFETs and diodes. This facility will cater to critical sectors such as Electric Vehicles (EVs), Renewable Energy, and 5G. The company had previously extended inter-corporate funding to Neun Infra to advance procurement of long-lead machinery pending FSA execution.

announcements.subject: Pakka Ltd-$ - 516030 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Kindly find attached herewith disclosure under SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for your reference and record.
announcements.ai_summary: Pakka Limited has provided a detailed bifurcation of the project cost for its 'Jagriti Project', an ongoing capital expenditure program at its existing manufacturing facility aimed at capacity expansion, facility upgradation, and integrated operations. The total revised cost of the Jagriti Project is INR 744.00 Crore. This project includes the installation of a new paper machine (PM-4), upgrading existing paper machines (including PM-3), expanding and modernizing the pulp mill, installing captive power generation facilities, developing chemical recovery systems, and upgrading the effluent treatment plant. The cost is bifurcated across Phase I (INR 95.65 Crore), Phase II (INR 644.53 Crore), and Phase III (INR 3.83 Crore), including components like project land, civil work, plant & machinery, contingency, pre-operative expenses, and interest during construction. This bifurcation is based on a revised Techno-Economic Viability assessment, reflecting cost escalations due to design changes, time overruns, and foreign exchange fluctuations.

announcements.subject: Active Clothing Co Ltd - 541144 - Opening Of Retail Outlets Under The Brand Name 'NUEMO'. It Is A Company'S Strategic Entry Into The Multi-Brand Retail Segment.
announcements.detail: opening of retail outlets under the brand name "NUEMO". it is a Company Strategic entry into the multi-brandretail segment.
announcements.ai_summary: Active Clothing Co Ltd announced its strategic entry into the multi-brand retail segment with the approval to open retail outlets under the brand name "NUEMO". This initiative will operate as a multi-brand retail platform targeting growth opportunities in India's Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns. NUEMO will feature flexible retail models offering men's, women's, and kids' apparel under one roof, alongside category-specific stores based on market demand, aiming to create a curated and scalable retail ecosystem. The company expects NUEMO to strengthen its retail presence in underserved markets, leverage existing manufacturing and brand-building capabilities, and establish a scalable, technology-driven retail model. The projected topline for NUEMO is approximately ₹200–250 crore within four years, subject to market conditions and execution.

(NEDFi) to implement a comprehensive digital lending ecosystem. This partnership aims to enhance credit access across the North Eastern Region of India by deploying Veefin's cloud-hosted solutions, including a Loan Origination System (LOS), Loan Management System (LMS), and Loan Collection System (LCS). The deployment will also feature dedicated mobile applications for sales and collection, along with a customer portal for borrowers. The solution will integrate with credit bureaus and banking APIs to create a unified financial ecosystem. NEDFi expects the new software, to be fully implemented within the next few months, to help reach entrepreneurs in remote areas and benefit small borrowers in unserved and underserved regions. Veefin Solutions was selected through an extensive RFP process, and their solutions were found to meet NEDFi's digital transformation requirements.

announcements.subject: L&T Technology Services Ltd - 540115 - Press Release Titled 'L&T Technology Services And Emerson Announce A Global Cooperation And Strategic Engagement To Drive Innovation In Engineering Excellence'
announcements.detail: Press Release attached.
announcements.ai_summary: L&T Technology Services (LTTS) and Emerson have announced a global cooperation and strategic engagement to drive innovation in engineering excellence. This partnership, focused on LTTS's sustainability segment, will combine LTTS's engineering capabilities with Emerson's NI test platform to accelerate system integration and product development across various industries. LTTS will act as a global System Integrator and technology development partner, supporting the design, deployment, and lifecycle enablement of advanced systems engineering platforms. The collaboration will also involve joint engagement approaches for customer projects, positioning LTTS as a key system integration partner for the NI test platform. As part of this agreement, LTTS will establish a dedicated Centre of Excellence (CoE) at its Mysuru campus, based on the NI test and measurement platform, to serve as a global hub for joint development.

announcements.ai_summary: Voltas Limited has provided an update on a pending material litigation as required by Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The Court of Appeal in Qatar issued a judgment on May 4, 2026 (English translation received on May 9, 2026) in a matter involving Voltas and a Joint Venture of OHL International, Spain, and Contrack (Cyprus) Limited. The judgment mandates OHL International, Spain, and Contrack (Cyprus) Limited to pay QAR 163.62 million (approximately ₹425.58 crores) to Kentz Voltas Consortium (KVC) for outstanding subcontract payments and an additional QAR 40 million (approximately ₹104.04 crores) as compensation. The counterclaims filed by OHL International, Spain, and Contrack (Cyprus) Limited have been dismissed. Voltas Limited has filed an application for the execution of this order and will monitor further developments.

announcements.subject: Shanti Gold International Ltd - 544459 - Change In Accounting Policy - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Change in Accounting Policy - Disclosure under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Shanti Gold International Limited's Board of Directors, at a meeting held on May 11, 2026, approved a voluntary change in its accounting policy for inventory valuation. The policy has been changed from the First-In-First-Out (FIFO) method to the Weighted Average Cost (WAC) method, effective retrospectively from April 01, 2024, and applicable for financial reporting from FY 2025-26 onwards. This change, made in accordance with Ind AS 8, is intended to provide more reliable and relevant financial information by better reflecting the blended cost of inventories, improving cost-revenue matching, and aligning with industry practices. The company has conducted a detailed analysis to quantify the financial impact of this change on key financial parameters.

announcements.subject: Sai Life Sciences Ltd - 544306 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

This initiative reflects the company's long-term view on sustainability, resilience, and resource efficiency in its infrastructure.

announcements.subject: 7Seas Entertainment Ltd - 540874 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release

The company plans to develop and release multiple new and upgraded gaming titles, such as "Treasure King" (an open-world action-adventure strategy game) and "Formula Rush" (a next-generation car racing game), ahead of the Christmas holiday season. 7Seas Entertainment Ltd is also exploring AI technologies for cinematic content creation, animation, voice cloning, screenwriting, and post-production, aligning with the projected growth of the global AI Gaming market to over USD 51 billion by 2033 and the AI Video industry to cross USD 42 billion by 2030.

announcements.subject: L. T. Elevator Ltd - 544518 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Annual Performance Update & Strategic Direction
announcements.ai_summary: L.T. Elevator Limited announced its financial performance for FY26, marking its first full fiscal year since listing on BSE SME on September 19, 2025. The company achieved a topline revenue of over Rs. 111 crore in FY26, representing approximately 97% year-on-year growth compared to FY25 revenue of around Rs. 56.5 crore, while maintaining operating margins. This milestone of crossing Rs. 100 crore in annual revenue was driven by disciplined execution, scalable operations, expanding geographical reach, and design-led engineering capabilities. The company reported a Profit after Tax (PAT) of over Rs. 17 crore for FY26. The merger with Ricardo Elevators is currently underway, and Ricardo's PAT-positive financials will be consolidated from FY27 onwards. Ricardo Elevators is generating healthy order inflows of approximately Rs. 6 crore per month, with an annualised run-rate of over Rs. 70 crore, and a typical delivery timeline of 3 to 6 months, expected to contribute significantly to FY27 revenue.
