To ensure a smooth transition, both the old and new websites will point to the same location with identical content and services, adhering to Regulation 46 and other applicable SEBI regulations. The company has updated its letterhead to reflect the new domain name.

announcements.subject: PMC Fincorp Ltd - 534060 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Intimation Of Regularisation Of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director Pursuant To Postal Ballot Read With SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 Dated January 30, 2026
announcements.detail: Regularisation of Mr. Puneet Arora Non Executive Non Independent Director
announcements.ai_summary: On May 11, 2026, PMC Fincorp Ltd announced that its members have approved the regularisation of Mr. Puneet Arora as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director through a postal ballot, with the results declared on May 08, 2026. Mr. Arora was initially appointed as an Additional Director on February 17, 2026, for a term of five years, ending February 16, 2031. Following a recommendation from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Board approved the change in his designation from Executive Director to Non-Executive Director, effective April 01, 2026. Mr. Arora will continue to be associated with the company in this capacity but will not be involved in day-to-day operations. The company confirmed that Mr. Puneet Arora is not debarred from holding a director's office by any SEBI or other authority order.

announcements.subject: Jagatjit Industries Ltd - 507155 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Meeting Updates
announcements.detail: updates regarding outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Jagatjit Industries Ltd met on May 11, 2026, to discuss several key initiatives. The Board noted a proposal for the development and launch of a Premium Single Malt Whisky within the current financial year 2026-27. Additionally, the company will shift from a Franchisee operated model to a Company operated model in Chhattisgarh starting FY 2026-27 to improve volumes and margins. The Board also acknowledged a significant reduction in debt liabilities, with outstanding Term Loan from Indusind Bank decreasing from Rs. 158.68 Crores to Rs. 49.63 Crores. The company received inter-corporate deposits from promoter-held entities for working capital requirements. Furthermore, Mr. Roopak Chaturvedi was appointed as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and Mr. Parshant Giare as Chief of Commodity & Manufacturing Officer.

announcements.subject: Jindal Stainless Ltd - 532508 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release.
announcements.ai_summary: Jindal Stainless Limited has announced that its Hisar unit has achieved 'Zero Waste to Landfill' (ZWTL) certification with a Platinum+ rating, verified by Bureau Veritas India Pvt. Ltd. This certification underscores the unit's strong waste management framework, including waste segregation and minimization of landfill disposal. For the fiscal year 2024-25, the facility reported an impressive waste diversion rate of 99.99%, meaning almost all generated waste was recycled, reused, or recovered. The assessment, based on mass balance methodology, aligns with circular economy principles. Managing Director, Mr. Abhyuday Jindal, highlighted the company's commitment to responsible manufacturing, while Unit Head – Hisar, Mr. Vijay Bindlish, emphasized the team's focus on operational excellence and environmentally conscious practices.

announcements.subject: KP Green Engineering Ltd - 544150 - Press Release - Groundbreaking Ceremony For Telecom Infrastructure Project In Collaboration With BSNL
announcements.detail: KP Green Engineering Limited has informed the exchange regarding Press Release titled Groundbreaking Ceremony for Telecom Infrastructure Project in Collaboration with BSNL. The Disclosure is attached herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: KP Green Engineering Limited has conducted a groundbreaking ceremony for a telecom infrastructure project in collaboration with Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL). This project is based on advance work orders previously disclosed, aggregating to ₹819 Crore. The project will be executed across 5 States and 1 Union Territory, aiming to enhance digital connectivity in strategically important and challenging regions. This initiative signifies the company's growing capabilities in executing large-scale infrastructure projects and its commitment to contributing to India's digital growth. The commencement of this project further strengthens KP Green Engineering Limited's position in the telecom infrastructure sector.

announcements.subject: Container Corporation of India Ltd - 531344 - Assumption Of Additional Charge By Shri Harbrinder Singh Bajwa, Director (Domestic Division) On The Board Of CONCOR.
announcements.detail: Assumption of additional charge by Sh. Harbrinder Singh Bajwa, Director (Domestic Division) on the Board of CONCOR.
announcements.ai_summary: Container Corporation of India Ltd (CONCOR) has provided an update regarding the additional charge of Director (Domestic Division). The Ministry of Railways has informed that the Competent Authority has approved, ex-post facto, the entrustment of this additional charge to Shri H. S. Bajwa, IRIS, ED(FM), Railway Board. This charge is for a period of 9 months, effective from March 1, 2026, or until a regular incumbent assumes the post, whichever is earlier. Shri Harbrinder Singh Bajwa had initially assumed this additional charge on March 1, 2026.

announcements.subject: HandsOn Global Management (HGM)Ltd - 532761 - Receipt Of Request For Re-Classification Of Shareholding Of Promoter/S Category To Public Category Under 31A Of SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) Regulation
announcements.detail: Attached three request letter dated May 11,2 206 a received from the Promoter/s.
announcements.ai_summary: HandsOn Global Management (HGM) Ltd has received requests from its promoters, Stern Capital Partners LLC, Surinder Rametra, and Sun Investment Partners LLC, to re-classify their shareholding status from "Promoter" to "Public" shareholder category. These requests, dated May 11, 2026, pertain to a total of 814,246 shares, representing 6.46% of the total shareholding. The company has confirmed that these requests meet the conditions prescribed under Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The Board of Directors will consider these re-classification requests in due course.

announcements.subject: Magellanic Cloud Ltd - 538891 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Attached Herewith the Intimation under Regulation 30
announcements.ai_summary: Magellanic Cloud Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Provigil Surveillance Limited, has received a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from South-Western Railway, Bengaluru Division. The aggregate value of this order is ₹3.59 Crore. The project involves the replacement and additional provision of a CCTV Surveillance System at Mysuru Railway Station. The scope of work includes the supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and integration of CCTV surveillance systems, encompassing VMS, VAS & FRS integration, various camera types, video analytics servers, storage systems, networking infrastructure, UPS systems, and centralized monitoring infrastructure with failover architecture. This award highlights the company's growing presence in railway surveillance projects and the increasing demand for technology-driven infrastructure modernization.

announcements.subject: Gopal Snacks Ltd - 544140 - Announcement Under Reg. 30 (LODR) - Business Update
announcements.detail: The Company has re-commenced its manufacturing facility at Rajkot Main Plant, details attached herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: Gopal Snacks Limited has announced the re-commencement of its manufacturing facility at the Rajkot Main Plant, effective May 11, 2026. This facility, which had been non-operational since a fire incident in December 2024, has now completed its reinstatement and resumed operations after obtaining necessary approvals. The company will discontinue operations at its Gondal facility and consolidate production at the Rajkot plant, which has an installed capacity of 1,05,233 MTPA. This move is expected to improve profitability through lower power costs, reduced transportation expenses due to proximity to dealers, and lower labor and manufacturing costs. The Rajkot facility will produce a diversified product portfolio including Gathiya, Namkeen, Snack Pellets, and Extruded Snacks. The reinstatement of the Corporate Office and other support facility buildings is still in progress.

announcements.subject: Mini Diamonds India Ltd - 523373 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Receipt of significant domestic order for Cut and Polished Lab Grown Diamonds amounting to INR 12.00 Crores
announcements.ai_summary: Mini Diamonds (India) Limited (MDIL) announced on May 11, 2026, the receipt of a significant domestic order valued at INR 12.00 Crores for the supply of cut and polished lab grown diamonds. This order was secured from a Mumbai-based existing client and marks a positive start to the company's domestic order book for FY 2026–27. The order reflects the client's confidence in MDIL's product capabilities and timely service. MDIL is focusing on the Indian market, where demand for lab-grown diamonds is increasing, and aims to maintain consistent quality, disciplined pricing, and dependable fulfillment to strengthen customer relationships and enhance its domestic market positioning.

announcements.subject: Biocon Ltd - 532523 - Company Statement
announcements.detail: Company Statement
announcements.ai_summary: Biocon Pharma Limited, a subsidiary of Biocon Limited, announced on May 11, 2026, that it has received approval from Health Canada for micafungin for injection, USP, in 50 mg and 100 mg strengths. This approval is for the treatment of various candidiasis infections in adults and children four months and older, as well as for prophylaxis in patients undergoing hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. The company stated that this approval will further strengthen Biocon’s integrated biosimilars and generics portfolio. The information will also be available on Biocon's website.

announcements.subject: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd - 512068 - Update On Altyn Tor Gold Project, Kyrgyz Republic.
announcements.detail: Please refer the attached letter.
announcements.ai_summary: Deccan Gold Mines Limited has provided an update on its Altyn Tor Gold Project in the Kyrgyz Republic. Work is progressing rapidly to prepare the plant for commercial operations, with approximately 130 Indian expatriates and a large local team on-site. The gravity circuit has been fully commissioned, and concentrate production is expected to commence in June, in preparation for the Merril-Crowe circuit commissioning. The Merril-Crowe circuit is also anticipated to be commissioned in June, enabling the production of Dore Bar from gravity concentrates. Full-scale plant operations, following all trials, are projected to be ready by August 2026, coinciding with the inauguration planned around Indian and Kyrgyz Independence Days. This project marks the first investment by an Indian mining and exploration company in the Kyrgyz Republic.

announcements.subject: Hampton Sky Realty Ltd - 526407 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Reg 30 (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Custody of Mr. Sanjeev Arora, part of Promoter/Promoter group of Hampton Sky Realty Limited by Directorate of Enforcement ("ED")
announcements.ai_summary: Mr. Sanjeev Arora, a member of the Promoter/Promoter Group of Hampton Sky Realty Limited, was taken into custody by the Directorate of Enforcement (ED) on May 09, 2026. This action is in connection with the export of mobile phones undertaken by the company during 2023 and 2024. The company has issued a press statement on May 09, 2026, to provide the factual position. Hampton Sky Realty Limited has expressed faith in the country's legal framework and judiciary and remains committed to transparency with its stakeholders. Further updates will be provided as material developments occur.

announcements.subject: Adani Green Energy Ltd - 541450 - Operationalisation Of Project
announcements.detail: Operationalisation of Project
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL) announced that its wholly-owned stepdown subsidiary, Adani Green Energy Twenty Five C Limited (AGE25CL), has operationalized a 150 MW solar power project located in Khavda, Gujarat. This commissioning brings AGEL's total operational renewable generation capacity to 19,735.8 MW. Additionally, the company's total operational Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) capacity now stands at 1,376 MWh. The decision to operationalize the project and commence power generation was made on May 10, 2026, at 7:40 p.m., with operations commencing on the same date.

announcements.subject: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd-$ - 522249 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Strikes /Lockouts / Disturbances
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations , 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Urban Uniquoters Ltd has announced a partial operational impact at its Dhodsar manufacturing plant due to a strike by contractual workers, effective May 9, 2026. Production has stopped on one coating line, potentially leading to a loss of approximately 15,000 linear meters per day. The company has increased wages for contractual workers as per industry standards and applicable laws, but some workers are demanding further increases. Other manufacturing plants of the company remain fully operational. Urban Uniquoters is actively engaged in discussions with the workers and contractors to resolve the issue amicably and will provide further updates. All assets at the affected unit are covered by insurance.

announcements.subject: Dhampur Bio Organics Ltd - 543593 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Demise
announcements.detail: With deep sorrow and grief, we inform about the sad demise of our beloved Chairman and Executive Director - Shri Vijay Kumar Goel, on May 10, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Dhampur Bio Organics Ltd. has announced with deep sorrow the sad demise of its Chairman and Executive Director, Shri Vijay Kumar Goel, on May 10, 2026. The company expressed pride in his hard work and dedication throughout his tenure and stated that his values, contributions, guidance, and vision will continue to inspire and be remembered. The company and its employees are mourning the loss. Further details as required under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, are enclosed as an annexure.

announcements.subject: Welspun Enterprises Ltd - 532553 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR)- Incorporation Of A Wholly-Owned Subsidiary
announcements.detail: Welspun Enterprises Limited has informed the exchange regarding the Incorporation of a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Welspun Enterprises Limited announced on May 9, 2026, the incorporation of a wholly-owned subsidiary named Welspun Pune Shirur Projects Limited. This new entity has an authorized and paid-up capital of 10,000 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, subscribed by the company for Rs. 1,00,000/- in cash. The subsidiary's objective is to carry out the project for the construction of a 6-Lane Partially Elevated Highway Corridor along with improvement of the existing road from Km. 10+600 to Km. 64+000 (Section Pune to Shirur of NH-753F) in Maharashtra on DFBOT (Toll) Mode.

announcements.subject: Ritco Logistics Ltd - 542383 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Business update for the month of April 2026
announcements.ai_summary: The company Ritco Logistics Ltd has secured new transportation contracts worth approximately ₹49 crores in April 2026. A significant portion of this, around ₹44 crores, comes from a 1-year contract with a leading petrochemical giant for multi-location polymer logistics. The company also secured multiple contracts totaling approximately ₹1.7 crore with India’s leading electrical company for infrastructure, engineering, and industrial goods, with tenures ranging from 9 months to 2 years. These wins reinforce Ritco's strong positioning in the polymer segment and expand its presence in heavy engineering and project logistics, with additional contracts from the tyre and renewable industries.

announcements.subject: Veedol Corporation Ltd - 590005 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, As Amended - Receipt Of Insurance Claim Repudiation Letter
announcements.detail: Veedol Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Receipt of Insurance Claim Repudiation Letter
announcements.ai_summary: Veedol Corporation Limited has received a repudiation letter from National Insurance Company Limited on May 8, 2026, regarding an insurance claim filed after a fire incident at a third-party depot in Bhiwandi, Thane, Maharashtra, which was previously disclosed on October 5, 2024. The company is currently evaluating all available options and remedies in response to this repudiation. Any further material developments concerning this matter will be duly intimated to the stock exchanges as per applicable laws.

announcements.subject: LCC Infotech Ltd - 532019 - Updates on Open Offer
announcements.detail: Grow House Wealth Management Pvt Ltd ("Manager to the Offer") has submitted to BSE a copy of Post-offer Advertisement to the Public Shareholders of LCC Infotech Ltd ("Target Company").
announcements.ai_summary: Grow House Wealth Management Pvt Ltd, acting as the Manager to the Offer, has submitted a Post-offer Advertisement to BSE for the public shareholders of LCC Infotech Ltd. This advertisement pertains to the open offer made by Mr. Kunjit Maheshbhai Patel for the acquisition of 4,38,34,271 equity shares of LCC Infotech Limited. These shares represent 26.00% of the emerging voting share capital of the target company. The offer price for each equity share is ₹ 4.55. The Post-offer Advertisement was published on May 02, 2026, in the Financial Express, Jansatta, Mumbai Lakshadeep, and Duranta Barta newspapers.

announcements.subject: Pervasive Commodities Ltd - 517172 - Disclosure Of Material Event Under Regulation 31A Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation of Application submitted for Reclassification of Promoter to Public category
announcements.ai_summary: Pervasive Commodities Limited has submitted an application to BSE Limited for the reclassification of its Promoter/Promoter Group to the Public category. This application was filed on May 9, 2026. The details provided indicate that Enigma Merchants LLP, holding 5,04,900 shares (0.06% of total voting capital), and Winspire Project Consultants Private Limited, holding 41,000 shares (0.00% of total voting capital), are the entities seeking this reclassification. In total, these entities hold 5,45,900 shares, representing 0.06% of the company's total voting capital.

announcements.subject: Jetking Infotrain Ltd - 517063 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith Disclosure under Regulation 30 - Order passed by the Securities Appellate Tribunal, Mumbai in Appeal No 474 of 2025 - Submission of prescribed summary format in terms of Regulation 30(13)
announcements.ai_summary: Jetking Infotrain Ltd has submitted a disclosure regarding an order passed by the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT), Mumbai, in Appeal No. 474 of 2025. The order was made available on May 8, 2026. This disclosure is in compliance with Regulation 30(13) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company's Joint Managing Director & CFO, Siddharth Bharwani, has confirmed the accuracy and completeness of the information provided.

announcements.subject: Hexaware Technologies Ltd - 544362 - Update
announcements.detail: Intimation
announcements.ai_summary: Hexaware Technologies Ltd provided an update on ongoing legal proceedings initiated against a European client. The company learned that the client's insolvency proceedings have commenced in Germany and have been recognized in the US to protect against litigations. This update was received from lawyers on May 8, 2026. Hexaware Technologies is pursuing legal remedies before the appropriate authorities. The company states there is no additional financial impact as adequate provisions were already made in earlier financial statements. This information will be hosted on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Chiraharit Ltd - 544561 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: We wish to inform you that Chiraharit Limited has received a Purchase Order from TP Vardhaman Surya Limited (Tata Group Company) for Supply and Services for Wind Power Project.
announcements.ai_summary: Chiraharit Limited has received a Purchase Order from TP Vardhaman Surya Limited, a Tata Group Company, for the supply and services related to a Wind Power Project. The order involves services for SVG and Filters, along with miscellaneous services as per the Bill of Quantities, to be executed in Karnataka. The order is to be executed within 16 weeks. The broad consideration for this domestic order is Rs. 4,93,25,000 (Rupees Four Crore Ninety-Three Lakh and Twenty-Five Thousand only), excluding GST. The company's Managing Director and CEO, Pavankumar Bang, has signed the intimation.

announcements.subject: REC Ltd - 532955 - Intimation Of Incorporation Of Subsidiary Companies.
announcements.detail: Intimation of incorporation of subsidiary companies.
announcements.ai_summary: REC Ltd informed on May 9, 2026, about the incorporation of three new subsidiary companies, which are wholly-owned subsidiaries of REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL), itself a wholly-owned subsidiary of REC Limited. The newly incorporated entities are Bhadla Ramgarh Power Transmission Limited, Lakadia II Power Transmission Limited, and Jam Khambhaliya Jamnagar Power Transmission Limited. Each of these companies has an authorized and paid-up capital of ₹5,00,000/- and has not yet commenced business. Their incorporation is linked to the allocation of inter-state transmission projects by the Ministry of Power, Government of India, where RECPDCL has been appointed as the Bid Process Coordinator for the selection of bidders for specific transmission projects. These companies are also considered subsidiaries of REC Limited under Section 2(87) of the Companies Act, 2013.

announcements.subject: Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd - 544457 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Brigade Hotel Venture Limited''s (BHVL) Grand Mercure Celebrates 10 years of Operations in Mysuru
announcements.ai_summary: Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd (BHVL) has announced an investment of approximately ₹1,000 crore over the next five years in Karnataka. This announcement coincides with the 10th anniversary of its flagship property, Grand Mercure Mysuru. The investment plan includes developing new projects and modernizing existing assets to enhance experiential tourism. BHVL aims to strengthen Mysuru's position as a global tourism destination by investing in local micro-economy and sustainable infrastructure. The company views Mysuru as a successful testing ground for integrating international hospitality standards into a heritage-rich environment, providing the confidence and financial blueprint to expand its footprint across Karnataka. Since its inauguration in 2016, Grand Mercure Mysuru, a 146-key property, has established a significant economic footprint and pioneered sustainability as a Green Key certified establishment.

announcements.subject: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd - 500520 - Report For The Month Of April 2026
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed Production, Sales and Exports figures for the month of April 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd has released its production, sales, and export figures for the month of April 2026. The report includes detailed breakdowns for various vehicle models, including Utility Vehicles, Vans, E-Rickshaws, E-Carts, 3-Wheelers (Pass and Goods), and 2-Wheelers. For Utility Vehicles, total production stood at 87,683 units, with sales at 92,631 units and exports at 5,007 units in April 2026. The figures for April 2025 were 87,683 units produced, 92,631 units sold, and 3,401 units exported. The report also notes that sales figures include those from subsidiary companies Mahindra Electric Automobile Limited, Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Limited, and SML Mahindra Limited. These figures have not been independently verified or audited.

announcements.subject: Jyothy Labs Ltd - 532926 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Intimation Of Non- Renewal Of License Agreements With Henkal  AG & Co. Kgaa
announcements.detail: Announcement under regulation 30(LODR) - Intimation of Non-renewal of License Agreement with Henkal AG & Co. KGaA
announcements.ai_summary: Brigjyoti Labs Limited has announced that Henkel AG & Co. KGaA will not renew the license agreements for the Pril and Fa brands beyond May 31, 2026. These agreements, initially entered into on May 31, 2011, covered the manufacturing, distribution, marketing, and sale of these brands. The company was in discussions with Henkel regarding renewal and other options, but it has been concluded that there is no further reasonable possibility of renewal. The company is currently evaluating all available options and will promptly disclose any material developments. This disclosure is made following a board meeting held earlier today and in accordance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Pee Cee Cosma Sope Ltd - 524136 - Change In Nominee Shareholder Of Wholly Owned Subsidiary
announcements.detail: change in nominee shareholder of subsidiary company
announcements.ai_summary: Pee Cee Cosma Sope Ltd has reported a change in the nominee shareholders of its wholly-owned subsidiary, India Trading Infra Limited. This administrative change, approved by the Executive Committee of the Board of Directors on May 09, 2026, involves Mayank Jain being replaced by Prabhav Jain as the nominee shareholder for one equity share of Rs. 10. The company has clarified that this change is purely administrative and does not affect the beneficial ownership, control, or shareholding pattern of the subsidiary, which continues to be wholly owned by Pee Cee Cosma Sope Ltd.

announcements.subject: Zuari Agro Chemicals Ltd - 534742 - Intimation Of Interim Orders Received From Regional Director, Western Region, Ministry Of Corporate Affairs, Mumbai
announcements.detail: Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR 2015, Intimation of Interim orders received from Regional Director, Western Region, Mumbai
announcements.ai_summary: Zuari Agro Chemicals Ltd has received four interim orders from the Regional Director, Western Region, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Mumbai. These orders are related to compounding applications filed under Section 441 of the Companies Act, 2013, for alleged non-compliances under Section 129 of the Companies Act, 2013, read with applicable Indian Accounting Standards and Schedule III. The alleged non-compliances pertain to accounting disclosures and presentation matters and are described as unintentional and procedural. The interim orders were received by the company on May 8, 2026. The specific alleged violations include non-disclosure of Basic and Diluted EPS separately for FY 2019-20 to FY 2022-23, alleged non-compliance with IND AS-36 for impairment assessment of investment in Zuari Farmhub Limited, and alleged non-compliance with IND AS-37.

announcements.subject: TVS Motor Company Ltd - 532343 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations , 2015
announcements.detail: Grant of Stock Options by the Company under TVS Motor Company Employee Stock Option Plan
announcements.ai_summary: TVS Motor Company Ltd has announced the grant of 22,998 stock options under the TVS Motor Company Employee Stock Option Plan. This grant was approved by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee on May 9, 2026. The options cover 22,998 equity shares, each with a face value of Re 1. The exercise price has been determined based on the market value of the company's shares on May 8, 2026. Vested options cannot be exercised more than 4 years from their vesting date. The terms of the employee stock option plan, previously approved by shareholders, are applicable to this grant.

announcements.subject: Aptech Ltd - 532475 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Aptech Limited has received a Work Order from an autonomous body under the State Government. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Further details regarding the significant terms and conditions of the order are provided in Annexure A. Aptech Limited is a prominent player in the vocational training sector with a global presence, offering training and assessment solutions across various sectors including IT, media, retail, aviation, banking, and pre-school education. The company operates through its brands such as Arena Animation, MAAC, Lakmé Academy, and Aptech Learning. The receipt of this work order is a significant development for the company, though the specific value and timeline of the order are not disclosed in this announcement.

announcements.subject: Setco Automotive Ltd - 505075 - Update Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Interim Order Passed By The Securities Appellate Tribunal
announcements.detail: Intimation
announcements.ai_summary: The Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) has issued an interim order dated May 08, 2026, staying the operation of a SEBI order dated February 05, 2026, against Setco Automotive Limited. This stay is subject to certain conditions specified in the SAT's order. The original SEBI order had directed payment of approximately ₹208.77 Crore, debarment from the securities market, and imposed a penalty. The appeal was filed by the promoters of Setco Automotive Limited, Harish Sheth and another, against SEBI and other respondents. The SEBI investigation pertained to the financial statements of Setco Automotive Limited for FY 2019-20 to FY 2021-22 and potential violations of securities laws. The SAT's interim order provides a temporary relief to the promoters and the company while the appeal is being heard.

announcements.subject: SEPC Ltd - 532945 - Update On Rights Issue - Receipt Of First And Final Call Money On The Partly Paid-Up Equity Shares Of The Company.
announcements.detail: We hereby inform that the Rights Issue Committee at its Meeting held today, approved the conversion of 24236652 Partly Paid- up equity shares in to Fully Paid- up equiy shares upon receipt of the final call money. Detailed letter is enclosed.
announcements.ai_summary: SEPC Ltd has provided an update on its Rights Issue, reporting the receipt of first and final call money on partly paid-up equity shares. Out of the 49,291,505 partly paid-up equity shares for which the first and final call notice was sent, the company has received payment for 24,236,652 shares. The Rights Issue Committee of the Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 09, 2026, approved the conversion of these 24,236,652 partly paid-up equity shares into fully paid-up equity shares upon receipt of the final call money. This action is in furtherance to the previous intimation dated April 13, 2026, regarding the reminder and forfeiture notice.

announcements.subject: Constronics Infra Ltd - 523844 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 SEBI(LODR) - Intimation Of Lapse Of Convertible Warrants And Forfeiture Of Upfront Consideration
announcements.detail: Intimation of lapse of 30,09,899 convertible warrants and forfeiture of upfront consideration
announcements.ai_summary: Constronics Infra Ltd has announced the lapse of 30,09,899 convertible warrants and the forfeiture of the upfront consideration received for them. These warrants were allotted on a preferential basis on November 4, 2024, at an issue price of Rs. 110 per warrant. The company had received Rs. 8.27 crores, representing 25% of the total consideration, as an initial subscription amount. The allottees failed to exercise the conversion option for the pending 30,09,899 warrants within the stipulated 18-month period, which ended on May 4, 2026. As per Regulation 169(3) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, the upfront payment received on these lapsed warrants shall be forfeited.

announcements.subject: PB Fintech Ltd - 543390 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 -Grant Of Certificate Of Registration As A Stock Broker By SEBI To PB Marketing And Consulting Private Limited
announcements.detail: Please find attached disclosure under regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: On May 09, 2026, PB Fintech Ltd announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, PB Marketing and Consulting Private Limited, has been granted a Certificate of Registration as a Stock Broker by the Securities Exchange Board of India (SEBI). announcements.subject: Fino Payments Bank Ltd - 543386 - Business Update For The Month Of April, 2026
announcements.detail: Business update for the month of April, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Fino Payments Bank Ltd has provided a business update for April 2026, highlighting continued strength in its liability franchise and growth in its loan referral business. The bank's CASA accounts opened increased by 9% YoY to 2,36,437, and average total deposits grew by 13% YoY to approximately ₹2,801 crore. Digitally active customers rose by 19% YoY to 62.1 lakh, with FinoPay active customers increasing by 28% YoY to 7.7 lakh. Renewal income grew by 9% YoY to ₹19.3 crore. In the loan referral segment, disbursements increased to approximately ₹166 crore, a more than threefold increase compared to April 2025. Transaction business throughput saw a decrease of 47% YoY to ₹2,649 crore, and B2B UPI P2M throughput decreased by 96% YoY to ₹101 crore.

announcements.subject: Power Finance Corporation Ltd - 532810 - Incorporation Of Two Wholly Owned Subsidiaries Of PFC Consulting Limited (A Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of Power Finance Corporation Limited)- (1)WESTERN GHATS PSP TRANSMISSION LIMITED  (2) HINGOLI WEST POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED
announcements.detail: INTIMATION
announcements.ai_summary: Power Finance Corporation Ltd (PFC) has informed about the incorporation of two wholly owned subsidiaries of its subsidiary, PFC Consulting Limited (PFCCL). The newly incorporated Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) companies are WESTERN GHATS PSP TRANSMISSION LIMITED and HINGOLI WEST POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED. These SPVs are established for the purpose of establishing 400 kV GIS Igatpuri / Murbad Switching Station and 400 kV AIS Hingoli West Switching Station, respectively. PFC Consulting Limited has been nominated as the Bid Process Coordinator by the Ministry of Power for these Independent Transmission Projects. The SPVs will undertake preparatory activities such as land acquisition and forest clearance, and will be transferred to the Successful Bidder selected through a tariff-based competitive bidding process.

announcements.subject: Swiggy Ltd - 544285 - Shareholders'' Letter - May 08, 2026
announcements.detail: Shareholders'' Letter for Q4 2025-26 dated May 08, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Swiggy Ltd has released its Shareholders' Letter for Q4 2025-26, dated May 08, 2026. The company reported a 22.6% Year-on-Year (YoY) growth in Food GOV, the highest since demand normalized post-COVID, driven by increased order and user volumes. Swiggy achieved its best-ever Adjusted EBITDA margins of 3.3%, a 26 basis points increase quarter-on-quarter, due to disciplined improvement in contribution margin and operating leverage. The company is focusing on affordability as a key driver for future growth, with experiments in initiatives like 99-Store, quick food (Snacc), and an affordable restaurant marketplace (Toing). Swiggy proactively shut down its Snacc business during the quarter due to concerns about its steady-state size and incremental complexity. The quick commerce segment remains highly competitive, reinforcing Swiggy's strategy to enhance its staying power and differentiation.

announcements.ai_summary: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd has issued a revised outcome of its Board Meeting held on May 07, 2026, pertaining to fund raising. The revision corrects a typographical error in the number of equity warrants mentioned for allottees 2 and 3. The Board approved the allotment of 19,51,000 Fully Convertible Warrants, each convertible into one equity share of face value Rs. 10, within 18 months from allotment, for cash consideration on a preferential basis. The issue price per warrant is Rs. 358.00. The proposed allottees include Ambition Tie-Up Private Limited (12,01,000 warrants for Rs. 42,99,58,000), Zyana Developers LLP (5,00,000 warrants for Rs. 17,90,00,000), Shailja Sandeep Jindal (1,00,000 warrants for Rs. 3,58,00,000), Gautam Gopi Kishan Makharia (75,000 warrants for Rs. 2,68,50,000), and Punit GopiKishan Makharia (75,000 warrants for Rs. 2,68,50,000). Post-allotment, Ambition Tie-Up Private Limited will be categorized under the Promoter Group.

announcements.subject: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd - 532796 - Board Meeting Outcome for Intimation Under Regulation 30- Sale Of Stake In Lumax Jopp Allied Technologies Private Limited
announcements.detail: The Board of Directors of the company in their meeting held on Friday, May 08, 2026, have considered and approved the sale of its entire equity stake (alongwith its nominee shareholders) aggregating to 50% of the equity share capital of Lumax Jopp Allied Technologies Private Limited, to Jopp Holding GmbH, Germany, the Joint Venture Partner, subject to completion of customary conditions in terms of the Share Purchase Agreement amongst the Company, ....
announcements.ai_summary: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 08, 2026, approved the sale of its entire 50% equity stake in Lumax Jopp Allied Technologies Private Limited, along with its nominee shareholders, to Jopp Holding GmbH, Germany, the Joint Venture Partner. This sale is subject to the completion of customary conditions as per the Share Purchase Agreement. Consequently, Lumax Jopp Allied Technologies Private Limited will cease to be a joint venture of Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd. This portfolio realignment is intended to sharpen focus on businesses aligned with the company's future growth and financial priorities.

announcements.subject: Neetu Yoshi Ltd - 544434 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Neetu Yoshi Limited has announced a strategic fund raise of ₹27.48 crore through the issuance of 26,42,400 convertible warrants. These warrants, with a face value of ₹5 each, are proposed to be issued at a price of ₹104 per warrant and are subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. The fund raise aims to support the company's growth and expansion plans, including scaling manufacturing capabilities and strengthening its presence in the railway components sector. The company also announced securing a purchase order worth ₹14.76 Cr from an India-based wagon manufacturer. The preferential allotment includes participation from promoters and other investors, reflecting confidence in the company's business outlook.

announcements.subject: Borosil Renewables Ltd - 502219 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment
announcements.detail: Allotment of equity shares upon conversion of warrants
announcements.ai_summary: Borosil Renewables Limited's Management Committee of the Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 08, 2026, approved the allotment of 94,338 equity shares. These shares are fully paid-up, have a face value of Re. 1/- each, and are allotted upon the conversion of warrants. The warrants were originally allotted on a preferential basis on February 14, 2025, to non-promoter category individuals, at an issue price of Rs. 530/- per warrant. The allotment includes 66,037 shares to Brescon Ventures Private Limited and 28,301 shares to Trinity Credit Management Services LLP. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased to Rs. 14,02,83,183, comprising 14,02,83,183 equity shares.

announcements.subject: Kanpur Plastipack Ltd - 507779 - Board Meeting Outcome for Intimation Of Grant Of Options Under Employee Stock Option Scheme.
announcements.detail: Grant of Options under Kanpur Plastipack Limited Employee Stock Option Scheme - 2025.
announcements.ai_summary: Kanpur Plastipack Limited's Nomination and Remuneration Committee met on May 8, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 12:20 PM to grant employee stock options. Under the Kanpur Plastipack Limited Employee Stock Option Scheme – 2025, a total of 4,04,740 options were granted to eligible employees. These options are convertible into an equal number of equity shares of the company, each with a face value of Rs. 10/-. This grant is in continuation of previous intimations dated November 10, 2026, and May 05, 2026, and complies with SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Dee Development Engineers Ltd - 544198 - Update On Order Book Of The Company For The Month Of April 2026.
announcements.detail: Update on Order Book of the company for the month of April 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Dee Development Engineers Limited has provided an update on its order book for April 2026. The company's order book for Pipings (DEE India) in the Power sector had an opening balance of ₹1,004.81 Crores as of April 1, 2026, with an order inflow of ₹8.58 Crores and ₹1.87 Crores executed during April 2026, resulting in a closing balance of ₹1,011.53 Crores. For the Oil & Gas sector, the opening balance was ₹582.65 Crores, with an inflow of ₹18.78 Crores and ₹38.60 Crores executed, leading to a closing balance of ₹562.84 Crores. The company also reported being 'L1' for additional orders worth ₹211 Crores from reputed clients.

announcements.subject: Remsons Industries Ltd - 530919 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Award of Order
announcements.ai_summary: Remsons Industries Limited has announced a significant new order for its step-down subsidiary, Remsons Automotive Ltd. (UK). The subsidiary has been nominated by a leading global commercial vehicle OEM manufacturer for a 10-year pedal box program. The production for this program is scheduled to commence in Q4 CY2028. The estimated lifetime value of this nomination is approximately ₹160 Crores over the 10-year program term. This international order, awarded by a foreign entity, is for the supply of pedal boxes and is expected to be executed over 120 months.

announcements.subject: SML Mahindra Ltd - 505192 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Report for the month of April 2026
announcements.ai_summary: SML Mahindra Limited has released its business update for April 2026. In the commercial vehicles segment, the company reported a production of 1,588 units, an increase from 1,529 units in April 2025. Sales for April 2026 stood at 1,711 units, up from 1,492 units in the previous year. Exports also saw an increase, with 30 units exported in April 2026 compared to 20 units in April 2025. These figures reflect the company's operational performance for the specified month.

announcements.subject: Himalaya Food International Ltd - 526899 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release - Shipment of French Toast Sticks to UK; Expansion into Europe & Japan.
announcements.ai_summary: Himalaya Food International Ltd has announced a significant expansion of its global footprint with the first-ever shipment of three containers of Frozen French Toast Sticks to the United Kingdom. This shipment, which occurred on May 8th, 2026, follows a successful product launch in Australia with the same customer, indicating strong repeat demand. The company is also actively expanding its product presence into Europe and Japan, reinforcing its strategy to build a diversified international export business. Himalaya Food International Ltd has been exporting French Toast Sticks to the United States for several years, and this entry into the UK marks a crucial step in its European market penetration. The company aims to leverage existing customer relationships and focus on value-added frozen food products to strengthen its global distribution and brand presence.

announcements.subject: JSW Infrastructure Ltd - 543994 - Update-Permission To Commence Operation At The Berth No. 7 & Back Up Area Of Netaji Subhash Dock Under Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed the disclosure
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Infrastructure Ltd has received permission for its wholly-owned subsidiary, JSW Kolkata Container Terminal Private Limited, to commence operations at Berth No. 7 and its Back Up Area of Netaji Subhash Dock under Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata. This follows the earlier receipt of a Letter of Award for the reconstruction and mechanization of Berth No. 8 and Berth No. 7, and the signing of the Concession Agreement. The Principal Commissioner of Customs (Port) granted this operational permission via a trade circular dated May 07, 2026.

announcements.subject: Star Housing Finance Ltd - 539017 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 - Letter Of Intent Received From Bassinvictus Private Limited Addressed To The Lenders.
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 - Letter of Intent received from Bassinvictus Private Limited addressed to the lenders.
announcements.ai_summary: Star Housing Finance Ltd has received a Letter of Intent (LOI) from Bassinvictus Private Limited, addressed to the lenders of the company. Bassinvictus Private Limited intends to infuse Rs. 200 crore into Star Housing Finance Ltd through equity, subject to necessary approvals, with the aim of acquiring a majority stake and buying out the stakes of promoters and ARKFIN Investment and Advisors Limited. Post-agreement, Bassinvictus Private Limited would immediately infuse Rs. 25 crore as an Inter-Corporate Deposit (ICD) to clear pending dues of lenders and statutory payments. The LOI also outlines plans to restructure term loan facilities and grant a moratorium on interest and principal repayments for six months.

announcements.subject: Le Travenues Technology Ltd - 544192 - Media Release - Confirmtkt Launches AI Seat Finder, Rolls Out Unconventional Campaign With RCB Players
announcements.detail: Media Release titled ''ConfirmTkt Launches AI Seat Finder, Rolls Out Unconventional Campaign with RCB Players''
announcements.ai_summary: Le Travenues Technology Ltd has announced the launch of its AI Seat Finder feature on ConfirmTkt, an intelligent, in-app tool powered by TARA, an AI native agent developed by ixigo. This feature helps travelers find confirmed train tickets even when their preferred train is waitlisted, by analyzing real-time availability and suggesting alternatives. The AI Seat Finder is now available in Hindi and English and is integrated into the ConfirmTkt app, transforming the train ticket booking experience into a simpler, guided journey. Additionally, ConfirmTkt has rolled out a new campaign featuring RCB players Virat Kohli, Rajat Patidar, and Venkatesh Iyer, highlighting the AI Seat Finder in action.

announcements.subject: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd - 540879 - Business Updates
announcements.detail: Business Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd has received new orders in the ordinary course of its business, totaling Rs. 510.25 million. These orders include Rs. 174.78 million from the Ministry of Defence, Rs. 95.28 million from Public Sector Defence Undertakings, and Rs. 240.18 million from Private Companies. This update is provided for the information of shareholders.

announcements.subject: True Colors Ltd - 544531 - Intimation About New Product Launch
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, Intimation about new Product Launch
announcements.ai_summary: True Colors Ltd has announced the launch of new product lines in the Commercial Printing and Packaging segments, effective May 08, 2026. These new products include Web-to-Sheet Book Printing Machines, Sheet-fed Book Printing Machines, Digital Label Printers, Label Embellishment Printers, Flexible Packaging Printing Machines, and Label Die-Cutting & Finishing Machines, along with related accessories and auxiliary equipment. This launch caters to both domestic and international markets, with initial launches in India, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. A press release detailing these launches has been enclosed and will also be hosted on the company's website.

announcements.subject: MIC Electronics Ltd - 532850 - Update On Integrated Passenger Information System - IPIS V2.0
announcements.detail: Please find attached the intimation regarding the development of IPIS v2.0 by the company for Indian Railways.
announcements.ai_summary: MIC Electronics Ltd has initiated the development of its Integrated Passenger Information System (IPIS) version 2.0 for Indian Railways, with the project progressing as planned. The company has successfully established the product architecture, and dedicated teams are concurrently working on hardware, firmware, and Network Management System (NMS) application software. Significant progress has been made across all major development areas, keeping the project on track for product realization and delivery. The company's focused engineering approach and coordinated team efforts are facilitating steady development towards successful deployment. MIC Electronics Ltd will continue to inform the stock exchanges of any further material developments.

announcements.subject: KPIT Technologies Ltd - 542651 - General - Update
announcements.detail: We are deeply saddened by passing of our Founder & Chairman of the Board, Mr. S. B. (Ravi) Pandit, on the morning of May 8, 2026 in Pune.
announcements.ai_summary: KPIT Technologies Ltd has announced the passing of its Founder and Chairman of the Board, Mr. S. B. (Ravi) Pandit, on the morning of May 8, 2026, in Pune. The company expressed deep sadness over his demise. Further details about Mr. Pandit are available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: IIFL Capital Services Ltd - 542773 - Open Offer

Each equity share has a face value of INR 2. ICICI Securities Limited is acting as the Manager to the Offer. This open offer is being made in compliance with SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. A public announcement detailing the offer was made on May 7, 2026.

announcements.company: Shri Gang Industries & Allied Products Ltd
announcements.subject: Shri Gang Industries & Allied Products Ltd - 523309 - Intimation For Approval Of Reclassification U/R 31A Of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation for approval of Reclassification
announcements.ai_summary: Shri Gang Industries and Allied Products Limited's Board of Directors, in their meeting on May 07, 2026, approved the reclassification of Mr. Ajay Gupta, Mr. Shailesh Gupta, Mr. Siddharth Gupta, and Mr. Ramesh Gupta from the 'Promoter & Promoter Group' category to the 'Public' category. This reclassification is in accordance with Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and is subject to the approval of the stock exchange and any other necessary approvals. The Board's views on this proposed reclassification are enclosed as Annexure I.

announcements.subject: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd - 543324 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Amendments to Memorandum & Articles of Association

This alteration to the MOA was approved by the shareholders and has been filed with the relevant authorities.

announcements.subject: Mindspace Business Parks REIT - 543217 - Reg 23(5)(c): Disclosure of additional issue of units by the REIT
announcements.detail: Mindspace Business Parks REIT has informed the Exchange regarding Issue of units through  Preferential issue on 07/05/2026

The REIT has also completed the allotment of units on a preferential basis, following the satisfaction of conditions precedent and receipt of all necessary approvals. This action is in continuation of previous intimations regarding board meetings and postal ballot results.

announcements.subject: Sammaan Capital Ltd - 535789 - Receipt Of 'No Objection Certificate' From Reserve Bank Of India ('RBI') For Transfer Of NBFC Business Of Sammaan Finserve Limited To Samaman Capital Limited Pursuant To The Scheme Of Arrangement Between Sammaan Capital Limited ('Company' / 'SCL' / 'Resulting Company') And Sammaan Finserve Limited ('SFL' / 'Demerged Company') And Their Respective Shareholders And Creditors ('Scheme' Or 'Scheme Of Arrangement').
announcements.detail: In continuation to our earlier intimation dated December 31, 2025, informing about the decision taken by the Board of Directors of the Company approving Scheme of Arrangement between the Demerged Company i.e. SFL and the Resulting Company i.e. SCL and their respective shareholders and creditors under Section 230 to 232 read with Section 52, Section 66 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, and the rules framed thereunder, subject ....
announcements.ai_summary: Sammaan Capital Ltd has received a 'No Objection Certificate' from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) dated May 7, 2026, for the transfer of the NBFC business of Sammaan Finserve Limited (SFL) to Sammaan Capital Limited (SCL) under a Scheme of Arrangement. This approval from RBI is a significant regulatory milestone for the scheme's implementation. The Scheme is still subject to other statutory and regulatory approvals, including those from the National Company Law Tribunal, and the respective shareholders and creditors of both companies.

announcements.subject: Agi Greenpac Ltd - 500187 - General Updates
announcements.detail: General updates
announcements.ai_summary: AGI Greenpac Ltd has issued a clarification regarding the e-Voting period for a postal ballot. Due to an inadvertent error, the end date was previously stated as June 6, 2025, but the correct end date is Saturday, June 6, 2026. The remote e-Voting will commence on Friday, May 8, 2026, at 09:00 A.M. (IST) and conclude on Saturday, June 6, 2026, at 05:00 P.M. (IST). Apart from this typo, the postal ballot notice and its contents remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: Gowra Leasing & Finance Ltd - 530709 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 For Approval For Borrowings
announcements.detail: With reference to cited subject we hereby submit that the Board has approved the borrowing through Intercorporate Loan for unrelated parties.
announcements.ai_summary: Gowra Leasing & Finance Ltd's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 07, 2026, approved a proposal to borrow up to Rs 25,00,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Five Crore only) through intercorporate loans from unrelated parties. These funds will be raised in tranches to meet the company's working capital requirements and enhance business operations. The borrowing is intended to support better performance of business operations.

announcements.subject: Bombay Dyeing & Manufacturing Company Ltd - 500020 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Bombay Dyeing & Manufacturing Company Ltd has received a challenge from SEBI against the Securities Appellate Tribunal's (SAT) order dated January 16, 2026, which had set aside SEBI's order from October 21, 2022. The company is currently reviewing this development with its legal advisors and will take necessary steps as per applicable law. Bombay Dyeing maintains its compliance with legal and regulatory requirements and will defend its position. The company will continue to inform the stock exchanges of any further material developments.

announcements.subject: Gravita India Ltd - 533282 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed press release of the company for setting up of copper recycling plant in Mandvi, Gujarat
announcements.ai_summary: Gravita India Ltd has announced plans to establish a Copper Recycling plant in Mandvi, Gujarat, with an approximate capital expenditure of ₹160 crore. The plant will have an installed capacity of approximately 29,400 MTPA and is expected to commence commercial operations within the next 12 months, funded through internal accruals. This strategic expansion aims to enhance the company's non-ferrous metal recycling portfolio, support vertical integration, and meet growing demand for recycled copper, aligning with its commitment to the circular economy and sustainable manufacturing.

announcements.subject: CyberTech Systems and Software Ltd - 532173 - Investment In Wholly-Owned Subsidiary Of The Company
announcements.detail: Investment in Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: CyberTech Systems and Software Limited has made an investment of US$ 4,344,900 on May 6, 2026, in its wholly-owned subsidiary, CyberTech Systems & Software Inc., USA. This investment is in the nature of a capital contribution via a cash remittance through bank transfer. CyberTech Systems & Software Inc., USA, incorporated in 2003, had a turnover of USD 22.40 million for the period April 2024 – March 2025. The company has confirmed that this transaction is on an arm's length basis, with common non-independent directors Mr. Viswanath Tadimety and Mr. Steven Jeske in both entities. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd - 544029 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 For An Order Received From The Office Of The Commissioner Of Customs (Appeals), Mumbai -I.
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Clause 20 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the Company has received an Order from the office of the Commissioner of Customs (Appeals), Mumbai Custom Zone - I
announcements.ai_summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd has received a favourable order from the Office of the Commissioner of Customs (Appeals), Mumbai Customs Zone – I. The order, dated April 30, 2026, and received on May 6, 2026, sanctions a refund claim of Rs. 22,92,06,499/- for two claims filed by the company for the periods 2018-19 and 2019-20. This order is expected to augment the company's working capital. The company has disclosed this information as per Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Westlife Foodworld Ltd - 505533 - Submission Of Recording Of The Earnings Conference Call For The Quarter Ended 31St March 2026.
announcements.detail: Submission of recording of the Earning conference call for the quarter ended 31st March 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Westlife Foodworld Ltd has uploaded the recording of its earnings conference call for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, on its website. This announcement is in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Investors can access the recording at the provided weblink. The company has requested the stock exchanges to take this information on record.

announcements.subject: D.P. Abhushan Ltd - 544161 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015 - Launch Of D.P. Jewellers' E-Commerce Website On May 10, 2026
announcements.detail: We hereby submit Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015 for the launch of D.P. Jewellers'' E-commerce website on May 10, 2026 and inaccessibility of the current website for the Stakeholders.
announcements.ai_summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited will be launching its official E-commerce website, www.dpjewellers.com, on May 10, 2026. This new platform will enable online sales of jewellery products directly to customers across India, aiming to expand the company's digital presence and enhance customer reach. The launch is expected to contribute to revenue growth through an omni-channel retail strategy. The website will offer a wide range of gold, diamond, and other jewellery products with secure payment options and online delivery. During the transition, stakeholders will be unable to access the current website until the new one is launched. This announcement is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Capri Global Capital Ltd - 531595 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release - Capri Global Capital Limited - Secured, Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) - Tranche 1 Issue Oversubscribed and Successfully Closed
announcements.ai_summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has announced the successful closure of its Tranche I issue of Secured, Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs), which was oversubscribed. The issue, which opened on April 15, 2026, and closed on April 28, 2026, had a base issue of ₹1,000 million with a Green Shoe Option of ₹4,000 million, aggregating up to ₹5,000 million. Investor response was strong across all categories, with the QIB and Corporate categories subscribed over 2x and 1.14x respectively. The NCDs offer coupon rates of up to 9.50% per annum. This successful second public NCD issuance provides the company with greater flexibility in fundraising to serve underbanked and underserved customers. The press release will be available on the company's website, www.capriloans.in.

announcements.subject: Arvind Ltd - 500101 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Update on Acquisition by AAML
announcements.ai_summary: Arvind Ltd provided an update on May 07, 2026, regarding an acquisition and internal group structuring by its wholly-owned subsidiary, Arvind Advanced Materials Limited (AAML). Arvind Advanced Materials US Bidco LLC, a step-down subsidiary of the Company through AAML, has merged with Dalco GF Technologies, LLC, a Delaware-based limited liability company. Dalco GF Technologies, LLC is now the surviving entity and the wholly-owned step-down subsidiary of the Company. This transaction involved a cash consideration of USD 85.40 million.

announcements.detail: Scheme of Amalgamation between Savita GreenTec Limited, wholly owned subsidiary, and the Company

announcements.subject: Comfort Fincap Ltd - 535267 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI Listing Regulation - Product Launch
announcements.detail: Intimation of launch of New Financial Product - Consumer Durable Loan, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
announcements.ai_summary: Comfort Fincap Limited has launched a new financial product, the Consumer Durable Loan, along with a dedicated digital platform to enhance customer convenience and operational efficiency. This launch aligns with the company's strategic objectives to expand its retail lending portfolio and strengthen its presence in the consumer finance segment. The Consumer Durable Loan product is now operational in the domestic market, specifically in India. The company is committed to leveraging technology for a smoother and more efficient customer experience.

announcements.subject: Delta Corp Ltd - 532848 - Announcement Under Regulation 30
announcements.detail: Announcement Under Regulation 30
announcements.ai_summary: Delta Corp Ltd has provided an update regarding its new cruise vessel in Goa, following a public interest litigation. announcements.subject: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd - 539682 - MMA India Study In Association With Mobavenue Reports 84-88% Of AI Adopters Achieving Medium-To-High Business Impact.
announcements.detail: MMA India study in association with Mobavenue Reports 84-88% of AI Adopters achieving meduim to high business impact
announcements.ai_summary: Mobavenue AI Tech Limited (MATL), in collaboration with MMA India, has released "The AI Marketing Maturity Study." This benchmarking report, based on insights from over 60 senior marketing leaders across 11 industry verticals, indicates that 84-88% of AI adopters are experiencing medium-to-high business impact across key marketing functions. The study assesses AI maturity across four pillars: Creative & Content, Measurement & Insights, Propensity Modelling, and Customer & Sales Journeys, with full-stack AI adoption ranging from 35% to 57%. The findings suggest a shift from AI experimentation towards integrated, AI-led operational systems designed for measurable and scalable business outcomes.

announcements.subject: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd - 517334 - General Updates
announcements.detail: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with the Stock Exchange regarding Press Release issued by Abu Dhabi Investment Office.
announcements.ai_summary: The Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) has announced its support for Samvardhana Motherson International Limited's (Motherson) manufacturing hub in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. This initiative aims to strengthen Abu Dhabi's position as a global hub for advanced manufacturing and automotive supply chains. The partnership will support the development of a large-scale integrated manufacturing facility to produce a range of automotive components for Motherson's global operations and third-party OEM customers. The project is expected to create over 1,000 jobs in technical, engineering, manufacturing, and corporate functions, contributing to Emiratisation and knowledge transfer. The facility, located within Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD), is being developed on an approximately 87,652 square metre land plot, with construction already underway. Once operational, it will serve as a regional manufacturing and export base, leveraging Abu Dhabi's logistics infrastructure.

announcements.subject: JSW Energy Ltd - 533148 - Material Litigation
announcements.detail: Material litigation under Regulation 30 of the Securities Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Energy Limited has announced that its wholly-owned step-down subsidiaries, JSW Hydro Energy Limited and JSW Energy (Kutehr) Limited, have filed writ petitions before the Hon’ble High Court of Himachal Pradesh. These petitions challenge the constitutional validity and legal sustainability of the Himachal Pradesh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2025, the Himachal Pradesh Land Revenue (Special Assessment) Amendment Rules, 2025, and subsequent demand notices issued by the State of Himachal Pradesh. The legislation in question seeks to impose a land revenue levy calculated as a percentage of the "Average Market Value" of hydroelectric projects. JSW Energy Limited has been advised that this levy is constitutionally infirm on multiple grounds, considering it a charge on electricity generation infrastructure rather than land. Similar petitions have been filed by other companies with hydro power plants in Himachal Pradesh.

announcements.subject: Midwest Ltd - 544587 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Midwest Limited selected as Lead Consortium Partner by Kerala Minerals and Metals Ltd (KMML) for Strategic Rare Earth Elements Pilot Project.
announcements.ai_summary: Midwest Limited has been selected as the Lead Consortium Partner by Kerala Minerals and Metals Ltd. (KMML), a Government of Kerala undertaking, for a strategic rare earth elements pilot project. This collaboration aims to develop technology and establish a pilot plant for processing monazite-rich tailings and residue to produce rare earth mixed compounds and subsequently separate individual Rare Earth Elements (REEs). The scope of work includes end-to-end execution from mineral processing to high-purity monazite concentrate (≥96%) and extraction of rare earth mixed compounds (≥99%). A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) will be signed with KMML after KMML obtains necessary statutory and administrative approvals from the Government of India and the Government of Kerala. This project signifies a significant step towards strengthening India's domestic capabilities in the critical rare earth value chain and is one of the first collaborations between the state and private sector in this domain.

announcements.ai_summary: Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd has issued a press release regarding a new study on its Poly Lactic Acid (PLA) vertical. The study, conducted by a premier government institution under the Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, confirms that PLA microplastics safely break down in Indian soil conditions, unlike conventional plastics. Over a 180-day period, PLA microplastics reduced from 287 particles/kg to just 18 particles/kg, indicating near-complete degradation. This suggests PLA offers a sustainable alternative to traditional plastics that persist for decades. The press release will also be available on the company's website, www.chini.com.

announcements.subject: Cochin Shipyard Ltd - 540678 - Setting Up Of Ship Repair Facility At Vadinar, Gujarat
announcements.detail: Please refer the attachment.
announcements.ai_summary: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) will jointly develop a state-of-the-art Ship Repair Facility at Vadinar, Gujarat, with Deendayal Port Authority (DPA). The total investment for this project is Rs.1,570 crore, with DPA contributing Rs.650 crore for civil infrastructure and CSL investing Rs.920 crore for ship repair infrastructure, including two large floating docks. This facility will address a critical gap in India's ship repair capabilities, enabling the repair of vessels up to 300 meters in length, which are currently too large for domestic shipyards. The project is planned as a brownfield facility with a 650-meter jetty and associated marine infrastructure, and both DPA and CSL aim for completion within 36 months. The development is expected to reduce dependence on foreign shipyards, curb foreign exchange outflow, and create employment opportunities.

announcements.subject: Goldiam International Ltd - 526729 - Press Release- Launch Of India'S First Digital 3D Ring Builder By Goldiam International Limited

This innovative platform, available on Origem's digital storefront and in-stores, enables customers to select from various ring styles, center stone shapes and sizes, metal types (10/14K white, yellow, or rose gold), and engraving options. Every customization is instantly rendered on a photorealistic 3D model that can be rotated and zoomed. The platform is integrated with Goldiam's ORIGEM brand, providing transparent access to certified, IGI-graded lab-grown diamond jewelry at competitive price points.

announcements.subject: Lords Mark Industries Ltd - 501261 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Launch Of AI-Powered Hemodialysis Centre
announcements.detail: Launch of AI powered hemodialysis intimation under reg 30
announcements.ai_summary: Lords Mark Industries Limited has announced the launch of the world's first cost-optimised AI-powered hemodialysis centre at Shakti Hospital, Ahmedabad, under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This centre utilizes the indigenously developed Lord’s Renal Renalyx Machine, an AI-based hemodialysis system. Key features include personalized dialysis protocols, Kt/V tracking, precise fluid management, and endotoxin filtration for enhanced patient safety, with capabilities for remote supervision and centralized data access. The company plans to establish 50 dialysis centres by March 2027 and also engage in domestic sales and export of the Renalyx Machine. Lords Mark Industries is pursuing US FDA approval to support its global expansion strategy. The Managing Director, Mr. Sachidanand Upadhyay, stated that the Renalyx Machine aims to provide scalable, high-quality treatment and position India as a leader in AI-based medical devices.

announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Kings Infra Ventures Limited hosted senior representatives from LX International Corp. at its Kochi office on April 26, 2025, to discuss a potential long-term association and expansion of trade volumes. LX International, a Republic of Korea-based global trading and investment company, operates across commodities, logistics, and industrial materials with over 50 business bases worldwide. The AAP-Wh has progressed from concept to combat-ready status in under three years. This development is a testament to the Development Cum Production Partner (DCPP) model, integrating DRDO's expertise with industry partners' scale. Bharat Forge and its subsidiary, Kalyani Strategic Systems Limited (KSSL), are committed to this partnership to build new strategic capabilities for India.

announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Premier Energies Limited, a leading integrated solar manufacturer, has launched India's first All-Black G12R DCR Solar Module, the NeoBlack Series, at RenewX Chennai on April 27, 2026. This module ranges from 600 Wp to 630 Wp and utilizes next-generation TOPCon cell technology with a uniform black aesthetic, aiming to improve rooftop solar adoption for residential and commercial segments. The NeoBlack Series offers high performance, superior design, and enhanced durability, backed by a 12-year product warranty and a 30-year power output warranty. Srini Adapa, Chief Growth Officer, highlighted the product's seamless integration with modern homes, while Chandra Mauli Kumar, Chief Production Officer, emphasized the precision manufacturing and advanced capabilities ensuring consistency and efficiency.

announcements.ai_summary: On April 25, 2026, Kiran Vyapar Limited announced the acquisition of equity shares of Maharaja Shree Umaid Mills Limited (MSUM) pursuant to a Scheme of Amalgamation. The Scheme of Amalgamation, approved by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) on March 16, 2026, became effective on April 25, 2026. As a result, Placid Limited, the transferor company, has been dissolved. Kiran Vyapar Limited will receive 8,21,55,375 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- each of MSUM in lieu of its shareholding in Placid Limited. Post-amalgamation, Kiran Vyapar Limited will hold 8,97,29,943 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each in MSUM, representing approximately 27.73% of the post-amalgamation paid-up equity share capital, classifying MSUM as an associate of the company.

announcements.ai_summary: One 97 Communications Ltd has announced the voluntary winding up of its associate company, Paytm Payments Bank Limited (PPBL).
