announcements.subject: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd - 500312 - Disclosure Of Event Or Information Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure of event or information under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd (ONGC) has received a "Stop Production Order" dated April 23, 2026, from the Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board (APPCB) regarding Well Mori #05 in the Mori Field. The order was received on April 24, 2026. This action follows a well blowout and fire incident on January 5, 2026, and a show cause notice issued to both ONGC and its Production Enhancement Contract (PEC) Operator, M/s Deep Exploration Services Private Limited (M/s DESPL), for environmental violations, including operating without necessary consents and causing air pollution. The APPCB has directed ONGC to immediately stop all further operations at Well Mori-5. ONGC intends to review the order in detail and respond accordingly.

announcements.subject: Jayaswal Neco Industries Ltd - 522285 - Announcement Under Regulation 30_Proposed Equity Investment In Solar Power Generation SPV(S) Under Group Captive Multiple Consumers Structure
announcements.detail: Announcement under regulation 30_Proposed equity investment in solar power generation SPV(s) under group captive multiple consumers structure.
announcements.ai_summary: Jayaswal Neco Industries Ltd has executed a non-binding term sheet with a Waaree Group entity for an equity investment of approximately Rs. 40.97 Crores. This investment will be made in one or more tranches into a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) for setting up solar power projects. The objective is to procure solar energy on a captive basis for the Company's Steel Plant Division in Raipur and Chhotedongar Iron Ore Mines in Chhattisgarh, aiming to augment green power usage and mitigate grid power tariff volatility. The proposed solar power generation capacity is 104 MWAC / 145.60 MWp, with an anticipated annual consumption of approximately 26.55 Crore Units. This investment is below the disclosure threshold under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd - 500104 - Update On HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited
announcements.detail: This is further to our earlier communication dated April 21, 2026 regarding the unfortunate fire incident that occurred on April 20, 2026 in the Crude Distillation Unit (CDU) of HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL), a Joint Venture Company of Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd (HPCL) has provided an update on its joint venture, HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL), following a fire incident on April 20, 2026. The fire was localized to the Crude Distillation Unit (CDU), affecting 6 heat exchangers and their supporting equipment. Investigations suggest a leakage from a pressure gauge tapping point as the suspected cause. Restoration work is underway and is expected to be completed in 3-4 weeks, with the CDU restart anticipated in the second fortnight of May 2026. Trial production of main products is expected to commence within May 2026.

announcements.ai_summary: Bluegod Entertainment Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on Friday, April 24, 2026, approved the alteration of the company's Object Clause ("Main Objects") to incorporate new sub-clauses aimed at supporting expansion plans. This alteration is subject to shareholder approval through a postal ballot process. The proposed amendments include the ability to carry on business as merchants, manufacturers, wholesalers, traders, commission agents, importers, exporters, buyers, sellers, retailers, suppliers, indenters, packers, movers, preservers, stockists, agents, sub-agents, distributors, and consignors of all kinds of sports equipment, gear, apparel, accessories, and related products for indoor and outdoor games and sports. It also includes the ability to deal and trade in all types of goods, produce, and merchandise, and to conceptualize, establish, and operate inclusive, innovation-driven sports and wellness clubs across India.

announcements.subject: Asian Energy Services Ltd - 530355 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Asian Energy Services Ltd has informed the stock exchanges that India Ratings & Research (‘Ind-Ra’) has withdrawn the rating assigned to the company’s bank loan facilities. This withdrawal was made at the request of the company and based on a no-objection certificate from the lenders, in accordance with Ind-Ra’s Policy on Withdrawal of Ratings. The rating for the bank loan facilities, amounting to INR 1,250 million, was withdrawn after being maintained at ‘IND BBB/Rating Watch with Developing Implications’ and ‘IND A3+/Rating Watch with Developing Implications’. The company had previously intimated the stock exchanges on November 04, 2025, regarding ratings assigned by CRISIL Ratings Limited, which remain in force. The withdrawal rating has been published and is accessible via a provided link.

announcements.subject: String Metaverse Ltd - 534535 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: press release
announcements.ai_summary: String Metaverse Limited (formerly Bio Green Papers Limited) has announced the successful completion of its Offer for Sale (OFS), which saw strong participation from both non-retail and retail investors. The OFS for non-retail investors was subscribed to approximately 149% on April 21, 2026, while retail investors subscribed approximately 495% on April 22, 2026. This successful OFS is expected to bring the company into compliance with Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) requirements. In recognition of investor support, the Board of Directors will meet on April 29, 2026, to consider a bonus issue for public shareholders, with promoters potentially foregoing their entitlement.

announcements.subject: Tata Elxsi Ltd - 500408 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed Press Release dated April 24, 2026, titled "JSW Motors and Tata Elxsi Form Strategic Partnership to Power Next-generation Connected & Software-Defined Mobility in India".
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Motors and Tata Elxsi have formed a strategic partnership to establish the JNEXT – JSW NextGen Technology Center in Pune, aimed at developing next-generation software-defined, AI-powered mobility solutions. This alliance focuses on connected and electrified vehicles, including New Energy Vehicles (NEVs) such as electric vehicles (EVs), hybrids, and plug-in hybrids. Tata Elxsi will lead the implementation of the Connected Vehicle Platform and a unified customer experience app for JSW Motors' upcoming vehicle programs, managing the platform from conceptualization to aftersales support. The partnership will leverage capabilities in user experience design, cloud platforms, over-the-air (OTA) frameworks, digital twins, and intelligent solutions like location-based services, cybersecurity, AI/ML analytics, and immersive technologies. This collaboration supports JSW Motors' vision of building a technology-led, new-energy mobility ecosystem in India.

announcements.subject: AK Capital Services Ltd - 530499 - Intimation Regarding Trading And Admission To Dealings Of The Company'S Equity Shares On The National Stock Exchange Of India Limited

announcements.ai_summary: A. K. This admission to dealings on NSE was communicated via a circular from the National Stock Exchange of India dated April 17, 2026.

announcements.subject: Mangal Credit and Fincorp Ltd - 505850 - Intimation Of Registration Of The Company To Act As Corporate Agent (Composite) With IRDAI Under IRDAI (Registration Of Corporate Agents) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith disclosure under Regulation 30 read with Regulation 51 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

This license, effective from April 24, 2026, allows the company to procure or solicit insurance business for a period of three years, until April 23, 2029. This regulatory approval is significant as it enables the company to offer insurance products to its customers. The company has complied with SEBI Listing Regulations by disclosing this development.

announcements.subject: Twamev Construction And Infrastructure Ltd - 532738 - Addendum To The Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On 26Th February, 2026
announcements.detail: Addendum to the outcome of the board meeting held on 26th February, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Ltd has issued an addendum to the outcome of its Board Meeting held on February 26, 2026. This addendum clarifies that Ms. Suparna Chakrabortti (DIN: 07090308), who was appointed as an Independent Director, has also been inducted as a member of the Audit Committee, Chairperson of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, and a member of the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee. announcements.subject: Prism Johnson Ltd - 500338 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: The Company informed about the conclusion of  Arbitration proceeding between the Company and M/s Doosan Power Systems India Pvt Ltd in a commercial dispute.
announcements.ai_summary: Prism Johnson Ltd has announced the conclusion of arbitration proceedings with M/s Doosan Power Systems India Pvt Ltd concerning a commercial dispute. An oral Arbitral Award was pronounced on April 16, 2026, in New Delhi, favoring Prism Johnson Ltd. As per the award, M/s Doosan Power Systems India Pvt Ltd is obligated to pay the company an amount of Rs. 8,86,52,116/- by May 27, 2026, to settle all claims, counterclaims, interest, and costs. The company had previously written off this claim amount in earlier years. The written and signed Arbitral Award was received by Prism Johnson Ltd on April 23, 2026.

announcements.subject: DHP India Ltd - 531306 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Todays Board Meeting Dated 24/04/2026 And Todays All Four Committees Meetings Of Annual Meet Of Statutory Requirement Related To Year Ended 31/03/2026
announcements.detail: Outcome of Todays Board Meeting dated 24/04/2026 and Todays all Four Committees Meetings of Annual Meet of Statutory requirement related to Year ended 31/03/2026
announcements.ai_summary: DHP India Ltd held its Board of Directors meeting on April 24, 2026, following meetings of its four committees: Stakeholders Committee, Nomination & Remuneration Committee, Corporate & Social Responsibility (CSR) Committee, and Audit Committee. The Nomination & Remuneration Committee recommended an increase in employee remuneration for FY2026-27, which was approved by the Board. The Board also approved the commencement of Statutory Audit, Tax Audit, Cost Audit, and Secretarial Audit for FY2025-26. These outcomes are related to the annual general affairs for the year ended March 31, 2026.

announcements.subject: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Ltd-$ - 506767 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: The company, Alkyl Amines Chemicals Ltd, has issued an update regarding its production of Ammonia-based products. This announcement follows a previous disclosure on March 16, 2026, concerning disruptions caused by the geopolitical conflict in the Middle East, which had impacted logistics and the global supply chain for crude oil and petrochemicals. While the overall ammonia supply situation remains uncertain and dynamic, it has improved sufficiently to allow for a gradual restart of production for ammonia-based products. This information is provided for the record and is in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Patel Retail Ltd - 544487 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Patel Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Press Release dated Friday, April 24,2026 with respect to opening of Patel''s R MART Store No. 51.
announcements.ai_summary: Patel Retail Limited has announced the opening of its 51st Patel’s R Mart store, located at Ganesh Nagar, Rasayani, Khalapur, Raigad. This opening, effective April 24, 2026, strengthens the company's presence in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) and aims to increase accessibility to quality groceries and daily essentials in suburban and emerging urban markets. The company highlights its integrated sourcing, packaging, processing, and logistics capabilities, which enable efficient scaling of operations and ensure product quality, affordability, and customer convenience. This expansion aligns with Patel Retail Limited's cluster-based growth strategy and its commitment to expanding organized retail accessibility in high-potential residential and semi-urban clusters.

announcements.subject: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd - 524715 - Incorporation Of A Subsidiary Company
announcements.detail: Incorporation of a Subsidiary Company
announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has announced the incorporation of a new subsidiary company, Sun Pharma America, Inc., in the United States of America on April 23, 2026. The initial capital consideration for this newly set-up company was in cash. announcements.subject: Apcotex Industries Ltd - 523694 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition

The company has requested that this revised intimation supersede any previous submissions regarding this matter. No further approvals are indicated as pending for this transaction.

announcements.subject: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd - 533271 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order

announcements.subject: Greaves Cotton Ltd - 501455 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail:
Please find enclosed herewith Press Release issued by Greaves Electric Mobility Limited, subsidiary of the Company , with the heading, "Greaves Electric Mobility strengthens Ampere Magnus portfolio with the New Magnus Neo"

Kindly take the same on record.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Greaves Electric Mobility Limited, a subsidiary of Greaves Cotton Ltd, has launched the all-new Magnus Neo under its Ampere electric two-wheeler brand. This new variant is designed to offer a lighter, smoother, and more comfortable riding experience, with a focus on seat ergonomics and rider comfort for everyday use. The vehicle features a lightweight construction for easier maneuverability and a 10-inch rear tire for improved control in city conditions. The new Magnus Neo aims to make electric mobility more practical and accessible for a wider range of riders by addressing practical riding needs and enhancing rideability through ergonomic design and a new wheel and motor configuration for smoother acceleration and stability.

announcements.subject: Tamboli Industries Ltd - 533170 - Admission & Trading Permission On National Stock Exchange (NSE). Regulation 30 Of LODR, 2015.

This approval is effective from April 20, 2026, as per NSE's Listing Department Circular Ref. No. NSE/CML/73797 dated April 17, 2026. The company's securities will now be permitted to trade on the NSE portal. The trading symbol for Tamboli Industries Ltd on the NSE will be 'TAMBOLIIN'. This development is in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Brightcom Group Ltd - 532368 - OMS Operational Updates
announcements.detail: OMS Operational Updates
announcements.ai_summary: Brightcom Group Ltd has announced a significant operational milestone achieved by its subsidiary, OMS. OMS has successfully completed a large-scale programmatic infrastructure deployment in partnership with Azerion, a global digital entertainment and media platform. This project involved scaling Azerion's publisher network from approximately 11 domains to over 100+ domains within a six-month period. OMS utilized its proprietary infrastructure, including independently managed data centers and AI-driven systems, to handle high-volume traffic expansion without performance degradation. The deployment enabled high-throughput query handling, seamless onboarding of multiple domains, and stable performance. By operating its own infrastructure, OMS optimized cost structures and improved operational margins. The company also deployed AI-powered monitoring systems for continuous performance tracking and optimization. This achievement reinforces Brightcom Group's focus on infrastructure-led competitive advantages and AI-driven programmatic capabilities.

announcements.subject: Reliance Industries Ltd - 500325 - Media Release - "TIME To Bring 'TIME100 Next' To India For The First Time In Partnership With Reliance.'
announcements.detail: Please find attached a media release by the Company, titled "TIME to bring ''TIME100 Next'' to India for the First Time in Partnership with Reliance."
announcements.ai_summary: Reliance Industries Ltd has entered into a partnership with TIME to launch "TIME100 Next India" for the first time. This initiative will recognize 100 emerging Indian leaders across various sectors, including arts, science, business, sports, and advocacy. The list will be curated by TIME editors and will be published online, culminating in a gala event at the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre in Mumbai in December 2026. This collaboration signifies Reliance's commitment to empowering the next generation of talent and leadership in India, aligning with their vision of bringing global best practices to India and showcasing Indian talent to the world.

announcements.subject: JTL Industries Ltd - 534600 - Receipt Of Trading Approval By Subsidiary Company_JTL Defence Limited

announcements.ai_summary: JTL Industries Ltd has announced that its subsidiary, JTL Defence Limited (formerly RCI Industries & Technologies Limited), has received trading approval from BSE Limited. The approval is for 1,05,26,315 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each. These shares will be available for trading on the exchange starting from Monday, April 27, 2026. The trading approval covers new equity shares issued on account of capital reduction (5,26,315 shares) and on a preferential basis (1,00,00,000 shares). JTL Defence Limited will be listed and admitted to dealings on the BSE under the XT Group and will continue to trade in the Trade-to-Trade segment.

announcements.subject: Aayush Wellness Ltd - 539528 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Aayush Wellness Limited launches "Liver Detox Tablets" to capture growing demand in Preventive Wellness and Lifestyle Disease Management.
announcements.ai_summary: Aayush Wellness Limited has launched "Liver Detox Tablets," a herbal formulation aimed at supporting liver health and addressing the growing prevalence of lifestyle-related liver disorders. This launch represents a strategic expansion of the company's preventive healthcare portfolio and aligns with its focus on condition-led wellness categories. The new product is designed to naturally detoxify, protect, and regenerate liver cells, catering to increasing health awareness and demand for daily preventive solutions. The company believes this move positions it to capitalize on the large and growing wellness opportunity driven by lifestyle disorders and consumer preference for daily health supplements.

announcements.subject: Indian Oil Corporation Ltd - 530965 - Disclosure Under Chapter XIV - Centralized Database For Corporate Bonds/ Debentures Of SEBI Operational Circular Dated August 10, 2021 (Updated As On April 13, 2022)
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Chapter XIV- Centralized Database for Corporate Bonds/Debentures of SEBI Operational Circular dated August 10, 2021 (Updated as on April 13, 2022) for the year ended March 31, 2026.

announcements.subject: Hindustan Construction Company Ltd - 500185 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: We are enclosing a copy of the Press Release being issued by the Company today in this regard. We request you to take the same on record.
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Construction Company Ltd (HCC) has won a contract valued at approximately ₹2,917 crore from the City and Industrial Development Corporation of Maharashtra Limited (CIDCO). The contract is for the construction of a 22.21 km raw water tunnel and a 250 MLD water treatment plant in Raigad. This project has been awarded to the LCESPL-HCC Joint Venture, with HCC responsible for executing works estimated at approximately ₹1,100 crore. The scope includes tunnel construction using Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) technology and the design, build, supply, erection, testing, and commissioning of the water treatment plant, along with 15 years of operation and maintenance under a Design, Build and Operate (DBO) model. This project is crucial for CIDCO's strategy to enhance water supply infrastructure for Navi Mumbai and surrounding areas.

announcements.subject: Atul Auto Ltd-$ - 531795 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Atul Auto and Exponent Signed Contract/ MOU for the manufacture and supply of 15000 electric three-wheelers in a period of 3 years from state approval to vehicles.
announcements.ai_summary: Atul Auto Ltd has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Exponent Energy Private Limited for the manufacturing and supply of 15,000 electric three-wheelers. Under this agreement, Atul Auto will act as the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and will integrate Exponent's battery system and powertrain into the vehicles. The collaboration covers manufacturing, supply, sales, servicing, and customer support. The volume commitment of 15,000 electric three-wheelers is for a period of three years, extendable by an additional six months, from the date of state transport authority approvals. This MOU is expected to accelerate Atul Auto's presence in the electric vehicle segment.

announcements.subject: Edelweiss Financial Services Ltd - 532922 - Disclosure Under The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 regarding IPO of EAAA India Alternatives Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Edelweiss Financial Services Ltd has received an observation letter from the Securities & Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on April 23, 2026, for the proposed Initial Public Offering (IPO) of its wholly-owned subsidiary, EAAA India Alternatives Limited. The IPO will include an Offer for Sale (OFS) by Edelweiss Securities & Investments Private Limited (ESIPL), not exceeding ₹15,000 million. The receipt of SEBI's observations allows EAAA India Alternatives Limited to proceed with the IPO within the next 12 months, subject to market conditions, necessary approvals, and other regulatory compliances. This disclosure is made in continuation of the company's letter dated January 20, 2026.

announcements.subject: Hari Govind International Ltd - 531971 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change of Company Name
announcements.detail: Submission of new Certificate of Incorporation pursuant to the Name change of the Company from "Hari Govind International Limited" to "Popees Baby Care India Limited".
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Ltd has announced a significant change in its corporate identity. The Ministry of Corporate Affairs has officially approved the company's name change from "Hari Govind International Limited" to "Popees Baby Care India Limited". This change is effective from April 22, 2026, as evidenced by the fresh Certificate of Incorporation received on the same date. The company is now operating under its new name, Popees Baby Care India Limited. As per regulations, the company must display its old name, Hari Govind International Limited, alongside its new name for a period of two years. Investors should note this name change for all future correspondence and record-keeping.

announcements.subject: Sheela Foam Ltd - 540203 - Sale Of Fraction Share In Open Market In Pursuant Of Merger
announcements.detail: Sale of 575 fraction shares in open market in pursuant of merger of KEL into SFL
announcements.ai_summary: Sheela Foam Ltd announced on April 23, 2026, the sale of 575 fractional shares in the open market. This sale is a consequence of the composite scheme of arrangement involving the amalgamation of Kurlon Enterprise Limited (KEL) into Sheela Foam Limited (SFL). The fractional entitlements arising from the share exchange ratio have been consolidated and allotted to a Trust appointed by the Board. This Trust sold the consolidated shares on April 22, 2026. The net proceeds from this sale, after deducting charges and taxes, will be distributed to the eligible shareholders of Kurlon Enterprise Limited based on their respective fractional entitlements.

announcements.company: Anzen India Energy Yield Plus Trust
announcements.subject: Anzen India Energy Yield Plus Trust - 543655 - Reg 21: Disclosure of valuation report received by the manager
announcements.detail: Anzen India Energy Yield Plus Trust has informed the Exchange regarding Full Valuation report subsequent to material development FY ended 2025-26
announcements.ai_summary: On April 23, 2026, EAAA Real Assets Managers Limited, the Investment Manager for Anzen India Energy Yield Plus Trust, announced that its Board of Directors has taken on record the Valuation Report issued by Mr. Jayesh Kumar Shah. This report is in connection with the proposed acquisition of SEPL Energy Private Limited. The valuation report was received on April 15, 2026, and is enclosed with the announcement. This submission is in accordance with Regulation 21(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Infrastructure Investment Trusts) Regulations, 2014.

announcements.subject: Lux Industries Ltd - 539542 - Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On April 23, 2026
announcements.detail: Outcome of the Board Meeting held on April 23, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: On April 23, 2026, the Board of Directors of Lux Industries Ltd held a meeting where it was informed that the members of the promoter and promoter group from the Todi Family have entered into a Family Settlement Agreement (FSA). The company is not a party to this FSA. The Board has accorded its in-principle approval for a scheme of demerger, subject to regulatory and stakeholder approvals. This demerger contemplates separating the company's businesses into three verticals. Verticals A and C will be demerged into two new listed companies, led by the AKT Family and KKT Family, respectively. Vertical B will remain with Lux Industries Ltd, managed by the PKT Family. Following this, the AKT and KKT families will cease to hold management or control rights in Lux Industries Ltd, while the PKT family will continue to manage and control the company.

announcements.subject: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd - 544149 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: On April 23, 2026, Advait Krystal Solar Energy SPV Private Limited, an associate company of Krystal Integrated Services Ltd, entered into a Power Purchase Agreement with the Directorate of Medical Education & Research, Mumbai, and the Directorate of Ayush (M.S) Medical Education & Drug Department, Mumbai. This agreement is for the supply of power. The details of the agreement, including the counterparties and the date of execution, have been disclosed as per SEBI Listing Regulations. This development is for the information and records of the exchange.

announcements.subject: Gujarat Gas Ltd - 539336 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release - titled Gujarat Gas Limited Supports Revival of Morbi Ceramic Industry with Assured Gas Supply and Pricing.
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Gas Limited (GGL) has issued a press release on April 23, 2026, reaffirming its commitment to supporting the revival of the Morbi ceramic industry. Amidst recent geopolitical disruptions that led to increased raw material costs and restrictions on industrial propane usage, GGL ensured uninterrupted natural gas supply and price stability. The company proactively sourced gas from non-Middle East markets to maintain supply as per government directives. GGL's efforts, including engaging with the Morbi Ceramic Association, have facilitated the gradual resumption of industrial activity in Morbi. Gas consumption has increased significantly from approximately 0.36 mmscmd serving 83 units on March 31, 2026, to approximately 2.70 mmscmd serving 290 units on April 22, 2026.

announcements.subject: Havells India Ltd - 517354 - Intimation Of Grant And Vesting
announcements.detail: Intimation of Grant and Vesting of Shares under employees stock purchase schemes of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: On April 23, 2026, Havells India Limited announced the vesting of shares to eligible employees under its employee stock purchase plans for the financial year 2025-26. This action was taken based on the Nomination and Remuneration Committee Meeting held on April 21, 2026. Under the Havells Employees Long Term Incentive Plan 2014, 1,14,191 shares of Re. 1/- each were vested. Additionally, 1,50,000 shares of Re. 1/- each were vested under the Havells Employees Stock Purchase Scheme 2015, and 40,619 shares of Re. 1/- each were vested under the Havells Employees Stock Purchase Scheme 2016. The exercise period for these vested shares is 30 days from the date of vesting.

announcements.subject: Birla Corporation Ltd - 500335 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Commencement Of Coal Mining Operations - Corrigendum
announcements.detail: In continuation of our earlier intimation of even date, please find enclosed the corrigendum issued by the Company in the above subject matter.
announcements.ai_summary: Birla Corporation Limited has issued a corrigendum on April 23, 2026, regarding its earlier intimation about the commencement of coal mining operations. The company clarified that the figure of 9.44 Million Tonnes, previously stated as the Annual Production Capacity of the Bikram Coal Mine at Burhar, Shahdol, Madhya Pradesh, actually represents the Extractable Reserves of the mine. The Peak Rated Capacity of the mine is 0.36 Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA). This correction is to ensure accurate information is available to stakeholders and has been uploaded to the company's website.

announcements.subject: Bharat Wire Ropes Ltd - 539799 - Intimation Of Acquisition Of Shares By Shareholder(S)
announcements.detail: Intimation of acquisition of shares by shareholder(s)

announcements.subject: Digispice Technologies Ltd-$ - 517214 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Order dated April 22, 2026 passed by Hon''ble NCLT for convening meeting of equity shareholders of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: DigiSpice Technologies Limited has received an order dated April 22, 2026, from the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Principal Bench, New Delhi. The order directs DigiSpice Technologies Limited to convene a meeting of its equity shareholders, through Video Conferencing/Other Audio Visual Means, as part of the Scheme of Amalgamation by way of merger. This merger involves DigiSpice Technologies Limited, Spice Money Limited, E-Arth Travel Solutions Private Limited, and Vikasni Fintech Private Limited. The Hon’ble Court has dismissed the claim filed by Comex with no order as to costs. Comex had filed a claim for £543,501.07 for breach of contract on June 3, 2024, allegedly in retaliation to Clearcomm's £195,000.00 adjudication award. The dismissal follows an out-of-court settlement for an amount of £25,000 (excluding taxes). This settlement has no significant financial impact on STL Networks Ltd. The company had previously attempted to strike out Comex's claim, and an agreement was reached to sample 110 claims. Comex had faced delays in providing required documentation and evidence for these samples.

announcements.subject: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd - 500040 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.ai_summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited (ABREL) announced strong financial performance for FY2026 through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Birla Estates Private Limited. The company achieved a booking value of ₹8,136 crores, driven by robust demand in key markets such as NCR, Bengaluru, and MMR. Collections saw a significant increase of 23.5% year-on-year, indicating strong customer engagement and sales momentum. Birla Estates launched 8 new projects spread across four regions during FY2026, catering to the growing demand for integrated community ecosystems and premium residential offerings. The company attributes its success to a focus on design differentiation, execution excellence, and the assurance of a trusted legacy brand, supported by stable macroeconomic fundamentals and sustained end-user demand in India's residential real estate sector.

announcements.subject: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd - 507526 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release (Revised)
announcements.detail: Submission of revised press release regarding approval of Resolution Plan of SDF Industries Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd (AABL) has received approval from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Kochi Bench, for its resolution plan to acquire SDF Industries Ltd. This acquisition, costing ₹30.85 crore, will make SDF Industries Ltd. a wholly owned subsidiary of AABL. The approved plan includes SDF Industries Ltd. having an IMFL bottling capacity of approximately 3.60 lakh cases per month and an ENA distillery capacity of 75 lakh liters per annum. The strategically located facility in Kerala spans around 10 acres and is well-connected to major airports, facilitating distribution. AABL entered the Kerala market in 2018, and this acquisition is expected to strengthen its position in the region. The NCLT order was dated April 16, 2026, and the company submitted a revised press release on April 23, 2026, to correct a typographical error regarding the bottling capacity.

announcements.ai_summary: Dynamic Cables Ltd has entered into a Manufacturing Agreement with TS Conductor Corp, a company based in the United States of America, on April 23, 2026. This agreement is for manufacturing operations within India. TS Conductor Corp manufactures advanced power transmission lines using patented Aluminum Encapsulated Carbon Core (AECC) technology, which can increase grid capacity and reduce line loss. Dynamic Cables Limited will be granted a limited, non-transferable license to use TS Designs and Intellectual Property at its facility for manufacturing the approved HTLS conductor. The agreement does not involve a share exchange ratio.

announcements.subject: Cipla Ltd - 500087 - Cipla Receives U.S. FDA Approval For First AB Rated Generic Of Ventolin® HFA
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed intimation
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Cipla Limited announced on April 23, 2026, that its wholly owned subsidiary, Cipla USA Inc., has received final approval from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA). This approval is for Albuterol Sulfate Inhalation Aerosol, 90 mcg per actuation, which is the first AB-rated generic therapeutic equivalent of Ventolin® HFA, marketed by GlaxoSmithKline. The product is indicated for the treatment or prevention of bronchospasm in adult and pediatric patients aged four years and older with reversible obstructive airway disease, as well as for preventing exercise-induced bronchospasm. Cipla USA Inc. expects to launch this product in the United States in the first half of FY 2026-27.

announcements.subject: K.P. Energy Ltd - 539686 - Press Release - KP Energy Limited Receives Inter-State Electricity Trading Licence From CERC, Expanding Access To Nationwide Power Markets

Energy Limited has been granted an Inter-State Electricity Trading Licence (Category V) by the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) as announced on April 23, 2026. This license allows the company to trade electricity across state boundaries and participate in nationwide power markets, thereby expanding its market reach and trading capabilities. This development is a significant milestone for K.P. Energy Limited, enhancing its flexibility in power sales, enabling better market-linked realizations, and supporting its strategy of building an integrated renewable energy platform. The company will now be able to access demand centers across multiple states, optimize power sales based on market conditions, engage with a broader customer base, and participate in exchange-led and short-term markets.

announcements.subject: Dynamatic Technologies Ltd-$ - 505242 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: The company, Dynamatic Technologies Limited, through its division Dynauton Systems, has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Aerodata AG, a German aviation solutions provider. This MoU establishes a strategic partnership to develop a new unmanned, airborne surveillance and reconnaissance solution specifically for the Indian region. The collaboration will focus on further developing Aerodata's AeroForce® X platform, a Male UAS with high payload capacity and up to 40 hours of endurance, suitable for ISR missions. Dynauton Systems will contribute its engineering and manufacturing expertise in unmanned systems, while Aerodata will bring its experience in integrating complex airborne surveillance systems. This partnership aims to tailor the AeroForce® X platform to meet the requirements of the Indian market for ISR missions, particularly in challenging terrains like the Himalayas and the Indian Ocean Region.

announcements.ai_summary: Escorts Kubota Ltd has issued a press release announcing the expansion of its Digitrac tractor series and the launch of three new tractor models. This expansion broadens the Digitrac range to a comprehensive series of five models, covering the 45–55 HP category, including a 4-Wheel Drive option. This marks the company's fourth major tractor launch since February 2025 across its three brands: Kubota, Farmtrac, and Powertrac. The Digitrac series, part of the Powertrac brand, is designed for advanced agricultural and heavy haulage applications and will be launched pan-India. The new models are the Digitrac PP 46i 4WD, Digitrac PP 43i Plus, and Digitrac PP 41i, all featuring enhanced specifications like bigger engines and a 12 forward and 3 reverse constant mesh gearbox.

announcements.subject: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd - 543895 - Signing Of Term Sheet - Exhibition & Convention Centre At MMLP Indore
announcements.detail: Intimation is enclosed herewith
announcements.ai_summary: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Limited has signed a Term Sheet for a strategic Design & Construction along with Operations & Maintenance (O&M) partnership for an Exhibition & Convention Centre at MMLP Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Under an asset-light model, the entire project CAPEX will be funded by the Developer, with Exhicon Global Development Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, awarded the design and construction, converting project CAPEX into execution revenue. The company will also act as the Operator with zero capital deployment, generating dual revenue streams from execution and annuity operations. The O&M phase includes a 35% revenue share for Years 1-3 and 30% from Year 4 onwards, applicable across various event types and ancillary revenues. This 10-year O&M agreement with a lock-in period provides long-term revenue visibility and a stable, growing revenue stream with built-in escalation. The project is strategically located at MMLP Indore, spanning approximately 4 acres within a 255-acre Multimodal Logistics Park, and is part of a larger commercial ecosystem. This marks Exhicon's 5th multipurpose venue signed in the last 2 years, reinforcing its position as a fast-growing integrated event venue company.

announcements.subject: Bharat Parenterals Ltd - 541096 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Outcome of the U.S. FDA Inspection at Innoxel Lifesciences Private Limited subsidiary Company of Bharat Parenterals Limited
announcements.ai_summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) conducted a surprise inspection at Bharat Parenterals Limited's subsidiary, Innoxel Lifesciences Private Limited, at its finished dosage manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, from April 13, 2026, to April 17, 2026, and on April 20, 2026. The inspection resulted in five observations classified under Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI). Innoxel Lifesciences will submit its response to these observations within the prescribed timelines, and the final Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) is awaited. This facility is crucial for supplying sterile injectable formulations to regulated markets like the United States and the European Union. The company highlighted that this outcome reflects the consistency of its quality and compliance systems, and it remains focused on strengthening its manufacturing and regulatory capabilities.

announcements.subject: Tata Steel Ltd - 500470 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Tata Steel Partners SMS Group to Deploy World-First EASyMelt Decarbonisation Technology
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Steel Limited announced on April 21, 2026, that it has partnered with SMS Group GmbH (part of Paul Wurth, S.A) to deploy the world's first EASyMelt decarbonisation technology. This technology will be implemented in Tata Steel's 'E' Blast Furnace (649 m3) at its Jamshedpur Works, aiming to reduce CO2 emissions by over 50% compared to its baseline operation. This initiative is a significant step towards achieving net-zero emissions. The partnership follows a Memorandum of Understanding signed in June 2023 and a successful front-end loading study. The EASyMelt technology is described as a resource-flexible solution for decarbonising ironmaking.

announcements.subject: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd - 500104 - Intimation To The Stock Exchanges Regarding Fire Incident At HRRL Refinery
announcements.detail: Intimation to the stock exchanges regarding fire incident at HRRL Refinery
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) has informed about a fire incident that occurred on April 20, 2026, at the Crude Distillation Unit (CDU) section of the HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited (HRRL) refinery, a joint venture company. The fire is believed to have been caused by a leakage of hydrocarbons from a valve or flange in the heat exchanger circuit and was localized to the heat exchangers stack. The CDU, Vacuum Distillation Unit (VDU), and other associated units were promptly isolated and are structurally safe. There were no loss of life or injuries. As a precautionary measure, the scheduled dedication of the refinery by the Hon’ble Prime Minister on April 21, 2026, has been postponed, with a new date to be announced later. An investigation is underway to determine the cause and necessary remedial actions, and the financial and operational impact is being assessed but is not expected to be material.

announcements.subject: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd - 533274 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

'Prestige Golden Grove' is a large-scale development spread across approximately 29 acres, comprising around 5,120 units across 10 towers. The total estimated gross development value (GDV) for the project is approximately ₹9,500 crore. The company highlighted the sustained homebuyer demand and the project's strategic location, modern living blend, quality construction, and lifestyle amenities as key drivers for its success.

announcements.subject: Biocon Ltd - 532523 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Biocon Limited announced on April 21, 2026, that Health Canada has granted a Notice of Compliance (NOC) for its biosimilars Bosaya™ (denosumab) and Vevzuo™ (denosumab). Bosaya™ is a biosimilar to Prolia®, approved for treating postmenopausal women with osteoporosis at high risk for fracture, increasing bone mass in men with osteoporosis at high risk for fracture, and increasing bone mass in men with nonmetastatic prostate cancer receiving androgen deprivation therapy. Vevzuo™ is a biosimilar to Xgeva®, approved for treating bone complications associated with cancer. Both products are denosumab injections for subcutaneous use, with Bosaya™ in a 60 mg/mL prefilled syringe and Vevzuo™ in a 120 mg/1.7 mL single-dose vial. This approval signifies Biocon's expanding access to high-quality biosimilars in key global markets and strengthens its portfolio of affordable biologic therapies.

The company has deployed over 15,000 deep freezers across its retail network, a substantial increase from 3,732 units at the beginning of the year to 15,490 units as of March 31, 2026. This initiative aligns with the company's growth outlook and its strategy to capture the increasing demand for its ice cream portfolio.

announcements.subject: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd - 524000 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Intimation w.r.t Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd has announced the launch of its next-generation conversational AI platform for omnichannel customer service, a key step in its AI-first transformation. This unified platform aims to serve as a single customer service interface across all channels, ensuring a seamless and consistent customer experience. The platform is designed to autonomously resolve up to 80% of voice and chat interactions, which is expected to reduce service costs while simultaneously enhancing customer experience. More complex or high-empathy cases will be routed to human agents, allowing them to focus on value-added tasks. The AI platform incorporates an industry-first contextual interface with real-time insights, including customer history, loan risk flags, and sentiment analysis, to facilitate faster resolutions and improve first-contact closure rates. This initiative underscores Poonawalla Fincorp's strategy to leverage AI as a core driver for growth, sharper decision-making, and operational excellence across customer engagement, credit underwriting, risk management, and internal productivity.

announcements.subject: UltraTech Cement Ltd - 532538 - Company Update: Commissioning Of Cement Capacity
announcements.detail: Commissioning of cement capacity
announcements.ai_summary: UltraTech Cement Limited has announced the commissioning of an additional 8.7 million tonnes per annum (mtpa) of cement capacity. This expansion includes a 2.7 mtpa cement grinding unit in Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh, a 3.0 mtpa cement grinding unit in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, and a 3.0 mtpa cement grinding unit in Patratu, Jharkhand. Following this commissioning on April 17, 2026, the company's total domestic grey cement manufacturing capacity has increased to 200.1 mtpa. Including its overseas capacity of 5.4 mtpa, UltraTech Cement's global capacity now stands at 205.5 mtpa. This makes the company the world's largest cement company by sales volume and the largest single-country cement manufacturer globally (excluding China).

announcements.subject: Petronet LNG Ltd - 532522 - Incorporation Of A Section 8, Limited By Guarantee, A Wholly-Owned Subsidiary Company Of Petronet LNG Limited
announcements.detail: Disclosure regarding incorporation of MC2 Foundation, a wholly-owned subsidiary of PLL is enclosed herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: Petronet LNG Limited (PLL) has incorporated a new wholly-owned subsidiary named 'MC2 Foundation' on April 3, 2026, with the Certificate of Incorporation received on April 17, 2026. This Section 8, limited by guarantee company, is established to foster innovation and sustainable entrepreneurship within the energy sector. MC2 Foundation aims to support startups through incubation, mentorship, acceleration, and promotion, aligning with India's national development and energy transition goals. It will focus on innovation infrastructure, industry-led mentorship, research translation, capital mobilization, and ecosystem integration. The first directors of MC2 Foundation include Dr. Neeraj Mittal (Chairman, PLL), Shri Akshay Kumar Singh (MD & CEO, PLL), Shri Sanjay Khanna (CMD, Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited), and Shri Vikas Kaushal (CMD, Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited).

announcements.subject: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd - 500103 - Withdrawal Of BHEL''s  Acceptance To Letter Of Intent From MB Power (Madhya Pradesh) Limited
announcements.detail: Withdrawal of BHEL''s acceptance of Letter of Intent from MB Power (Madhya Pradesh) Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has withdrawn its acceptance of a Letter of Intent (LOI) from MB Power (Madhya Pradesh) Limited. The LOI was for the supply of equipment, specifically Boiler, Turbine, and Generator, for the 1x800 MW Anuppur Thermal Power Project. BHEL had initially accepted this LOI on September 3, 2025. However, the LOI was contingent on the execution of a formal contract within an agreed timeline. Despite multiple discussions and extensions, the contract could not be finalized as per the terms of the LOI. Consequently, BHEL formally informed the customer of the withdrawal of its acceptance to the LOI on April 17, 2026, at 1636 hrs.

announcements.subject:

Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Redemption Of Non-Convertible Debentures (Ncds)

Therefore, the actual redemption on March 30, 2026, was for 25 NCDs, each with a face value of ₹10,00,000, aggregating to ₹2,50,00,000. Following this correction, the reported balance of NCDs post-redemption has been revised from 881 to 979. All other details from the previous intimation remain unchanged.

announcements.subject: PC Jeweller Ltd - 534809 - Update On Debt Reduction
announcements.detail: Update on debt reduction
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: PC Jeweller Limited has provided an update on its debt reduction efforts, reporting a further approximately 10% reduction in its outstanding bank debt as per the Joint Settlement Agreement with its Consortium Lenders. With this latest reduction, the company has now repaid over 90% of its outstanding bank debt since the agreement was executed. This progress reaffirms the company's commitment to achieving a debt-free status in the near future. The company has informed the stock exchanges of this development for their records.

announcements.subject: Jash Engineering Ltd - 544402 - TV Interview

The interview, titled "Know your Company (KYC)," is scheduled for Monday, April 20, 2026, at approximately 11:40 AM. announcements.subject: Mirc Electronics Ltd - 500279 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, April 17, 2026
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith Outcome of the Board Meeting held on Friday, April 17, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Mirc Electronics Limited held a Board Meeting on April 17, 2026, where two significant property-related decisions were approved. The Board discussed and approved the redevelopment and/or sale or transfer of the company's property, "Onida House," in Mumbai, which measures approximately 2,143 square meters. Additionally, the Board discussed and approved a proposal for the monetization of the company's property located in Lote, District Ratnagiri, measuring approximately 20,004 square meters. In both instances, Mr. Kaval Mirchandani, the Managing Director, has been authorized to take appropriate actions, subject to obtaining necessary regulatory approvals. The company has assured that these actions will not involve any manpower cuts, and all permanent employees will be relocated if required during redevelopment. Further disclosures will be made at appropriate times as per SEBI Master Circular dated January 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: TTK Prestige Ltd - 517506 - Award Of CII Greenco Certification
announcements.detail: Award of GreenCo Certification
announcements.ai_summary: TTK Prestige Limited has been awarded the CII GreenCo Certification for all its manufacturing plants, recognizing its commitment to environmental stewardship and sustainable operations. The certification, awarded by the CII–Sohrabji Godrej Green Business Centre, is valid for three years for each plant. The Karjan plant in Gujarat received a SILVER rating (Feb 2024-Feb 2027), Hosur in Tamil Nadu also received SILVER (Jan 2025-Jan 2028), Coimbatore in Tamil Nadu achieved PLATINUM (Nov 2025-Nov 2028), Roorkee in Uttarakhand received GOLD (Feb 2026-Feb 2029), and Khardi in Maharashtra was awarded GOLD (Apr 2026-Apr 2029). The certification follows a comprehensive assessment of parameters like energy efficiency, water conservation, renewable energy usage, and waste management, reinforcing the company's ESG objectives and stakeholder confidence. This disclosure was made voluntarily under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Cipla Ltd - 500087 - USFDA Inspection At Company'S Manufacturing Facility In Goa, India
announcements.detail: USFDA inspection at Company''s manufacturing facility in Goa, India
announcements.ai_summary: Cipla Ltd has informed that the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) conducted a routine current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI) at its manufacturing facility in Verna, Goa, India, from April 6 to April 17, 2026. Upon conclusion of the inspection, the company received two observations in Form 483. Cipla has stated its commitment to working closely with the USFDA and addressing these observations comprehensively within the stipulated time.

announcements.subject: Amrutanjan Health Care Ltd-$ - 590006 - Product Launch
announcements.detail: Product Launch
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Amrutanjan Health Care Limited announced on April 17, 2026, its strategic entry into the razors category with the launch of new brands: Comfy Close & Clean Women’s Razor, Comfy Silky Smooth Women’s Razor, and Smoothe’ Xpress Men’s Razor. These products are developed using advanced Korean technology. The company is also launching Amrutanjan Plastry, a range of medicated antiseptic plasters, including Regular and Wash proof variants. This expansion aims to strengthen the company's personal care portfolio and enter the male grooming segment.

announcements.subject: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd - 500245 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement

The buyback will exclude promoters and members of the promoter group and will be carried out through the "Tender Offer" route. Transaction costs such as brokerage, taxes, and fees are not included in the stated buyback size.

announcements.subject: Aditya Birla Capital Ltd - 540691 -  Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR)
announcements.detail: Aditya Birla Capital Limited has informed the Exchange about its subsidiary, Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited raising Rs. 2,750 crore of growth capital.
announcements.ai_summary: Aditya Birla Capital Limited announced that its material subsidiary, Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL), has raised growth capital. On April 17, 2026, ABHFL's Board approved the allotment of 12,32,52,061 equity shares of face value INR 10 each at a price of INR 223.12 per share to Indriya Limited, an entity of Advent International, L.P., through a preferential issue. Following this allotment, Indriya Limited now holds 14.286% of ABHFL's equity share capital on a fully diluted basis. Consequently, ABHFL is no longer a wholly owned subsidiary, and Aditya Birla Capital Limited now holds 85.505% of ABHFL's paid-up equity share capital on a fully diluted basis. ABHFL's revenue and net worth in FY 2024-25 were INR 2,655.18 crore and INR 3,783.06 crore, respectively, contributing 6.54% and 12.45% to the company's consolidated revenue and net worth.

announcements.subject: Future Consumer Ltd - 533400 - Update On NCLT Hearing - Resurgent India Special Situations Fund Vs Future Consumer Limited
announcements.detail: Update on NCLT hearing- Resurgent India Special Situations Fund Vs Future Consumer Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Future Consumer Limited provided an update on the NCLT hearing concerning the case filed by Resurgent India Special Situations Fund. During the hearing on April 17, 2026, the company's counsel resumed arguments, but the Tribunal directed both parties to file written submissions instead of continuing oral arguments. The Company has been instructed to file its written submissions within 10 days, with the Financial Creditor to respond within one week thereafter. The matter has been adjourned to June 8, 2026, for further hearing, and the company will continue to provide updates.

announcements.subject: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd - 539876 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Intimation of receipt of award
announcements.ai_summary: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd has received an award of order from Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL). The company has been empanelled and has secured a rate contract for the design, manufacture, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of Off-grid DC Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems (SPWPS). This order is part of the MTSKPY/ PM -KUSUM-B scheme and covers various locations across Maharashtra. The total order value is approximately Rs. 71.75 Crores, excluding GST, for 3540 units of Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems. The announcement was made on April 17, 2026.

announcements.subject: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd - 540879 - General Update
announcements.detail: General Update
announcements.ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd (AMS) has been granted a License by the Government of India, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), for the manufacture of ammunitions. This Lifetime License, issued on April 10, 2026, authorizes AMS to manufacture, assemble, integrate, and proof-test high-value strategic weapon systems and munitions. The license covers the manufacturing of Missiles, Anti-Tank Guided Missiles (ATGMs), Torpedoes, Underwater Mines, Aerial Bombs, Rockets, and Loitering Munition. The company will utilize its owned facilities in Hyderabad for commercial manufacture and proof-testing. This grant significantly transforms AMS's revenue architecture and strategic positioning in defence manufacturing.

announcements.subject: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd - 538446 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith the Press Release dated April 17, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd has successfully onboarded STCI Finance Limited and IndusInd Bank as new lenders in March 2026, raising a total of INR 350 million. This includes INR 15 crore from STCI Finance Limited and INR 20 crore from IndusInd Bank. The company, which focuses on impact financing for small and micro entrepreneurs in semi-urban and rural India, has now raised over INR 12 billion in debt funding to date from 32 lenders, including HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank. This additional capital will be used to further extend its reach and provide financial resources to micro-entrepreneurs.

This new facility will enhance Sasken's regional delivery capabilities and strengthen its collaboration with key chipset customers like Qualcomm and their OEMs. The Hyderabad CoE will focus on next-generation engineering for connected devices, 5G platforms, IoT solutions, and embedded systems. As part of this expansion, Sasken has appointed Nirmala Datla as the Site Leader for the Hyderabad CoE and plans to hire over 100 specialized engineering professionals in the coming months. The hiring will focus on high-skill roles in semiconductors, ODM, automotive, and Data Science & Engineering.

announcements.subject: Pune E - Stock Broking Ltd - 544141 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Allotment Of 16,00,000 Convertible Warrants On Preferential Basis.
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith annoucement / Board meeting outccome under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 for allotment of 16,00,000 covertible warrants on preferential basis.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Pune E - Stock Broking Ltd, in a meeting held on April 16, 2026, has approved the allotment of 16,00,000 (Sixteen Lakhs) convertible warrants on a preferential basis. This decision was made upon receiving duly signed application forms and application amounts from the proposed allottees. The board meeting commenced at 11:00 am and concluded at 11:30 am. This allotment is in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd - 543299 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015-Commencement Of Commercial Production Of Phase II Of Colour Coated Sheets Facilitity
announcements.detail: We are enclosing disclosure Under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd, through its step-down subsidiary Shyam Sel and Power Limited (SSPL), has successfully commenced commercial production for Phase II of its Colour Coated Sheets facility at its Jamuria plant. This expansion adds an incremental capacity of 0.15 Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA) for Colour Coated Sheets. The total installed capacity for this facility now stands at 0.40 MTPA, combining the existing 0.25 MTPA from Phase I and the new 0.15 MTPA from Phase II. This development is a significant step in the company's phased capacity expansion strategy, aiming to strengthen SSPL's production capabilities and product offerings in the value-added steel segment. The company anticipates this enhancement will improve its manufacturing competitiveness and market presence in the Colour Coated Sheets sector.

announcements.subject: Gail (India) Ltd - 532155 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed a copy of Press Release on "GAIL to set up 600 MW Solar Power Project in UP"
announcements.ai_summary: GAIL (India) Limited is set to establish a 600 MW solar power project in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, at TUSCO's Solar Park. The company has signed contract agreements with M/s TUSCO Limited for this project, which will also include a 550 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). This initiative is primarily aimed at meeting the captive energy requirements of GAIL's Petrochemical Plant in Pata, Auraiya district, Uttar Pradesh. Additionally, it will cater to the increased demand from electrification of gas-based equipment and CBG plants being set up in the state. This project signifies GAIL's diversification into low-carbon and sustainable energy solutions and its commitment to expanding its business footprint in Uttar Pradesh.

announcements.subject: Birlasoft Ltd - 532400 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release - Birlasoft Recognized as a Leader in ISG''s Manufacturing Industry Services and Solutions Report
announcements.ai_summary: Birlasoft Ltd, a part of the CK Birla Group, has been recognized as a Leader in ISG's Manufacturing Industry Services and Solutions report. The company achieved leadership positions in two key quadrants: Supply Chain & Aftermarket Services and Technology, Transformation & Consulting Services. This recognition highlights Birlasoft's expertise in AI-led digital manufacturing transformation, its strong domain knowledge, ecosystem partnerships, and proprietary solutions like IntelliBridge and IntelliAsset. In the Supply Chain & Aftermarket Services quadrant, Birlasoft was acknowledged for its ability to modernize and optimize operations using technologies such as AI, IoT, and GenAI. For the Technology, Transformation & Consulting Services quadrant, ISG noted Birlasoft's integrated transformation framework and its capabilities in digital engineering and smart factory solutions.

announcements.subject: Vashu Bhagnani Industries Ltd - 532011 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome For The Board Meeing Of The Company Held On 16Th April, 2026
announcements.detail: Outcome of the meeting of the Board of Directors of Vashu Bhagnani Industries Limited (''the Company'') in accordance with Regulation 29 and 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015 (''Listing Regulation'') held on 16th April, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Vashu Bhagnani Industries Limited, in its meeting held on April 16, 2026, noted a clerical error in the books of accounts of a subsidiary. The Board concluded that this error does not have any material impact on the financial statements of the subsidiary or the holding company. The Statutory Auditors confirmed that no revision or restatement of the financial statements of the Indian holding company is necessary. Therefore, the financial statements previously approved and submitted to the stock exchanges are considered final and conclusive, with no requirement for restatement or re-submission.

announcements.subject: Elitecon International Ltd - 539533 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Order of Long-Term Supply of Goods
announcements.ai_summary: Elitecon International Limited has secured a long-term supply contract for cigarettes and other tobacco-allied products, with an aggregate contract value of INR 2.02 Billion. This order is expected to provide steady export visibility and reflects continued demand in international markets, particularly strengthening the company's presence in South African markets. The contract is considered a milestone for entering the African continent and is anticipated to contribute positively to business stability and long-term growth. The order has been received in the normal course of business, supporting efficient utilization of manufacturing capacities and better operational planning.

announcements.subject: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Ltd - 504973 - Intimation On NOC Received From Exchanges
announcements.detail: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited has informed the exchange regarding No objection received under Regulation 31A(8) of SEBI Listing regulations from stock exchanges

The NSE granted its approval via letter no. NSE/LIST/COMP/CHOLAHLDNG/575/2026-2027 dated April 15, 2026, and BSE provided its approval through letter no. LIST/COMP/KR/031/2026-27, also dated April 15, 2026. This follows previous communications regarding the de-classification application, which was initially dated February 11, 2026. The company is required to ensure compliance with subsequent disclosure requirements under Regulation 31A of SEBI Listing Regulations.

announcements.subject: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd - 544309 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Enclosed is the Press Release titled "IKS Health Debuts First-of-Its-Kind Agentic AI Platform that Automates and Personalizes Patient Engagement at the 2026 American Medical Group Association Annual Conference."
announcements.ai_summary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd announced the debut of its innovative Agentic AI platform, MyCareHubTM, at the 2026 American Medical Group Association Annual Conference on April 15, 2026. This platform is designed to automate and personalize patient engagement throughout their healthcare journey, before, during, and after care. MyCareHubTM is integrated with Epic and available in the Epic Connection Hub, utilizing a multi-agent behavioral algorithm for an adaptive and autonomous patient experience. The company highlights that prioritizing patients through this platform leads to improvements in total collections, patient payments, and net payments. IKS Health has already implemented MyCareHubTM at OrthoNY, a leading orthopedic and pain management practice.

announcements.subject: NESCO Ltd - 505355 - Update
announcements.detail: Update
announcements.ai_summary: NESCO Ltd has issued an update following its disclosure on April 13, 2026, enclosing a press release that clarifies the company's position regarding an incident at its venue. The company expresses condolences to the families affected and hopes for the recovery of the injured. NESCO Ltd is fully cooperating with investigating authorities and states that it has always complied with applicable laws, regulatory requirements, and prescribed protocols for events hosted at its venue, including adequate safety and security measures. The company maintains a zero-tolerance policy for illegal substances and emphasizes that attendees are subject to entry conditions and event terms that prohibit such conduct. NESCO Ltd unequivocally states that there has been no lapse or negligence on its part or its employees' in relation to this incident, expressing full confidence that the ongoing investigation will establish this.

announcements.subject: 63 Moons Technologies Ltd - 526881 - Investor Update Received From Our Subsidiary-63SATS Cybertech Limited
announcements.detail: Investor update received from our Subsidiary-63SATS Cybertech Limited
announcements.ai_summary: 63 Moons Technologies Ltd has provided an investor update received from its subsidiary, 63SATS Cybertech Limited. The update highlights significant growth for 63SATS Cybertech Limited in FY 2025-26, with a 24x revenue growth from Rs. 3.6 Cr to Rs. 87 Cr. The subsidiary serves 72 enterprise clients, including large enterprises, and has achieved over 18 lakh CYBX downloads with 2.32 lakh subscribers for its B2C, B2B, and B2G offerings. The Chairman's message emphasizes the importance of constant preparedness in the cyber landscape, comparing it to modern warfare, and positions 63SATS to play a meaningful role in economic stability and institutional resilience. The MD & CEO's message also underscores the company's strong foundation and clear direction for future execution.

announcements.subject: Syschem India Ltd - 531173 - Announcement Under Regulation 30
announcements.detail: Under regulation 30_Material Information _Fraudulent Funds transfer.
announcements.ai_summary: The company, Syschem India Ltd, has reported a fraudulent transfer of funds amounting to Rs. 1,96,00,000 (Rupees One Crore Ninety-Six Lakhs only). This incident occurred on April 15, 2026, and was detected on the same day, stemming from cyber fraud through WhatsApp impersonation. Syschem India Ltd has promptly lodged a formal complaint with cybercrime authorities and is reviewing its internal controls to prevent recurrence. The company is also exploring recovery options and legal remedies. While the financial impact is estimated at Rs. 1.96 Cr, the management believes this incident will not materially impact the company's operations. Further updates will be provided to the stock exchange as developments occur.

announcements.subject: Quadrant Future Tek Ltd - 544336 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order

announcements.ai_summary: Quadrant Future Tek Limited has received a Letter of Acceptance from Patiala Locomotive Works (PLW) for the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of Onboard KAVACH Loco Equipment Ver- 4.0 with warranty. The contract value is Rs. 20,19,27,500/- (Rupees Twenty Crores Nineteen Lakhs Twenty-Seven Thousand Five Hundred Only), inclusive of taxes. announcements.subject: Vishnu Chemicals Ltd - 516072 - Intimation On Maintenance Shutdown Of Company'S Visakhapatnam Parwada Plant.

announcements.subject: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd - 517334 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015.
announcements.detail: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with the Stock Exchange a disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has disclosed a penalty imposed by the State of California Franchise Tax Board (SCFTB) on its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Motherson SAS Automotive Services USA Inc. The penalty of $28,518 USD, equivalent to approximately INR 26,62,742, relates to the income and tax computation return for the year ended March 31, 2025. This arose from the classification of certain sales as foreign, impacting the calculation of eligible tax for Motherson SAS. The company states there is no material impact on the financial or operational activities of either Motherson SAS or Samvardhana Motherson International Limited. The disclosure was made on April 15, 2026.

announcements.subject: Suraj Estate Developers Ltd - 544054 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release for Acquisition of Land
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Suraj Estate Developers Limited has acquired a piece of land in Dadar (West), Mumbai, for an acquisition cost of ₹8.53 crore plus an additional area of 2,200 sq ft to be handed over to the landowners, resulting in a total acquisition cost of approximately ₹18.00 crore. This plot is situated in a micro-market with strong demand fundamentals and excellent connectivity. Suraj Estate Developers plans to redevelop the land to create a project with a saleable carpet area of approximately 0.18 lakh sq ft and an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹100 crores. This acquisition is expected to strengthen the company's project pipeline and consolidate its presence in South-Central Mumbai. The company is actively evaluating additional strategic acquisition opportunities.

announcements.subject: Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd - 543732 - Announcement Regarding Frauds In Subsidiary By A Former Employee Of Subsidiary Company
announcements.detail: Announcement regarding fraud in subsidiary by a former employee of subsidiary company
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd has disclosed an incident of fraud within its subsidiary, Aceware Fintech Services Private Limited (RadiantAcemoney), perpetrated by a former employee. The fraud involved unauthorized and fraudulent activities through the misuse of residual system access credentials, leading to an estimated financial exposure of approximately ₹3.13 crore at the subsidiary level. The incident, which occurred between July 2025 and February 2026, was confined to a limited number of Business Correspondent (BC) Agent accounts. The investigation, including a forensic audit, confirmed no involvement of existing employees. RadiantAcemoney has taken immediate containment measures, including suspending affected functionalities and filing complaints with law enforcement. The Audit Committee of RadiantAcemoney and the Company reviewed the investigation reports on April 15, 2026. The consolidated financial impact on Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd is not considered material.

announcements.subject: Allcargo Terminals Ltd - 543954 - Allca
announcements.detail: Monthly business update for the month of March 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Allcargo Terminals Ltd released its monthly business update for March 2026 on April 15, 2026. This information is provided in accordance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and has undergone a limited review by the management. The update also notes that the ICD is a joint venture with CONCOR. The information will be available on the company's website at www.allcargoterminals.com.
