announcements.subject: UFO Moviez India Ltd - 539141 - Press Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith Press Release titled ''UFO MOVIEZ TIES UP WITH CHINA FILM GROUP PROMOTED "CINITY" A HOLLYWOOD APPROVED PREMIUM LARGE SCREEN FORMAT TO PROVIDE A LARGER-THAN-LIFE EXPERIENCE TO CINEGOERS IN INDIA''
announcements.ai_summary: UFO Moviez India Limited has announced an exclusive tie-up with China Film Group for their Hollywood-approved Premium Large Screen Format (PLF) called "CINITY," for the Indian market. This collaboration aims to provide a larger-than-life cinematic experience to cinegoers in India. CINITY integrates advanced cinema technologies such as 4K resolution, 3D, high brightness, high frame rate (HFR), high dynamic range (HDR), wide color gamut, and immersive sound. UFO Moviez believes this partnership will offer Indian exhibitors a platform to deliver premium large screen experiences that align with global industry standards, enhancing the quality of cinema viewing and drawing more audiences to theaters.

announcements.subject: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd - 526263 - Utilization Of Proceeds Of Preferential Issue Of Equity Shares.
announcements.detail: Utilization of proceeds of Preferential Issue of Equity Shares.
announcements.ai_summary: Mold-Tek Technologies Limited has provided details on the utilization of proceeds from its preferential issue of equity shares, which aggregated to ₹4,75,60,000. The entire amount, representing 100% of the proceeds, will be utilized for capital expenditure towards the construction of the company's new branch office building at its Nashik location. The land for this project was acquired in 2023, and the construction is intended to establish a dedicated facility to support current business operations and future growth, as the Nashik branch currently operates from rented premises. The utilization of these funds for the construction project is expected to be completed within an estimated timeline of 15 to 18 months from the date of allotment.

announcements.subject: Vikram Kamats Hospitality Ltd - 539659 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015-Lapse Of 45,270 Fully Convertible Warrants Held By Non-Promoter Entity.
announcements.detail: Lapse of 45,270 fully convertible Warrants held by Non-Promoter entity
announcements.ai_summary: Vikram Kamats Hospitality Limited has announced the lapse of 45,270 fully convertible warrants held by a non-promoter entity, Nabs Vriddhii LLP. These warrants were part of an allotment of 19,12,163 warrants on October 16, 2024, at a price of ₹74 per warrant. The allottee failed to exercise the option to convert the warrants within the stipulated 18-month period. Consequently, the 45,270 warrants have lapsed, and the upfront subscription amount of ₹10,04,994, representing 30% of the issue price, has been forfeited. There is no change in the company's paid-up equity share capital as a result of this lapse.

announcements.subject: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd - 530007 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition
announcements.detail: The Directors at their meeting approved an Investment up to Rs. 1.31 Crore for acquiring 26% equity shares of Roofsol Renewables Five Pvt. Ltd.

Ltd. Ltd throughout the term of the Power Purchase Agreement. announcements.subject: Orient Tradelink Ltd - 531512 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail:
Please find enclosed herewith the disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations') regarding acquisition of Film Rights

The scope includes global marketing, distribution, promotion, and merchandising across theatrical, OTT, and digital platforms, with an expected release timeline in June 2026. This acquisition is expected to strengthen the company's presence in the spiritual and entertainment segment, generate increased revenue streams over the next 12-18 months, and positively impact profitability and shareholder value.

announcements.subject: Tarc Ltd - 543249 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

Additionally, Tarc Kailasa has introduced its most premium tower inventory, with its total gross development value now standing at ₹4,400 crore, and has launched a new Experience Gallery and Sample Residence to drive sales. These achievements are underpinned by strong cash flows, supporting long-term value creation. The company is focused on expanding its luxury offerings and delivering on its development commitments.

announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith intimation regarding Acquisition/Investment in Godawari New Energy Private Limited, a Wholly owned subsidiary of Godawari Power and Ispat Limited.

announcements.subject: John Cockerill India Ltd-$ - 500147 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order

announcements.subject: Brigade Enterprises Ltd - 532929 - Material Information - 'Brigade Group Signs JDA For 8.63 Acres, Unlocking A 39 Acre Development In East Bengaluru
announcements.detail: Material Information - "Brigade Group Signs JDA for 8.63 Acres, Unlocking a 39 Acre Development in East Bengaluru
announcements.ai_summary: Brigade Enterprises Ltd has signed a Joint Development Agreement (JDA) for an 8.63-acre parcel of land in Gunjur, East Bengaluru. This agreement is a crucial step that enables the development of a larger, integrated 39-acre residential township in the Whitefield–Sarjapur corridor. The entire 39-acre development is projected to have an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of approximately ₹7,200 crore. This development is being undertaken through a combination of outright purchases and joint development agreements. The company is making this disclosure as per Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and has also released a press release detailing this material information.

announcements.subject: Starlog Enterprises Ltd - 520155 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, As Amended ('Listing Regulations') - Update
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ('Listing Regulations') - Update
announcements.ai_summary: Starlog Enterprises Ltd has received a significant update regarding an arbitration award concerning its material subsidiary, Starlift Services Private Limited. An arbitration award dated April 18, 2011, had initially granted Starlift approximately ₹9.02 crore plus interest against Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata (KPT). Although KPT challenged this award, leading to its setting aside by the Hon'ble High Court at Calcutta on December 24, 2020, Starlift appealed this decision. On April 9, 2026, the Division Bench of the Hon'ble High Court at Calcutta set aside the earlier order, deeming it without jurisdiction, and has thereby restored the original arbitration award in favor of Starlift. The company is continuing to evaluate the matter and will take appropriate legal steps.

announcements.subject: Aelea Commodities Ltd - 544213 - Achievement Of The Fairdeal Filaments Award For Outstanding Entrepreneurship In The MSME Segment For 2024-2025
announcements.detail: Intimation under Reg.30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Achievement of Fairdeal Filament Award for Outstanding Entrepreneurship in the MSME Segment for 2024-2025.
announcements.ai_summary: Aelea Commodities Limited has been honored with the Fairdeal Filaments Award for Outstanding Entrepreneurship in the MSME Segment for the fiscal year 2024-2025. This recognition was bestowed by The Southern Gujarat Chamber of Commerce & Industry (SGCCI). The company is formally informing the stock exchange about this achievement as per Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. This award highlights the company's significant contributions and entrepreneurial spirit within the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises sector.

announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Rubicon Research Ltd has announced the acquisition of an 85% equity ownership in Arinna Lifesciences Limited from its current shareholders. This acquisition marks Rubicon's entry into the Indian Central Nervous System (CNS) formulations market. Arinna Lifesciences possesses a portfolio of over 60 brands in chronic therapies and an established distribution network across India. This move aligns with Rubicon's strategy to leverage its intellectual property and chronic products to drive growth in key markets, particularly in the CNS therapeutic category. The acquisition is expected to provide Rubicon with access to patients and prescribers in India for its specialized offerings.

announcements.subject: Vega Jewellers Ltd - 512026 - Receipt Of BSE In-Principle Approval For Bonus Issue
announcements.detail: BSE In principle Approval for Bonus Issue
announcements.ai_summary: Vega Jewellers Ltd has received in-principle approval from BSE Limited for its proposed Bonus Issue. The approval, dated April 15, 2026, grants permission for the issue and allotment of 4,07,05,192 equity shares of Re.10/- each as bonus shares. This will be in the ratio of 4:1, meaning shareholders will receive four new equity shares for every one existing equity share held. This follows the company's earlier intimation on March 5, 2026, regarding the bonus issue proposal.

announcements.subject: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd - 533047 - Update
announcements.detail: As per corporate announcement attached
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd (IMFA) has provided an update on its ongoing projects. The 100,000 tpa (2 x 33 MVA) Greenfield Ferro Chrome Project in Kalinganagar is in its final construction stages, with pre-commissioning for the first furnace scheduled for June 2026 and the second furnace in September 2026. The strategic acquisition in Kalinganagar is complete, and all four furnaces are now operational. The Ethanol Project in Therubali is experiencing a delay in commissioning, now expected in July 2026, due to equipment delivery slippage and geopolitical impacts, though this is not expected to materially affect the company's financials.

announcements.subject: Samhi Hotels Ltd - 543984 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: A copy of Press Release on signing of Agreement with INGKA Centres for leasing ~162 rooms upscale hotel in Noida, Uttar Pradesh is enclosed for your kind information.
announcements.ai_summary: Samhi Hotels Ltd, through its wholly owned subsidiary SAMHI Skyline Private Limited, has signed an agreement with INGKA Centres India Private Limited, part of the Ingka Group, for leasing an upscale ~162-room hotel. This hotel will be part of Ingka Centres’ upcoming ~2.5 million sq. ft. mixed-use development in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The agreement was signed on April 15, 2026. The project will be executed under Samhi Hotels' long-term variable lease model, with Ingka Centres leasing the building and Samhi Hotels investing in interior fit-outs. This partnership aims to create a modern retail-led destination combining shopping, leisure, and community experiences.

announcements.subject: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd - 544476 - Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited Has Informed The Exchange About Receipt Of NABH Accreditation For Noida Hospital.
announcements.detail: Receipt of NABH Accreditation for Noida Hospital.
announcements.ai_summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has received NABH Accreditation for its Noida Hospital, located at Plot No. 24, Block SB, Sector 117, Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The accreditation, specifically for Panchakarma services, has the certification number AH-2026-0451 and is valid until March 09, 2029. This accreditation signifies the hospital's adherence to national standards for quality healthcare, patient safety, and operational excellence. The company stated that this development is in the ordinary course of business and does not constitute business expansion, capacity enhancement, or acquisition.

announcements.subject: Triveni Turbine Ltd - 533655 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations - Merger between two step-down wholly owned subsidiaries of the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Triveni Turbine Limited has announced a merger between two of its step-down wholly owned subsidiaries, TSE Engineering (Pty) Ltd and Triveni Turbines Africa (Pty) Ltd (TTAPL). The Companies and Intellectual Property Commission, South Africa, approved this merger on April 14, 2026, with the effective date of April 01, 2026. Following the merger, TSE Engineering (Pty) Ltd has been dissolved and is no longer a subsidiary of Triveni Turbine Limited. The merger was executed as per a merger agreement between the two entities.

announcements.subject: City Union Bank Ltd - 532210 - Opening Of 3 New Branches
announcements.detail: Our Bank has opened 3 new Branches on April 15,2026 and as on date the Bank has 959 Branches in total.
announcements.ai_summary: City Union Bank Ltd has opened 3 new branches on April 15, 2026. This expansion brings the bank's total branch count to 959. The new branches are located in Barmer, Rajasthan; Zirakpur, Punjab; and Lucknow - Mahanagar, Uttar Pradesh. This move is in line with Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations 2015.

announcements.subject: Varun Beverages Ltd - 540180 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Update
announcements.detail: Varun Beverages Limited has acquired 29.99% of Equity Share Capital of FPEL HR2 Energy Private limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Varun Beverages Limited has acquired 29.99% of the Equity Share Capital of FPEL HR2 Energy Private Limited for Rs. 1.58 Crore. This acquisition, which took place on April 15, 2026, is an update to a previous intimation dated February 3, 2026. FPEL HR2 Energy Private Limited is a special purpose vehicle engaged in generating and supplying solar power to consumers in Haryana. The purpose of this acquisition is to obtain solar power for captive consumption by Varun Beverages Limited. The detailed disclosure requirements under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, were already submitted in the previous intimation.

announcements.subject: Indiqube Spaces Ltd - 544454 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Indiqube Signs Rs. 52 Crore Workspace Deal with Japanese E-Commerce Giant in Bangalore
announcements.ai_summary: IndiQube Spaces Limited has announced the signing of a workspace deal worth ₹52 crore with a leading Japanese e-commerce giant. The deal is for approximately 35,000 sq. ft. of space located on the Outer Ring Road in Bengaluru, with a tenure of five years. This agreement is expected to support the client's India operations by providing a fully managed, enterprise-grade workplace. The transaction highlights the increasing adoption of managed workspaces by enterprises for faster expansion and operational flexibility. Bengaluru, particularly the Outer Ring Road, is identified as a strategic hub for global companies due to its talent pool and business infrastructure. The workplace solution is designed to be operationally seamless and tailored to the client's brand.

announcements.subject: Samhi Hotels Ltd - 543984 - Signing Of An Agreement To Lease/ Sub-Lease For A Proposed ~162 Rooms Up-Scale Hotel To Be Constructed As Part Of A Mixed-Use Development In Noida, Uttar Pradesh
announcements.detail: SAMHI Skyline Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has on 15th April 2026 executed an agreement with INGKA Centres India Private Limited ("Lessor") for a long term lease in respect of ~162 rooms Upscale hotel to be developed as a part of mixed use development in Noida, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh. The required information as per SEBI Listing Regulations is provided in enclosed disclosure.
announcements.ai_summary: SAMHI Skyline Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of SAMHI Hotels Limited, has executed a long-term lease/sub-lease agreement with INGKA Centres India Private Limited on April 15, 2026. The agreement is for a proposed upscale hotel with approximately 162 rooms, to be constructed as part of a mixed-use development in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The estimated built-up area for the hotel is 15,022 square meters. SAMHI Skyline will take possession for hotel fit-outs and branding after the Lessor completes their scope of work. The hotel will operate under an international brand to be determined later. This agreement is part of SAMHI's capital-efficient growth strategy and aims to expand its presence in key markets.

announcements.subject: Retaggio Industries Ltd - 544391 - Board Meeting Outcome for Meeting Held Today 15Th April, 2026
announcements.detail: Please find the attached outcome of the board meeting

Secondly, the company approved the incorporation of a subsidiary named "Lodha Heritage Private Limited" or any other name approved by the Registrar of Companies. This subsidiary will have an authorized capital of Rs. 10,00,000 divided into 1,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each, and a paid-up capital of Rs. 10,00,000. The board also approved the draft postal ballot notice for the revision in Mr. Savinay Lodha's remuneration. The meeting commenced at 4:00 p.m. and concluded at 4:30 p.m.

announcements.subject: Adani Enterprises Ltd - 512599 - Intimation For Allotment Of Equity Shares Pursuant To The Composite Scheme Of Amalgamation
announcements.detail: Intimation for allotment of equity shares pursuant to Composite Scheme of Amalgamation
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Enterprises Ltd's Management Committee of the Board of Directors met on April 15, 2026, and approved the allotment of 90,11,048 equity shares of face value Re. 1 each, fully paid up. These shares are being allotted to eligible shareholders of Adani Emerging Business Private Limited as per the Composite Scheme of Amalgamation, which was approved by the National Company Law Tribunal on March 16, 2026. The newly allotted shares will rank pari passu with the existing equity shares. The committee meeting took place from 4:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m.

announcements.subject: Infosys Ltd - 500209 - 7-Time Grand Slam Champion Carlos Alcaraz Is Infosys Global Brand Ambassador
announcements.detail: Enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Infosys Limited has announced a multi-year partnership with Carlos Alcaraz, the youngest athlete to achieve the World No. 1 ranking in men's tennis, appointing him as its Global Brand Ambassador. This collaboration aims to leverage Alcaraz's champion mindset, relentless drive, and pursuit of excellence, aligning with Infosys' values of responsible leadership and innovation. Infosys will work with Alcaraz and his coaching team to develop an AI-powered match analytics and personalized performance application using Infosys Topaz. The partnership also includes joint initiatives with the Carlos Alcaraz Foundation to drive social impact through tech-for-good initiatives.

announcements.subject: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd - 524804 - Expanding Existing CMO Operations With Merck Sharpe & Dohme Singapore Trading Pte. Ltd  By Theranym Biologics Private Limited, A Subsidiary Of The Company .
announcements.detail: Intimation of addition of  additional  product schedule  to the existing CMO agreement entered in to with  Merck Sharpe & Dohme Singapore Trading Pte (MSD) by TheraNym Biologics Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: TheraNym Biologics Private Limited, a subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma Ltd, has executed an additional product schedule with Merck Sharp & Dohme Singapore Trading Pte. Ltd. (MSD). This expands their existing Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) agreement, which was initially disclosed in May 2024. Under this new schedule, TheraNym Biologics will construct a greenfield project for a large-scale mammalian Drug Substance manufacturing facility, referred to as "Unit 2," with a total capacity of 60 KL bioreactors. This development further strengthens the CMO relationship between the two entities.

announcements.subject: Goodyear India Ltd - 500168 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015

These products were launched on April 15, 2026, and cater to the domestic market in India. The newly launched tyres will be manufactured by Goodyear South Asia Tyres Pvt Ltd. in Aurangabad and sold by Goodyear India Limited in the replacement market. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Baazar Style Retail Ltd - 544243 - Intimation Regarding Settlement Of Insurance Claim
announcements.detail: Pursuant to the Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the insurance claim in respect of inventory loss has been settled, the details of which is enclosed herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: Baazar Style Retail Limited has announced the settlement of an insurance claim related to inventory loss due to a fire incident that occurred on May 20, 2024, at their erstwhile central warehouse in Hooghly, West Bengal. The company had initially recognized a receivable of ₹43.65 Crores against inventory loss valued at ₹50.85 Crores. Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Limited has settled the claim for an aggregate amount of ₹23.00 Crores under Policy No. OG-24-2495-4008-00000005. The company has accepted this settlement, and the amount will be received in due course.

announcements.subject: Shriram Finance Ltd - 511218 - Update With Respect To Subsidiary
announcements.detail: Shriram Overseas Investments Limited, wholly owned subsidiary  of the Company has received today i.e. April 15, 2026 an in-principle approval to commence Primary Dealer (PD) business from Reserve Bank of India, subject to compliance with the conditions specified therein
announcements.ai_summary: Shriram Finance Ltd has announced an update regarding its wholly-owned subsidiary, Shriram Overseas Investments Limited. On April 15, 2026, Shriram Overseas Investments Limited received an in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India to commence Primary Dealer (PD) business. This approval is subject to the subsidiary complying with the conditions specified by the RBI. This development is a significant step for the subsidiary in expanding its financial services offerings.

announcements.subject: A-1 Ltd - 542012 - Clarification W.R.T Regulation 30 Of The SEBI(LODR) Regulations,2015 -A-1 Limited_BSE Email Dated 13.04.2024
announcements.detail: Clarification w.r.t Regulation 30 of the SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015- A-1 Limited_BSE email dated 13.04.2024
announcements.ai_summary: A-1 Ltd has issued a clarification regarding a false rumor circulating on the Telegram channel 'Chase Alpha-SEBI REG' that the company acquired a 20% stake in Yashvi Lifesciences. A-1 Ltd categorically states that this information is false, baseless, and fabricated. The company has not acquired any stake in Yashvi Lifesciences, nor is there any such proposal under consideration by its Board of Directors. A-1 Ltd also clarifies that it has no affiliation with the mentioned Telegram channel or its operators. The company is evaluating legal action against those spreading the misinformation and reiterates its commitment to transparency and compliance with SEBI regulations.

announcements.subject: Shraddha Prime Projects Ltd - 531771 - Intimation Under Reg. 30 For Receiving CC For New Project Shraddha Paradise Enclave
announcements.detail: Intimation under Reg. 30 for receiving CC for New Project Shraddha Paradise Enclave
announcements.ai_summary: Shraddha Prime Projects Ltd has received the Commencement Certificate (CC) for its new project, "Shraddha Paradise Enclave," located in Mulund West, Mumbai. This project, which involves the redevelopment of Himgiri CHS, will have a RERA carpet area of approximately 1,30,000 Sq. Ft. for residential units and 20,000 Sq. Ft. for commercial units. The company anticipates this project will generate revenue of approximately Rs. 420 Crores over the next three years. This development signifies a strategic expansion for Shraddha Prime Projects Ltd in the Mumbai real estate market, focusing on residential and redevelopment opportunities. The company aims to strengthen its presence in key suburban areas.

announcements.subject: Welspun Corp Ltd - 532144 - Compliances-Half Yearly Report (SEBI Circular No. CIR/IMD/DF-1/67/2017)
announcements.detail: Specifications related to ISIN of private placement of debt securities outstanding as on 31st March 2026.

The second issuance also had an amount of Rs. 20,00,00,000, with an outstanding amount of Rs. 20,00,00,000 as of the same date. This information was submitted on April 15, 2026.

announcements.subject: AVI Polymers Ltd - 539288 - Revised Intimation Under Requlation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Requlations, 2015 - Launch Of 'Krishibuddy' Agritech Platform By Wholly-Owned Subsidiary, AVI Eco Spark Private Limited.
announcements.detail: Revised Intimation under regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) regulations, 2015- Launch of ''"KrishiBuddy"'' Agritech Platform by Wholly-Owned Subsidiary, AVI Eco Spark Private Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: AVI Polymers Ltd has submitted a revised intimation regarding the launch of the 'KrishiBuddy' Agritech Platform by its wholly-owned subsidiary, AVI Eco Spark Private Limited. The platform is now live and accessible to the public at https://krishibuddy.tech/. This launch signifies AVI Polymers Ltd's strategic move into high-growth technological sectors, particularly in artificial intelligence and IoT for Indian agriculture. KrishiBuddy is an AI-powered smart farming assistant designed for Indian smallholder farmers, aiming to capture a significant share of the $9 billion agritech market. The platform features a multimodal, multilingual AI with a conversational interface that supports voice, text, and image inputs in regional languages.

announcements.subject: Globe Civil Projects Ltd - 544424 - Business Update
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) 2015, please find attached the business update for FY 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Globe Civil Projects Ltd has provided a Business Update for FY 2026, highlighting a strong order book of ₹730 Crore as of March 2026. The company operates in 11+ states with over 37 completed projects and 13-15 ongoing projects. Approximately 55% of its pending order book is from government exposure. Key order wins in FY26 include projects for Central University of Punjab (₹173 Crore), an International Cricket Stadium (₹222 Crore), IIT Kanpur (₹71 Crore), and NIT Delhi (₹13 Crore). The company expects continued growth driven by the execution of its existing order book and participation in government infrastructure projects, with margins expected to remain stable due to disciplined bidding and efficient execution.

announcements.ai_summary: Umiya Mobile Limited has announced the opening of five new retail stores on April 15, 2026. Two stores have been opened in Gujarat, specifically in Sutrapada. The remaining three stores are located in Maharashtra, in the cities of Beed, Amravati, Hingoli, and Ahilyanagar. This expansion is in line with the company's earlier announcement dated February 19, 2026, and is being reported under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Aster DM Healthcare Ltd - 540975 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Strikes /Lockouts / Disturbances
announcements.detail: Update in relation to Nurse  Strike at Hospital in Kerala
announcements.ai_summary: Aster DM Healthcare Ltd has provided an update regarding the nurse strike at its hospitals in Kerala. The company has been actively engaging with the United Nurses Association to resolve wage structure demands. While the Hon’ble High Court has extended the deferral of the strike until May 31, 2026, proceedings are ongoing for a final settlement. Importantly, the entire nursing staff across Aster hospitals in Kerala has resumed work, and operations have returned to full capacity. The company incurred an additional revenue loss of INR 5,77,60,948 due to the strike, but no further losses are expected if the current status quo is maintained until settlement terms are agreed upon.

announcements.subject: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd - 532540 - Press Release - TCS And University Of Cincinnati Announce ''My First AI Job'' Program To Prepare Students For Entry-Level AI Careers
announcements.detail: Press Release - TCS and University of Cincinnati Announce ''My First AI Job'' Program to Prepare Students for Entry-Level AI Careers
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has partnered with the University of Cincinnati and Salesforce to launch the "TCS My First AI Job" program. This initiative aims to equip final-year students with essential AI skills through an intensive three-month curriculum. The program includes hands-on projects, mentorship, global certifications, and practice interviews to prepare students for entry-level AI roles at TCS. The goal is to build a future-ready workforce in the US and enhance the competitiveness of American companies. This program is being launched in Cincinnati, home to TCS's new North America Salesforce Center of Excellence.

announcements.subject: Techknowgreen Solutions Ltd - 543991 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that Techknowgreen Solutions Limited ('TSL') has entered into a Teaming Up Agreement (TUA) dated April 14, 2026, with Sri Sri Naisargik LLP ('SSNL').

The agreement establishes a strategic collaboration between TSL and SSNL for the deployment, promotion, and execution of Yuka Yantra - Ambient Air Purification System ....
announcements.ai_summary: On April 15, 2026, Techknowgreen Solutions Limited (TSL) announced the execution of a Teaming Up Agreement (TUA) with Sri Sri Naisargik LLP (SSNL) on April 14, 2026. This agreement establishes a strategic collaboration for the deployment, promotion, and execution of the Yuka Yantra - Ambient Air Purification System and other environmental technologies. SSNL will serve as the Promotional Partner, focusing on stakeholder engagement and market outreach, while TSL will act as the Technology Partner, responsible for design, engineering, deployment, and monitoring. The agreement outlines a revenue-sharing mechanism and aims to enhance TSL's reach through SSNL's network for air pollution mitigation projects.

announcements.subject: Datamatics Global Services Ltd - 532528 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please refer attached  PDF File
announcements.ai_summary: Datamatics Global Services Ltd announced that its Automatic Fare Collection (AFC) and mobile ticketing systems have gone live for Phase 1 of Mumbai Metro Lines 2B and 9. This system facilitates faster entry-exit and auto fare deduction using QR coded tickets or common mobility cards. The inauguration of Phase 1 for these lines took place on April 8, 2026. Datamatics has previously implemented AFC solutions for Mumbai Metro Lines 2A and 7, and has a global track record of over 30 AFC projects in cities like London, New York, and Dubai, as well as in India for projects such as Delhi-Meerut RRTS and Pune Metro. The company's Vice Chairman and CEO, Rahul Kanodia, expressed pride in their continued association with Mumbai Metro, highlighting the positive impact on millions of Mumbaikars.

announcements.subject: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd - 543895 - Business Update For The Half Year Ended March 31, 2026
announcements.detail: Business update is enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd has provided a business update for the half-year ended March 31, 2026. The company reported strong performance in aviation, infrastructure development, and marquee events, maintaining leadership in India and eight international markets. Despite market volatility, Exhicon maintained a high-growth trajectory and strong cash flows with a lean balance sheet. The company is strategically pivoting towards large-scale infrastructure ownership and high-margin service diversification for its FY27 outlook. A significant development is the board meeting convened to consider migration to the Main Board of BSE & NSE, subject to approvals. Exhicon also emerged as the winning bidder for the Mohali Convention & Exhibition Centre project under a PPP model and completed Phase I of Exhibition Hall expansion at Expo Centre Greater Noida. Additionally, the company secured a helicopter shuttle contract for the Mandakini Valley to Shri Kedarnath Ji route.

announcements.subject: Scan Steels Ltd - 511672 - Non-Applicability Of Escrow Payment Mechanism
announcements.detail: Escrow Payment Mechanism is not applicable to the Company.

This is because Scan Steels Limited has not issued, nor does it currently have, any instruments or arrangements for which this mechanism is required under the relevant SEBI Regulations. Therefore, no disclosure or submission related to the Escrow Payment Mechanism is necessary for the company.

announcements.subject: Ramco Systems Ltd - 532370 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release titled "Korean Air goes live with Ramco Aviation" which is being released from our end.
announcements.ai_summary: Ramco Systems Limited has announced that Korean Air, South Korea's flag carrier, has successfully gone live with Ramco Aviation Suite. This implementation digitally transforms Korean Air's Engine Maintenance Center and establishes the technology foundation for its upcoming Maintenance Cluster, which is set to be Asia's Largest Engine MRO Hub. The Ramco Aviation Suite will streamline complex operations, enhance productivity, and support the expansion of Korean Air's engine maintenance capabilities. It facilitates seamless collaboration across Engine Maintenance, Finance, Customer Support, and Billing, and integrates with internal and external platforms, including Korean Air’s Automated Storage Retrieval System. Over 400 mechanics and engineers will now utilize Ramco’s mobile application for paperless performance maintenance execution.

announcements.subject: Megastar Foods Ltd - 541352 - Revised Disclosure Undrer Regulation 30 (2) Of SEBI LODR Regulations
announcements.detail: Revised disclosure under Regulation 30 (2) of SEBI LODR Regulations read with Clause 20 of Part A of Para A of Schedule III of LODR, in continuation of the original disclosure dated 14.04.2026

announcements.subject: Chalet Hotels Ltd - 542399 - Disclosure On Outcome Of Litigation/Dispute
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations and letter dated August 14, 2023, this is to inform you that the Karnataka High Court has dismissed the Writ Petition filed by the Company as per the enclosed letter
announcements.ai_summary: The Karnataka High Court has dismissed the Writ Petition filed by Chalet Hotels Limited challenging the revision in Property Tax rates for its Bengaluru Marriott Hotel Whitefield. The court stated that the revision factors in escalation as per law. Consequently, the company will now pay the disputed Property Tax amount, which is approximately Rs. 8.88 crore. Chalet Hotels Limited has confirmed that this outcome does not impact its business operations or financials. The company has informed the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited of this development.

announcements.subject: Hampton Sky Realty Ltd - 526407 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 - Signing Of Memorandum Of Understanding (MOU)

announcements.subject: Hitachi Energy India Ltd - 543187 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please refer the attached document
announcements.ai_summary: Hitachi Energy India Limited, in collaboration with Adani Energy Solutions Ltd. (AESL), has successfully commissioned a high-voltage direct current (HVDC) city center infeed in Mumbai. This new HVDC link increases the city's power supply from external sources by 50%, injecting up to 1,000 megawatts (MW) of clean power. The project, which includes a space-saving converter station and 50 km of underground HVDC cables, strengthens Mumbai's transmission infrastructure to support over 20 million people. The technology enhances grid resilience, facilitates renewable energy integration, and aligns with the city's Climate Action Plan and decarbonization goals. This development sets a global benchmark for urban transmission.

announcements.subject: Vedanta Ltd - 500295 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations')
announcements.detail: Please refer the enclosed file.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Vedanta Ltd is reporting an unfortunate incident that occurred at Unit-1 boiler of its Athena Power plant in Singhita rai, Chhattisgarh, on April 14, 2026. The incident involved personnel of its sub-contractor, NGSL, resulting in 24 affected workmen, with 10 succumbing to their injuries. The company's immediate priority is to provide medical assistance to the injured and support to the families of the deceased. Vedanta is coordinating with medical teams and local authorities to ascertain the details and has initiated a detailed investigation in conjunction with its sub-contractor and relevant authorities. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.ai_summary: Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) has announced the incorporation of four new wholly owned subsidiaries through its wholly owned subsidiary, PFC Consulting Limited (PFCCL). These new entities are BABAI TRANSMISSION LIMITED, BIKANER TRANSMISSION LIMITED, HUMNABAD POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED, and HEBBANI POWER TRANSMISSION LIMITED. announcements.subject: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd - 539254 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Adani Energy Commissions 1,000 MW Power Link to bring More Clean Energy into Mumbai
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL), through its subsidiary Adani Electricity Mumbai Infrastructure Limited (AEMIL), has successfully commissioned a 1,000 megawatt (MW) high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission link. This new link connects Kudus and Aarey, comprising a 30-kilometer overhead line and a 50-kilometer underground corridor, designed for dense urban environments. The project includes the world's first compact HVDC substation and aims to improve grid reliability and energy security across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR). This initiative, conceived after the October 2020 Mumbai blackout, will enable greater flow of renewable energy into Mumbai, reducing dependence on in-city generation and lowering outage risks. The HVDC link enhances connectivity by allowing more controlled, efficient, and higher-capacity power flows, particularly for renewable energy integration.

The investment for this expansion was Rs. 54 crores, financed through internal accruals. The rationale behind this capacity addition is to meet the projected demand growth in the packaging, construction, and cold supply chain sectors. The company's existing capacity utilization was 75%.

announcements.subject: Nexxus Petro Industries Ltd - 544265 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Nexxus Petro Industries Limited has intimated to the Stock Exchange regarding Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for Press Release titled "Nexxus Petro Indutries Limited Positioned at the Forefront of India''s Bio-Bitument Revolution"
announcements.ai_summary: Nexxus Petro Industries Limited has issued a press release titled "Nexxus Petro Industries Limited Positioned at the Forefront of India's Bio-Bitumen Revolution." The company is leveraging its CSIR-CRRI & CSIR-IIP certified license for proprietary Bio-Bitumen Technology (KrishiBind™) as India aims to reduce its bitumen import costs, which have surged by approximately 40% due to the West Asia conflict. Domestic bitumen prices have risen from around ₹40,000 per tonne to ₹54,000–₹76,000 per tonne. India currently imports about 54% of its bitumen requirement, totaling nearly 6 million tonnes annually. Nexxus Petro Industries Limited is among only 15 companies nationwide holding this crucial technology license, positioning it to benefit from government policies promoting indigenous bitumen supply and the acceleration of India's road construction programs.

announcements.subject: Eraaya Lifespaces Ltd - 531035 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: As per letter attached
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Eraaya Lifespaces Limited has resolved a long-standing shareholder matter concerning Ebix Payment Services, a step-down subsidiary of ItzCash, with the Bombay High Court approving the Consent Terms. This matter originated from legacy structures under the previous Ebix group management and was an inherited overhang post-acquisition, not part of the original acquisition consideration. Eraaya will execute a complete buyout of the minority shareholding in Ebix Payment Services Private Limited for an aggregate settlement amount of approximately INR 1,800 million, to be discharged over an agreed timeframe. announcements.subject: Valencia Nutrition Ltd - 542910 - Press Release- Resistance To 2026 Strait Of Hormuz Crisis
announcements.detail: We hereby provide comprehensive update on the operations and strategic resilience of Valencia Beverages and Superwater Private Limited (VBSW) Unit I & Unit II in Cherlaplly, Hyderabad.
announcements.ai_summary: Valencia Nutrition Ltd has provided an update on the operational resilience of its Valencia Beverages and Superwater Private Limited (VBSW) Unit I & Unit II in Cherlapally, Hyderabad, in the face of the 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis. The company secured a three-month supply of packaging materials before the crisis began on February 28, 2026, and purchased fruit pulp at low prices due to export chokes, securing its entire year's requirement. VBSW also converted its boilers from LPG to Diesel, creating a dual-fuel system, and is managing supply and demand using its in-house ERP and FIFO methodology. The company has seen growth in its own brand sales, is awaiting final orders from GCC clients for juice samples, and has signed an agreement with Virchow Laboratories Ltd to manufacture eight juice SKUs, securing 15% of Unit II's capacity. Despite a labor challenge on April 06, 2026, operations remained uninterrupted due to engineering executives from Valencia Engineering Group stepping in.

announcements.detail: Litigation Involving Wholly Owned Subsidiary  - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Jyoti CNC Automation Limited has disclosed a litigation involving its material wholly-owned subsidiary, Huron Graffenstaden SAS. French authorities have initiated an investigation against Huron Graffenstaden SAS and certain employees concerning export controls and documentation of dual-use machinery. As interim measures, the director general of Huron Graffenstaden SAS has been temporarily restricted from duties, and certain bank accounts totaling approximately EUR 4.0 million, along with two residential properties owned by Jyoti SAS, have been seized. A formal judicial investigation has been launched. Huron Graffenstaden SAS refutes the allegations and is seeking clarity and legal advice to contest these actions. The company believes that while seized assets and involved employees may be temporarily unavailable, the current business and operations of Huron Graffenstaden SAS remain unaffected. Furthermore, these actions are not expected to adversely impact Jyoti CNC Automation Limited's standalone business and operations, which contribute over 85% of the Group's revenue.

(“SMRC-Croatia”). The Commercial Court of Zagreb dissolved SMRC-Croatia from its register effective April 11, 2026, following an application by the subsidiary. SMRC-Croatia was dissolved as it had no foreseeable new business and was incurring significant annual costs. The turnover and net worth of SMRC-Croatia during FY 2024-25 were Euro 256,362 and €6,448 respectively, which are considered negligible and represent 0.00% of the consolidated revenue and net worth of Samvardhana Motherson International Limited. The dissolution was based on a Commercial Court order dated March 24, 2026.

announcements.subject: Baazar Style Retail Ltd - 544243 -  Intimation Of Opening Of A New Retail Store Of The Company
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the Company has opened a new store of Express Baazar at Balasore, Odisha, today
announcements.ai_summary: Baazar Style Retail Limited has opened a new retail store under the brand "Express Baazar" in Balasore, Odisha. This marks an expansion of the company's retail footprint. With the addition of this new store, the total number of stores operated by Baazar Style Retail Limited now stands at 270 as of today, April 12, 2026. This expansion is in line with the company's ongoing strategy to increase its market presence.

announcements.subject: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Ltd - 540530 - Mous Between HUDCO And NBCC
announcements.detail: MoUs between HUDCO and NBCC
announcements.ai_summary: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Limited (HUDCO) has signed two Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with NBCC (India) Limited on April 11, 2026. These MoUs aim to foster collaboration and leverage each other's strengths. The first MoU focuses on the redevelopment of a leasehold plot of approximately 18830 sqmt. at Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi, covering techno-economic feasibility, construction, project management, and space monetization. The second MoU involves undertaking asset monetization activities for NBCC's self-sustainable model projects, where HUDCO will provide funding and NBCC will offer project management and consultancy services, subject to Government of India approval.

announcements.subject: NCL Industries Ltd-$ - 502168 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail:
Dear Sir, 

Please take this intimation on record.

Thanks
Company Secretary
announcements.ai_summary: NCL Industries Ltd has provided its monthly business updates for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026. For cement, production increased by 2% to 8,02,600 MT and dispatches by 1% to 8,04,813 MT for the quarter, with year-end figures showing a 2% increase in both production and dispatches. However, Cement Boards saw a significant decline in production (-51%) and dispatches (-22%) for the quarter, and a -39% and -29% decrease respectively for the year. RMC production and sales decreased by 5% for the quarter and 12% for the year. Door production and sales saw a 100% drop for the quarter and a 94% drop for the year. Energy (Hydro Power) production decreased by 21% for the quarter but increased by 3% for the year.

announcements.subject: Everest Industries Ltd - 508906 - Completion Of Sale Of Land At Podanur Under Phase I
announcements.detail: This intimation is in furtherance to our initial intimation dated August 29, 2025 on the board approval and execution of a binding term sheet for the sale of vacant land at Podanur and subsequent updates in connection with the said transaction on October 27, 2025, January 25, 2026 and April 01, 2026. As per the last update dated April 01, 2026, we had informed the exchanges that the phase I sale of land of ~ 16 acres would be completed  in the month ....
announcements.ai_summary: On April 10, 2026, Everest Industries Limited concluded the sale of approximately 16.84 acres of vacant land at Kurichi Village, Podanur, Coimbatore District, Tamil Nadu, to G Square Properties Private Limited. This transaction is the Phase I completion of a sale initiated with a binding term sheet approved by the board on August 29, 2025, with subsequent updates provided on October 27, 2025, January 25, 2026, and April 1, 2026. The sale deed was executed and registered on the transaction date. The company has stated that the sale of vacant, excess land is not applicable for turnover or revenue contribution calculations for the last financial year.

announcements.subject: Shalby Ltd - 540797 - Intimation Of Receipt Of Approval For Kidney Transplant At Shalby Hospitals, Krishna Unit-Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation of receipt pf approval for kidney transplant of Shalby Hospitals, Krishna unit-Regulation 30 SEBI LODR
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Shalby Hospitals' Krishna unit in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, has received approval for performing kidney transplants for a period of 5 years, effective from April 9, 2026. This approval aims to provide local access to advanced transplant services, reducing the need for patients to travel long distances and incur associated costs. It also facilitates comprehensive pre- and post-transplant management within a single facility, enhancing continuity of care. The company has informed the National Stock Exchange of India and BSE Limited about this development.

announcements.subject: Fabtech Technologies Cleanrooms Ltd - 544332 - Corporate Announcement On Order Booking And Update
announcements.detail: Corporate Announcement on Order booking and update for month of March 31,2026
announcements.ai_summary: Fabtech Technologies Cleanrooms Ltd. has announced its order bookings and business updates for the month ending March 31, 2026. During March 2026, the company secured consolidated orders totaling ₹9.82 crore, with the Pharma sector contributing ₹7.67 crore, Renewable Energy ₹2.13 crore, and Others ₹0.02 crore. By business vertical, Cleanroom Partitions accounted for ₹7.49 crore and HVAC Systems for ₹2.33 crore. As of March 31, 2026, the consolidated order book stands at ₹199.21 crore, with significant portions from Renewable Energy (₹117.08 crore) and Pharma (₹41.95 crore). The company also has orders under active consideration amounting to ₹482 crore, with major opportunities in Renewable Energy (₹296.10 crore) and Pharma (₹164.71 crore). This indicates continued growth and diversification across high-growth sectors.

announcements.subject: Pee Cee Cosma Sope Ltd - 524136 - Disclosure Under Reg 30 For Change In Nominee Shareholders Of Wholly Owned Subsidiary

announcements.subject: Chartered Logistics Ltd - 531977 - Announcement Under Regulation 30

announcements.subject: Simran Farms Ltd - 519566 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment

announcements.subject: Panacea Biotec Ltd - 531349 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail:
We are delighted to inform you that Panacea Biotec Ltd. has received a Letter of Award dated 10.04.2026 from Central Medical Services Society, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India ("CMSS") for supply of Diphtheria and Tetanus Vaccine (Absorbed) for Adults and Adolescents IP in several tranches to  CMSS for the value aggregating to Rs.20.79 Crore.

A detailed disclosure as required under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations ....
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Panacea Biotec Ltd has received a Letter of Award dated April 10, 2026, from the Central Medical Services Society (CMSS), an entity under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. The award is for the supply of Diphtheria and Tetanus Vaccine (Absorbed) for Adults and Adolescents IP. announcements.subject: RBL Bank Ltd - 540065 - Board Meeting Outcome for RBL Bank Limited Informs The Exchange About Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: RBL Bank Limited informs the exchange about disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of RBL Bank Ltd, in its meeting held on April 11, 2026, approved an Amendment Agreement to the Investment Agreement dated October 18, 2025, with Emirates NBD Bank (P .J.S.C). This amendment relates to the proposed issuance of up to 95,90,45,636 equity shares of RBL Bank, with a face value of INR 10 each, at a price of INR 280 per share, aggregating to INR 268,53,27,78,080. The transaction is subject to member, Reserve Bank of India (RBI), and other regulatory approvals. The members had previously approved the transaction on November 12, 2025, with 98.84% votes in favour. The RBI had also approved the acquisition of up to 74% of the bank's paid-up share capital by Emirates NBD Bank on April 1, 2026, with the condition that RBL Bank will be classified as a foreign bank in subsidiary mode.

announcements.subject: Affordable Robotic & Automation Ltd - 541402 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

announcements.subject: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Ltd - 532371 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Action Initiated or Order passed
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Ltd has received an order dated April 10, 2026, from the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI). The order imposes a financial disincentive of Rs. 64,000 for the quarter ending June 2024. The violation pertains to the company's alleged failure to curb Unsolicited Commercial Communications (UCC) sent through its network, as required by the Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations, 2018. The company is currently reviewing the order and evaluating its next steps. The financial impact is limited to the penalty amount.

announcements.subject: SJ Corporation Ltd - 504398 - Intimation Of Approval Received For Listing 3,50,00,000 Equity Shares On A Preferential Basis.

The company has been informed by BSE that trading approval will be granted only after the company files the listing approval from the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd (if applicable) and confirmation letters from NSDL/CDSL regarding the crediting of shares to beneficiary accounts. SJ Corporation Ltd must also ensure compliance with SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, including Regulation 167.

announcements.subject: NTPC Ltd - 532555 - Declaration Of COD Of 4Th Unit (250) MW Of Tehri PSP (4X250 MW) Of THDC India Limited.
announcements.detail: Disclosure attached.

This unit has a capacity of 250 MW, and the project comprises four such units totaling 1000 MW. The COD is effective from 00:00 Hrs on April 12, 2026. Following this declaration, the total installed capacity of the NTPC group has reached 89,378 MW, with a commercial capacity of 88,298 MW. This development signifies an increase in NTPC's overall operational capacity.

announcements.subject: Rudra Ecovation Ltd - 514010 - Admission Of Second Motion Petition Pertaining To Merger Between Rudra Ecovation Limited And Shiva Texfabs Limited

announcements.subject: Kamdhenu Ventures Ltd - 543747 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition

announcements.subject: Vikas Lifecare Ltd - 542655 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Saturday, April 11, 2026

The 'Fund Raising Committee' has been authorized to finalize details, including proposed allottees and issue price, which must adhere to SEBI pricing formulas. The company's scrip code is 542655.

announcements.subject: Advance Agrolife Ltd - 544562 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30, The Company has informed regarding Bagging/Receiving of order/contract

This is a domestic order, and the company's promoter or promoter group has no interest in NFL. The announcement was made on April 11, 2026.

announcements.subject: PC Jeweller Ltd - 534809 - Update On The Conversion Of Fully Convertible Warrants Allotted On September 30, 2024 And October 11, 2024
announcements.detail: Update on conversion of Fully Convertible Warrants allotted on September 30, 2024 and October 11, 2024
announcements.ai_summary: PC Jeweller Ltd has successfully completed the conversion of 43,58,82,572 Fully Convertible Warrants into equity shares, benefiting 111 allottees, including promoter group entities. The update was provided on April 11, 2026.

announcements.subject: Sundaram Brake Linings Ltd - 590072 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) With-Regarding To Fire Incident.
announcements.detail:
Dear Sir/Madam,
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the listing Regulation , it is hereby informed that on Friday, 10th April 2026, at around 09.55 PM a fire incident occurred at the factory of Plant -1 situted at Kariapatti, Virundhunagar, Tamil nadu.

This is for your information and records.

Thanking You,
Hari S.
CFO
announcements.ai_summary: Sundaram Brake Linings Ltd has reported a fire incident at its Plant-1 located in Kariapatti, Virudhunagar, Tamil Nadu, which occurred on Friday, April 10, 2026, at approximately 09:55 PM IST. The fire was controlled, and fortunately, there were no casualties or injuries. However, the affected operations will be temporarily shut down. The extent of damage to assets and equipment is currently being evaluated, and a detailed estimate will be provided in due course. The assets at the affected plant are adequately insured, and the company has already informed the insurance company, with an insurance survey expected shortly. The company has provided this disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Craftsman Automation Ltd - 543276 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, (SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015)

This update follows a previous communication dated February 18, 2026, regarding the vessel's off-hire status. The information was received on April 10, 2026, at 22:20 hours.

announcements.subject: Dabur India Ltd - 500096 - Submission Of Information Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Imposition Of Penalty
announcements.detail: Submission of information under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Imposition of Penalty
announcements.ai_summary: Dabur India Ltd has been notified of a penalty imposed by the Additional District Magistrate, Almora. The penalty amounts to INR 4,00,000/- and is related to alleged contraventions of Section 26 and Section 27 of The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, concerning the labelling of one of the company's products. Dabur India Ltd received this order on April 10, 2026. The company believes the demand is not maintainable and intends to file an appeal before the 1st Appellate Authority. Dabur India Ltd states that this order will not have any impact on its financial, operational, or other activities, and it is confident of a favorable outcome in higher forums. The company will also make this information available on its website.

announcements.subject: Jindal Poly Films Ltd - 500227 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Order Passed By The Hon'Ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Dated 09.04.2026
announcements.detail: Update
announcements.ai_summary: The Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Principal Bench, New Delhi, has issued an order dated April 9, 2026, in response to a petition filed by minority shareholders of Jindal Poly Films Limited. The NCLT has issued notice in an intervention application filed by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and directed parties to file their replies. Jindal Poly Films Limited has received the SEBI intervention application but is awaiting the NCLT order. The company reiterates its commitment to legal and regulatory compliance and states that all transactions were conducted according to due process and necessary approvals. Further disclosures as required by SEBI regulations are provided in Annexure A. The company expresses full trust in the judicial system.

announcements.subject: PC Jeweller Ltd - 534809 - Update On Reduction Of Outstanding Debt Payable To Banks
announcements.detail: Update on reduction of outstanding debt payable to banks

This reduction brings the company closer to its objective of achieving a debt-free status. The repayment was facilitated by the balance consideration received from the conversion of Fully Convertible Warrants into equity shares by both the Promoter Group and Non-Promoter, Public entities. This marks significant progress towards the company's financial goal of becoming debt-free in the near future.

The UCO G-Sec Rate for a 1-year tenor has been revised from 5.58% to 5.72%, and the 10-year G-Sec Rate YTM has increased from 6.83% to 7.24%. Rates for TBLR (6 month), TBLR (12 month), Repo Linked Rate – UCO Float, Repo Linked Rate – UCO Prime, Base Rate, and BPLR remain unchanged.

The Castrol Activ range will now include viscosities 10W-30 and 5W-30 as full synthetic, expanding its offering for modern motorcycles. Additionally, Castrol GTX will become full synthetic for viscosities 5W-30 and 0W-20, marking a significant upgrade for its four-wheeler engine oil range. This move positions Castrol India as a segment disruptor by bringing full synthetic technology to mass market segments. announcements.detail: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Receives U.S. FDA Approval for Progesterone Vaginal Inserts, 100 mg

announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) has been directed by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) to pay an environmental compensation of Rs. 1 crore for failing to install Vapour Recovery Systems (VRS) at its storage locations by the prescribed deadline of March 2024. BPCL had appealed this direction to the National Green Tribunal, but the Tribunal, in its order received on April 7, 2026, upheld the CPCB's directive. The company has confirmed that VRS have since been installed at all 41 mandated storage locations by March 2025. This environmental compensation payment is not expected to have a material impact on BPCL's financial or operational activities.

announcements.subject: Network People Services Technologies Ltd - 544396 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Reg 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of SEBI LODR, 2015, please find attached press release on securing AI-Powered Risk Management Order from Public Sector Bank
announcements.ai_summary: Network People Services Technologies Limited (NPST) has secured an order from a public sector bank to deploy its AI-Powered Risk Intelligence and Decision Platform (RIDP). This platform is a cloud-native solution designed for merchant underwriting and lifecycle risk monitoring across online and Point of Sale (POS) channels. The RIDP offers automated risk assessment, monitoring, and compliance functionalities and is provided under a managed SaaS model, which is expected to generate recurring revenue. The solution includes automated website crawling to detect prohibited content and payment scheme violations, and it triggers re-underwriting when a merchant's business details change materially. The risk scoring is based on identity, behavioral, and website risk signals.

announcements.subject: Adani Green Energy Ltd - 541450 - Further Update On USA Matter
announcements.detail: Further update on USA matter
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Green Energy Limited has provided a further update regarding a civil matter initiated by the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of New York (EDNY). This update is in furtherance of previous intimations filed with the stock exchanges. The update states that the Defendants, Mr. Gautam Adani and Mr. Sagar Adani, who are directors of Adani Green Energy Limited, intend to move to dismiss the SEC's complaint by April 30, 2026. They have submitted a pre-motion conference letter to the EDNY judge, outlining their grounds for dismissal. These grounds include the court lacking personal jurisdiction over the Defendants, the claims being impermissibly extraterritorial, the alleged misstatements being non-actionable, and the Defendants' lack of involvement in the Offering barring the SEC's claims. The company, Adani Green Energy Limited, is not a party to these proceedings, and no charges have been brought against it.

announcements.subject: Indian Hotels Company Ltd - 500850 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed copy of press release titled "IHCL accelerates portfolio expansion; reaches 628 hotels marks a year of inorganic & sustained organic growth with 373 in operations and a pipeline of 255 hotels"
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) has announced a significant expansion of its hotel portfolio, reaching a total of 628 hotels, with a pipeline of 255 properties. This growth was driven by both inorganic and organic strategies, with 373 hotels currently in operation. The company added over 100 operating hotels through acquisitions this year, bringing the total operating hotels to 373 with over 33,000 rooms. IHCL aims to achieve its goal of a 700-hotel portfolio under its "Accelerate 2030" strategy. Key expansions include the onboarding of Claridges Collection, acquisition of a controlling stake in Atmantan, and majority stake acquisitions in ANK and Pride hospitality, bolstering the midscale segment. The company also saw organic growth across its brands, including 19 signings in Taj, with a new hotel in Cairo and a 500-key hotel in Patna.
