announcements.subject: Oberoi Realty Ltd - 533273 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: NCLT approves the Scheme of Amalgamation of Nirmal Lifestyle Realty Private Limited (''NLRPL'' or ''Transferor Company'') with Oberoi Realty Limited (''ORL'' or ''Transferee Company'') and their respective shareholders (''Scheme'')
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Oberoi Realty Limited has announced that the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, has approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Nirmal Lifestyle Realty Private Limited (Transferor Company) with Oberoi Realty Limited (Transferee Company) and their respective shareholders. The NCLT's order was pronounced on April 6, 2026. The Scheme will become effective from the date of filing the certified copy of the NCLT order with the Registrar of Companies. The company has enclosed the order as available on the NCLT website and will obtain the certified copy in due course. This amalgamation is being undertaken in accordance with Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

announcements.subject: Indian Overseas Bank - 532388 - Compliances-Half Yearly Report (SEBI Circular No. CIR/IMD/DF-1/67/2017)
announcements.detail: Debt instruments outstanding as on 31.03.2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Indian Overseas Bank has submitted its half-yearly statement of debt securities outstanding as of March 31, 2026, in compliance with SEBI Master Circular no. SEBI/HO/DDHS/PoD1/P/CIR/2024/54. The bank has outstanding debt instruments with a total issued amount of ₹3,665.00 Crore and an outstanding amount of ₹3,665.00 Crore as of the reporting date. Specifically, there is an outstanding amount of ₹500.00 Crore from a debenture issued on September 24, 2019, maturing on September 24, 2029, with a coupon rate of 9.0802% paid annually. Additionally, there are outstanding amounts of ₹665.00 Crore, ₹1,000.00 Crore, and ₹1,000.00 Crore from debentures issued on March 31, 2022, March 24, 2023, and January 23, 2026, respectively, with maturity dates in 2032, 2033, and 2036. These latter three issuances have coupon rates of 8.60%, 9.00%, and 7.80% respectively, and feature a call option at the end of 5 years, subject to RBI approval.

announcements.subject: Highway Infrastructure Ltd - 544477 - Announcement Of Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR
announcements.detail: Announcement of Regulation 30of SEBI LODR
announcements.ai_summary: Highway Infrastructure Limited has provided an update concerning the withdrawal of a Letter of Acceptance (LOA) issued by the National Highway Authority of India (NHAI) for the operations of Venkatapalem Fee Plaza in Andhra Pradesh. Following the non-acceptance of the LOA, NHAI has imposed a penalty of Rs. 26,33,000 on the company. The detailed disclosure regarding this order, as required by SEBI circular SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD- PoD-1/P/CIR/2023/123 dated July 13, 2023, has been enclosed.

announcements.subject: Amwill Health Care Ltd - 544353 - Update On Prior Intimation Regarding Cyber Security Incident.
announcements.detail: Please find the attached intimation under Regulation 30 of Listing Regulation.
announcements.ai_summary: Amwill Health Care Limited has provided an update regarding the IT security incident that occurred on February 18, 2026. The company has implemented containment and remediation protocols to mitigate the impact and ensure the integrity of its systems, infrastructure, and data. As a containment measure, the company proactively isolated its network. Data related to affected accounts and Structured Digital Database (SDD) data that was lost has been re-entered. To ensure compliance and accuracy, Amwill Health Care Limited has obtained a PCS certificate from Mr. Saurabh Talwar, PCS Delhi, confirming the completion of all SDD entries based on available information. This information will also be available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd - 524804 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Submission of Press Release on receipt of USFDA approval for Dapagliflozin and Metformin Hydrochloride Extended-Release tablets.
announcements.ai_summary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has received final approval from the US Food & Drug Administration (USFDA) for its Dapagliflozin and Metformin Hydrochloride Extended-Release Tablets. These tablets are available in strengths of 5 mg/ 500 mg, 5 mg/1000 mg, 10 mg/500 mg, and 10 mg/1000 mg, and are bioequivalent to AstraZeneca AB's Xigduo XR Tablets. The product will be manufactured at Unit-IV of APL Healthcare Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, and will be launched immediately. The estimated market size for these products is US$ 514 Million for the twelve months ending February 2026. Aurobindo Pharma has a total of 579 ANDA approvals from the USFDA as of March 31, 2026. As one of the first ANDA applicants with a paragraph IV certification, the company is eligible for 180 days of shared generic drug exclusivity.

announcements.subject: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd - 522275 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding imposition of penalty
announcements.ai_summary: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd has been informed of a penalty imposed by the Joint Commissioner of Customs. The company imported certain goods and assessed them at concessional rates of Basic Customs Duty. However, the authority determined that the imported goods did not qualify for these concessional rates, leading to a demand for short-levied differential duty. The order dated April 4, 2026, received on April 6, 2026, includes a short-levied differential duty of INR 15,14,900/-, a penalty of INR 15,14,900/-, and a redemption fine of Rs. 200,000/-. The company states there is no material impact on its financial or operational activities, with the financial impact limited to the order amount.

announcements.subject: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd - 544410 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Of Prostarm Info Systems Limited Held On Tuesday, April 07, 2026
announcements.detail: Please Find Attached the Outcome of the Board Meeting of Prostarm Info Systems Limited held on Tuesday, April 07, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd held a Board Meeting on April 07, 2026, where several key decisions were approved. The company resolved to strategically realign its business operations by shifting its UPS-related business from the Pisoli Unit to the Bakrol Unit in Gujarat, impacting its wholly owned subsidiary, Prostarm Energy Systems Private Limited. Furthermore, Prostarm Info Systems Ltd signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Shenzhen Topband Co. Ltd (TOPBAND) of China. This MOU aims to explore a strategic alliance for Exclusive Cooperation in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), where TOPBAND will provide SKD kits and technology, and Prostarm will handle local assembly and commercialization in India, aligning with the "Make in India" initiative.

announcements.subject: Yash Trading & Finance Ltd - 512345 - General- Updates
announcements.detail: Clarification for details mentioned in Outcome of Board Meeting held on April 04,2026
announcements.ai_summary: Yash Trading & Finance Ltd (now Lexora Global Limited) has issued a clarification regarding the outcome of its Board Meeting held on April 04, 2026. The company corrected a typographical error where the EGM date was incorrectly stated as "Monday" instead of "Saturday," May 02, 2026. Additionally, a pre-split share capital error was rectified; the number of equity shares was corrected from 10,00,00,000 to 1,00,00,000. This clarification aims to improve market liquidity and affordability for retail shareholders following a 10:1 share split.

announcements.subject: LMW Ltd - 500252 - Dislcosure letter  under  Regulation 11(5) of The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.detail: Adi Lakshmi Family Trust has submitted a letter to Exchange on amendment to trust deed  under Regulation 11(5) of The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Adi Narayana Family Trust has submitted a disclosure letter to the exchange regarding an amendment to its trust deed, as per Regulation 11(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This certificate from RJC Associates verifies the Trust's compliance with SEBI's exemption order dated June 4, 2019, and subsequent addendums, as well as the SEBI Master Circular dated February 16, 2023, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The Trust has confirmed that the beneficial interest of its beneficiaries has not been transferred, assigned, or encumbered, and that trustees have not delegated their powers. Furthermore, only individual promoters or their immediate relatives/lineal descendants serve as trustees and beneficiaries, with no outsiders introduced and no changes in beneficial interest or ownership/control of shares or voting rights. The Trust has also complied with the Companies Act, 2013, in connection with share acquisitions following an NCLT-approved amalgamation scheme.

announcements.subject: Super Sales India Ltd-$ - 512527 - Dislcosure letter  under  Regulation 11(5) of The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.detail: Adi Lakshmi Family Trust has submitted a letter to Exchange on amendment to trust deed  under Regulation 11(5) of The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
announcements.ai_summary: The Adi Lakshmi Family Trust has submitted a letter to the Exchange regarding an amendment to its trust deed under Regulation 11(5) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is in relation to an exemption order granted by SEBI on May 28, 2019, and a subsequent Master Circular dated February 16, 2023. The trust has confirmed compliance with the conditions stipulated in the exemption order for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. These conditions include ensuring that the beneficial interest of beneficiaries has not been transferred, assigned, or encumbered, and that trustees have not delegated their powers. The trust also confirmed that only individual promoters or their immediate relatives or lineal descendants are acting as trustees and beneficiaries, and no outsiders have been introduced.

announcements.subject: Supra Pacific Financial Services Ltd - 540168 - Business Update
announcements.detail: Business updates for the Quarter and year ended March 31, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Supra Pacific Financial Services Ltd has provided a business update for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026. The company's principal outstanding loans as of March 31, 2026, were ₹211.69 crore for Gold Loans, ₹54.93 crore for Vehicle Loans, ₹62.04 crore for Micro Finance Loans, and ₹6.98 crore for Other Loans, totaling ₹335.63 crore. Disbursements for the quarter and year amounted to ₹268.79 crore and ₹1057.62 crore, respectively, with collections of ₹274.43 crore for the quarter and ₹968.21 crore for the year. The company operates 88 branches across five states, and its Gross NPA as of March 31, 2026, was ₹3.64 crore. Total borrowings stand at ₹325.92 crore, comprising ₹136.37 crore in Non-Convertible Debentures, ₹128.06 crore in Subordinated Debts/ICD, and ₹61.48 crore in Other Secured Borrowings. This data is provisional and subject to audit by the company's statutory auditors.

announcements.subject: Kohinoor Foods Ltd - 512559 - Quarterly Disclosures By Listed Entities Of Defaults On Payment Of Interest/ Repayment Of Principal Amount On Loans From Banks / Financial Institutions And Unlisted Debt Securities
announcements.detail: Quarterly Disclosures by listed entities of defaults on payment of interest/ repayment of principal amount on loans from banks / financial institutions and unlisted debt securities
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Kohinoor Foods Ltd is providing its quarterly disclosure regarding defaults on loan payments. This announcement is a routine filing required for listed entities. The company is reporting on its obligations for interest payments and principal repayments on loans from banks, financial institutions, and unlisted debt securities. Investors should review these disclosures to understand the company's current debt servicing status.

announcements.subject: Ind-Swift Laboratories Ltd - 532305 - Intimation Of Receipt Of Arbitration Award
announcements.detail: Intimation of receipt of Arbitration Award
announcements.ai_summary: Ind-Swift Laboratories Ltd has received an arbitration award from the Arbitral Tribunal on April 7, 2026, concerning arbitration proceedings with PI Industries Limited. The Arbitral Tribunal has rejected all claims made by the claimant, PI Industries Limited, as well as all counterclaims filed by the respondents, including Ind-Swift Laboratories Limited. Consequently, the arbitration proceedings have concluded with no financial impact on Ind-Swift Laboratories Limited. This update is in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.company: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd
announcements.subject: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd - 544469 - Intimation Of Initial Subscription To Ordinary Shares In Wholly Owned Subsidiaries Of The Company
announcements.detail: Enclosed herewith Intimation of initial subscription to ordinary shares in Wholly Owned Subsidiaries of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd has informed the stock exchanges about its initial subscription to ordinary shares in its wholly-owned subsidiaries. This investment was made on March 4, 2026, as part of the company's ongoing strategy, following previous intimations on March 12, 13, 17, and 18, 2026. The company has invested in Sri Lotus Elegancia Realty Private Limited, Sri Lotus Legacy Realty Private Limited, Sri Lotus Marquee Projects Private Limited, Sri Lotus Imperial Projects Private Limited, and Sri Lotus Grand Abodes Private Limited. Each of these wholly-owned subsidiaries has an authorized capital of Rs. 10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakhs only), with Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited subscribing to Rs. 10,00,000/- in paid-up capital for Sri Lotus Grand Abodes Private Limited.

announcements.subject: Tulive Developers Ltd - 505285 - Letter of Offer
announcements.detail: Saffron Capital Advisors Pvt. Ltd. (Manager to the Delisting Offer") has submitted to BSE a copy of Letter of Offer for the attention of the Public Shareholders of Tulive Developers Ltd ("Target Company").
announcements.ai_summary: Altis Properties Private Limited and GKS Technology Park Private Limited, along with Atul Gupta and K V Ramana Shetty (collectively "Acquirers" and "Persons Acting in Concert"), have initiated a voluntary delisting proposal for Tulive Developers Limited. Saffron Capital Advisors Private Limited, acting as the Manager to the Delisting Offer, has submitted a Letter of Offer to BSE Limited for the public shareholders. The Acquirers intend to acquire all equity shares held by public shareholders and subsequently delist the company's shares from BSE Limited in accordance with the SEBI (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021. The Letter of Offer will be dispatched to public shareholders and made available on the company's and the manager's websites.

announcements.subject: Mangal Credit and Fincorp Ltd - 505850 - Intimation For Opening Of New Branch In The State Of Rajasthan (Bhilwara).
announcements.detail: Enclosed herewith intimation for opening of new branch in accordance with Regulation 30 read with Regulation 51 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Mangal Credit and Fincorp Ltd has informed the stock exchanges about the opening of a new branch in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, effective April 8, 2026. This intimation is made in compliance with Regulation 30 read with Regulation 51 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The new branch will be located at Shop no. G-10, 11 Ground Floor, Prem Bhavan, 14-B, Gandhi Nagar, Pur Road, Bhilwara, Rajasthan- 311001. The company has requested that this information be taken on record.

announcements.subject: The Phoenix Mills Ltd - 503100 - Business Update - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Please refer the attached letter.
announcements.ai_summary: The Phoenix Mills Limited has provided an operational business update for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. For the fiscal year 2026, the company achieved an all-time high retail consumption of approximately Rs. 16,578 crore, representing a 21% year-on-year increase, solely from its existing mall portfolio without any new additions. The fourth quarter of FY26 saw even stronger growth, with consumption reaching approximately Rs. 4,251 crore, up 31% year-on-year. The company's office portfolio also expanded significantly, with gross leasing of over 2.2 million square feet, leading to improved occupancy. Residential sales more than doubled year-on-year, and the hospitality segment remained resilient. The company has also uploaded this information on its website.

announcements.subject: Laurus Labs Ltd - 540222 - Update On Meetings Of Unsecured Creditors In Relation To The Composite Scheme Of Arrangement
announcements.detail: Please see annexed enclosure.
announcements.ai_summary: Laurus Labs Limited has announced a significant development regarding its Composite Scheme of Arrangement. The meetings of the unsecured creditors for both the Transferor Company (Laurus Synthesis Private Limited) and the Resulting Company (Sriam Labs Private Limited), which are wholly-owned subsidiaries, were held on April 06, 2026. These meetings were convened as per the directions of the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Amravati Special Branch (NCLT). The company confirms that the requisite quorum was present, and the meetings were conducted fairly and transparently. Crucially, the unsecured creditors of both entities have approved the Composite Scheme of Arrangement. This approval is a key milestone, though the scheme remains subject to further approval from the Hon’ble NCLT and other applicable statutory/regulatory authorities.

announcements.subject: Aegis Logistics Ltd - 500003 - Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Aegis Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about providing Corporate Guarantee and intimation for the same is attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Aegis Logistics Limited has provided a Corporate Guarantee to Itochu Corporation for the full and faithful performance of obligations by its subsidiary, Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited (AVTL), as per a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) dated March 27, 2026. This guarantee is related to Itochu Corporation becoming a shareholder of Aegis Terminal (Pipavav) Limited (ATPL), a subsidiary of AVTL, prior to the transfer of an Ammonia Terminal. The Corporate Guarantee amounts to INR 80,32,00,000/- and is for a limited period. The company has confirmed that this guarantee is at arm's length and no promoters or group companies have an interest in this transaction.

announcements.subject: Dhabriya Polywood Ltd - 538715 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (The "Listing Regulation') - Purchase Of Industrial Property.
announcements.detail: Intimation of Purchase of Industrial Land & Building.
announcements.ai_summary: Dhabriya Polywood Ltd has purchased an industrial property, including land and a building, for a total consideration of ₹22.46 crore. The property, measuring 2436 sq. meters, is located at Plot No. B-10(A,D,D1)A, Malviya Nagar Industrial Area, Jaipur - 302017, and is situated opposite the company's existing factory premises and registered office. This acquisition is intended to support the company's future expansion plans, including capacity enhancement for new and existing product lines. The purchase has been funded through internal accruals and partial bank funding. This intimation is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Shubham Polyspin Ltd - 542019 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulation 2015 For Capacity Expansion
announcements.detail: Disclosure for Capacity Expansion
announcements.ai_summary: Shubham Polyspin Ltd announced a capacity expansion of 200 MT per month at its existing unit in Borisana, Gujarat. The company's current capacity is 225 MT per month, with an approximate utilization of 90%. The proposed expansion is expected to be completed by March 2027 and requires an investment of approximately Rs. 1650 Lacs. This expansion will be funded by Rs. 415 Lacs from promoters' unsecured loans and Rs. 1235 Lacs from additional bank finance. The rationale behind this expansion is the increasing demand for PP yarn in domestic and international markets, aiming to improve operational efficiency, reduce per-unit costs, and strengthen competitiveness through economies of scale. The expanded capacity will also enable the adoption of modern, energy-efficient machinery, leading to improved yarn quality and reduced waste.

announcements.subject: Infosys Ltd - 500209 - Infosys And Harness Announce Strategic Collaboration To Unlock AI Value For Enterprise Transformation And Modernization Programs
announcements.detail: Enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Infosys Ltd has announced a strategic collaboration with Harness, an AI Software Delivery Platform company, effective April 7, 2026. This partnership aims to accelerate agentic AI-led software delivery transformation for global enterprises. The combined capabilities of Infosys Topaz Fabric, Infosys Cobalt, and the Harness Software Delivery Platform will focus on enhancing productivity, software engineering, AI governance, and scaling AI adoption. The collaboration seeks to automate the end-to-end software delivery lifecycle by applying AI to downstream activities such as testing, deployment, security, and governance. This initiative is designed to support large-scale modernization programs, particularly in complex and regulated environments, and will be hosted on Infosys' website.

announcements.subject: Rajshree Sugars & Chemicals Ltd - 500354 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Operational data of our sugar factories for the month of March 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Rajshree Sugars & Chemicals Ltd has provided its monthly business update for March 2026, detailing the operational data for its sugar factories. For the month of March 2026, the company crushed a total of 67,261 MTs of cane across its Coimbatore Unit I and Unit II, producing 6,875 MTs of sugar and selling 4,336 MTs. In the same period, molasses production was 4,305 MTs, with own consumption and sales at 4,454 MTs. Cogeneration operations produced 92.33 Lakh Units of power, with 27.37 Lakh Units for captive consumption and 64.96 Lakh Units exported to the grid. The report also includes cumulative figures up to March 2026 for cane crushed, sugar produced and sold, molasses production, and power generation.

announcements.subject: Titan Company Ltd - 500114 - Modification To The Trust Deed Consequent To The Change In Composition Of The Trustees - Titan Employee Stock Option Trust
announcements.detail: Modification to the Trust Deed consequent to the change in composition of the trustees - Titan Employee Stock Option Trust
announcements.ai_summary: Titan Company Ltd has informed the stock exchanges about a modification to the Trust Deed of the Titan Employee Stock Option Trust. This change is consequent to an alteration in the composition of the trustees. The modification has been made in compliance with Regulation 3 of the SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021. A copy of the Deed of Variation has been enclosed with the announcement for information and records.

announcements.subject: Praxis Home Retail Ltd - 540901 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of LODR - Grant Of Stock Options
announcements.detail: Grant of Stock Options.
announcements.ai_summary: The Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Praxis Home Retail Ltd, in its meeting held on April 07, 2026, approved the grant of 5,00,000 stock options to eligible employees under the 'Praxis Employee Stock Option Plan 2024'. Each option will have an exercise price of Rs. 5/-. These options cover 5,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 5/- face value each. The options will vest in tranches: 40% after one year, 30% after two years, and 30% after three years from the grant date. Grantees can exercise these options within three years of their respective vesting dates. The meeting of the committee commenced at 4:05 p.m. and concluded at 4:16 p.m.

announcements.subject: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd - 542907 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Completion of Acquisition of Manufacturing facility at Bhuj, Gujarat
announcements.ai_summary: Prince Pipes and Fittings Limited has successfully completed the second phase of its acquisition of a manufacturing facility in Bhuj, Gujarat. This follows the company's earlier disclosure on March 20, 2024, regarding an Asset Purchase Agreement (APA) with Klaus Waren Fixtures Private Limited and Mr. Narshi Mulji Shah for the Aquel bathware business. The second phase involved the acquisition of the land parcel, buildings, machinery, manufacturing equipment, and office furniture and fixtures. This acquisition is a strategic move to strengthen Prince Pipes' diversification into the bathware segment and will serve as a manufacturing base for its bathware operations, supporting the scaling of the "Aquel by Prince" product portfolio.

announcements.subject: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd - 517334 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI(Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements)Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with the stock exchange regarding disclosure under regulation  30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted an announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, regarding the settlement of proceedings. SMR Hyosang Automotive Ltd., an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the company in South Korea, entered into a mediation agreement with its sub-contractor on April 6, 2026. As part of this settlement, SMR Hyosang will pay KRW 360,000,000, equivalent to approximately INR 22,179,600, excluding VAT, by April 27, 2026. This settlement resolves dues and claims arising from sub-contracting transactions. The company has stated that there is no material impact on the financial, operational, or other activities of SMR Hyosang or the parent company.

announcements.subject: GHV Infra Projects Ltd - 505504 - Intimation Of Receipt Of Request For Reclassification From ''Promoter Group / PAC'' To ''Public Shareholder'' Under Regulation 31A Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

announcements.detail: Aftertrade Broking Pvt Ltd ("Manager to the Offer") has submitted to BSE a copy of Letter of Offer to the Public Shareholders of Aspira Pathlab & Diagnostics Ltd ("Target Company").
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Aftertrade Broking Private Limited, acting as the Manager to the Offer, has submitted a Letter of Offer to the BSE on behalf of Mr. Arvind Karsandas Bhanushali, Mrs. Deepali Arvind Bhanushali, Mr. Jay Arvind Bhanushali, Mr. Nikunj Velji Mange, and Mr. Raj Arvind Bhanushali, along with Mrs. Shraddha Nikunj Mange (collectively referred to as the "Acquirers" and "PAC"). announcements.subject: Alkem Laboratories Ltd - 539523 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith Press release- Alkem Launches A to Z Daily, an everyday multivitamin supplement for body and mind.
announcements.ai_summary: Alkem Laboratories Ltd. has announced the launch of "A to Z Daily," a new everyday multivitamin supplement designed for adults to provide holistic nutritional support for both body and mind. The supplement is formulated with 26 essential vitamins, minerals, and select botanicals, including Vitamin B complex, Vitamin D3, Vitamin C, Zinc, Iron, Ashwagandha, Bacopa monnieri, Panax ginseng, and L-theanine. These ingredients are intended to help manage stress, improve energy levels, and strengthen immunity. Alkem Laboratories positions "A to Z Daily" as a consistent, long-term approach for individuals seeking to maintain physical energy and mental composure amidst daily pressures. The launch was announced on April 7, 2026.

announcements.subject: CarTrade Tech Ltd - 543333 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Attached
announcements.ai_summary: CarTrade Tech Limited announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Sobek Auto India Private Limited (OLX India), has appointed Mr. Varun Sanghi as its Non-Executive Chairman. Mr. Sanghi, who has been with CarTrade Tech for over a decade and currently serves as Chief Strategy Officer, was instrumental in the acquisition of OLX India in 2023 and has led post-integration initiatives. He also heads CarTrade Labs, the company's innovation hub. As Chairman of OLX India, Mr. Sanghi will provide strategic guidance to support the company's next phase of growth, focusing on innovation, trust, and customer-centricity. This appointment is effective from April 7, 2026.

announcements.subject: Larsen & Toubro Ltd - 500510 - Compliances-Half Yearly Report (SEBI Circular No. CIR/IMD/DF-1/67/2017)
announcements.detail: Disclosure pursuant to Paragraph 9.1 (a) of the Chapter VIII of SEBI Master Circular no. SEBI/HO/DDHS/PoD1/P/CIR/2024/54 dated Nay 22, 2024
announcements.ai_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has submitted its half-yearly report as required by SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/DDHS/PoD1/P/CIR/2024/54 dated May 22, 2024. The disclosure pertains to debt securities issued under SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-convertible Securities) Regulations, 2021. The report details five outstanding debt issuances as of March 31, 2026. These include Rs. 2,000 Crore with a coupon rate of 7.725% maturing on April 28, 2028; Rs. 1,800 Crore at 8.00% maturing on April 23, 2030; Rs. 1,500 Crore at 7.19% maturing on December 5, 2034; Rs. 4,000 Crore at 7.20% maturing on January 22, 2035; and Rs. 500 Crore at 6.35% maturing on June 19, 2028. All these issuances have a yearly payment frequency and no embedded options. The company has provided the ISIN numbers, issuance dates, maturity dates, coupon rates, and amounts issued and outstanding for each debt security.

announcements.subject: Coffee Day Enterprises Ltd - 539436 - Quarterly Disclosures By Listed Entities Of Defaults On Payment Of Interest/ Repayment Of Principal Amount On Loans From Banks / Financial Institutions And Unlisted Debt Securities
announcements.detail: Quarterly Disclosures by listed entities of defaults on payment of interest/ repayment of principal amount on loans from banks / financial institutions and unlisted debt securities
announcements.ai_summary: Coffee Day Enterprises Ltd is required to submit quarterly disclosures regarding defaults on payment of interest or repayment of principal on loans from banks, financial institutions, and unlisted debt securities. announcements.subject: Regency Ceramics Ltd - 515018 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2025
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2025, we here by inform that the Hon''ble  Principal District Court, puducherry has passed judgement in favour of the Company in the matter  of National Insurance company Limited vs Regency Ceramics Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: On April 7, 2026, Regency Ceramics Limited announced that the Hon'ble Principal District Court, Puducherry, passed a judgment in favor of the company on April 6, 2026. The case involved National Insurance Company Limited vs. Regency Ceramics Limited (OP No. 33 of 2022). The court partly allowed the petition, modifying an arbitral award to Rs. 133,30,60,000 (Rupees One Hundred Thirty-Three Crores Thirty Lakhs Sixty Thousand Only) and confirming the remaining portion along with proportionate costs. This outcome is expected to have a positive impact on the company's financial position.

announcements.subject: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd - 532811 - Clarification On Dated 09-07-2024 Reply To NSE On 12-07-2024 But Missed With BSE

announcements.ai_summary: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd has submitted a clarification to BSE Limited regarding a non-compliance with Regulation 21(3C) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The Risk Management Committee meetings were held on February 13, 2023, and November 10, 2023, with a gap of 270 days, which exceeded the 180-day limit stipulated by the regulation. The company acknowledges the unintentional delay in intimation to BSE and assures future compliance.

announcements.subject: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Ltd - 532365 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed intimation for securing project from Jammu and Kashmir Bank for ERP solution
announcements.ai_summary: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Ltd has secured a significant project from Jammu & Kashmir Bank for an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Solution. The project involves designing, implementing, and supporting a centralized, enterprise-wide ERP platform to modernize and integrate the bank's core financial and operational processes. This initiative aims to standardize and automate operations, establish a single source of truth for organizational data, and strengthen decision-making through real-time reporting. The contract is for a duration of 5 years and has a broad consideration of Rs. 25 Crores (Excluding GST). The company is a domestic entity, and the scope of work includes ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and supporting future growth with a scalable system.

announcements.subject: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd - 543300 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release on achievement of significant production milestones by the Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd announced on April 7, 2026, that it has achieved significant production milestones, manufacturing 500 million differential gears and 10 million differential assemblies since its inception. This achievement reinforces its position as a key global driveline solutions provider. The company, a leading global provider of mobility technology solutions, designs and manufactures components for Battery Electric Vehicles (BEV), Passenger Vehicles, Commercial Vehicles, and Off-highway Vehicles. Sona Comstar held an estimated 8.7% global market share in differential gears in CY25, an increase from 4.5% in 2019. Production began in 1999 at its Gurugram plant, followed by its Pune facility in 2005, with accelerated production in recent years.

announcements.subject: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd - 532143 - Updates
announcements.detail: Updates
announcements.ai_summary: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd has issued an update confirming the absence of bird flu incidents in its poultry farms, particularly in Tamil Nadu, where all its operations are located. The company clarified that it has no operations in Kerala, where avian influenza cases were previously reported. Their farms are recognized by the Government of India as avian influenza-free compartment farms, with continuous and rigorous surveillance for diseases like avian influenza, Newcastle disease, and salmonella. Enhanced biosecurity measures, including securing bird waste areas and restricting external visitors, are in place. The company assures stakeholders that the health of its layer birds remains stable, and egg production continues uninterrupted.

announcements.subject: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd - 538446 - Business Updates On Collection Efficiency
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith the intimation w.r.t. business updates.
announcements.ai_summary: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd has provided business updates on its collection efficiency for the period ending March 2026. The company's collection efficiency for the 'POS resolution %' in the 61-90 bucket showed an upward trend, reaching 62.8% in March 2026, up from 42.9% in October 2025. The number of bounce cases in the 'X Bucket' increased from 40,600 in September 2025 to 66,200 in March 2026. These updates are made pursuant to SEBI regulations and are available on the company's website, www.moneyboxxfinance.com. The update is subject to a quarterly limited review by the statutory auditors.

announcements.company: Swan Defence And Heavy Industries Ltd
announcements.subject: Swan Defence And Heavy Industries Ltd - 533107 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 7, 2026 titled "SDHI secures India''s First Ammonia Dual-Fuel Bulk Carrier Order".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited (SDHI) has secured a shipbuilding contract with Energy ONE Limited for the construction of four (4) 92,500 DWT dual-fuel ammonia bulk carriers. This marks India's first order for such vessels and represents one of the largest commercial vessels ever to be built at an Indian shipyard. Each vessel will be 229.5m in length with a beam of 37m and will feature an ammonia-fuelled propulsion system. The vessels will be designed by KMS-EMEC, South Korea, and classed by Det Norske Veritas (DNV). The first vessel is scheduled for delivery in October 2029, with subsequent deliveries at four-month intervals.

announcements.subject: Brightcom Group Ltd - 532368 - Monthly Updates
announcements.detail: Monthly updates
announcements.ai_summary: Brightcom Group Limited has submitted its monthly update presentation for February and March 2026, detailing operational progress, governance initiatives, and business developments. The company focused on structured execution across operations, partnerships, and governance during this period, rather than expansion. Key highlights include improving revenue quality, strengthening internal processes and control frameworks, and aligning global operations. The presentation emphasizes a strategic shift towards improving yield per unit of supply and deepening partner integration, with a focus on increasing direct publisher integrations and demand efficiency. Growth continues in video, CTV, and in-app ecosystems, with heightened performance expectations.

announcements.subject: TechNVision Ventures Ltd - 501421 - Emagia Unveils Gia Order Management Super Agent On Its Autonomous Finance Platform To Accelerate Order-To-Cash For Global Enterprises
announcements.detail: Please find the attached information for dissemination at the Corporate Announcement section of BSE website.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Emagia, an AI-powered Autonomous Finance platform provider, has announced the launch of its Gia Order Management Super Agent. This new solution is designed to autonomously capture, validate, and process customer purchase orders, aiming to accelerate order-to-cash cycles for global enterprises. Key highlights include 80-95% touchless order processing across omni-channels and multi-languages, up to 10x faster order entry cycles, and 50-70% cost reduction in processing with improved data accuracy. The platform also offers over 120 enterprise integrations. TechNVision Ventures Ltd is disseminating this news for corporate announcement purposes.

announcements.subject: PDS Ltd - 538730 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: PDS Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding press release.

This engagement will be executed through PDS subsidiary, GSCL, under the leadership of Michael Yee, who is spearheading PDS's efforts to scale its US business. The contract signifies a crucial step in strengthening PDS's presence in key markets through on-ground leadership and execution capabilities. The company highlighted that this partnership reflects the resilience of the PDS platform and the strength of its global ecosystem, with its widespread sourcing network and ability to deliver agile solutions positioning it as a partner of choice for leading global retailers. Continued investments in cost transformation, digital capabilities, and AI-led initiatives have enhanced PDS's sourcing platform and value proposition, as evidenced by this new partnership.

announcements.subject: Valencia Nutrition Ltd - 542910 - Press Release-Strategic Manufacturing Agreement Between Valencia Beverages And Superwaters P Ltd And Virchow Laboratories Ltd

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Valencia Nutrition Ltd, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Valencia Beverages and Superwaters Private Limited, has entered into a strategic manufacturing agreement with Virchow Laboratories Limited. This agreement covers the manufacturing of Valencia's juice product portfolio, including 8 SKUs such as Mango, Guava, and Apple variants. A committed monthly production volume has been secured, representing approximately 15% of Valencia Beverages Unit II's installed capacity in Hyderabad. This partnership aims to enhance Valencia's manufacturing capabilities and leverage Virchow Laboratories' expertise to improve production efficiency and meet growing demand. The collaboration is expected to contribute to optimal capacity utilization at Valencia's Hyderabad facility.

announcements.subject: Greenlam Industries Ltd - 538979 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Acquisition
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR), 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Greenlam Industries Ltd announced that its wholly owned subsidiaries, Greenlam Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) and Greenlam Industries SDN. BHD. (Malaysia), have jointly acquired the entire 33% local shareholding of PT. Greenlam Indo Pacific in Indonesia. Previously, the Singapore subsidiary held 67% of PT. Greenlam Indo Pacific. Following this acquisition, the Indonesian entity has become a wholly owned step-down subsidiary of Greenlam Industries Limited, with the collective shareholding of the Singapore and Malaysia subsidiaries now at 100%. The turnover of PT. Greenlam Indo Pacific for FY 2024-25 was IDR 13,169,408,093, with a comprehensive income of IDR (7,318,172,587). This transaction aims to rationalize the group's holding structure and minimize compliance requirements. The announcement was made on April 6, 2026.

announcements.detail: In relation to voluntary delisting of equity shares of the Company from BSE Limited, pursuant to regulation 28(1) of SEBI (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021 and Detailed Public Announcement published in newspapers on April 06, 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company has constituted a Committee of Independent Directors to provide reasoned recommendations on the delisting offer
announcements.ai_summary: Tulive Developers Ltd has announced the formation of a Committee of Independent Directors to provide recommendations on its voluntary delisting offer from BSE Limited. This action is in accordance with Regulation 28(1) of the SEBI (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021. The committee members are Mr. Jacob George Kandathil (Chairman), Mr. Pradeep Bhandari, and Mrs. Bhumika Jignesh Shah. The company will publish the committee's reasoned recommendations and voting pattern details at least two working days before the bidding period commences, in the same newspapers where the Detailed Public Announcement (DPA) was published on April 06, 2026. Saffron Capital Advisors Private Limited is the Manager to the Delisting Offer.

announcements.subject: Globus Spirits Ltd - 533104 - Press Release - Launch Of TERAI Tequila
announcements.detail: Press Release - Launch of TERAI Tequila
announcements.ai_summary: Globus Spirits Limited has announced the launch of TERAI Tequila, marking its entry into the premium tequila market. This new product is positioned as India's first authentic, CRT-certified tequila to be bottled domestically. TERAI Tequila is crafted in Jalisco, Mexico, at the La Huaracha Distillery using 100% Blue Weber Agave and traditional methods. The spirit is then imported to India and bottled under the strict supervision of the Consejo Regulador del Tequila (CRT). The initial offering is a Blanco expression, highlighting the purity of the agave. This launch signifies Globus Spirits' strategy to cater to evolving Indian consumer preferences for global, authentic, and luxury spirits.

announcements.subject: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Ltd - 512608 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Meeting Of Board Of Directors Of Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited (The Company) - Revision In The Utilisation Of Funds Raised In Rights Issue Concluded In March 2026

The rights issue was only 48.44% subscribed. As of March 31, 2026, Rs. 678 Lakhs were utilized for repayment of MSME and pressing creditors, suppliers, and rights issue expenses. The remaining funds, totaling Rs. 2378.41 Lakhs, will be utilized by June 30, 2026, primarily for long-term working capital and rights issue expenses. The company has deferred the object of payment of long-term loans and will limit the use of funds for general corporate purposes.

announcements.subject: Midwest Gold Ltd - 526570 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Regulations) 2015.
announcements.detail: Midwest Energy Devices Private Limited, Step-down subsidiary company has commenced trial production at its Lithium Battery Assembly Line and Certification - Led BESS Platform.
announcements.ai_summary: Midwest Gold Ltd announced that its step-down subsidiary, Midwest Energy Devices Private Limited, has commenced trial production at its Lithium Battery Assembly Line and Certification-Led BESS Platform. This facility, located in Bengaluru, has a semi-automated, process-driven manufacturing platform with an initial annual capacity of 1 GWh, which has a roadmap to scale up to 3 GWh. The production line is designed for traceability, process control, validation rigor, and certification readiness, verifying each battery cell before production and testing finished units. The platform offers flexibility to handle different cell types, pack capacities, and configurations, supporting Midwest's branded BESS products, contract manufacturing, and customized battery pack requirements. The company is currently advancing two flagship BESS platforms under certification-led development, including a 418 kWh Outdoor BESS Unit.

Neetu Yoshi Ltd plans to continue focusing on strengthening its financial position, improving operational efficiencies, and pursuing growth opportunities.

announcements.subject: Ethos Ltd - 543532 - Opening Of Ethos Watch Boutiques At Jodhpur
announcements.detail: Opening of Ethos Watch Boutiques at Jodhpur
announcements.ai_summary: The company Ethos Limited has inaugurated a new Ethos Watch Boutique in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, located at Upper Ground Floor, UG, Shop No.02, K Mall, Plot 13 -18, Pali Road, Sushil Nagar. This expansion marks a significant milestone in strengthening their luxury brand portfolio and further consolidates their presence in a prominent luxury retail market in India. With this new launch, Ethos Limited now operates 94 boutiques across India, aiming to make exclusive brands more accessible to discerning customers and deliver unparalleled luxury experiences. The company has not provided any specific financial figures related to this expansion.

announcements.ai_summary: JOJO Limited, formerly known as Madhuveer Com 18 Network Limited, has announced the successful go-live of its content integration with Airtel Xstream Platform. announcements.subject: Waaree Energies Ltd - 544277 - Commencement Of Commercial Production
announcements.detail: Commencement of Commercial Production by Sangam Solar One Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary at Samakhiali-Kutch, Gujrat, India.

announcements.subject: Nimbus Projects Ltd - 511714 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Nimbus Projects Ltd has successfully listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) on April 06, 2026, in addition to its existing listing on the BSE since 2000. This dual listing is expected to enhance stock liquidity, improve price discovery, and provide broader access to institutional and retail investors. The stock opened at INR 199 on the NSE on its listing day. The company, a real estate developer, has approximately 3 million square feet under development, focusing on residential and mixed-use assets. With over three decades of experience, Nimbus Projects has a market capitalization in the range of ₹350-365 crore, with shares trading close to book value.

announcements.subject: Bharti Airtel Ltd - 532454 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: We are enclosing herewith a press release dated April 06, 2026 titled ''Airtel expands its 5G network footprint across UP East with over 4300+ new sites'' being issued by the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Bharti Airtel Limited has announced the expansion of its 5G network footprint across UP East, deploying over 4300 new sites in the last 12 months. This expansion covers 48 districts and aims to strengthen network presence for approximately 34 million people across urban, growth towns, and rural areas. The company is averaging the deployment of 12 new sites daily to enhance high-speed connectivity for work, education, entertainment, and digital payments. Customers in cities like Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi, and Ayodhya will benefit from this enhanced coverage, supporting the digital needs of citizens, students, micro-entrepreneurs, enterprises, and government institutions. This initiative underscores Airtel's commitment to strengthening digital connectivity and making sustained investments in advanced network infrastructure in UP East.

announcements.subject: Max Estates Ltd - 544008 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached the Press Release.
announcements.ai_summary: Max Estates Limited announced its pre-sales performance for the financial year 2026, achieving total pre-sales of approximately INR 5,305 crore, marking the second consecutive year of surpassing INR 5,000 crore. The fourth quarter of FY2026 contributed significantly with approximately INR 3,392 crore in bookings. Key project performances include Estate 105 (Noida) which booked approximately INR 1,783 crore within 10 days of its March 20 launch, and Estate 361 (Gurugram) which achieved pre-sales of approximately INR 1,704 crore since its December 2025 launch. The company has a total Gross Development Value (GDV) pipeline of over INR 16,000 crore for FY27 onwards.

announcements.subject: LTIMindtree Ltd - 540005 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Intimation attached
announcements.ai_summary: LTIMindtree Ltd (now LTM Limited) has issued a press release announcing that it will offer MIT Open Learning's Universal AI program to its workforce in cooperation with upGrad Enterprise. This initiative aims to institutionalize foundational AI reasoning across LTM's talent pool, empowering employees in both tech and non-tech functions. The Universal AI program, developed by MIT Open Learning faculty, covers 16 foundational modules and vertical-specific modules, requiring no coding and suitable for all skill levels. This upskilling effort is intended to equip employees with scientific thinking and first-principles reasoning skills for success in an AI-driven economy and for long-term career development.

announcements.subject: UCO Bank - 532505 - Provisional Business Figures Of The Bank As On 31.03.2026
announcements.detail: Provisional Business Figures of the Bank as on 31.03.2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: UCO Bank has released its provisional business figures as of March 31, 2026. announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Jindal Steel has announced a significant advancement in India's energy sector by pioneering the use of swadeshi coal through advanced coal gasification. The company achieved a global first by establishing India's first coal gasification-based Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) plant, utilizing syngas for iron-making. In response to fuel shortages, Jindal Steel has successfully deployed syngas in galvanizing and color coating line furnaces, a first for the steel industry, to mitigate supply disruptions. Furthermore, the company has pioneered syngas injection into its blast furnace, reducing reliance on imported coking coal and lowering carbon emissions per tonne of steel. This integrated approach across the steelmaking value chain aims to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and energy self-reliance, supported by government policies like the National Coal Gasification Mission.

announcements.subject: Hindustan Copper Ltd - 513599 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.ai_summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd (MDL) has announced the commissioning of INS Taragiri, an indigenously built stealth frigate, into the Indian Navy on April 3, 2026, at Visakhapatnam. This marks a significant advancement in India's warship design and construction capabilities, as INS Taragiri is the third vessel in the Project 17A series. The ship, measuring 149.02 meters in length and 17.8 meters in width, has a displacement of 6400 tons and is powered by a CODOG propulsion system, enabling a speed of over 28 knots. Equipped with advanced stealth features, weapon systems, sensors, and automation, INS Taragiri is expected to substantially enhance India's maritime security and operational reach in the Indian Ocean Region. The commissioning ceremony was presided over by the Hon’ble Raksha Mantri, Shri Rajnath Singh.

announcements.detail: Half Yearly Statement of NCDs ( Debt Securities) as on March 31, 2026.

announcements.subject: Moil Ltd - 533286 - Information Relating To Fixation Of Price Of Different Grades Of Manganese Ore.
announcements.detail: Information relating to fixation of price of different grades of Manganese Ore.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: MOIL Limited has announced the fixation and revision of prices for different grades of Manganese Ore and other products, effective from April 1, 2026. For the quarter April-June 2026 and specifically for the month of April 2026, prices for all Ferro grades of manganese ore with a Manganese content of Mn- 44% and above have been increased by 15% compared to prices prevailing since March 1, 2026. Similarly, prices for all other Ferro grades with Manganese content below Mn-44%, as well as SMGR (Mn -30%), SMGR (Mn 25%), Fines grades, and Chemical grades, have been increased by 17.5% on the prices prevailing since March 1, 2026. The basic price of EMD has been continued at Rs. 1,80,000/- PMT for April 2026, as it was since March 1, 2026. This information was disclosed on April 3, 2026.

announcements.subject: ARCL Organics Ltd - 543993 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements

The Sale Deed for the land was executed by Mr. Sandeep Patel and Mr. Hasmukhbhai Patel in favor of ARCL Organics Ltd. announcements.subject: Shankara Buildpro Ltd - 544517 - Shankara Buildpro Surpasses FY 26 Volume Target Of 1 Million Tonnes, Delivers 32% YOY Growth
announcements.detail: Shankara Buildpro surpasses FY26 Volume Target of 1 million tonnes, delivers 32% YOY Growth
announcements.ai_summary: Shankara Buildpro Limited has announced that it surpassed its financial year 2026 (FY26) volume target of 1 million tonnes, achieving a total volume of 10.2 lakh tonnes for the year ended March 31, 2026. This represents a significant year-on-year growth of 32%, compared to 7.7 lakh tonnes in FY25. The company attributes this achievement to its marketplace strategy, portfolio expansion, and increased distribution across new geographies. The Managing Director, Mr. Sukumar Srinivas, expressed pride in meeting and exceeding the target, highlighting the company's execution capability and the strength of its marketplace and distribution franchise. Growth was observed across key categories such as Pipes & Tubes, Flats, and Roofing products, providing confidence for the upcoming financial year FY27.

announcements.subject: Vibhor Steel Tubes Ltd - 544124 - Intimation Regarding New Product Launch

announcements.subject: Max Financial Services Ltd - 500271 - Disclosure Under The Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI LODR') - Approval For Issuance Of Equity Shares On Preferential Basis By Axis Max Life Insurance Limited To Axis Bank Limited
announcements.detail: As per the disclosure attached
announcements.ai_summary: Max Financial Services Limited has disclosed that its subsidiary, Axis Max Life Insurance Limited, has received approval from its Board of Directors for a capital infusion. Axis Max Life will issue equity shares of Rs. 10/- each to Axis Bank Limited for an aggregate investment of up to Rs. 389 crores. This preferential issuance is intended to meet Axis Max Life's funding requirements and support its future growth initiatives. Following this infusion, Axis Bank Limited will collectively hold 19.99% of the equity share capital of Axis Max Life, with Max Financial Services Limited holding approximately 80.01%. Axis Bank has already received the requisite approval from the RBI for this infusion. The proposal is subject to the approval of the shareholders of Axis Max Life. This information was disclosed on April 2, 2026.

announcements.subject: Bank of Baroda - 532134 - Provisional Business Figures - March 2026
announcements.detail: Provisional Business Figures - March 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Bank of Baroda has released its provisional business figures for March 2026, showing significant year-on-year growth. As of March 31, 2026, the bank's Global Business grew by 13.93% YoY to ₹ 30.79 trillion. Global Advances increased by 16.23% YoY to ₹ 14.30 trillion, while Global Deposits rose by 12.00% YoY to ₹ 16.49 trillion. Domestic Deposits also saw a healthy increase of 12.83% YoY to ₹ 14.01 trillion, and Domestic Advances grew by 14.56% YoY to ₹ 11.70 trillion. Domestic Retail Advances experienced a substantial growth of 17.93% YoY, reaching ₹ 3.03 trillion. These figures are provisional and subject to audit by the bank's Statutory Central Auditors. The bank has intimated these figures in accordance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Union Bank of India - 532477 - Intimation Under SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Provisional Business Figures as 31.03.2026
announcements.ai_summary: Union Bank of India has released its provisional business figures as of March 31, 2026. The bank reported a 9.76% Year-on-Year (YoY) growth in Total Gross Advances and a 10.06% YoY growth in Total Domestic Advances. RAM Advances (Domestic) saw a growth of 12.59% YoY. Domestic CASA Deposits grew by 7.90% YoY and 10.82% Quarter-on-Quarter (QoQ). Total Global Business stood at Rs. 23,85,679 Crores, with Global Advances at Rs. 10,78,779 Crores and Global Deposits at Rs. 13,06,900 Crores. The Domestic CASA Deposits reached Rs. 4,59,988 Crores, representing 35.21% of total deposits. This information is provisional and subject to audit by the Statutory Central Auditors.

announcements.subject: 3i Infotech Ltd - 532628 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Please find attached intimation letter that Company has received an Order from a leading Private Sector Bank.
announcements.ai_summary: 3i Infotech Limited has secured a new order from a leading private sector bank in India, dated April 2, 2026, for a digitization and document management project. The project involves handling legacy credit card application records, including inventory preparation, data entry, scanning, indexing, storage, retrieval, and shredding, with secure data handling and compliance. This is a rate card-based contract with an approximate value of Rs. 2.04 Crore, exclusive of applicable taxes, based on anticipated volumes. The contract duration is 12 months, and 3i Infotech will focus on enhancing the visibility, accessibility, and compliance of historical customer records.

announcements.subject: IRM Energy Ltd - 544004 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith press release on the subject -Commissioned 150th CNG Station.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: IRM Energy Limited has announced a significant milestone with the commissioning of its 150th Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) station located in Banaskantha, Gujarat, on March 31, 2026. During the financial year 2025-26, the company commissioned a total of 39 CNG stations, demonstrating its commitment to expanding green energy infrastructure within its authorized geographical areas. This expansion aims to drive the transition towards sustainable and eco-friendly transportation solutions. IRM Energy Limited operates under authorizations from the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) in four Geographical Areas: Banaskantha (Gujarat), Fatehgarh Sahib (Punjab), Diu & Gir Somnath (Gujarat), and Namakkal & Tiruchirappalli (Tamil Nadu). CNG currently represents approximately 60% of the company's volumes and is considered the primary growth driver.

announcements.subject: Highway Infrastructure Ltd - 544477 - General Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR 2015

There is no quantifiable financial or operational impact beyond the penalty amount.

announcements.subject: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Ltd - 540701 - DISCLOSURE PURSUANT TO REGULATIONS 30 AND 51 OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS, 2015 : Amendment In Terms Related To Financial Covenants For FY Ended 31St March, 2026 In Respect Of Non-Convertible Debentures ('NCDS') Issued Under ISIN INE385W07059
announcements.detail: Pls. find enclosed herewith the intimation under Regulations 30 and 51 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Ltd has received a letter from Axis Trustee Services Limited, the Debenture Trustee, dated March 31, 2026, proposing amendments to financial covenants for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, concerning Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) issued under ISIN INE385W07059. The NCDs, totaling INR 50,00,00,000 (Rupees Fifty Crores only) with a face value of Rs. 1,00,000/- each, were issued on a private placement basis. The proposed amendments include a waiver on the Total Net Debt to EBIDTA covenant (previously 4 times), a waiver on the Adjusted Debt Service Coverage Ratio (previously at least 1.15x), and a waiver on the Interest Coverage Ratio (previously at least 2x). The Net Debt to Tangible Net Worth covenant of 1.75 times remains unchanged. These amendments are in relation to the Debenture Trust Deed dated January 17, 2026.

announcements.subject: Ambuja Cements Ltd - 500425 - Clarification On Media Report Appearing On NDTV Profits Dated March 30, 2026
announcements.detail: Clarification on media report appearing on NDTV Profits dated March 30,2026 titled "Ambuja Cements-Penna Cement Merger Gets Green Light from NCLT Ahmedabad"

Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail:
Outcome and Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure
Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of LE Lavoir Ltd held a meeting on Thursday, April 2, 2026, at the company's registered office in Rajkot, Gujarat. Firstly, Mr. Amit Kumar Bera (DIN: 05228122) was appointed as an Additional Non-Executive and Independent Director, effective from April 2, 2026. announcements.subject: National Aluminium Company Ltd - 532234 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: NALCO delivers historic FY26 performace, setting new benchmarks in production and sales.
announcements.ai_summary: National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO) has announced a historic performance for the financial year 2025-26, setting new benchmarks in production and sales. The company achieved its highest-ever bauxite excavation at 77.01 Lakh Tonne and bauxite transportation at 77.07 Lakh Tonne. Significant production records were also set for Alumina Hydrate (23.00 Lakh Tonne), Calcined Alumina (22.75 Lakh Tonne), Cast Metal (4.72 Lakh Tonne), Net Power Generation (6,953 MU), and Coal Production (40 Lakh Tonne). In terms of sales, NALCO recorded its highest-ever total Alumina Sale at 14.46 Lakh Tonne, with domestic Alumina Sale at 1.38 Lakh Tonne. Aluminium Metal Sale reached a record 4.74 Lakh Tonne, including a domestic sale of 4.61 Lakh Tonne. This performance underscores NALCO's leadership as an integrated player in the alumina and aluminium sector.

announcements.subject: Marico Ltd - 531642 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Please find attached intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.ai_summary: Marico Limited's wholly owned subsidiary, Marico South East Asia Corporation (MSEA), has successfully completed the acquisition of 75% of the total share capital of Skinetiq Joint Stock Company. Skinetiq is a Vietnamese company that owns the digital-first skincare brand 'Candid' and holds exclusive distribution rights for the brand 'Murad' in Vietnam. This transaction, which was completed on April 2, 2026, makes Skinetiq a subsidiary of MSEA and consequently a subsidiary of Marico Limited. This acquisition is expected to strengthen Marico's presence in the Southeast Asian market.

announcements.subject: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd - 508869 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting
announcements.detail: As per annexure enclosed

announcements.subject: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd - 532734 - Receipt Of Consent To Operate For 6.91 MW Waste Heat Recovery Based Power Plant.

announcements.subject: Narmada Agrobase Ltd - 543643 - DISCLOSURE UNDER REGULATION 30 OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS, 2015 - RECEIPT OF ADMINISTRATIVE WARNING LETTER

announcements.ai_summary: Narmada Agrobase Ltd has received an Administrative Warning Letter from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) dated April 01, 2026. announcements.subject: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd - 500108 -  COMPLIANCE WITH REGULATION 30 & 51 OF SEBI (LODR) REGULATIONS, 2015- NON FUNDING OF 11Th SEMI ANNUAL INTEREST PAYMENT IN ESCROW ACCOUNT MAINTAINED IN BANK OF INDIA WRT MTNL BOND SERIES V (INE153A08089)

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd (MTNL) has informed about its non-funding of the 11th semi-annual interest payment for its Bond Series V (INE153A08089) into the escrow account maintained with Bank of India. announcements.company: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd
announcements.subject: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd - 532921 - Operational Performance Update
announcements.detail: Operational performance update
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZ) has reported strong operational performance for FY26, handling a record 500.8 million metric tons (MMT) of cargo, an 11% year-on-year increase. In March 2026 alone, APSEZ achieved its highest-ever monthly cargo volume of 46 MMT, up 11% year-on-year, primarily driven by a 14% increase in container handling. The company's CWIT terminal surpassed the 1 million TEU milestone in FY26, handling 1.06 million TEUs, and recorded its highest monthly volume of 134,960 TEUs in March 2026. The Haifa port also showed operational progress, handling 0.77 MMT in March 2026. While logistics rail volume saw a slight decrease of 7% year-on-year in March 2026 to 55,237 TEUs, it increased by 8% year-on-year for FY26, reaching 695,517 TEUs.

announcements.subject: Firstsource Solutions Ltd - 532809 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group company, has announced that it has been named a Leader in the Everest Group Healthcare Payer Intelligent Operations PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 and a Leader in the Overall Market Segment of NelsonHall’s Healthcare Payer Agility & Innovation NEAT Evaluation 2026. In the Everest Group assessment, Firstsource is among nine Leaders evaluated globally, highlighting its market impact, vision, and delivery capability in payer back-office intelligent operations, including double-digit revenue growth driven by BPaaS and intelligent operations. NelsonHall recognized Firstsource for its production-ready AI workflows, the relAI™ platform, UnBPO™ approach, and R&D investments, noting a ~70% reduction in manual effort through AI-generated feedback loops. This dual recognition, announced on April 02, 2026, underscores the company's platform-led, AI-powered approach to transforming healthcare payer operations.

announcements.subject: Softtech Engineers Ltd - 543470 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: SoftTech launched India''s First TDR Trading Exchange Platform-e-TDR (A Government of Maharashtra & BMC Initiative)
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: SoftTech Engineers Limited has been appointed as the technology partner for the e-TDR platform, India's first unified digital platform for Transfer of Development Rights (TDR) transactions. This initiative is launched by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) under the direction of the UDD, Government of Maharashtra. The platform is designed to serve over 18,000 registered developers and TDR owners within BMC. Key features include online payments, real-time bidding, digital contracts with IGR integration, AI-enabled analytics, and blockchain-anchored TDR certificate issuance. The e-TDR platform aims to eliminate opaque pricing, reduce transaction cycle times, and prevent fraud by replacing manual processes with automated, auditable workflows. This launch sets a national benchmark for GovTech-driven urban development.

announcements.subject: Indian Bank - 532814 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Interest Rates Updates
announcements.detail: Revision in Benchmark Rates
announcements.ai_summary: Indian Bank announced on April 2nd, 2026, a revision in its benchmark rates as decided by the Asset Liability Management Committee (ALCO). The Treasury Bills Linked Lending Rate (TBLR) for tenors of up to 3 months has been revised downwards from 5.35% to 5.30%. Rates for tenors greater than 3 months and up to 1 year, as well as for tenors greater than 1 year and up to 3 years, remain unchanged at 5.50% and 5.60% respectively. The revised TBLR is effective from April 3rd, 2026. The Marginal Cost of Funds based Lending Rate (MCLR), Base Rate, Benchmark Prime Lending Rate (BPLR), Policy Repo Rate, and Repo Linked Benchmark Lending Rates (RBLR) remain unchanged.

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd. has announced a significant price reduction for its weight management drug, Poviztra® (semaglutide injection), effective April 3, 2026. The starting dose price will now be Rs. 999/- per week or Rs. 3,999/- per month, representing a 55% reduction in the starting dose price and an average reduction of 47% across all doses. The price revision brings the innovator molecule, backed by extensive clinical and real-world evidence, within reach of a larger patient base in India, addressing the growing public health challenge of obesity.
