announcements.ai_summary: Sejal Glass Ltd has announced that its Founder and Promoter, Mr. Amrut S Gada, is scheduled to participate in a TV interview. The interview, titled "Small Cap Buzzers," will be broadcast on NDTV Profit on Thursday, April 2nd, 2026, at 01:30 P.M. The discussions during the interview will be based solely on publicly available information, and no unpublished price-sensitive information (UPSI) will be disclosed. The company has noted that the schedule of this interview is subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances. This intimation is provided under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: YOGI Ltd - 511702 - Board Meeting Outcome for Meeting Held On 02Nd April, 2026
announcements.detail: Please find the attached Outcome of Board Meeting  for Allotment of Equity Shares pursuant to Conversion of Warrants
announcements.ai_summary: YOGI Ltd's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on April 2nd, 2026, approved the allotment of 18,40,000 Equity Shares upon the conversion of 18,40,000 convertible warrants. This allotment is on a preferential basis and follows a special resolution passed by shareholders on October 24th, 2024, and in-principle approval from BSE Limited. The allottee, Mr. Tirth Ghanshyam Patel, has paid the balance 75% of the consideration, amounting to INR 4,41,60,000, to exercise the conversion right. The face value of each equity share is Rs. 10. Consequently, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased to Rs. 45,00,00,000, comprising 4,50,00,000 equity shares. The newly issued shares rank pari passu with existing equity shares.

announcements.subject: Alkem Laboratories Ltd - 539523 - Please Find Attached Herewith Intimation About Increase In Investment To Be Made For Setting Up Of Manufacturing Facility Of The Company In Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh.
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith intimation about increase in investment to be made for setting up of manufacturing facility of the Company in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Alkem Laboratories Ltd has approved an increase in investment for setting up a manufacturing facility in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh. The total investment has been revised upwards from up to INR 533 crores to up to INR 1036 crores. This expansion is planned to be undertaken in a phased manner. The company had previously received an allotment letter for approximately 30 acres of land for this greenfield formulations manufacturing facility. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company will make a copy of this disclosure available on its website.

announcements.subject: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Ltd - 532626 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Demise
announcements.detail: Intimation of demise of Mr. Anil Kumar Bansal, Promoter, Chairman and Whole-time Director of the Company (DIN: 00232223)
announcements.ai_summary: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Ltd has announced the sad demise of Mr. Anil Kumar Bansal, who was a Promoter, Chairman, and Whole-time Director of the company (DIN: 00232223). Mr. Bansal passed away on April 1, 2026. The company has conveyed its deep sympathy and condolences to his family, acknowledging his significant contributions and legacy. The Board of Directors expressed that his hard work, dedication, values, and guidance will continue to inspire and be remembered. The company deeply mourns the loss of its Chairman, who was an integral part and pillar of strength.

announcements.subject: GE Power India Ltd - 532309 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: As enclosed
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: GE Power India Limited has received an observation letter with 'No Adverse Observations' from BSE Limited on April 1, 2026, and a 'No Objection' letter from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on April 1, 2026, regarding the proposed Scheme of Arrangement. This scheme involves GE Power India Limited (Demerged Company) and JSW Energy Limited (Resulting Company) and their respective shareholders, under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The company had previously informed the exchanges about the Board's approval of the scheme on September 18, 2025. The Scheme of Arrangement remains subject to further regulatory and other approvals.

announcements.subject: Latent View Analytics Ltd - 543398 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we have enclosed herewith the press release on the Strategic Investment made by M/s. LatentView Analytics Corporation (Incorporated in New Jersey), a Material & Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company in M/s. Healtheon AI INC.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Latent View Analytics Limited announced a strategic investment of $3 million made by its material and wholly owned subsidiary, LatentView Analytics Corporation (New Jersey), into Healtheon AI INC. This investment, detailed in a press release dated April 2, 2026, targets the healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) sector, focusing on Agentic AI solutions. Healtheon AI develops AI teammates to automate complex tasks in healthcare finance. LatentView Analytics views this as a step towards its AI vision and aims to leverage Healtheon AI's solutions with its clients. The partnership is expected to enhance efficiency and address healthcare finance challenges.

announcements.subject: Banganga Paper Industries Ltd - 512025 - Offer Opening Public Announcement
announcements.detail: Navigant Corporate Advisors Ltd ("Manager to the Offer") has submitted to BSE a copy of Offer Opening Public Announcement to the Shareholders of Banganga Paper Industries Ltd ("Target Company").
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Asgard Alcobev Limited, formerly known as Banganga Paper Industries Limited, is the subject of an open offer to acquire up to 9,17,41,759 equity shares. These shares represent 26.00% of the expanded equity and voting share capital. The offer price is Rs. 1.45 per fully paid-up equity share of face value of Re. 1/-. The acquirers are Ronak Jain, Sarita Jain, Priyanka Jain, and K K Impex & Trading Private Limited, along with persons acting in concert (PACs) Karan Jain, Karishma Rohit Jain, and Radhika Karan Jain. Navigant Corporate Advisors Ltd is acting as the Manager to the Offer. The pre-offer advertisement was published on April 2, 2026, in various newspapers including Business Standard (English and Hindi), Pratahkal (Marathi), and Prahaar (Marathi).

announcements.subject: McNally Bharat Engineering Company Ltd - 532629 - Quarterly Disclosures By Listed Entities Of Defaults On Payment Of Interest/ Repayment Of Principal Amount On Loans From Banks / Financial Institutions And Unlisted Debt Securities
announcements.detail: Quarterly Disclosures by listed entities of defaults on payment of interest/ repayment of principal amount on loans from banks / financial institutions and unlisted debt securities
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: McNally Bharat Engineering Company Ltd has submitted quarterly disclosures regarding defaults on the payment of interest or repayment of principal amounts on loans from banks and financial institutions, as well as unlisted debt securities. The specific details of these defaults, including the amounts and dates, are expected to be provided in the full disclosure document. This announcement is a regulatory requirement for listed entities to inform stakeholders about any such financial defaults.

announcements.subject: Astra Microwave Products Ltd - 532493 - Receipt Of Order By Astra Rafael Comsys Private Limited, Joint Venture Company.
announcements.detail: as per covering letter
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Astra Rafael Comsys Private Limited, a joint venture company of Astra Microwave Products Ltd, has received a new order worth Rs. 250.58 crores (including taxes) from Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) on April 1, 2026. This order is for the supply of Software Defined Radio (SDR) for HAL, Bangalore. Astra Microwave Products Ltd expects to receive a portion of the business from this order. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, and relevant SEBI circulars.

announcements.subject: Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd - 544290 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited (EIEL) has announced securing five major project wins in March 2026, with a combined value of INR 1,481 Crores. These new projects include a significant INR 1070 Cr order in the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) segment, with a combined capacity of 930 MWH across these projects. The company is expanding its geographical footprint into Bihar, Assam, and Telangana. These wins mark a strong closure to the financial year and strengthen EIEL's position in the renewable energy and BESS segments, aligning with India's growing demand for energy storage solutions. The projects are from NTPC Limited and represent a step-up in scale for EIEL in executing large energy projects.

announcements.subject: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Ltd - 539056 - Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited Entered Into An Operation And Management Agreement With Keshav Holiday Resort Private Limited (Shankus Water Park)
announcements.detail: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited entered into an Operation and Management Agreement with Keshav Holiday Resort Private Limited (Shankus Water Park)
announcements.ai_summary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has entered into an Operation and Management Agreement with Keshav Holiday Resort Private Limited (KHRPL), which operates Shankus Water Park in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Effective April 01, 2026, Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited will manage and operate KHRPL's water park business. This agreement follows a previous disclosure on January 20, 2026, regarding a potential joint venture. Under the terms, Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited is entitled to receive a management fee linked to pre-agreed milestones and has the option to use its Intellectual Property (IP) at the water park. The agreement is for providing operation and management services.

announcements.subject: Dhanlaxmi Bank Ltd - 532180 - Business Updates For The Year Ended March 31,2026
announcements.detail: Business updates for the Year ended March 31,2026
announcements.ai_summary: Dhanlaxmi Bank Ltd has provided business updates for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The bank reported a Total Business of INR 33,773 Crore for the provisional period ending March 31, 2026, representing a Year-on-Year growth of 19.68% compared to INR 28,219 Crore in the previous year. Total Deposits stood at INR 18,643 Crore, up 16.42% from INR 16,013 Crore. Gross Advances increased by 23.96% to INR 15,130 Crore from INR 12,206 Crore. Notably, Gold Loans saw a significant increase of 71.41% to INR 6,512 Crore, and MSME advances grew by 30.90% to INR 2,135 Crore. This data is provisional and subject to audit.

announcements.subject: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd - 533271 - Intimation Regarding Extension Of Expected Date Of Completion Of Sale/Disposal Of Stake In Subsidiaries Of The Company And Ashoka Concessions Limited (ACL)
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding extension of expected date completion of Sale of stake in SPVs up to 30-06-2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd has provided an update regarding the extension of the expected completion date for the sale of its stake in several subsidiaries and Ashoka Concessions Limited (ACL). The company had previously entered into Share Purchase Agreements with Epic Concesiones 2 Private Limited, Infrastructure Yield Plus II, and Infrastructure Yield Plus IIA (managed by EAAA India Alternatives Limited) for the sale of its entire share capital and management control of 11 Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs). The expected date for the completion of the sale for the remaining 6 SPVs has now been extended up to June 30, 2026. This extension is subject to the fulfillment of certain conditions precedent and other terms and conditions outlined in the respective transaction documents.

announcements.subject: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd - 544283 - Update On Commissioning Of Fourth Phase Of 33.333 MW Capacity Of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Project Located In Rajsthan
announcements.detail: Update on commissioning of fourth phase of 33.333 MW capacity of BESS project located in Rajsthan
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary ACME Sun Power Private Limited, has commissioned the fourth phase of its Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Project in Rajasthan. This commissioned phase adds 33.333 MW / 160.48 MWh to the project's capacity. The total commissioned capacity now stands at 133.336 MW / 641.980 MWh out of the total project capacity of 300 MW / 1409.34 MWh. The Commercial Operation Date (COD) for this fourth phase is April 03, 2026. This update follows previous intimations on March 06, 2026, March 12, 2026, and March 31, 2026.

announcements.subject: JTL Industries Ltd - 534600 - Announcement Under Reg. 30- Change In The Name Of Subsidiary Company As JTL Defence Limited
announcements.detail: Change in the name of Subsidiary Company-JTL Defence Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: JTL Industries Limited has announced a change in the name of one of its subsidiary companies. Effective April 1, 2026, RCI Industries & Technologies Limited has been renamed "JTL Defence Limited". This change has been approved by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. Additionally, JTL Defence Limited has formally adopted its official logo. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Vedanta Ltd - 500295 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, As Amended ('SEBI Listing Regulations')
announcements.detail: Please refer the enclosed file.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Vedanta Limited's subsidiary, Talwandi Sabo Power Limited (TSPL), has received a direction from the Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM) to deposit an Environmental Compensation of Rs. 33,02,56,800. This penalty is allegedly for not achieving the mandatory five percent blend of crop residue pellets or briquettes with coal for FY 2024-25, as per Rule 3 of the Environment (Utilization of Crop Residue by Thermal Power Plant) Rules, 2023. TSPL received this direction via email on April 01, 2026, and intends to file an appeal before the appropriate forum within the prescribed timeline. The company expects a favourable outcome and does not anticipate any material financial impact on TSPL or Vedanta Limited.

announcements.subject: Sanathan Textiles Ltd - 544314 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 - Completion Of Phase I Ramp-Up At Punjab Facility.
announcements.detail: Please find attached the press release pertaining to completion of Phase I at Punjab Facility.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Sanathan Textiles Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary Sanathan Polycot Private Limited, has successfully completed the Phase I ramp-up at its Punjab facility. The facility, which commissioned its Continuous Polymerisation line with an initial capacity of 350 tonnes per day on August 27, 2025, is now operating at approximately 96% of its installed capacity. This achievement reflects strong execution capabilities and robust demand absorption, particularly from North India's textile ecosystem. The company is now focused on advancing its expansion roadmap, including the planned progression towards Phase II, to further enhance its position as an integrated and diversified polyester yarn manufacturer. The Executive Director, Mr. Sammir Dattani, highlighted the operational discipline and market positioning that enabled this successful ramp-up despite geopolitical challenges.

announcements.subject: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd - 544225 - Disclosure Of Shareholders' Communication Dated April 1, 2026, Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Ola Electric Mobility Limited has informed the exchange regarding the Shareholders communication dated April 1, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd has reported a significant surge in its business performance for March 2026. Daily orders for electric vehicles exceeded 1,000 units in the last week of March, indicating strong demand momentum. Vehicle registrations in March 2026 reached 10,117 units, a substantial increase of over 150% compared to 3,973 units in February 2026. This performance signifies a sharp market share recovery, driven by structural improvements in service operations, with over 80% of vehicles now serviced on the same day. The company has implemented operational changes to improve turnaround times and customer experience, thereby strengthening customer trust and boosting demand. Ola Electric has communicated these positive developments to shareholders on April 1, 2026, and the information will be hosted on their website.

announcements.company: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd
announcements.subject: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd - 532921 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Update On The Scheme Of Amalgamation.
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Update on the Scheme of Amalgamation.
announcements.ai_summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd has announced that the Scheme of Amalgamation of Adani Harbour Services Limited with Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited has been sanctioned by the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench. This order was passed on April 1, 2026. This follows a previous intimation dated November 4, 2025, regarding the scheme under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

announcements.subject: Lakhotia Polyesters (India) Ltd - 535387 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Update on the Proposed Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Lakhotia Polyesters (India) Ltd has provided an update on its proposed acquisition of 100% stake in New Nexus FZ LLC, a Dubai-based entity. The acquisition, initially expected to conclude by March 31, 2026, has been delayed due to the prevailing geopolitical situation impacting regulatory approvals. The company now anticipates completing the acquisition by June 30, 2026. Investors should monitor further updates regarding the progress of these regulatory clearances.

announcements.subject: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd - 539448 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: InterGlobe Aviation Limited, operating as IndiGo, has announced a revision in fuel charges for all new domestic and international bookings made after 0001 hrs on April 2, 2026, due to a significant increase in Air Turbine Fuel (ATF) costs. The Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas and Ministry of Civil Aviation have allowed a partial and staggered increase of 25% for domestic operations. Revised fuel charges per sector for domestic routes will range from ₹ 275 for distances up to 500 kms to ₹ 950 for routes above 2,000 kms. For international operations, revised fuel charges will vary by region, with charges for the Indian Subcontinent up to 500 kms at ₹ 900 and for UK & Europe at ₹ 10,000. These revisions are intended to mitigate the impact of rising fuel prices on the airline's operating costs.

announcements.subject: Prime Focus Ltd - 532748 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Diversification / Disinvestment
announcements.detail: Pursuant to provisions of Regulation 30 of LODR Regulations, the subsidiaries of Prime Focus Limited have proposed to undertake certain steps for internal restructuring within the group to streamline the business operations and details of key restructuring steps.
announcements.ai_summary: Prime Focus Limited (PFL) is undertaking an internal restructuring of its subsidiaries to streamline business operations. This involves the transfer of 100% equity shareholding of Prime Focus Technologies Inc. (PFT US) from Brahma AI Services India Limited (Brahma India) to DNEG S.a.r.l. (DNEG). This transfer is contingent upon the conversion of optionally convertible redeemable preference shares and loans previously extended by Brahma India to PFT US into equity shares, which does not involve any fresh capital infusion. Additionally, DNEG will transfer its entire 100% equity shareholding in Brahma AI Services India Limited to Brahma AI Holdings Limited. Following these transactions, PFT US and Brahma India will remain step-down subsidiaries of PFL. The Audit Committee has approved these restructuring steps, which were finalized by the Board of Directors on April 1, 2026.

announcements.subject: Diamines & Chemicals Ltd-$ - 500120 - Announcement Under Reg 30 Of SEBI (LODR)- Non-Exercise Of Option To Convert Of Warrants
announcements.detail: We submit herewith disclosure under Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations regarding non-exercise of option to convert warrants.
announcements.ai_summary: Diamines & Chemicals Ltd announced that 6,36,988 convertible warrants have lapsed due to non-exercise of the conversion option within the stipulated 18-month period from the allotment date of October 1, 2024. The initial subscription amount received for these warrants, amounting to ₹ 8,79,04,344, has been forfeited as per SEBI regulations. The company had initially allotted 9,06,390 warrants at an issue price of ₹ 552 per warrant, with 25% of the issue price, or ₹ 138 per warrant, collected upfront. As of March 31, 2026, 3,23,388 warrants were allotted to promoters and 3,13,600 to non-promoters that have now lapsed. This disclosure is made in accordance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations.

announcements.subject: ICICI Bank Ltd - 532174 - Update On ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited And ICICI Venture Funds Management Company Limited
announcements.detail: Update on ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited and ICICI Venture Funds Management Company Limited
announcements.ai_summary: ICICI Bank Limited has provided an update on the transfer of the private equity, venture capital, and real estate fund management business from ICICI Venture Funds Management Company Limited (IVen) to ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited (IPru AMC). Following the receipt of requisite approvals, IPru AMC has completed the transfer of investment management rights for specific Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) and executed the necessary agreements with IVen. Effective April 1, 2026, IPru AMC will manage the following AIFs: India Advantage Fund S4 I, India Advantage Fund S5 I, India Advantage Fund S5 II, India Real Estate Investment Fund Series 2, and Iven Amplifi Fund. This update follows previous disclosures made by the bank on May 9, 2025, and March 2, 2026.

announcements.subject: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd - 500570 - Compliances-Half Yearly Report (SEBI Circular No. CIR/IMD/DF-1/67/2017)
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed a statement containing details of the Company''s listed debt securities as per the formal specified by SEBI as on March 31, 2026 for reporting of debt securities issued through private placement..
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited has submitted a half-yearly report detailing its listed debt securities as of March 31, 2026, as per SEBI's requirements for debt securities issued through private placement. Additionally, the company has transferred outstanding Non-Convertible Debentures aggregating ₹2,300 crore, along with all associated rights, obligations, and liabilities, to the resulting company, Tata Motors Limited, following a Composite Scheme of Arrangement approved by the Board on August 8, 2025, and September 26, 2025.

announcements.subject: G R Infraprojects Ltd - 543317 - Disclosure Under Regulation 10(6), 29(1) & 29(2) Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Substantial Acquisition Of Shares And Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 Received By The Company.

The company has received these intimations from its members and is requesting that the stock exchanges take this information on record. No specific share counts or percentages of voting capital were provided in this announcement, but the transfer is among immediate relatives within the promoter group.

announcements.subject: Nimbus Projects Ltd - 511714 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015-Listing Of Equity Shares Of Nimbus Projects Limited ("The Company") On National Stock Exchange Of India Limited ("NSE")

The company has been informed via a letter from NSE dated April 01, 2026, received at 18:26 hours. All future filings and submissions will be made through the NSE Electronic Application Processing System (NEAPS).

announcements.subject: Wipro Ltd - 507685 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, it is informed that Cardinal US Holdings, Inc. (step-down subsidiary) has transferred its entire shareholding in Capco Consulting Services LLC (step-down subsidiary) to The Capital Markets Company, LLC (step-down subsidiary), effective March 30, 2026 (Eastern Time). announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Wipro Ltd has informed that its step-down subsidiary, Cardinal US Holdings, Inc., transferred its entire shareholding in Capco Consulting Services LLC to another step-down subsidiary, The Capital Markets Company, LLC. No benefits are expected for the promoter or promoter group from this internal restructuring.

announcements.subject: Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd - 544457 - The Company Has Entered Into Registrar And Transfer Agent Agreement With M/S Kfin Technologies Limited.
announcements.detail: The company has entered into Registrar and Transfer Agent Agreement with M/s. Kfin Technologies Limited

announcements.subject: Marico Ltd - 531642 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Update on intra-group restructuring involving integration of business of Zed Lifestyle Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Marico Ltd has provided an update on its intra-group restructuring involving Zed Lifestyle Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary. The boards and shareholders of Zed approved its voluntary liquidation and the distribution of its entire business undertaking to Marico Ltd on April 1, 2026. announcements.subject: Dhampur Sugar Mills Ltd - 500119 - Certificate From Chief Financial Officer Confirming The Utilisation Of Proceeds From Commercial Paper
announcements.detail: Please find attached certificate from CFO confirming the utilisation of proceeds from Commercial Paper.

This certificate pertains to the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and has been provided in compliance with SEBI circulars. The company has informed both the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd and BSE Limited about this submission.

announcements.subject: DCM Shriram Ltd - 523367 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Commissioning Of Epichlorohydrin (ECH) Plant
announcements.detail: Commissioning of ECH Plant at full capacity on 1st April 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: DCM Shriram Ltd has announced the full commissioning of its Epichlorohydrin (ECH) plant located in Jhagadia, Bharuch District, Gujarat. The plant now operates at its total capacity of 52,000 TPA, with the remaining 17,000 TPA capacity being commissioned on April 1, 2026. This follows the earlier commissioning of 35,000 TPA capacity, as previously intimated on October 14, 2025. The company has made this information available on its investor website.

announcements.subject: Nestle India Ltd - 500790 - Regulation 30 And Schedule III Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations'): Intimation Regarding The Addition Of A New Maggi Noodles Production Line At The Sanand Factory, Gujarat
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding the addition of a new Maggi Noodles production line at the Sanand Factory, Gujarat
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: On April 01, 2026, Nestlé India Ltd informed the stock exchanges about the addition of a new Maggi Noodles production line at its Sanand Factory in Gujarat. This expansion is part of the company's planned capital expenditure to increase overall capacities and meet future demand. The new production line will add approximately 20,500 tons per annum to the existing capacity of 141,600 tons per annum, which currently operates at an approximate utilization of 80%. The investment required for this expansion is approximately ₹90 crores, which will be financed through internal accruals. The addition of this new line is expected to be completed within the Financial Year 2026-27.

announcements.detail: Agreement
announcements.ai_summary:
KRN Heat Exchanger And Refrigeration Ltd - 544263 - Agreement

announcements.detail: Please find enclosed herewith the Press release on "Zuari Industries'' SPE Division Records Highest-Ever Sugarcane Crushing in FY26".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Zuari Industries Limited's SPE Division has achieved a record sugarcane crushing of 159.7 lakh quintals in FY26, exceeding the previous FY25 record of 157.2 lakh quintals. announcements.subject: Yatra Online Ltd - 543992 - Disclosure Regarding Outcome Of Appeal Before CESTAT, Chandigarh
announcements.detail: Disclosure regarding Outcome of Appeal before CESTAT, Chandigarh
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Yatra Online Ltd has disclosed the outcome of an appeal before the Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal (CESTAT), Chandigarh, which ruled in favor of the company and its subsidiary, TSI Yatra Pvt. Ltd. The CESTAT has set aside significant tax and penalty demands previously raised by the Revenue Department. For Yatra Online Limited, a total duty demand of approximately Rs.111.25 Crore (Rs.1,11,25,81,653/-) and penalties of approximately Rs.39.47 Crore (Rs.39,47,89,549/-) have been dropped. For TSI Yatra Pvt. Ltd., duty demands of approximately Rs.1.99 Crore (Rs.1,99,42,636/-) and penalties of approximately Rs.1.99 Crore (Rs.1,99,52,636/-) have also been set aside. The Tribunal held that incentives received from Computer Reservation System (CRS) companies are not subject to service tax. This order provides significant relief to the company regarding long-standing tax litigations.

announcements.subject: Advik Capital Ltd - 539773 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: SEBI Interim Findings in Elitecon and Update on Ongoing Judicial Proceedings New Delhi
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Advik Capital Limited has issued a media release regarding interim findings by SEBI in the Elitecon matter and an update on ongoing judicial proceedings. SEBI, through an Ex-Parte Interim Order dated March 30, 2026, has issued directions against Elitecon International Limited, its promoter, and connected persons for alleged regulatory violations. The order notes SEBI's prima facie observations regarding financial statement irregularities, misleading disclosures, changes in share capital and promoter shareholding, and abnormal price movements in Elitecon's scrip. Notably, SEBI has recorded the receipt of ₹64 crore by Advik Capital Limited through banking channels from Elitecon during August 2024, in line with Advik Capital's claim regarding a loan advanced to Elitecon. The legal nature and accounting treatment of this transaction remain sub-judice before the Hon’ble High Court of Delhi.

announcements.subject: Rushil Decor Ltd - 533470 - Intimation About Temporary Shutdown Due To Technological Upgradation At Manufacturing Unit, Mansa, Gujarat.
announcements.detail: Intimation about temporary shutdown due to Technological Upgradation at Manufacturing Unit, Mansa, Gujarat.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Rushil Decor Limited is undertaking a technological upgradation at its laminate sheet manufacturing unit in Mansa, Gujarat. The company will replace its existing steam boiler system with a Thermic Fluid Heater system, which is expected to improve fuel efficiency, reduce water consumption, enhance plant efficiency, and improve product quality and productivity. This upgrade will also enable automation and reduce manpower dependency. The plant will be temporarily shut down until approximately April 20, 2026, with an estimated loss of sale of Rs. 4 Crores during this period. The other two manufacturing units of the company will continue operations without interruption.

announcements.subject: Orient Electric Ltd - 541301 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please refer the enclosed attachment.

This innovative product utilizes patented Bio-Oxy Plasma ION+ Technology to enhance indoor air quality by enriching oxygen levels, reducing fatigue, and revitalizing homes. announcements.subject: Citizen Infoline Ltd - 538786 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.detail: CERTIFIED COPY OF ORDER OF NCLT ALONG WITH CERTIFIED COPY OF SCHEME AND PETITION
announcements.ai_summary: Citizen Infoline Limited has received a certified copy of the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Ahmedabad's order dated March 19, 2026, approving a Scheme of Amalgamation. announcements.subject: Rain Industries Ltd - 500339 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Rain Industries Limited - Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Rain Industries Limited, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Rain Carbon Canada Inc., in collaboration with Green Graphite Technologies Inc., has successfully completed a project to advance the production of coated spherical purified graphite. This critical material is used in lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, micromobility, and energy storage systems. The project received CA$682,000 in support from the Government of Ontario through the Ontario Vehicle Innovation Network (OVIN), out of a total project value of CA$2.05 million. This initiative aims to address the domestic supply gap for battery materials, as over 90% of battery-grade graphite is currently sourced from China. The collaboration leverages Green Graphite Technologies' purification technology and Rain Carbon Canada's expertise in carbon precursors and processing. This press release was issued on April 1, 2026.

announcements.subject: CSL Finance Ltd - 530067 - Quarterly Update For The Quarter Ended March 31, 2026
announcements.detail: Please find the attached herewith Quarterly update for the Quarter ended March 31, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: CSL Finance Limited has provided a quarterly and yearly update for the period ended March 31, 2026. The company's Assets Under Management (AUM) reached approximately INR 1450 Crores (including DA of INR 50 Crores) as of March 2026, marking a year-on-year growth of 21.13% from INR 1197 Crores (including DA of INR 39 Crores) in March 2025. During the year, INR 135 Crores were disbursed in SME and INR 1115 Crores in WSL, with collections of INR 93 Crores in SME and INR 905 Crores in WSL. The company raised INR 523.53 Crores in debt during FY 2025-26 and secured fresh sanctions of Rs 82 Crores from 4 lenders in the current quarter. CSL Finance added 6 new lenders during the year, bringing the total to 35 lenders by March 2026. The company maintains a liquidity surplus of approximately INR 108 Crores and a Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of approximately 44%. The portfolio mix remained stagnant at 69:31 (WSL: SME) as of March 2026. The company operates 44 branches with a team of 469 employees. This update is provisional and subject to a limited review by statutory auditors.

The decision was approved by the Boards of Directors of both companies. The refinery, established in 2006 as an export-oriented unit, faced challenges including non-availability of natural gas, increased operating costs due to coal boilers, a sharp decline in white premiums, reduced power export revenue, factory accidents, demurrage charges, inventory write-offs, hedge losses, and high finance costs. announcements.subject: Yash Highvoltage Ltd - 544310 - Reporting Of Cyber Fraud
announcements.detail: On the subject matter, a Intimation / Disclosure is sent herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Yash Highvoltage Ltd is reporting a cyber fraud incident involving orders for raw materials from a vendor in China. The company received an email purportedly from the exporter requesting a change in bank account details, which was confirmed through documentation. Subsequently, the company processed a payment to the revised account, and a partial shipment of materials was received. The fraud was discovered when the supplier reported non-receipt of funds. The estimated financial impact is Rs. 1.36 crore for the material received and Rs. 73.90 lacs for the non-receipt of material, totaling Rs. 2.10 crore. The company has initiated an internal investigation, is filing a formal complaint with regulatory authorities, and is evaluating solutions with its bankers for fund recovery. Yash Highvoltage Ltd has also stated that the partial shipment of material was successfully received on March 31, 2026, and the incident has no material impact on the company's operations. Corrective measures are being reviewed to strengthen internal processes.

announcements.detail:
The Company is pleased to announce the commissioning of additional new grinding capacity of 1.20 mtpa at its Aligarh Unit in Uttar Pradesh. With this commissioning, the total cement capacity of the Aligarh unit now stands at 1.95 mtpa.

Consequent to the above, the Company''s total grey cement manufacturing capacity stands at 5.60 mtpa.

announcements.subject: PTC Industries Ltd - 539006 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: As enclosed.
announcements.ai_summary: PTC Industries Ltd, through its wholly owned subsidiary Aerolloy Technologies Limited, has completed the installation and successful trials of an advanced 4500/5100 Tonne Intelligent Open Die Forging System. This new system is located at the Strategic Materials Technology Complex in Lucknow and is capable of forging aerospace-grade materials such as Titanium and Superalloys. This acquisition significantly enhances Aerolloy's manufacturing capabilities, enabling the production of critical components for next-generation aeroengines, defence platforms, space systems, and industrial gas turbines. This development integrates melting (VIM), casting (VAR), and forging processes, creating a comprehensive aerospace manufacturing ecosystem. The company aims to capitalize on the multi-billion dollar global market for aerospace-grade forged components and promote import substitution, strengthening India's self-reliance.

announcements.subject: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd - 543942 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI Listing Regulations)

announcements.subject: Tata Communications Ltd - 500483 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Tata Communications Maintains A leader Position for 13th Straight Year in Gartner Magic Quadrant
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Communications has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global WAN Services for the 13th consecutive year. This recognition highlights their Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. The company has enhanced its network fabric with AI and analytics, offering composable, high-speed, and on-demand connectivity for global enterprises. Key advancements include expanding the network-on-demand portfolio with IZOTM DC Dynamic Connectivity and multi-cloud on-demand options, investing in 800G wavelength services for AI cloud infrastructure, and extending global coverage through strategic partner PoPs. They have also strengthened Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) capabilities and plan to offer quantum-safe encryption services leveraging Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms.

announcements.subject:
NTPC Ltd - 532555 - Declaration Of COD Of NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, A
Stepdown Subsidiary Of NTPC Limited Through Its Subsidiary NTPC Green Energy Limited.
announcements.detail: Disclosure attached.
announcements.ai_summary: NTPC Ltd has announced the declaration of Commercial Operations Date (COD) for NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, a stepdown subsidiary. This declaration is made through its subsidiary, NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL). Specifically, the twelfth and final part capacity of 78.02 MW out of the 1255 MW Khavda-I Solar PV Project in Gujarat has achieved COD effective March 31, 2026. announcements.subject: Max India Ltd - 543223 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release-Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)
announcements.ai_summary: Max India Ltd has announced a press release from its wholly owned subsidiary, Antara Assisted Care Services Limited (AACSL). The press release details the launch of AGEasy's new adult diaper pants featuring proprietary Smart Liquid Distribution™ technology. This in-house developed technology, currently awaiting patent grant, aims to address challenges such as sagging, leakage, and uneven absorption, offering up to 12 hours of protection with an anti-bacterial core. The product is designed specifically for seniors to enhance independence and dignity by addressing incontinence issues. AGEasy conducted extensive research to re-engineer existing adult hygiene products, which have historically fallen short in areas like leakage protection and fit. This innovation represents a significant step in improving the quality of life for seniors.

announcements.subject: Bank of Baroda - 532134 - Clarification On News Item Appearing In Media/Publication
announcements.detail: Clarification on news item appearing in Media/Publication
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Bank of Baroda has provided a clarification regarding a news item that appeared in the media. The bank's branch received an email on March 26, 2026, for a fund transfer from an MP Government savings account, but there was a mismatch in the available balance. A revised email was received later that day. On March 27, 2026, an email with an attached letter from the State Government Department was received for fund transfer on the same day, which was a holiday. After necessary arrangements and approvals, funds were remitted on March 27, 2026. However, on the same day, the Commissioner, DIF, Bhopal, issued a letter debarring Bank of Baroda from conducting government business. On March 28, 2026, the bank submitted a written representation, and subsequently, on the same day, the debarment letter was cancelled with immediate effect. The bank stated that since the order was revoked within 24 hours, it was not disclosed, and there is no material impact on the bank.

announcements.subject: 3M India Ltd - 523395 - Announcement Under Reg 30 Of SEBI (LODR)
announcements.detail: Announcement under Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR) update on PG&F business
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: 3M India Limited has announced an update regarding its Precision Grinding & Finishing (PG&F) business. Following the agreement by 3M Company, USA, to sell its global PG&F business to Nimbus, a European private equity firm, 3M India will cease its PG&F operations in India. The PG&F business in India generated approximately INR 26 crore in sales during FY 2024-25 and is supported by two employees. The global sale is expected to close on April 1, 2026, after which 3M India will no longer be able to continue these operations. The company will provide limited post-closing support for up to 12 months, extendable by an additional 6 months, under a Transition Distribution Services Agreement to ensure customer supply continuity.

announcements.ai_summary: Prism Johnson Ltd has divested its entire equity shareholding in three wholly owned subsidiaries: Venkataramiah Tile Bath Kitchen Private Limited, Samiyaz Tile Bath Kitchen Private Limited, and Tescon Buildcon Private Limited, on March 30, 2026. Consequently, these companies have ceased to be wholly owned subsidiaries of Prism Johnson Ltd. The consideration received for the sale of shares includes Rs. 4,31,932 for Venkataramiah Tile Bath Kitchen Private Limited, Rs. 6,48,510 for Samiyaz Tile Bath Kitchen Private Limited, and Rs. 10,000 for Tescon Buildcon Private Limited. The revenue and net worth contributed by these subsidiaries to Prism Johnson Ltd as of March 31, 2025, were minimal, with revenues reported as Rs. 0.00 and net worth contributions of Rs. 0.06 crore, Rs. 0.08 crore, and Rs. 0.002 crore respectively.

announcements.subject: Jupiter Infomedia Ltd - 534623 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 In Respect Of Its Material Unlisted Subsidiary 'Jineshvar Securities Private Limited'.
announcements.detail: As per annexure attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Jupiter Infomedia Ltd has disclosed changes in the Board of Directors of its material unlisted subsidiary, Jineshvar Securities Private Limited, effective March 30, 2026. Mr. Anshul Laxkar (DIN: 11100544) has been appointed as an Additional Director (Non-Executive and Independent) for a term of five years. Concurrently, Mr. Umesh Vasantlal Modi (DIN: 01570180) and Mrs. Manisha Umesh Modi (DIN: 02057625) have resigned from their positions as Directors. These changes have been approved by the Board of Directors of Jineshvar Securities Private Limited.

announcements.subject: Oil India Ltd - 533106 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Oil India and CSIR-IMMT signs MoU to pursue joint Research in Critical Minerals
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Oil India Limited (OIL), a Maharatna CPSE, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with CSIR - Institute of Minerals and Materials Technology (IMMT) on March 30, 2026. This collaboration aims to pursue joint Research & Development (R&D) projects in the critical minerals sector, aligning with the National Critical Mineral Mission (NCMM). The MoU was signed by the Director (Exploration & Development) of OIL and the Director of CSIR-IMMT, in the presence of the CMD of OIL and senior officials from both organizations. This initiative is expected to foster R&D activities in the critical mineral domain.

announcements.subject: Bilcare Ltd-$ - 526853 - Update On Voluntary Liquidation Of Wholly Owned Subsidiary - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015,
announcements.detail: Bilcare Limited has informed the Exchange about the update on Voluntary Liquidation of Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Bilcare Limited has redeemed 31,50,000 preference shares of Caprihans India Limited for an aggregate of ₹3.15 crore on March 23, 2026. Furthermore, the company exercised its right to convert 12,90,000 warrants into equity shares of Caprihans India Limited, at a price of ₹200 per warrant, with each warrant convertible into one equity share of ₹10 face value. Following these conversions on March 20, 23, 24, and 25, 2026, Bilcare Limited's shareholding in Caprihans India Limited increased from 55.99% to 59.56%, with the number of equity shares held rising from 81,88,325 to 94,78,325. The company also reviewed the voluntary winding up status of its wholly owned subsidiary, Bilcare GCS Limited, in a board meeting held on March 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Tube Investments of India Ltd - 540762 - Update On Incremental Investment In TI Clean Mobility Private Limited
announcements.detail: Update on Incremental Investment in TI Clean Mobility Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Tube Investments of India Ltd has announced an incremental investment in its subsidiary, TI Clean Mobility Private Limited. On March 30, 2026, TI Clean Mobility Private Limited allotted 2,50,00,000 Series C Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares to Tube Investments of India Limited. This transaction is an update under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The company has requested that this information be taken on record.

announcements.subject: Dev Accelerator Ltd - 544513 - Monthly Newsletter - March 2026 Edition
announcements.detail: A Monthly Newsletter of March 2026 edition issued by the Company is attached.
announcements.ai_summary: Dev Accelerator Limited has issued its Monthly Newsletter for March 2026, providing an update on its business activities and market outlook. The company highlights the growing demand for professionally managed workspace infrastructure in India, driven by enterprise expansion. A significant development mentioned is the commitment to operate a 27-storey commercial tower in Ahmedabad, spanning over 8 lakh sq ft and valued at approximately ₹850 crore. This move reflects DevX's strategy to expand in markets with strong enterprise demand. The newsletter also notes DevX's ranking as the 8th fastest-growing company in India for 2026, with a reported growth of 512.79% between 2021 and 2024. Furthermore, it touches upon the rise of Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in India, which are driving demand for scalable workspace solutions.

announcements.subject: Quest Flow Controls Ltd - 543982 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Diversification / Disinvestment
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Intimation of disinvestment of stake in subsidiary of the company.
announcements.ai_summary: Quest Flow Controls Ltd's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on March 30, 2026, approved the disinvestment of its entire stake in its subsidiary, H2O DYNAMICS INDIA LIMITED. The sale agreement was entered into on March 30, 2026, with Stellarin Research and Development Private Limited. The consideration received from this sale is Rs. 7,35,00,000. The net revenue of H2O DYNAMICS INDIA LIMITED for FY 24-25 was Rs. 811.31 Lakhs, and its net worth was Rs. 134.96 Lakhs. The completion of the sale is expected within 2 months. This transaction is considered an arm's length transaction as H2O Dynamics India Limited is a related party.

announcements.subject: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd - 526668 - Closure Of IRA By Orchid Hotels, Mumbai
announcements.detail: As per the attached Intimation letter.
announcements.ai_summary: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd has informed the exchange about the closure of its hotel, IRA by Orchid Hotels, Mumbai, effective April 1, 2026. This closure is due to the expiry of the Leave and License Agreement dated October 26, 2023. The company had previously communicated about this agreement on October 26, 2023. Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd has stated that the discontinuance of operations for this hotel property will not adversely impact the company's profitability in the coming financial years. The revenue contribution from this unit during the last financial year (ending March 31, 2025) was Rs. 4807.59 Lakhs.

announcements.subject: Punjab National Bank - 532461 - Change In Interest Rates
announcements.detail: Change in Interest Rates
announcements.ai_summary: Punjab National Bank has announced that its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates (MCLR) will remain unchanged effective April 1, 2026. The existing MCLR rates for tenors ranging from one month to three years are 8.20%, 8.40%, 8.60%, and 8.75% respectively. Additionally, the bank's Repo Linked Lending Rate (RLLR) of 8.10% (including BSP of 0.10%) and its Base Rate of 9.50% will also remain unchanged. This update is for the record of the exchange.

The disclosure also details holdings of other promoter group entities, including Columbia Petro Chem Private Limited.

announcements.subject: Prithvi Exchange (India) Ltd - 531688 - Intimation Of Branch Opening In Gurugram
announcements.detail: Intimation of branch opening in Gurugram
announcements.ai_summary: Prithvi Exchange (India) Limited has expanded its presence by opening a new branch in Gurugram. The branch is located at Shop No. F-102, First Floor, Sapphire Ninety, Sector-90, Gurugram, Haryana-122 505. The company aims to offer forex services in a contemporary and technologically updated environment and expects to provide excellent service to its clients. Prithvi Exchange (India) Limited plans to increase its national footprint by establishing more branches in the near future. This expansion was intimated to the stock exchange on March 30, 2026, under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: LCC Infotech Ltd - 532019 - Recommendations of Committee of Independent Director (IDC)
announcements.detail: Grow House Wealth Management Pvt Ltd ("Manager to the Offer") has submitted to BSE a copy of Recommendations of the Committee of Independent Director (IDC) of LCC Infotech Ltd ("Target Company") under regulation 26 (7) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisiton of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 and subsequent amendments thereto ("SEBI (SAST) Regulations") in relation to the Open Offer to the Public Shareholders of LCC Infotech Ltd ("Target Company") ....
announcements.ai_summary: Grow House Wealth Management Pvt Ltd, acting as the Manager to the Offer, has submitted the Recommendations of the Committee of Independent Directors (IDC) of LCC Infotech Ltd to BSE. This pertains to an Open Offer for the acquisition of 4,38,34,271 equity shares of LCC Infotech Ltd, representing 26.00% of the emerging voting share capital. The Offer Price is set at ₹ 4.55 per equity share. The IDC recommendations were published on March 30, 2026, in the Financial Express, Jansatta, Mumbai Lakshadeep, and Duranta Barta. This open offer is being made by Mr. Kunjit Maheshbhai Patel pursuant to SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

announcements.subject: Westlife Foodworld Ltd - 505533 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release/Media Release-McDonald''s India opens a new restaurant at Metro-Linked Irrum Manzil hub in Hyderabad.
announcements.ai_summary: Westlife Foodworld Ltd announced the opening of a new McDonald's restaurant in Hyderabad, located at L&T Next Premia Mall, Irrum Manzil. This opening is part of the company's strategy to expand in high-growth urban areas and capitalize on transit-linked consumption. The new 2,800 sq. ft. dine-in restaurant offers seamless access with its direct skywalk connectivity to the Irrum Manzil Metro Station. As of December 2025, Westlife Foodworld operates 458 restaurants across 73 cities, and this addition strengthens its presence in Hyderabad with over 20 restaurants in the city. The company, which operates McDonald's restaurants in West and South India through its subsidiary Hardcastle Restaurants Pvt. Ltd., aims to provide convenience and relevance to evolving urban lifestyles.

announcements.subject: Avenue Supermarts Ltd - 540376 - Intimation Of Repayment Of Commercial Paper
announcements.detail: Redemption of Commercial Paper
announcements.ai_summary: On March 30, 2026, Avenue Supermarts Ltd confirmed the full redemption of its Commercial Paper (CP) with ISIN INE192R14311. The redemption was due to maturity and the total amount redeemed was Rs. 100 Crores. The company has duly paid the maturity proceeds to the holders of the CP. Following this redemption, the outstanding amount for this CP is now Nil. This action is in accordance with SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/DDHS/DDHS-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000000137 dated 15th October, 2025.

announcements.subject: Classic Leasing & Finance Ltd - 540481 - Board Meeting Outcome for OUTCOME OF BOARD MEETING HELD ON 30TH MARCH, 2026
announcements.detail: OUTCOME OF BOARD MEETING HELD ON 30TH MARCH, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Classic Leasing & Finance Ltd met on March 30, 2026. During this meeting, Mrs. Minu Datta resigned as a Non-Executive Independent Director due to other pre-occupations and commitments. The Board has appointed Mr. Mukesh Shaw as an Additional Non-Executive Independent Director for a term of 5 years, subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Shaw is a Commerce Graduate and Qualified Company Secretary with extensive experience in corporate laws and governance. Additionally, Mr. Abhishek Mussadi has been appointed as another Additional Non-Executive Independent Director, bringing valuable experience in business operations and management. Both new directors are not related to any existing directors and meet the independence criteria.

announcements.subject: KEI Industries Ltd - 517569 - Intimation Of Corporate Governance Rating/Grading Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
announcements.detail: Intimation of Corporate Governance Rating/Grading under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) regulations, 2015. CARE Analytics and Advisory Pvt Ltd (Care Edge Advisory) has assigned CG 2 + rating/grading to the overall performance of Corpoarte overnance of teh Company.
announcements.ai_summary: KEI Industries Limited has received a Corporate Governance Rating/Grading of 'CG 2+' from CARE Analytics and Advisory Pvt Ltd (Care Edge Advisory). This rating signifies that the company adheres to corporate governance practices that provide a high level of comfort to its stakeholders. The grading is assigned on a six-point scale, with CG 1 being the highest and CG 6 being the lowest. This assessment reflects the overall performance of KEI Industries Limited's corporate governance. The company operates six manufacturing facilities and has a presence in over 60 countries.

announcements.subject: Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd - 543271 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: update on acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited has successfully acquired 100% of the equity stake in Remidex Pharma Private Limited, as per the Share Purchase Agreement. This acquisition follows the initial disclosure made on March 13, 2026. The specific terms of this transaction were previously communicated to the stock exchanges on March 13, 2026. The company has confirmed the completion of this acquisition on March 30, 2026, at 6:05 pm IST. Further details regarding this acquisition are available on the company's website, www.jubilantingrevia.com.

announcements.subject: Hindustan Copper Ltd - 513599 - Construction Of New 3.0 MTPA Copper Concentrate Plant At Malanjkhand Copper Project (MCP), Madhya Pradesh, India
announcements.detail: Board of Directors of Hindustan Copper Ltd in its 461st meeting held today i.e., 30.03.2026 approved the proposal to place work order to Ardee Engineering Limited for construction of new 3.0 MTPA Copper Concentrate Plant at Malanjhkhand Copper Project, Madhya Pradesh, India.
announcements.ai_summary: Hindustan Copper Ltd's Board of Directors, in their 461st meeting held on March 30, 2026, approved the proposal to award a work order to Ardee Engineering Limited. The order is for the construction of a new 3.0 MTPA Copper Concentrate Plant at the Malanjkhand Copper Project (MCP) in Madhya Pradesh, India. This project will be executed on a turnkey basis and is expected to be completed over a period of twenty-seven (27) months. The financial implication for this project is Rs. 469.55 Crores plus GST. The Board meeting commenced at 10:30 AM and concluded at 03:45 PM.

announcements.subject: Davangere Sugar Company Ltd - 543267 - Capacity Addition
announcements.detail: Expansion of Company''s distillery production capacity.
announcements.ai_summary: Davangere Sugar Company Ltd's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on March 30, 2026, approved a significant expansion of the company's distillery production capacity. The company plans to add 85 KLDP to its existing capacity of 65 KLDP. This expansion is expected to be completed within 18 months and will require an investment of Rs. 127.50 Crores, which will be financed through FCCB Funding. The rationale behind this expansion is to capitalize on the rising demand for ethanol and leverage supportive government policies. The Board meeting commenced at 11:30 a.m. (IST) and concluded at 3:30 p.m. (IST).

announcements.subject: Bonlon Industries Ltd - 543211 - Board Meeting Outcome for OUTCOME OF BOARD MEETING FOR Allotment Of 22,00,000 Equity Shares Consequent To Conversion Of Warrants Of The Company
announcements.detail: The Company has submitted the outcome of Board meeting held today
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Bonlon Industries Ltd, in a meeting held on March 30, 2026, approved the allotment of 22,00,000 equity shares. These shares are a result of the conversion of 22,00,000 warrants, which were initially issued at an issue price of Rs. 33/- each on a preferential basis. The allotment is to the "Promoter/Promoter Group Category," specifically to Bon-Lon Securities Ltd (11,00,000 shares) and Harshit Finvest Pvt Ltd (11,00,000 shares). The company received a balance amount of Rs. 5,44,50,000/- (Rupees Five Crore Forty-Four Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) from these allottees, representing 75% of the issue price per warrant, which is Rs. 24.75/-. This conversion increases the company's issued and paid-up capital to Rs. 16,38,33,580/-, comprising 1,63,83,358 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each. The newly allotted shares will rank pari-passu with existing equity shares.

announcements.subject: KFin Technologies Ltd - 543720 - Update On Request For Re-Classification Of Entity Forming Part Of The ''Promoter(S) Group'' Category
announcements.detail: Please find attached update on request for Re-classification of Capital Foods Private Limited, entity forming part of the "Promoter(s) Group'' to "Public" Category, regarding receipt of no-objection letter from Stock Exchanges.
announcements.ai_summary: KFin Technologies Limited informed on March 30, 2026, that it has received no-objection letters from both BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) for the re-classification of Capital Foods Private Limited ("CFPL") from the 'Promoter(s) Group' category to the 'Public' category. This follows an application filed by KFin Technologies Limited with the stock exchanges seeking approval for this re-classification, as per Regulation 31A of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Accordingly, CFPL will now cease to be a part of the 'Promoter(s) Group' category of KFin Technologies Limited. The company had previously intimated the exchanges about this application on January 15, 2026, February 02, 2026, and February 04, 2026.

announcements.subject: Suraj Industries Ltd - 526211 - Update To Earlier Disclosure Dated March 26, 2026 In Relation To Acquisition Of Shares And Change In Shareholding In M/S Shri Gang Industries And Allied Products Limited. (' Shri Gang').
announcements.detail: Intimation
announcements.ai_summary: Suraj Industries Ltd provided an update on March 30, 2026, regarding its acquisition of shares in M/s Shri Gang Industries and Allied Products Limited ("Shri Gang"). The company has completed the acquisition of 25,000 equity shares of Shri Gang from Mr. Vikas Gupta. Additionally, Shri Gang has allotted 2,50,000 equity shares of face value ₹10 each, at a conversion price of ₹99 per equity share, through a preferential allotment on a private placement basis to entities belonging to the Promoter and Promoter Group category of Shri Gang. This allotment, pursuant to the conversion of 2,50,000 0.01% Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares, has increased Shri Gang's paid-up equity share capital to ₹19,98,00,000, comprising 1,99,80,000 equity shares. Consequently, Suraj Industries Ltd's shareholding in Shri Gang has been revised to 20.02% of the paid-up equity share capital.

announcements.subject: Nazara Technologies Ltd - 543280 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Nazara Technologies Limited informs the Exchange regarding a press release dated March 30, 2026, titled "Nazara raises INR 500 crores through Preferential Issue of Warrants".
announcements.ai_summary: Nazara Technologies Limited announced on March 30, 2026, a preferential issue of warrants aggregating ₹500 crores, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. Each warrant is convertible into one equity share at a price of ₹260 per share, which represents a premium to the current market price. The fundraising round includes participation from Riambel Capital PCC, S Gupta Family Investments, Plutus Investment and Holding Private Limited (Promoter Group), Classic Enterprises, and Founders Collective. The proceeds will be utilized to support strategic acquisitions, including the Bluetile and BestPlay transaction, and to accelerate growth across the company's existing business verticals. This capital infusion aims to position Nazara for building globally scalable, AI-enabled gaming businesses and strengthening its market leadership.

announcements.subject: Hilltone Software and Gases Ltd - 544308 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Hilltone Software and Gases Ltd, in a meeting held on March 30, 2026, has given in-principle approval for an investment in RZOLUT TECHNOLOGIES PTE. LTD., a Singapore and India-based company specializing in data products for risk and compliance. Rzolut Singapore, established on August 29, 2022, has a subsidiary in India named Rzolut DataStream Private Limited, incorporated on October 3, 2023. The startup, founded by Sarabjeet Singh, achieved a turnover of approximately ₹5 crores in FY 2024-25. Hilltone aims to acquire approximately 5% of Rzolut's stake, contingent on valuation and due diligence. This strategic move is expected to boost Hilltone's IT vertical and introduce it to the data solutions field with Rzolut's established customer base. Mr. Niket Shah has been authorized to appoint a valuer and consultants for due diligence, with the outcome to be presented to the Board.

announcements.subject: DLF Ltd - 532868 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Update on intimation(s) submitted on 16th April 2025 and 3rd February 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: DLF Limited announced on March 30, 2026, that it has completed the transfer of its IT/ITeS SEZ undertaking, including 'DLF TechPark II', to Makalu Builders LLP and Srijan Realty Private Limited. Concurrently, the company sold approximately 17.75 acres of vacant land in Kolkata to Gangapurna Projects LLP. These transactions, executed under a Master Framework Agreement, Business Transfer Agreement, and Agreement to Sell with Srijan Realty Private Limited and its subsidiaries, have an aggregate consideration of approximately ₹710.23 crore. The completion follows the fulfillment of conditions precedent and receipt of requisite regulatory approvals, as further to previous intimations dated April 16, 2025, and February 3, 2026.

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: T T Brands Limited, a Promoter Group entity of T T Ltd, has acquired 1,48,000 Equity Shares of T T Ltd on March 30, 2026. This acquisition was made from an unspecified seller. Following this transaction, T T Brands Limited has submitted a disclosure under regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to the stock exchanges. The company has requested that this information be taken on record.

announcements.subject: Indo Amines Ltd-$ - 524648 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Update
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith intimation under regulation 30 change in status of Subsidiary to Associate Company.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Indo Amines Limited has announced a change in the status of its subsidiary, Indo Speciality Chemicals Private Limited, to an Associate Company. This change, effective March 30, 2026, occurred because Indo Amines Limited did not participate in the Rights Issue of Indo Speciality Chemicals Private Limited. Consequently, the shareholding of Indo Amines Limited in the subsidiary was diluted from 51.39% to 39.39%. Although the number of shares held remains 172,140, the reduced percentage of shareholding means Indo Speciality Chemicals Private Limited no longer meets the criteria to be a subsidiary but maintains significant influence, classifying it as an Associate Company. There is no material impact on the overall operations of Indo Amines Limited.

announcements.subject: Alkem Laboratories Ltd - 539523 - Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015- Incorporation Of Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of The Company As A ''Scientific Office''.
announcements.detail: Please Find Attached herewith Intimation for Incorporation of Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company as a ''Scientific Office''.
announcements.ai_summary: Alkem Laboratories Limited has announced the incorporation of a new wholly-owned subsidiary named 'Alkem Pharmaceuticals Scientific Office FZ LLC' in Dubai Healthcare City, UAE, effective March 30, 2026. This new entity will function as a 'Scientific Office' and is intended to undertake the manufacturing of products and obtaining product registrations, excluding trading activities. The authorized and subscribed share capital of this subsidiary is AED 3,670,000, divided into 3,670 Equity Shares of AED 1,000 each, with the acquisition cost being AED 3,670,000 in cash. As a wholly-owned subsidiary, Alkem Pharmaceuticals is a related party to Alkem Laboratories Limited.

announcements.subject: TGV Sraac Ltd - 507753 - Announcement Under Reg.30 - Intimation Regarding Addition Of 2.5 Mwp Solar Power Capacity Addition
announcements.detail: Kindly note that the solar power capacity addtion of the company will be increased from the existing 55.40 Mwp to 57.90 MWp.
announcements.ai_summary: TGV Sraac Ltd has announced an addition of 2.5 MWp to its solar power capacity. This expansion will increase the company's total solar power generating capacity from the existing 55.40 MWp to 57.90 MWp. This announcement is in continuation of their earlier submission dated September 29, 2025, and is made in accordance with Regulation 30 read with Schedule III Part-A Para-B (3) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. This move signifies an expansion in the company's renewable energy infrastructure.

announcements.subject: DCW Ltd - 500117 -  Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI(LODR) Regulation, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: The company DCW Ltd has successfully commissioned the last milestone of its announced Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride (CPVC) capacity expansion project. This expansion adds 10,000 Metric Tonnes (MT) to its existing capacity, bringing the total installed capacity to 50,000 MT per annum. The project was commissioned on March 30, 2026, as per the scheduled timeline. DCW Ltd expects to gradually ramp up this new capacity throughout the first quarter of FY27. This expansion is a significant development for the company's CPVC business.

announcements.subject: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd - 533293 - General Update
announcements.detail: Please find attached herewith communication under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR
announcements.ai_summary: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd has announced the incorporation of a wholly-owned subsidiary, Kirloskar Advanced Systems Private Limited (KASPL), on March 30, 2026. The certificate of incorporation was issued by the Registrar of Companies, Central Registration Centre, on the same date, with Corporate Identification Number U28299PN2026PTC253954. KASPL will be engaged in various engineering and industrial business segments, including defence and railways. Its activities will encompass design, development, manufacture, assembly, testing, supply, import, export, and dealing in all types of industrial equipment, such as engines, power generating sets, motors, platforms, systems, sub-systems, unmanned systems, and integrated systems, along with providing Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) services.

announcements.subject: PVP Ventures Ltd - 517556 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Diversification / Disinvestment
announcements.detail: Divestment of Shares in Picturehouse Media Limited

The company holds 33,21,179 equity shares in PHML, representing 6.36% of its paid-up share capital, which is considered a minority and non-core investment. announcements.subject: CRISIL Ltd - 500092 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

announcements.subject: Tata Chemicals Ltd - 500770 - Press Release - Tata Chemicals' Mithapur Facility Achieves 1 Million Tonnes Soda Ash Production Milestone In FY 2025-26
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed a copy of the Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Tata Chemicals Limited announced that its Mithapur facility in Gujarat has achieved a significant milestone by producing 1 million tonnes of soda ash in the Financial Year 2025-26. This achievement is attributed to the consistent efforts and strong collaboration across various teams, including operations, maintenance, utilities, logistics, procurement, quality, safety, and support functions, as well as the Marketing & Sales teams. The company's Chief Financial Officer highlighted that this milestone reflects disciplined execution, cost optimization, and asset productivity, leading to enhanced margins and long-term value creation. This accomplishment reinforces Tata Chemicals' strong position in the global soda ash industry, emphasizing its focus on efficiency, reliability, and sustainable operations.

announcements.subject: NBCC (India) Ltd - 534309 - Intimation Of Engagement Of NBCC (India) Limited As Project Management Consultant In Republic Of Seychelles For Execution Of Housing And Associated Infrastructure Works

The project, valued at USD 75 million, will be funded by EXIM Bank under a Line of Credit (LoC) scheme. This engagement represents a significant international project for NBCC (India) Limited.

announcements.subject: Sayaji Hotels (Indore) Ltd - 544080 - Prior Intimation For Sale Of Equity Shares By The Promoter Under Sr. No. 7 (Ii) Of SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/Pod2/P/CIR/2023/18 Dated February 03, 2023 On The Manner Of Achieving Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS)

This sale is planned to be completed by March 30, 2026, and is being undertaken to comply with Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) requirements. announcements.subject: Aqylon Nexus Ltd - 530943 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Intimation About Execution Of Memorandum Of Understanding (Mou) With AITMC Ventures Private Limited
announcements.detail: Disclosure related to execution of MOU with AITMC Ventures Private Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Aqylon Nexus Limited has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with AITMC Ventures Private Limited to collaborate on a joint AI skilling program across India, with a focus on non-metropolitan areas. The program aims to train youth in AI skills, leveraging Aqylon's AI Code Platform and trained faculty to deliver a structured 3-month course. The objective is to achieve a minimum of 30,000 trained and certified AI professionals annually, with a total capacity of approximately 33,600 candidates. This initiative aligns with national government programs like Digital India and Skill India, enabling trained candidates to pursue roles such as AI Web Designers and AI Content Creators. This MoU outlines a framework for cooperation and does not constitute a legally binding agreement; any definitive agreements will be subject to mutual consent, due diligence, and regulatory compliance.

announcements.subject: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd - 500103 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Receipt of Notification of Award (NOA) from NTPC Ltd.
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has received a Notification of Award (NOA) from NTPC Limited for the Main Plant Package of the 3x800 MW Telangana Stage-II supercritical thermal power project. BHEL emerged as the successful bidder for this project in October 2024, and had previously received a Limited Notice to Proceed (LNTP) in November 2024 for basic engineering work. The scope of the contract includes the design, engineering, manufacturing, supply, erection, commissioning, and testing of the main plant package (Boiler, Turbine & Generator), along with civil and structural works. The execution of the Main Plant Package works is to be completed within 62 months from the date of the NOA. The consideration for this order is over Rs. 13,500 Crore, excluding GST. Both BHEL and NTPC are Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs).

announcements.subject: Cineline India Ltd - 532807 - Opening Of 2 - Screen Multiplex In Chennai, Tamil Nadu
announcements.detail: Opening of 2 - Screen Multiplex in Chennai, Tamil Nadu
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Cineline India Ltd has opened a new 2-screen multiplex under the brand name "MovieMax" in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. This is the company's first cinema in the state and expands its portfolio to 85 operational screens across 22 properties and 16 cities. The multiplex is located in Prince Ratnapuri Garden Residency, Walltax Road, Kondithope, Chennai, and features 452 seats, 4K laser projection systems, next-generation 3D capabilities, and Dolby sound systems. It also offers an enhanced F&B experience with a pure vegetarian menu and a live kitchen concept. The CEO, Ashish Kanakia, stated that this launch strengthens their pan-India presence and caters to evolving cinema audience preferences.
