This infusion of capital will strengthen the company's balance sheet and support its growth strategy.

announcements.subject: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd - 543895 - Award Of Contract For Helicopter Shuttle Services By Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority
announcements.detail: Intimation is enclosed herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: United Helicharters Private Limited (UHPL), a subsidiary of Exhicon Events Media Solutions Limited, has been awarded a contract for operating helicopter shuttle services in Uttarakhand by the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority. UHPL emerged as the L1 (Lowest) bidder after successfully qualifying at the technical evaluation stage, competing against established operators like Pawan Hans Limited and others. This contract is expected to enhance the company's presence in the aviation and pilgrimage logistics sector and contribute positively to its operational and financial performance.

announcements.detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of Listing Regulations, please find enclosed Press Release- "Wockhardt''s Zaynich (Zidebactam/ Cefepime) Receives Favourable Recommendation from CDSCO''s Subject Expert Committee for Treatment of Gram- Negative Infections".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Wockhardt Limited has announced that its novel antibiotic, Zaynich® (Zidebactam/Cefepime), has received a favourable recommendation from the Subject Expert Committee (SEC) of the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for marketing permission. This recommendation is for the treatment of Gram-negative infections and paves the way for final approval by the Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI). The recommendation is based on comprehensive data from non-clinical studies, Phase 1, Phase 2, and a global Phase 3 study involving 530 patients across multiple countries, as well as data from 85 compassionate-use cases. Zaynich® was developed over 15 years by a team of over 150 scientists and features a novel β-lactam enhancer mechanism designed to combat multidrug-resistant (MDR) and extensively drug-resistant (XDR) Gram-negative pathogens.

announcements.ai_summary: Jubilant FoodWorks Limited has issued a business update regarding supply constraints on commercial LPG distribution across India due to the ongoing geopolitical situation in the Middle East. This has led to a constrained supply of LPG cylinders to certain parts of the company's store network, although the operational impact is currently limited and being actively managed. The company is implementing measures to conserve LPG and is transitioning to alternative energy sources such as electricity and piped natural gas (PNG). The company emphasizes its resilient systems and processes to manage short-term operational challenges.

announcements.subject: NTPC Green Energy Ltd - 544289 - NTPC Green Energy Limited Has Informed The Exchange About Declaration Of Commercial Operation Of Third And Last Part Capacity Of 75 MW Out Of 500 MW Bhadla Solar PV Project Located In Phalodi, Rajasthan Of NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, A Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of NTPC Green Energy Limited, Is Declared On Commercial Operation W.E.F. 25.03.2026.

This project is undertaken by NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of NTPC Green Energy Limited. The commercial operation is effective from March 25, 2026. The company received the certificate for this declaration from Rajasthan Renewable Energy Corporation Limited on March 28, 2026.

announcements.subject: Adf Foods Ltd-$ - 519183 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR - Commencement Of Commercial Production.
announcements.detail: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 w.r.t. Commencement of Commercial Production at the Company''s new Green Field manufacturing facility at Surat.
announcements.ai_summary: ADF Foods Limited has commenced commercial production at its new Greenfield manufacturing facility located at Gujarat Agro Infrastructure Mega Food Park, Mangrol, Surat. This commencement of production took place on March 28, 2026. The new facility has a potential installed capacity of 10,000 MT per annum and involved an investment of approximately Rs. 90 crore in Phase 1. This expansion is intended to cater to both international and domestic markets, aiming to strengthen the company's production capabilities, improve operational efficiencies, and support future growth plans. The information has been made available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd - 544209 - Announcemnt Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Bansal Wire Industries Limited has informed the exchange regarding temporary disruption in supply of natural gas to our manufacturing facilities due to prevaling geopolitical situation
announcements.ai_summary: Bansal Wire Industries Limited has informed the stock exchanges about a temporary disruption in the supply of natural gas to its manufacturing facilities. This disruption is a consequence of ongoing geopolitical tensions in the West Asian region, leading to restrictions from Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) due to a force majeure situation. As a result, the company's production capacity has been impacted by 35% since mid-March. Bansal Wire Industries Limited is implementing measures such as enhancing the operationalization of electric furnaces and using alternative heating systems to mitigate the impact and ensure operational continuity. The company is coordinating with natural gas distribution partners and relevant authorities to restore affected production capacity and minimize adverse financial effects.

announcements.subject: Urban Company Ltd - 544515 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release titled- Urban Company''s ''Instahelp'' Crosses 1 Million Monthly Delivered Bookings; Becomes Fastest-Growing Vertical in Company History"
announcements.ai_summary: Urban Company Limited announced that its quick-service housekeeping vertical, InstaHelp, has achieved over 1 million monthly delivered bookings as of March 28, 2026, making it the fastest-growing vertical in the company's history. This milestone follows the reporting of over 50,000 daily orders in February 2026. InstaHelp is currently operational in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, and Pune, offering services like cleaning, dishwashing, laundry, and meal preparation within 10-15 minutes of booking. The company's CEO & Co-founder, Abhiraj Singh Bhal, highlighted the strong consumer trust in the platform for immediate, everyday needs. Urban Company Limited is a technology-driven platform connecting customers with professionals for home and beauty services.

announcements.subject: Bharti Hexacom Ltd - 544162 - Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

The company is evaluating the details of the alleged violations.

announcements.subject: Shriram Pistons & Rings Ltd - 544344 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Amendments to Memorandum & Articles of Association

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) has confirmed this change, issuing a certificate of alteration on March 27, 2026. The updated MOA now encompasses a broader scope for the company's business, including the design, development, manufacturing, assembly, and dealing in a wide array of automotive and engine components, such as pistons, piston rings, cylinder liners, engine valves, gaskets, and various types of gears. This expansion also covers components for internal combustion engines, steam engines, compressors, and other machinery, reflecting a strategic move to broaden its operational activities.

announcements.subject: Sayaji Hotels (Indore) Ltd - 544080 - Intimation For Sale Of Equity Shares By The Promoter Under Sr. No. 7 (Ii) Of SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/Pod2/P/CIR/2023/18 Dated February 03, 2023 Of Manner Of Achieving Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS)

announcements.subject: Crizac Ltd - 544439 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release titled "Strategic in-house development of AI-based Education Technology Platform"

This development signifies Crizac's mission to lead innovation and dominate the Edtech industry.

announcements.subject: Thermax Ltd - 500411 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

Through this agreement, Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited will sell 10% of the equity stake in ATPL, representing 5,000 equity shares of INR 10 each, to Itochu Corporation for an aggregate consideration of INR 80,32,00,000 (Indian Rupees Eighty Crores Thirty Two lakhs Only). announcements.subject: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd - 524715 - Updates On Fibromun And Nidlegy
announcements.detail: Updates on Fibromun and Nidlegy
announcements.ai_summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has provided clinical updates on its drug candidates, Fibromun and Nidlegy, from its partner Philogen. The Phase II FLASH study for Fibromun in soft tissue sarcoma did not meet its primary endpoint for Progression Free Survival (PFS). Similarly, the Phase II GLIOSTAR trial for glioblastoma also did not meet its primary endpoint, although an improvement in survival was observed in a subgroup of patients with limited exposure to alkylating agents. The company remains committed to the GLIOSUN trial for treatment-naïve glioblastoma patients, which is initiating its dose expansion phase, and the GLIOSTELLA study, which is expected to report survival data in September 2026. Following encouraging signals from the FIBROSARC study, a request for Parallel Scientific Advice with the FDA and EMA has been submitted to define the design of a new Phase III registrational study, FIBROSARC-2, planned to start in the second quarter of 2026.

announcements.ai_summary: G R Infraprojects Limited has emerged as the L-1 bidder for a project titled "Upgradation of Existing Two-Lane Carriageway to Four Lane Divided Carriageway from Ch. 208+90 (Existing Km. 535.93) in Nasarpore Village in Umarpada Taluka to Ch. 269+11 (Existing Km. 608.51) in Malotha Village in Vyara Taluka (Length 60.21 Km.) Section of NH-56 in Gujarat on HAM (Pkg-VI)." The contract price for this project is INR 1453.57 Crores, to be executed on a Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) with a completion period of 910 days from the appointed date. This information is disclosed in accordance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Kranti Industries Ltd - 542459 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Diversification / Disinvestment
announcements.detail: As per the Regulation 30 and other applicable provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that pursuant to the execution of Share Purchase Agreement dated March 27, 2026 between Kranti Industries Limited ("Company") and Mr. Sunil Gadiya and Mr. Kunal Vora, the Company has transferred 8,00,000 Equity Shares of Preciso Metall Pvt. Ltd. Consequently, Preciso Metall Pvt. Ltd. ceased ....
announcements.ai_summary: Kranti Industries Limited has divested 8,00,000 equity shares of Preciso Metall Private Limited, each with a face value of ₹10, on March 27, 2026. This transaction was executed through a Share Purchase Agreement with Mr. Kunal Vijay Vora and Mr. Sunil Rameshlal Gadiya. Consequently, Preciso Metall Private Limited has ceased to be a subsidiary of Kranti Industries Limited and has become an associate company. For the financial year ending March 31, 2025, Preciso Metall Private Limited contributed Rs. 737.9 Lakhs (9.40%) to consolidated turnover and had a net worth of Rs. (190.04) Lakhs (4.58% of consolidated net worth). The expected date of completion of this disinvestment is on or before March 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd - 500247 - Rumour verification - Regulation 30(11)
announcements.detail: Clarification attached
announcements.ai_summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited has responded to a news item published on www.moneycontrol.com regarding an alleged Rs. 160-crore FD fraud linked to Panchkula Municipal Corp. The bank clarifies that there is no material impact in terms of Regulation 30(4) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Kotak Mahindra Bank is examining the matter as per instructions from the Municipal Corporation of Panchkula and is cooperating fully with government authorities and law enforcement agencies.

announcements.subject: Landmark Property Development Company Ltd - 533012 - Announcement Under Reg 30
announcements.detail: Announcement of agreement with related party
announcements.ai_summary: Landmark Property Development Company Ltd has executed a Refund and Settlement Agreement with Eterna Living Private Limited, a related party. This agreement is for the cancellation of a balance space booking arrangement and the refund of an outstanding advance amounting to ₹35,26,15,047/. Eterna Living Private Limited is obligated to refund the full amount within six months from the agreement's execution date. Upon execution, Landmark Property Development Company Ltd received ₹15,00,000/- as a part payment, which will be adjusted against the outstanding advance. This transaction received prior approval from the Audit Committee, Board of Directors, and shareholders.

announcements.company: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
announcements.subject: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd - 532898 - POWERGRID Has Successfully Commissioned The Project
announcements.detail: POWERGRID has successfully commissioned the project.
announcements.ai_summary: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd (POWERGRID) has successfully commissioned a significant project titled “Transmission System for Power Evacuation from Arun -3 (900 MW) HEP, Nepal of M/s SAPDC – Indian Portion”. This commissioning is effective from September 3, 2023, in accordance with Regulation 5(2) of CERC (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019. The project's commissioning was referenced in a CERC Order dated March 10, 2026. This development signifies the operationalization of a key transmission infrastructure, contributing to the power evacuation capabilities from the Arun-3 Hydroelectric Project in Nepal.

announcements.subject: Universus Photo Imagings Ltd - 542933 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI(LODR)-Updates
announcements.detail: General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Universus Photo Imagings Limited (formerly JINDAL PHOTO IMAGING LIMITED) has approved the relocation of its Corporate Office. The office will move from Plot No. 87, Sector 32, Gurugram, Haryana -122001 to Plot No. 12, Local Shopping Complex Sector B-1, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi, 110070. This change will be effective from April 1, 2026. The company's Books of Account will also be kept at the new New Delhi address from the same effective date. This regulatory update informs stakeholders about the administrative change in the company's operational base.

announcements.subject: NHPC Ltd - 533098 - Signing Of Implementation Agreement
announcements.detail: In continuation to earlier letter dated 20.02.2026 and in compliance to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR, signing of implementation agreement on 27.03.2026 between NHPC Limited and JKSPDCL is submitted. The details given in the attached letter.
announcements.ai_summary: NHPC Limited has signed an Implementation Agreement with Jammu & Kashmir State Power Development Corporation Limited (JKSPDCL) on March 27, 2026, in Jammu. This agreement is for the development of the 240 MW Uri-I Stage-II and 260 MW Dulhasti Stage-II Hydroelectric Projects in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir. NHPC will develop these projects on a Build-Own-Operate-Transfer (BOOT) basis for a period of 40 years. This signing is in continuation of a previous letter dated February 20, 2026, and is in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Shalibhadra Finance Ltd - 511754 - Disclosure In Terms Of Regulation 29(2) Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Substantial Acquisition Of Shares And Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
announcements.detail: Disclosure in terms of Regulation 29(2) of SEBI(SAST), Regulation  2011.
announcements.ai_summary: Shalibhadra Finance Limited has disclosed an acquisition of shares under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Ayushi Doshi, who is part of the promoter group, acquired 78,500 shares through an open market transaction on March 27, 2026. Before this acquisition, Ayushi Doshi held 6,75,600 shares, representing 2.19% of the total voting capital. After the acquisition, her total holding increased to 7,54,100 shares, which represents 2.44% of the total voting capital. The acquisition was made via the open market.

announcements.subject: Aarti Pharmalabs Ltd - 543748 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Please find our intimation in captioned subject
announcements.ai_summary: Aarti Pharmalabs Limited has announced the completion of its US-FDA inspection at Unit-IV, Tarapur. The inspection concluded on March 27, 2026, and resulted in the issuance of one observation on Form 483. This observation is procedural in nature. The company will submit corrective and preventive actions to the US FDA within the stipulated period. This update is crucial for investors to monitor the company's compliance and operational status with international regulatory bodies.

announcements.subject: Suraj Industries Ltd - 526211 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition
announcements.detail: Update on Acquisition.
announcements.ai_summary: Suraj Industries Ltd has completed the acquisition of 24,800 equity shares of M/s Shri Gang Industries and Allied Products Limited (“Shri Gang”) from Mr. Ritesh Gupta. Following this acquisition, Suraj Industries Ltd's shareholding in Shri Gang has increased to 20.15% of Shri Gang's paid-up equity share capital. This update follows the company's previous intimation on March 26, 2026, regarding the acquisition.

announcements.subject: SJVN Ltd - 533206 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: SJVN"s 412 MW Rampur Hydro Power Station surpassed Highest-Ever Generation
announcements.ai_summary: SJVN Ltd announced that its 412 MW Rampur Hydro Power Station in Himachal Pradesh has surpassed its highest-ever generation record. On March 26, 2026, the station generated 2098.03 million units, exceeding the previous record set in FY 2019-20. The Head of Project, Rampur HPS, dedicated this achievement to the SJVN Management's leadership and the teamwork of all employees. The Rampur HPS had previously achieved its Design Energy target of 1,878 million units for FY 2025-26 on December 8, 2025, marking the fastest achievement since its commissioning.

announcements.subject: Omax Autos Ltd - 520021 - Intimation Of Cyber Security Incident.
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed intimation of cyber Security incident on Company''s IT Infrastructure.
announcements.ai_summary: Omax Autos Ltd has confirmed a ransomware attack on its IT infrastructure, which was initially suspected on March 26, 2026. The company has stated that the incident has not impacted its core systems and operations. Omax Autos is currently assessing the extent of any potential loss or impact and conducting a detailed investigation with ongoing remedial actions. The company is also strengthening its cybersecurity systems to prevent future occurrences and will provide updates on material developments.

announcements.subject: Ethos Ltd - 543532 - Opening Of Ethos Watch Boutiques At Srinagar
announcements.detail: Opening of Ethos Watch Boutiques at Srinagar
announcements.ai_summary: Ethos Limited has inaugurated a new Ethos Watch Boutique in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, on March 27, 2026. Located at Unit No-3, The Edition Mall, Sanat Nagar, this opening marks a significant step in strengthening the company's luxury brand portfolio and its presence in a key luxury retail market. This expansion aligns with the company's strategic vision to make exclusive brands more accessible to customers across India. With this new boutique, Ethos Limited now operates a total of 92 boutiques nationwide.

announcements.subject: Apcotex Industries Ltd - 523694 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On 27Th March 2026
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed Outcome of Board Meeting held on 27th March 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: A meeting of the Board of Directors of Apcotex Industries Limited was held on March 27, 2026, where several key decisions were made. The Board approved entering into a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) and a Share Subscription Cum Shareholders Agreement (SSSHA) with Amplus Ceres Solar Private Limited. As part of this, the company will subscribe to a minimum of 2.55% of the equity shares of Amplus Ceres Solar Private Limited, a subsidiary of Amplus Energy Solutions PTE Limited, for a total value of INR 72,00,000/-. Additionally, the Board approved a similar PPA and SSSHA with Amplus Energy One Private Limited, subscribing to a minimum of 2.14% of its equity shares for INR 1,32,00,000/-. The face value of these shares is INR 10/- each. Furthermore, Mr. Ravishankar Sharma was re-appointed as an Executive Director for two years, effective May 1, 2026.

announcements.subject: JNK India Ltd - 544167 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding receipt of order
announcements.ai_summary: JNK India Limited has announced the receipt of a major order on March 27, 2026, from JNK Global Co., Ltd., Korea. This order is for providing support services and supplies for a Cracker Furnace Package of a refinery project in India. JNK Global is a promoter of JNK India Limited, and the company has confirmed there is no potential conflict of interest arising from this transaction. The project delivery schedule is set for February 2, 2028. This order is classified as "Major" based on its value, and it is an international order to be executed in India.

announcements.subject: JSW Steel Ltd - 500228 - Update On 50:50 JV Between JSW Steel Limited And JFE Steel Corporation, For The Steel Business Of Bhushan Power And Steel Limited.
announcements.detail: Update on 50:50 Joint Venture between JSW Steel LImited and JFE Steel Corporation, Japan for the Steel Business of Bhushan Power and Steel Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: JSW Steel Limited has announced the completion of the transfer of the steel business undertaking of Bhushan Power and Steel Limited (BPSL) to JSW Sambalpur Steel Limited, a subsidiary of JSW Steel. This transfer was executed via a slump sale on a going concern basis and was completed on March 27, 2026. This is a key step in the previously approved 50:50 joint venture partnership between JSW Steel Limited and JFE Steel Corporation, Japan, for the steel business of BPSL.

announcements.subject: Onelife Capital Advisors Ltd - 533632 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Dated 27/03/2026
announcements.detail: Enclosed herewith Outcome of Board Meeting dated 27/03/2026
announcements.ai_summary: Onelife Capital Advisors Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on March 27, 2026, approved several loan grants and an investment. The Board approved a loan of Rs. 1,50,00,000 (Rupees One Crore Fifty Lakhs) to Mr. JayKishor Chatuvedi. Additionally, loans were approved for Abhidev Consultancy Services Private Limited (up to Rs. 5,50,00,000 at 12% per annum), Jeevan Jyoti Vanijya Limited (up to Rs. 2,00,00,000), Gandhi Nagar Leasing and Finance Limited (up to Rs. 2,00,00,000), and Gandhi Nagar Leasing and Finance (up to Rs. 1,50,00,000). The Board also approved an investment of up to Rs. 1,50,00,000 (Rupees One Crore Fifty Lakhs) in Dealmoney Real Estate Private Limited, a subsidiary. The meeting was held from 1:00 PM to 3:35 PM.

announcements.subject: Tata Communications Ltd - 500483 - Intimation Regarding Issuance, Allotment And Listing Of Commercial Paper Amounting To Rs 750 Crore
announcements.detail: Intimation regarding issuance, allotment and listing of Commercial Paper amounting to Rs 750 Crore
announcements.ai_summary: Tata Communications Limited has issued and allotted Commercial Paper aggregating to an amount of ₹750 crore on March 25, 2026. The Commercial Paper has a face value of ₹5,00,000/- per security and a discount rate of 7.85% per annum. The redemption date for this issuance is April 24, 2026. The Commercial Paper, with ISIN INE151A14263, was listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on March 27, 2026.

announcements.subject: Eicher Motors Ltd - 505200 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: The 2026 Royal Enfield Guerrilla 450: Sportier Performance meets urban agility
announcements.ai_summary: Eicher Motors Ltd has announced the launch of the 2026 Royal Enfield Guerrilla 450, featuring an all-new APEX variant. This variant offers sportier design and new road-focused tyres, enhancing urban agility and performance. The existing Dash and Flash variants will also receive improved grippier tyres, with the Dash variant getting a new colorway. Bookings for the 2026 Guerrilla 450 APEX commence today, March 27, 2026, with pan-India retail sales beginning on March 31, 2026. The APEX variant is built around the Sherpa engine and features a lower, more committed riding posture with road-biased 17” Vredestein Centuro ST tyres for enhanced grip. It also includes updated ride modes with mode retention and sharper visual aesthetics with new colourways.

announcements.subject: YOGI Ltd - 511702 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: Please find the attached Intimation of receipt of Purchase order.
announcements.ai_summary: YOGI Ltd has received purchase orders from Companion Vinimay Trading Private Limited for the supply and delivery of various industrial components, including Structure Assembly, Head Assembly, Rotary Table & Electrical Accessories, Tool Changer & Additional Axis, and Accessories. The total value of these orders is approximately Rs. 102.36 Crores, excluding all taxes. The company has received four purchase orders, each for one complete set of the specified equipment. The products will be delivered within an agreed timeline of approximately 15 days, with standard terms related to quality, delivery schedule, and pricing mutually agreed upon by both parties.

announcements.subject: Chemtech Industrial Valves Ltd - 537326 - Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Outcome For The Meeting Held On Friday, 27Th March 2026.
announcements.detail: Kindly find enclosed herewith the Outcome of the Board Meeting held today i.e. Friday, 27th March 2026 for conversion of the Convertible Warrants to Equity Shares
announcements.ai_summary: Chemtech Industrial Valves Ltd's Board of Directors has approved the allotment of 5,00,000 equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each at a premium of Rs. 190 each to Promoter/Promoter Group. This allotment is pursuant to the conversion of Convertible Warrants, which were initially issued and allotted on a preferential basis on October 1, 2024. The conversion was approved in compliance with SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2018, and received in-principle approval from BSE. The allottees are Harsh Pradeep Badkur and Puneet Pradeep Badkur, each receiving 2,50,000 equity shares.

announcements.subject: Birlanu Ltd - 509675 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Dated March 27, 2026
announcements.detail: In-principal approval for enhancement of the corporate guarantee limit from Euro 45 million to Euro 55 million
announcements.ai_summary: BirlaNu Ltd's Board of Directors, in their meeting held on March 27, 2026, granted in-principal approval to enhance the corporate guarantee limit from Euro 45 million to Euro 55 million. This enhanced guarantee, which may include a Stand-by Letter of Credit, will be provided on behalf of BirlaNu International GmbH, Germany, a wholly-owned subsidiary, and its subsidiaries. The purpose of this guarantee is to secure existing and future loan facilities availed or to be availed by BirlaNu International GmbH and its subsidiaries. Further details will be submitted at the time of execution of the corporate guarantee.

announcements.subject: iStreet Network Ltd - 524622 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment
announcements.detail: Allotment of Equity Shares pursuant to conversion of warrants through circular resolution.
announcements.ai_summary: iStreet Network Ltd's Board of Directors has approved the conversion of 11,16,667 warrants into 11,16,667 equity shares of face value ₹ 4 each. This conversion was made for cash upon receipt of the exercise price of ₹ 4.5 per warrant, aggregating to ₹ 50,24,999. The allotment was made to public category warrant holders, including Viral S. Acharya, Shahana Sen Mishra, Vipin Mishra, and Deldan Otsal. These newly allotted equity shares will rank pari-passu with the existing equity shares of the company. Following this allotment, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from ₹ 27,32,00,008 to ₹ 27,76,66,676.

announcements.subject: Vishnu Chemicals Ltd - 516072 - Update On Closure Of Vishnu International Trading FZE, UAE, Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company
announcements.detail: Update on closure of Vishnu International Trading FZE, UAE, Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company is enclosed.
announcements.ai_summary: Vishnu Chemicals Ltd has provided an update on the closure of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Vishnu International Trading FZE, located in the UAE. The voluntary winding-up process is still ongoing and has taken longer than initially expected due to prevailing geopolitical conditions in the Middle East. The company now anticipates that the closure of this subsidiary will be completed within approximately six additional months. This information is also available on the company's website.

announcements.subject: Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd - 539301 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Media Release dated 27th March, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd (ASL) has announced its entry into the society redevelopment segment with its first residential apartment project in Mumbai. The project, located in Santacruz (West), has a top-line potential of approximately Rs. 300 crore and a total estimated carpet area for sale of 42,000 sq. ft. This marks ASL's second project in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) and its first in the society redevelopment category. The company has also reported that its cumulative new business development top-line potential for the year now stands at approximately Rs. 3,140 crore.

announcements.subject: Gateway Distriparks Ltd - 543489 - Disclosures Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition Of Shares And Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
announcements.detail: refer the attached file
announcements.ai_summary: Perfect Communications Private Limited, a promoter of Gateway Distriparks Limited, has acquired 3,566,930 equity shares of the company. This acquisition, disclosed under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, was made on March 27, 2026. The specific percentage of total voting capital before and after this transaction is not provided in the announcement, but the acquisition by a promoter indicates a potential increase in their stake in Gateway Distriparks Limited.

announcements.subject:
Jaiprakash Associates Ltd - 532532 - Intimation In Accordance With Regulation 30 Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations And Disclosure
Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.detail: Intimation Regulation 30
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Jaiprakash Associates Limited (JAL) has informed the Exchange about a consented arbitral award dated March 25, 2026, in relation to a pending arbitration with UltraTech Cement Limited (UTCL). Upon receipt of settlement proceeds amounting to INR 1,000,00,00,000 (INR One Thousand Crores) from UTCL, all claims and liabilities concerning Series A Redeemable Preference Shares issued by UTCL in favor of JAL will be extinguished. Consequently, UTCL will be entitled to continue holding, using, and operating the JP Super Plant and associated mines and infrastructure at Kajrahat, Uttar Pradesh, free from any claims by JAL.

announcements.subject: ITCONS E-Solutions Ltd - 543806 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, - Formation Of Advisory Committee
announcements.detail: The Advisory Committee of the Board has been constituted effective from March 27, 2026, the members of the Advisory Committee will  provide guidance to the Board on business strategy, long term planning, operational and financial performance. For more details please refer attached file
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: ITCONS E-Solutions Ltd has constituted an Advisory Committee to the Board, effective from March 27, 2026. The committee members, including Alok Aggarwal (Chairman), Deepak Kumar Srivastava (Member), and Sanjay Kumar Verma (Member), will provide guidance on business strategy, long-term planning, and operational and financial performance. Mr. Deepak Kumar Srivastava has been appointed for a period of one year commencing March 27, 2026, and brings over four decades of legal experience, including 31 years in the Uttar Pradesh Judiciary. The formation of this committee is expected to offer valuable industry insights and financial expertise to support the company's growth.

announcements.subject: Xpro India Ltd - 590013 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 - Commencement Of Commercial Production/Operations
announcements.detail: The Company informs that the new dielectric film line at Barjora, WB was commissioned on March 27, 2026 and is operational.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Xpro India Limited has announced the commencement of commercial production for its new dielectric film line at Barjora, West Bengal, on March 27, 2026. This new line is now operational. Additionally, the company provided an update on its UAE project, being implemented by its subsidiary, Xpro Dielectric Films FZ-LLC. Xpro India Limited is actively monitoring evolving regional conditions and any potential impact on this project.

announcements.subject: Axis Solutions Ltd - 511144 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Memorandum of Understanding /Agreements
announcements.detail: Execution of Loan agreement with Vivriti Capital Limited
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Axis Solutions Limited has executed a Deed of Hypothecation with Vivriti Capital Limited on March 27, 2026, to secure a working capital facility of Rs. 25.00 crores. This facility is intended to support the expansion of the company's business operations. The agreement involves a subservient and continuing charge on all company assets, including current assets, book debt, and movable fixed assets. Additionally, a first-ranking exclusive charge is placed on a debt service reserve account or cash collateral, equivalent to 15.77% of the facility amount, held as an interest-free security deposit with a lien and set-off in favor of Vivriti Capital Limited. This transaction is not with a related party and is being undertaken in the ordinary course of business.

announcements.subject: Emami Paper Mills Ltd - 533208 - Intimation Of Redemption Of Unlisted Series II Tranche III Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares (OCRPS) Having ISIN - INE830C04038
announcements.detail: Please find the intimation for the redemption of OCRPS.
announcements.ai_summary: Emami Paper Mills Limited has redeemed its 2,70,000 unlisted Series II - Tranche III Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares (OCRPS) on March 27, 2026. Each OCRPS had a face value of Rs.100/- and a redemption premium of Rs.500/-. The redemption was carried out in accordance with the terms of the issue and was funded from the company's available profits/reserves. This action follows a Board of Directors' resolution communicated on February 12, 2026.

announcements.subject: K.P. Energy Ltd - 539686 - Intimation Of Receipt Of Letter Of Award (Loa) For Development Of A Wind-Solar Hybrid Power Project In Gujarat Aggregating To 91.4 MW.
announcements.detail: K.P. Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Receipt of Letter of Award (LoA) for Development of a Wind-Solar Hybrid Power Project in Gujarat aggregating to 91.4 MW. Detailed disclosure is attached herewith.
announcements.ai_summary: K.P. Energy Limited has received a Letter of Award (LoA) from JK Paper Limited for the development of a 91.4 MW Wind-Solar Hybrid Power Project in Gujarat. The project will be executed on a complete turnkey basis, including engineering, procurement, installation, commissioning, and development of evacuation infrastructure for grid connectivity. K.P. Energy Limited will also be responsible for obtaining all necessary statutory and regulatory clearances and providing operation & maintenance (O&M) services for the Balance of Plant (BoP) of the wind capacity and the complete installed capacity of the solar project. This award strengthens K.P. Energy Limited's position in the renewable energy sector.

announcements.subject: Nexome Capital Markets Ltd - 508905 - Disclosure Under Regulation 10(6) Of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
announcements.ai_summary: Nexome Capital Markets Limited (formerly SMIFS Capital Markets Limited) has made a disclosure under Regulation 10(6) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure pertains to the acquisition of equity shares by the Promoters and Promoter Group, specifically by Lend Lease Company (India) Limited. This acquisition is in compliance with Regulation 10(4)(a) and 10(4)(b) read with Regulation 10(6) of the SAST Regulations, 2011, and relates to the subscription of a Rights Issue of Shares, including additional shares allotted by Nexome Capital Markets Limited.

announcements.subject: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd - 543980 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order
announcements.detail: The Company has received a letter from Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority (MMRDA) conveying the acceptance of its tender for allotment of land on lease basis
announcements.ai_summary: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd has received a letter from the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority (MMRDA) confirming the acceptance of its tender for land allotment on a lease basis. The allotment pertains to a land parcel of approximately 10,026.44 sqm, located at plot no. SF5 in the GTxT-Block of Bandra-Kurla Complex, Maharashtra. The lease will be for a period of 80 years, with a total consideration of approximately Rs. 354 Crores. This land is intended for the development of a hospital with approximately 400 beds, subject to various statutory and regulatory approvals.

announcements.subject: JK Cement Ltd - 532644 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On March 27, 2026
announcements.detail: Outcome of Board Meeting held today on March 27, 2026
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of JK Cement Limited, in its meeting held on March 27, 2026, approved entering into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire cement grinding assets and land. The company will acquire 0.24 MnTPA cement grinding assets from Sri Chakra Cement Limited and approximately 34 acres of land from Envean Enterprises Private Limited, Sri Chakra Cement Limited, and K Sanjay Kumar. The aggregate consideration for this acquisition is Rs. 28.79 crores. These cement grinding assets have been non-operational since April 2025. The transaction is contingent upon the finalization and execution of definitive agreements and the fulfillment of customary conditions precedents.

announcements.subject: Cemindia Projects Ltd - 509496 - Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Approved the elevating Mr. Soumitra Ghosh, Vice President -Operations, in the category of Senior Management Personnel with effect from 02nd April, 2026.
announcements.ai_summary: The Board of Directors of Cemindia Projects Ltd, at their meeting held on March 27, 2026, approved the elevation of Mr. Soumitra Ghosh, Vice President - Operations, to the category of Senior Management Personnel. This elevation is effective from April 02, 2026, and is intended to enhance his contribution to the company's growth and operational excellence. Mr. Ghosh holds a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering and has over 28 years of experience in project management, having been associated with the company since 2003. His performance will be reviewed during annual appraisals.

announcements.subject: Wealth First Portfolio Managers Ltd - 544536 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release for Intimation of grant of Final License by SEBI to Subsidiary Company to act as Asset Management Company for Mutual Fund.
announcements.ai_summary: Wealth First Portfolio Managers Ltd has announced that its subsidiary, Lakshya Asset Management Private Limited (Lakshya AMC), has received the final license from SEBI to act as an Asset Management Company (AMC) for launching and managing mutual funds. Lakshya AMC has onboarded key members of the founding team of Benchmark Asset Management Company, pioneers of Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) in India, including Mr. Sanjiv Shah, Mr. Rajan Mehta, and Mr. Sanjay Gaitonde. Benchmark AMC was known for introducing India's first ETF, Nifty BeES, and other innovative products. This development marks a significant step for Wealth First Portfolio Managers in building an innovation-led asset management platform.

announcements.subject: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd - 539682 - Business Update: Mobavenue Strengthens AI-Led Two-Tower Modelling To Enhance  Advertising Outcomes.
announcements.detail: Business Update: Mobavenue strengthens AI-Led Two-Tower Modelling to enhance advertising outcomes
announcements.ai_summary: Mobavenue AI Tech Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Mobavenue Media Private Limited (MMPL), has enhanced its advanced two-tower neural network modelling framework. This upgrade is part of MMPL's transition towards AI-native platforms to improve advertising outcomes for its clients. The two-tower approach independently models and matches high-intent users with relevant offerings, with one tower focusing on predicting high-conversion users and the other on optimising bidding and budget allocation. The framework continuously learns from campaign and user data for real-time recalibration and performance optimisation, leading to improved targeting precision and campaign scalability. MMPL has observed improved conversion outcomes compared to conventional methods.

announcements.subject: Reliance Industries Ltd - 500325 - Statement
announcements.detail: Statement
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Reliance Industries Ltd has categorically rejected recent media reports alleging the purchase of crude oil of Iranian origin, stating these claims are entirely baseless, factually incorrect, and misleading. The company urges media outlets to verify facts thoroughly before publication and to refrain from disseminating unsubstantiated reports that could misinform stakeholders and the public. This statement was issued on March 26, 2026, and copies were sent to the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and Singapore Exchange Limited.

announcements.subject: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd - 543942 - Sale Of Unsecured Stressed MFI Loan Portfolio To ARC
announcements.detail: As per intimation appended herewith
announcements.ai_summary: On March 26, 2026, the authorized Management Committee of Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd approved a proposal for the sale of NPA and written-off loans to an Asset Reconstruction Company (ARC). This sale includes two portfolios of Unsecured Stressed MFI Loans. Pool 1 has an Aggregate Principal Outstanding as of December 31, 2025, of approximately ₹1,016.24 crore, with a Reserve Price/Binding Offer of ₹133.10 crore, to be settled in Cash + Security Receipts. The bank will separately intimate upon completion of the deal.

announcements.subject: Sadbhav Engineering Ltd - 532710 - Please Find Enclosed Announcement For Signing Of Master Restructuring Agreement By Sadbhav Engineering Limited With Majority Consortium Lenders.
announcements.detail: Please find enclosed announcement for signing of Master Restructuring Agreement by Sadbhav Engineering Limited with majority consortium lenders.
announcements.ai_summary: Sadbhav Engineering Limited announced on March 26, 2026, that it has signed a Master Restructuring Agreement (MRA) with a majority of its consortium lenders. This agreement, executed on March 25, 2026, involves IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited as the security trustee and debenture trustee, along with lenders including Punjab National Bank, Union Bank of India, Axis Bank Limited, Assets Enterprise Limited, Bank of India, and Yes Bank Limited. The MRA formally records the terms of the debt restructuring plan, prepared in accordance with the Reserve Bank of India's stressed assets restructuring framework. The debt being restructured aggregates to ₹1,516.71 Crores, comprising ₹906.35 Crore in fund-based exposure and ₹610.36 Crore in non-fund based limits, with the fund-based exposure to be restructured as convertible debentures. A significant term of the MRA is that the lenders have the right to appoint nominee directors.

announcements.subject: Cipla Ltd - 500087 - General Updates
announcements.detail: Mr Pradeep Bhadauria, Global Chief Scientific Officer has resigned to pursue interests outside Cipla and his last working day will be 31st March, 2026.

announcements.subject: Arihant Foundations & Housing Ltd-$ - 531381 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: Press Release titled "Prestige Group and Arihant Group jointly acquire prime land parcel in Padi, Chennai, adding GDV of INR 5,000 crores".
announcements.ai_summary: Arihant Foundations & Housing Ltd, as part of a joint venture with Prestige Group, has acquired a prime 16.331-acre land parcel in Padi, Chennai, on March 26, 2026. The acquisition, undertaken through Canopy Living LLP, a joint venture between Prestige Estates Projects Limited and Arihant Foundations and Housing Ltd, is projected to have a Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹5,000 crore. The land will be developed into a premium residential project with an estimated saleable area of 3.6 million square feet. The project's strategic location near Anna Nagar is expected to capitalize on the consistent growth in Chennai's residential market.

announcements.subject: AIA Engineering Ltd - 532683 - Announcement Under Regulation 30 - Update (Clarification)
announcements.detail: Clarification under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: AIA Engineering Limited has issued a clarification under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, to address apprehensions regarding the shortage of commercial LPG impacting its production. The company uses PNG as its primary fuel source, with LPG used in a very limited capacity in its heat treatment processes. AIA Engineering Limited confirms that there is no disruption in the availability of either PNG or LPG at its facilities, and all plants are operating normally. Furthermore, the company is in the process of modifying its fuel system to also utilize Light Diesel Oil (LDO) in addition to PNG and LPG.

announcements.subject: Archean Chemical Industries Ltd - 543657 - Intimation Of Agreement

announcements.subject: Bharat Dynamics Ltd - 541143 - General Updates On Advanced  Akash Weapon Systems
announcements.detail: General updates on Advanced Akash Weapon Systems

announcements.subject: Modi Naturals Ltd - 519003 - Commencement Of Commercial Operations At Expanded Ethanol Plant Of Subsidiary Company

announcements.ai_summary: Modi Naturals Ltd has announced the commencement of commercial operations at the expanded ethanol plant of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Modi Biotech Private Limited, located in Chhattisgarh. The plant's installed capacity has been significantly increased from 130 KLPD to 282 KLPD. This expansion aligns with the company's strategy to strengthen its presence in the ethanol segment and support the Government of India's Ethanol Blended Petrol (EBP) Programme. The increased capacity is expected to enhance operational efficiencies and boost production volumes.

announcements.subject: RACL Geartech Ltd - 520073 - General Update
announcements.detail:
The Company wishes to inform that there have been intermittent constraints in the availability of LPG/PNG/CNG for Industrial usage. 


Kindly take above information on record and oblige.
announcements.ai_summary: On March 25, 2026, RACL Geartech Ltd informed stakeholders about intermittent constraints in the availability of LPG, PNG, and CNG for industrial usage, which are essential inputs for its manufacturing processes and those of its sub-suppliers. These constraints have led to limited operational disruptions during the current month. The company is coordinating with suppliers and has implemented alternate production planning and contingency measures to mitigate the impact. While these temporary constraints may have a limited effect on production schedules for the month, the company expects operations to align as supplies stabilize. The company continues to monitor the situation, noting that demand remains robust.

announcements.subject: Power Mech Projects Ltd - 539302 - Intimation Regarding Annulment Of Tender And Cancellation Of Letter Of Award Issued To PM Green Private Limited (One Of The Wholly Owned Subsidiaries Of The Company).
announcements.detail: Please find the attached
announcements.ai_summary: On March 25, 2026, Power Mech Projects Ltd announced the annulment of a tender and the cancellation of a Letter of Award (LoA) previously issued to its wholly owned subsidiary, PM Green Private Limited. The annulment was initiated by West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (WBSEDCL) for a 250 MW/1000 MWh Standalone Battery Energy Storage System project. The reason cited for the annulment was administrative and procedural exigencies beyond the control of either party, and not due to any default by the subsidiary. Consequently, the Bid Security and Performance Bank Guarantee submitted by PM Green Private Limited have been released in full. This cancellation will reduce the company's order book value by Rs. 1,563 crores.

announcements.subject: Global Health Ltd - 543654 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

announcements.ai_summary: Global Health Limited (GHL) has issued a press release dated March 25, 2026, titled "Medanta to set up a 400 bed hospital in the centre of Varanasi, further strengthening its Uttar Pradesh footprint." This announcement was considered and approved by the Board of Directors of Global Health Limited at their meeting held on March 25, 2026. The press release details the company's expansion plans in Uttar Pradesh. The Board also noted the incorporation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Global Health Institute of Medical Sciences Foundation, a Section 8 Company, on March 30, 2024, for educational and healthcare management training.

announcements.subject: Cochin Shipyard Ltd - 540678 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Joint Venture
announcements.detail: Please refer attachment
announcements.ai_summary: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) has executed a Joint Venture Agreement with HBL Engineering Limited (HBL) on March 25, 2026. This agreement formalizes the formation of a Joint Venture Company aimed at developing electric mobility technology and energy storage solutions in the maritime space. This follows the Board of Directors' approval for this proposal on January 28, 2026. The company has submitted the requisite details as per Regulation 30 read with Para B of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI LODR Regulations and the relevant SEBI Master Circular. This JV represents a strategic step towards innovation in the maritime sector.

announcements.subject: Bharat Dynamics Ltd - 541143 - General Updates
announcements.detail: General updates on Additional manufacturing facilities
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Dynamics Ltd (BDL) has provided general updates on its expansion plans, specifically regarding the establishment of two additional manufacturing facilities. These facilities are being set up at Ibrahimpatnam, Hyderabad, Telangana, and Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, to meet the current scenario and requirements of the Indian armed forces. The inauguration of these facilities is scheduled to take place shortly, with production commencement expected during the financial year 2026-27. These new facilities are intended to help BDL meet additional requirements, expand capacity, enhance operational efficiency, and diversify its product profile. The facility at Ibrahimpatnam will include eight assembly lines.

announcements.subject: Markolines Pavement Technologies Ltd - 543364 - Clarification Regarding Share Exchange Ratio Mentioned In Outcome Of Board Meeting Dated 6Th March 2026
announcements.detail: The correct share exchange ratio approved by the Board in its meeting held on 6th March, 2026 and as per the latest valuation report is: 1:1.05 i.e. for every one existing equity share of Markolines Infra Limited, shareholder will receive 1.05 equity shares of Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Ltd has issued a clarification regarding the share exchange ratio approved in its Board Meeting held on March 6, 2026. The correct share exchange ratio for the Scheme of Amalgamation of Markolines Infra Limited with Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited is 1:1.05. This means that for every one existing equity share of Markolines Infra Limited, shareholders will receive 1.05 equity shares of Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited. The company stated that the previously mentioned ratio of 1:1.15 was due to an inadvertent clerical error. This corrected ratio is based on the latest valuation report and has been submitted to the stock exchanges for their records.

announcements.subject: SKF India Ltd - 500472 - Intimation Regarding Change In Name Of Promoter Entity.
announcements.detail: The company informs the BSE that the name of the promoter entity of the company has been changed from ''SKF Interim AB'' to ''SKF Vertevo AB''.
announcements.ai_summary: SKF India Ltd has announced a change in the name of its promoter entity from 'SKF Interim AB' to 'SKF Vertevo AB', effective March 25, 2026. This name change is part of a broader global rebranding initiative resulting from the demerger of the company's Automotive and Industrial businesses. The company has clarified that this modification is solely a name change and does not involve any alteration in shareholding or the promoter's status. SKF India Ltd is in the process of updating the new name with relevant regulatory authorities. While not considered material information under SEBI LODR Regulations, the disclosure is made voluntarily as a matter of good corporate governance.

announcements.subject: DSM Fresh Foods Ltd - 544568 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
announcements.detail: DSM Fresh Foods Limited signed MoU with a farm operator in Ghaziabad as a part of its strategy to strengthen backward intigration
announcements.ai_summary: DSM Fresh Foods Limited has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with a farm operator located in Ghaziabad on March 25, 2026. This agreement is a strategic move by the company to strengthen its backward integration and build a more reliable sourcing ecosystem for its operations. The partnership will involve approximately 50 acres of aquaculture farms in Village Masurie, Ghaziabad, and aims to enhance the quality, traceability, and consistency of its fish supply. This initiative is part of DSM Fresh Foods' strategy to meet the growing demand for safe and hygienic food products and build a transparent farm-to-fork supply chain. The company has submitted a press release detailing this development to the stock exchanges for their record.

announcements.detail: Intimation of receipt of Waiver approval from BSE pertaining to Reg 17(1A) of the SEBI (LODR) Regylation 2015.

This waiver pertains to Regulation 17(1A) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. announcements.subject: Ravindra Energy Ltd - 504341 - Ravindra Energy Limited Has Informed The Exchange About General Business Update Regarding Its Associate Entity - Energy In Motion Limited
announcements.detail: We would like to inform our stakeholders about General Business Update regarding REL''s associate entity Energy In Motion Limited.
announcements.ai_summary: Ravindra Energy Limited's associate entity, Energy In Motion Limited (EIM), has partnered with Transvolt Mobility Private Limited (Transvolt) for the deployment of 66 electric heavy vehicles. EIM will supply its Foton 55-ton e-tractor "Ashwa," which is a battery-swappable heavy electric vehicle. In addition to vehicle supply, EIM will provide swappable battery and charging services to Transvolt for these vehicles. The full supply of these 66 vehicles is expected to be completed in March and April 2026. Transvolt will deploy these vehicles at Kandla Port in Gujarat and Jawaharlal Nehru Port in Mumbai for the intra-port movement of containerized goods. This deployment is anticipated to reduce CO2 emissions by approximately 3300 tons annually and aligns with the objective of achieving 100% zero-emission transport at port terminals.

announcements.subject: Dc Infotech and Communication Ltd - 543636 - Media Release For Extending Agreement With Tata Communications Limited For Three Years
announcements.detail: Media Release for Extending Agreement with Tata Communication Limited for three years
announcements.ai_summary: DC Infotech and Communication Limited announced on March 25, 2026, the extension of its Procurement Agreement (Reseller) with Tata Communications Limited for a period of three years. The renewed agreement will be effective from March 05, 2026, through March 04, 2029. This extension ensures the continuity of the strategic relationship between the two companies, reinforcing DC Infotech's commitment to delivering advanced technology solutions. DC Infotech is a provider of IT, networking, and digital infrastructure solutions, while Tata Communications is a global digital infrastructure provider.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 20, 2026, titled "Ichnos Glenmark Innovation (IGI) Announces New Development Candidate, ISB 2301, a First-in-Class Multispecific Immune Cells Activator Targeting Solid Tumors".
announcements.ai_summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited, through its subsidiary Ichnos Glenmark Innovation, Inc. (IGI), announced a new development candidate, ISB 2301, on May 20, 2026. ISB 2301 is a first-in-class, multispecific immune cells (T and NK) activator, designed for the potential treatment of multiple solid tumor indications. This next-generation multispecific antibody targets three tumor-associated antigens (TAAs) to trigger tumor cell death and engages both T cells and NK cells to ignite the immune system. The development of ISB 2301 was enabled by IGI’s clinically validated BEAT® platform. IGI intends to submit an Investigational New Drug (IND) application for ISB 2301 this year, rapidly advancing it toward the clinic.

announcements.subject: Commencement of commercial production/operations
announcements.detail: Balaji Amines Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of Commissioning of Commercial Production of New Dimethyl Ether (DME) Plant and Press Release.
announcements.ai_summary: Balaji Amines Limited has commenced commercial production of Dimethyl Ether (DME) at its Unit-IV facility in Solapur, Maharashtra, effective May 20, 2026. This new plant has an annual production capacity of 1,00,000 TPA and utilizes advanced technology. DME is a new-age gas that serves as an alternative to LPG for fuel and aerosol applications, and Balaji Amines is the first company in India to manufacture it commercially. The company sourced its basic engineering technology for DME from a foreign entity. This expansion is seen as a significant step towards India's energy self-reliance, with the potential to be blended with LPG up to 8% as per a new IS Code published by BIS. Public sector Oil Marketing Companies are encouraged to adopt DME blending initiatives.

announcements.subject: Updates

The observations are procedural and relate to achieving compliance with GMP guidelines under Directive (EU) 2017/1572. The impact on existing business is expected to be minimal, though there may be a delay in the commercialization of the EU-CDMO product pipeline. Eris Lifesciences is committed to maintaining high manufacturing standards and will provide further updates.

A key outcome was the unveiling of HCL's Corporate Plan – Vision 2030, which has undergone a comprehensive review by Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP (DTTILLP). announcements.ai_summary: Praj Industries Limited has announced the launch of an Advanced Precision Fermentation Lab at Praj Matrix on April 20, 2026. This initiative aims to drive next-generation biotechnology and accelerate India's transition to low-carbon biomanufacturing, aligning with the Government of India's BioE3 vision. The lab, described as one of a kind globally, will focus on high-capacity, AI-enabled precision fermentation and next-generation bioprocesses to improve efficiency and reduce scale-up risks. This will enable Praj and its subsidiary, Praj HiPurity Systems, to deliver advanced fermentation solutions to the pharmaceutical, food, cosmetics, biofuels, and beverage sectors. The facility will integrate discovery, process development, and high-purity manufacturing.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: E2E Networks Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.ai_summary: E2E Networks Limited received an order dated May 14, 2026, from the Office of Collector of Stamps, Government of NCT of Delhi, concerning the adjudication of stamp duty for certain dematerialized share issuances. The order determined a stamp duty liability of Rs. 1,27,92,189/- along with a penalty of Rs. 1,25,00,000/-, aggregating to Rs. 2,52,92,189/-. This issue arose from a circular issued in 2025 by the Additional District Magistrate, Collector of Stamps, disputing the applicable stamp duty rate for dematerialized shares under the Indian Stamp Act, 1899, as amended by the Finance Act, 2019. The company had previously paid stamp duty in accordance with Section 9A (1) read with Article 56A of Schedule I of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899. E2E Networks Limited has already filed a writ petition before the Hon’ble High Court of Delhi regarding this matter, and the proceedings are currently under judicial consideration.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Amagi Media Labs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 19, 2026, titled "Amagi Managed Services Modernizes Broadcasting Operations for AccuWeather®".
announcements.ai_summary: Amagi Media Labs Limited has announced a significant modernization of AccuWeather's broadcasting operations through an expanded engagement. AccuWeather is transitioning from traditional satellite and hardware infrastructure to a unified, cloud-based, internet-driven system managed by Amagi. This new system will handle both linear TV and streaming workflows in a single platform, enhancing efficiency, flexibility, and scalability across various platforms. The transformation, centered at Amagi's Master Control Room (MCR) in Princeton, N.J., integrates AccuWeather's technology stack and managed operations under Amagi's purview. This move aims to provide AccuWeather with enhanced agility and faster channel customization. Amagi's role extends beyond providing cloud playout technology to actively operating, monitoring, and optimizing critical broadcast environments. The entire solution is built on Amagi's tech stack and managed services, ensuring seamless and rapid customizations.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Bharat Gears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'. We refer to our letter dated January 23, 2026 wherein, pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (the Regulations), we informed you that at the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held on January 23, 2026, the Board considered the legal opinion and opined that the power to determine the citizenship status of Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company vests exclusively with the Central Government and, accordingly, concluded that until any direction or order is issued by the Central Government in respect of his citizenship status, the citizenship status of Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company, continues to remain unchanged and he shall be regarded as a citizen of India. Thus, he shall continue to discharge his responsibilities as Chairman and Managing Director.This is to further inform you that the Board members have received an intimation from Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company vide his e-mail dated April 16, 2026 that he has received a communication from the Regional Passport Office regarding the revocation of his passport, with a right of appeal to the Central Passport Office. Acting on legal advice, he has promptly filed an appeal on April 15, 2026 before the competent authority at the Central Passport Office, seeking (i) a stay of the revocation during the pendency of the appeal and (ii) quashing of the revocation order.Mr. Kanwar has further clarified that as he concludes that the Central Passport Office is the authority empowered to adjudicate the revocation, he has immediately informed the Board at this substantive juncture i.e., upon filing the appeal.Mr. Kanwar has reiterated that the determination of his citizenship status lies exclusively with the Central Government (Ministry of Home Affairs) and the Board of Directors of the Company duly noted this position at its meeting held on January 23, 2026, after considering the independent legal opinion. Separately, he has also written to the Secretaries of the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of External Affairs vide his letter dated March 30, 2026 (through Speed Post on April 04, 2026), seeking clarification on his citizenship status, to which reply is still awaited.Mr. Kanwar has also assured that he remains fully mindful of his fiduciary duties and will continue to keep the Board promptly informed of any material developments and advised that the statutory authorities be informed accordingly in a fair and transparent manner.The Company will keep you informed of any material developments in this matter, as and when required, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.You are requested to kindly take the same on record.
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Bharat Gears Limited provided an update regarding the citizenship status of its Chairman and Managing Director, Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar. Following a communication from the Regional Passport Office regarding the revocation of his passport, Mr. Kanwar filed an appeal on April 15, 2026, seeking a stay and quashing of the revocation order. He has reiterated that the determination of his citizenship status rests exclusively with the Central Government. Mr. Kanwar has also written to the Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of External Affairs for clarification, with a reply still awaited. He assured the board of his continued commitment to his fiduciary duties and will keep them informed of material developments.

This initiative will lay the foundation for a dedicated "IIT Dharwad – Aequs Research and Development Center" to accelerate applied research and bridge the gap between laboratory science and industrial application. Desai, Director of IIT-D, highlighted the importance of strengthening industry-aligned research and providing students with real-world exposure.

announcements.ai_summary: Greaves Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange about a press release issued by its subsidiary, Greaves Electric Mobility Limited (GEML). GEML's e-scooter, the Ampere Magnus G Max, has won the 'Family Scooter of the Year' award at the Times Drive Auto Summit and Awards 2026. This recognition highlights GEML's Ampere brand's growing position in the Indian electric mobility market, driven by its focus on dependable, family-oriented electric scooters. The Ampere Magnus G Max, launched in January 2026, offers a certified range of 142 kms, LFP battery technology, and 33L boot space. Vikas Singh, Managing Director of Greaves Electric Mobility, stated that the award reinforces their commitment to providing practical, safe, and durable electric mobility solutions for Indian families at an affordable price point.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Lupin Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 15, 2026, titled "Lupin Inaugurates Atharv Ability, an Advanced Multidisciplinary Neuro-Rehabilitation Center in Delhi".
announcements.ai_summary: Lupin Limited has announced the inauguration of "Atharv Ability," its advanced multidisciplinary neuro-rehabilitation center in Naraina Vihar, Delhi. This facility aims to provide comprehensive, outcome-driven, and specialized care for adults and children with neurological disabilities, enhancing mobility and supporting long-term recovery. Atharv Ability combines clinical expertise, technological precision, and personalized care programs to address critical treatment gaps for conditions such as stroke, traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injury, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis, and pediatric neurological disorders. This expansion follows the successful launch of similar centers in Mumbai in 2023 and Hyderabad in 2024, aiming to increase access to integrated neuro-rehabilitation care in North India. Rajeev Sibal, President - India Region Formulations, Lupin, emphasized the belief that high-quality neuro-rehabilitation should be accessible and affordable across India.

announcements.subject: Press Release

announcements.ai_summary: LTM Limited has announced its win of the Golden Peacock Award for Excellence in Artificial Intelligence (GPAEAI) 2026, conferred by the Institute of Directors (IoD), India. This award recognizes LTM's leadership in enterprise-scale, responsible, and impact-driven AI adoption. The 'Excellence in AI' category, introduced in 2026, benchmarks strategic alignment, resource optimization, and operational reliability for AI initiatives. LTM was selected from over 511 applications after a rigorous three-tier assessment, with the jury chaired by Hon’ble Justice Uday U. Lalit, Former Chief Justice of India. The award acknowledges LTM's AI framework, anchored in its enterprise AI ecosystem, BlueVerse™, which enables large-scale AI deployment. Krishnan Iyer, Chief Growth Officer, stated that this recognition validates their BlueVerse-led approach focused on governance, ethics, and client-centric outcomes.

The company, formerly known as Tembo Defence Products Private Limited, is now positioned to commence commercial production as per its schedule. This development aligns with India's 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' and 'Make in India' initiatives, aiming to boost self-reliance in defence manufacturing. The Managing Director, Mr. Sanjay J. Patel, highlighted this as a landmark achievement that strengthens the company's commitment to supporting national self-reliance and creating opportunities in both domestic and global defence markets.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: GAIL (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 15, 2026, titled ""GAIL to invest Rs. 3800 crore in 700 MW Solar Power Projects in UP and Maharashtra"".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: GAIL (India) Limited has approved the establishment of 700 MW of solar power projects with an investment of Rs 3800 crore in Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra. The project in Uttar Pradesh includes a 600 MW Solar Power Project and a 550 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) at TUSCO Solar Park Jhansi, primarily for the captive energy needs of GAIL’s Petrochemical Plant at Pata. Additionally, a 100 MW Solar Power Project with a 22 MWh BESS will be set up in Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar district, Maharashtra, to serve the captive requirements of GAIL’s PDH-PP Plant at Usar. These projects, announced on April 14, 2026, are crucial for GAIL's Net Zero targets and India's energy transition goals, with the BESS ensuring efficient solar power utilization. Upon commissioning, GAIL's renewable energy capacity will increase to over 1,000 MW from the current 147 MW.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 14, 2026, titled "Receipt of final approval by our subsidiary, Caplin Steriles Limited, from the USFDA for Foscarnet Sodium Injection.".
announcements.ai_summary: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited announced on May 14, 2026, that its subsidiary, Caplin Steriles Limited (CSL), received final approval from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA). This approval is for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) for Foscarnet Sodium Injection (6000 mg/250 mL Infusion Bag). This product is a generic therapeutic equivalent of the Reference Listed Drug (RLD) Foscavir Injection, manufactured by Clinigen Healthcare Ltd. Foscarnet Sodium Injection is an antiviral medication used to treat CMV retinitis in AIDS patients and HSV infection in immunocompromised individuals. According to IQVIA™, the US sales for Foscarnet Sodium Injection (6000 mg/250 mL Infusion Bag) were approximately $15 million for the 12-month period ending March 2026. Caplin Steriles Limited has now developed and filed 54 ANDAs in the USA, securing 55 approvals to date.

".
announcements.ai_summary: Network People Services Technologies Limited (NPST) has secured three new orders from cooperative banks for its Bank-in-a-Box platform, as announced on May 14, 2026. One bank will implement NPST's acquiring switch along with Qynx, while the other two will deploy Qynx only. Qynx is NPST's offline acquiring platform designed to manage the full spectrum of offline merchant payment acceptance, including QR and Soundbox processing, device logistics, and field support. This move is expected to enhance NPST's recurring revenue pipeline and support long-term growth by providing cooperative banks with modern digital banking and payments infrastructure. The Bank-in-a-Box platform is a SaaS-based solution covering UPI, IMPS, Banking Connect, merchant acceptance, fraud monitoring, and an omnichannel SuperApp.

announcements.ai_summary: Indoco Remedies Limited has announced that its manufacturing facility for solid oral dosage forms, located at Baddi (Unit I), successfully cleared an audit by the Malta Medicines Authority. The inspection took place from January 29, 2026, to February 3, 2026. Following the audit, the facility has received EU GMP certification, confirming its compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice requirements as stipulated by the EC Directive. This certification underscores Indoco Remedies' commitment to quality and adherence to global regulatory standards. announcements.company: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited
announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited has informed the Exchange about GKSL scales up Renal Care: 100 units AI-Powered Haemodialysis Machines to be inducted across network. First 8 machines to go live at Gujarat Multi Speciality Hospital, Godhra, Gujarat, within 10 days following completion of all required inspections
announcements.ai_summary: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited (GKSL) has announced a significant expansion in its renal care services by procuring 100 AI-powered Haemodialysis machines. The first phase of deployment will see 8 of these machines operational at its Gujarat Multi Speciality Hospital in Godhra, Gujarat, within 10 days, following the completion of all required inspections. These AI-enabled machines offer advanced features such as real-time data analysis for fluid balance, blood pressure trends, and ultrafiltration response, enabling safer and more personalized patient treatment. The remaining 92 machines will be progressively deployed across GKSL's network of dialysis centers in Gujarat, aiming to substantially scale up access to high-quality, technology-enabled renal care. This initiative aligns with the company's strategic objective to expand dialysis capacity and enhance patient care across its facilities.

announcements.ai_summary: GK Energy Limited announced strong financial performance for FY2025–26 through a press release dated May 13, 2026, titled "GK Energy Delivers 40% Revenue & 51% PAT Growth in FY26 Through Asset-Light Renewable Energy Model". The company reported revenue from operations of ₹1,532.54 crore, a 40% year-on-year increase, and Profit After Tax grew by 51.1% to ₹201.27 crore. EBITDA stood at ₹313.18 crore with EBITDA margins at 20.44%. During the year, GK Energy deployed 61,085 decentralized renewable energy systems and commissioned 276 MW of capacity, bringing the cumulative installed systems to over 140,000 and commissioned capacity to over 617 MW. The company also improved its balance sheet with a surplus cash position of ₹240.61 crore as of March 31, 2026.
