announcements.detail: VA Tech Wabag Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 13, 2026, titled "WABAG and PEAK Announce First Bio-CNG Project in Ghaziabad".
announcements.ai_summary: VA Tech Wabag Limited (WABAG) and PEAK Sustainability Ventures (PEAK) announced on May 13, 2026, the development of their first Bio-CNG plant in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. This project is a key milestone under their waste-to-energy initiative, which was initially announced on January 29, 2024, with a shared vision to establish 100 Bio-CNG plants at sewage treatment facilities across India and other markets. The Ghaziabad plant will be developed at the 70 MLD Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) in Dundaheda under a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model on a Public-Private Partnership basis. The project will be executed through a newly incorporated special purpose vehicle named GHAZIABAD BIOENERGY PRIVATE LIMITED, jointly formed by WABAG and PEAK.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Intellect Design Arena Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 12, 2026, titled "37 Canadian Financial Institutions, part of NDBWG, select Intellect toDrive Digital Banking Transformation".
announcements.ai_summary: Intellect Design Arena Limited has announced a significant deal where 37 Canadian financial institutions, part of the National Digital Banking Working Group (NDBWG), have selected Intellect to transform their digital banking services. This partnership will impact over 262,000 members across 5 provinces and involves institutions managing over $11.7 billion CAD in assets. Intellect's eMACH.ai Digital Engagement Platform (DEP) will be provided to these institutions to enhance member management, ensure KYC and AML compliance, and deliver a modern digital banking experience. This initiative is considered one of the most substantial collaborative digital transformation efforts within Canada's financial sector. The NDBWG selected Intellect after an exclusive negotiation period, with 37 out of 59 participating institutions having formally signed on, and others still progressing.

announcements.detail: Creative Newtech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Order secured by Creative Newtech Limited from the Food Corporation of India (FCI), valued at Rs. 35.89 crore, for the FCI Smart Warehousing Project across 150 depots.'.
announcements.ai_summary: Creative Newtech Limited has secured a significant order valued at Rs. 35.89 crore from the Food Corporation of India (FCI) for the FCI Smart Warehousing Project. This project will be implemented across 150 depots nationwide and is part of the government's initiative to modernize India's food storage infrastructure using IoT-based systems and intelligent monitoring. The scope of work includes deploying sensor modules, bag counting systems, boom barriers, gateway infrastructure, software platforms, surveillance, AI, and intelligent monitoring systems. The project will be executed in two phases, with final commissioning within 180 days, followed by three years of Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) support. Creative Newtech Limited will leverage its government domain experience, financial strength, and deployment capabilities for this project.

This represents a 1% decrease year-on-year compared to April 2025's production of 21.40 Lakh tonnes. The production figures for Indian Operations were 20.40 Lakh tonnes, down 1% from 20.56 Lakh tonnes in April 2025, and JSW Steel USA – Ohio produced 0.78 Lakh tonnes, a 7% decrease from 0.84 Lakh tonnes. The company noted that Blast Furnace 3 at Vijayanagar was under shutdown for capacity upgradation, impacting crude steel production. Wagner, highlighted TCS's reach and execution capabilities in accelerating enterprise adoption. Shekar Krishnan, Head of Retail, UK and Europe at TCS, emphasized the combination of TCS's transformation capabilities with Rezolve Ai's specialized AI platform to deliver measurable business outcomes.

announcements.subject: General Updates

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Cartrade Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 11, 2026, titled "CarTrade Tech Delivers 50%+ YoY EBITDA Growth in Each of the Last 12 Consecutive Quarters".
announcements.ai_summary: CarTrade Tech Limited announced on May 11, 2026, that it has achieved over 50% year-on-year EBITDA growth for 12 consecutive quarters. During this period, the company has also expanded its EBITDA margins significantly, from approximately 3% to 35%. This sustained growth is attributed to the company's strong brand, network effects, unique technology, business model, operating discipline, and product-led execution. Over the last three years, CarTrade Tech has demonstrated consistent profitable growth, with a Revenue CAGR of 29%, EBITDA CAGR of 98%, and PAT CAGR of 82%, while continuing to invest in AI, product, and technology capabilities.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Inventure Growth & Securities Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.'.
announcements.ai_summary: Inventure Growth & Securities Limited disclosed on May 11, 2026, that the Hon’ble Bombay High Court has appointed a Sole Arbitrator in disputes stemming from an Agreement for Sale of Shares dated August 13, 2014. The company, through its Chairman & Managing Director Kanji B. Rita, contested its impleadment in the arbitration, asserting it was not a signatory to the arbitration agreement. The High Court observed that the Arbitral Tribunal would decide whether the company is bound by the agreement. Crucially, the court passed no findings against Inventure Growth & Securities Limited, keeping all rights and contentions of the parties open for future proceedings. This update follows a previous announcement made on April 10, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 11, 2026, titled ""Afcons forays in Europe"".
announcements.ai_summary: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has been selected as the most suitable bidder for the rehabilitation and construction of a railway line in Croatia, marking its foray into Europe. This project follows the company being declared the Lowest Bidder (L1) on July 21, 2025, for the reconstruction of an existing track and construction of a second track on the Dugo Selo – Novska railway line, including overhead electrification and signalling & telecommunication works. This will be Afcons' largest international order to date, underscoring its commitment to global infrastructure development. The project involves the reconstruction of the existing track and the construction of a second track railway line.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Ather Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'press release titled  Rizta crosses 3 Lakh unit milestone driving accelerated growth for Ather".
announcements.ai_summary: Ather Energy Limited announced that its family scooter, the Rizta, has crossed the 3 lakh unit sales milestone within two years of its launch. The Rizta, introduced in April 2024, has become the company's largest volume driver, contributing 76% of Ather's total sales volumes in FY26. The scooter reached the 1 lakh unit sales mark within 11 months and crossed 3 lakh units in the subsequent 11 months, indicating strong consumer demand. Ather Energy has seen significant market share growth in Southern India, becoming a leader in the region, and has also expanded its market share in 'middle India' by 4X since the Rizta's launch. In Northern states, market share has grown over 3X. Approximately 70% of Rizta customers are families with children, highlighting its appeal for everyday family usage.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Cyient Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 11, 2026, titled "Cyient Semiconductors Launches India s First GaN Power IC Family Leveraging Navitas Technology".
announcements.ai_summary: Cyient Limited announced on May 11, 2026, the launch of its first commercial GaN power product family through Cyient Semiconductors Private Limited, leveraging Navitas Semiconductor's technology. This launch introduces seven new gallium nitride (GaN) power ICs with a 650V rating, targeting emerging applications in Edge AI Computing and E-Mobility. The partnership with Navitas Semiconductor, established in December 2025, allows Indian customers access to GaN power solutions with enhanced local support and supply assurance. Cyient Semiconductors will also serve as a second source for select Navitas GaN devices, strengthening supply chain resilience. These GaN power semiconductors offer higher switching speeds and lower losses compared to traditional silicon devices, enabling smaller, more efficient power solutions for AI data centers, telecommunications, consumer fast charging, industrial power systems, and e-mobility charging platforms. Cyient Semiconductors plans to expand its GaN portfolio through partnerships with local OSATs.

announcements.subject: Incorporation
announcements.detail: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Incorporation of Adani Mangaluru Airport City Limited, Adani Jaipur Airport City Limited , Adani Lucknow Airport City Limited and Adani TRV Airport City Limited by Adani Airport City Limited, a step down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Adani Enterprises Limited has announced the incorporation of four new step-down wholly owned subsidiaries by its step-down wholly owned subsidiary, Adani Airport City Limited. The newly incorporated entities are Adani Mangaluru Airport City Limited ("AMACL"), Adani Jaipur Airport City Limited ("AJACL"), Adani Lucknow Airport City Limited ("ALACL"), and Adani TRV Airport City Limited ("ATACL"). AMACL and AJACL were incorporated on April 8, 2026, while ALACL and ATACL were incorporated on April 9, 2026, all in India. These entities will be engaged in real estate activities, including owning or leasing property, construction of buildings, and potentially operating hotels and resorts. Adani Enterprises Limited received this information on April 11, 2026, at 03:20 PM IST. This announcement is made in accordance with SEBI Listing Regulations and a SEBI Circular dated January 30, 2026.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
announcements.ai_summary: Piramal Pharma Limited has disclosed that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) conducted a Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) inspection of its Sellersville, USA facility from May 4, 2026, to May 8, 2026. Following the inspection, the US FDA issued a Form-483 with three observations, which were recommended to be classified under Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) by the inspectors. Importantly, none of the observations relate to data integrity. Piramal Pharma Limited is preparing a comprehensive response to these observations, which will be submitted to the US FDA within the stipulated timelines. The company is committed to maintaining high compliance standards and will work closely with the agency to address all observations.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Paisalo Digital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 10, 2026, titled "AUM up 17% YoY to Rs 61,009 Mn, PAT surges 56% YoY to Rs 722 Mn".
announcements.ai_summary: Paisalo Digital Limited has issued a press release on May 10, 2026, highlighting strong financial performance for the quarter and full year ended March 31, 2026. The company's Assets Under Management (AUM) grew by 17% year-on-year to Rs 61,009 Million, while Profit After Tax (PAT) surged by 56% year-on-year to Rs 722 Million. Total income for the quarter increased by 35% year-on-year to Rs 2,609 Million, and for the full year, it grew by 22% year-on-year to Rs 9,437 Million. The company also reported a decrease in Gross Non-Performing Assets (GNPA) by 23 basis points year-on-year to 0.76%. Paisalo Digital expanded its network to 5,299 touchpoints, adding 427 new touchpoints in the quarter, and increased its branch network from 402 to 422. The customer franchise grew to approximately 16 million.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Coal India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 10, 2026, titled "CIL Press release on CIL insulates Indian coal users from increasing input costs.".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Coal India Limited (CIL) has issued a press release on April 10, 2026, stating that it is absorbing increased operational costs to insulate Indian coal users from rising prices. Despite a 44 percent increase in Ammonium Nitrate (AN) prices from Rs. 50,500 per metric ton to Rs. 72,750 per metric ton as of April 1, 2026, and a 26% rise in the average cost of explosives from Rs. 39,588 per metric ton in February 2026 to Rs. 49,783 per metric ton by March end, CIL is not passing these costs on. CIL consumes approximately 9 Lakh metric tons of explosives annually. The company is also compensating contractors for increased industrial diesel prices.

announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited announced its operational update for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, with pre-sales reaching INR 1,701 crore, exceeding the FY26 guidance and marking the highest ever annual collections. The company achieved sales area of 6,60,246 sq. ft, up 11% YoY, and collections of INR 1,103 crore, up 71% YoY. Ajmera Realty launched four projects in FY26, aggregating an estimated GDV of INR 3,088 crore, with strong buyer interest in its flagship developments. This announcement was made on April 10, 2026.

announcements.subject: Product launch
announcements.detail: Park Medi World Limited has informed the Exchange about launch of Hospital in Panchkula
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Park Medi World Limited has announced the successful launch of its new multi-super specialty hospital in Panchkula on April 10, 2026. This expansion aims to address the growing demand for advanced healthcare services in Haryana, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, and Chandigarh, reducing the need for patients to travel to metropolitan areas for specialized treatments. The new facility is equipped with advanced diagnostics, modular operation theatres, and critical care infrastructure, offering comprehensive care across specialties like oncology, neurosciences, orthopedics, and cardiology, including robotic-assisted procedures. The hospital is designed with a significant proportion of beds dedicated to high-acuity critical care services. This launch, combined with the ongoing expansion of its Mohali facility, will bring the Group's total bed capacity in the Tricity region to approximately 850 beds, strengthening its integrated healthcare ecosystem in North India.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Datamatics Global Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 09, 2026, titled "Datamatics Launches TruAI Underwriting to Transform Insurance Underwriting with Agentic AI.".
announcements.ai_summary: Datamatics Global Services Limited has issued a press release on April 09, 2026, announcing the launch of "TruAI Underwriting." This new solution is an Agentic AI-based platform designed to significantly enhance and streamline the insurance underwriting process. TruAI Underwriting aims to assist insurers in assessing financial and medical risks with greater speed, consistency, and accuracy, particularly for complex, data-intensive cases. The solution ingests and analyzes data from various structured and unstructured sources, extracts relevant parameters, identifies risk indicators, and provides contextual recommendations to underwriters. It is designed to reduce underwriting turnaround time by up to 70%, lower costs by up to 50%, and improve accuracy by up to 25%. The final underwriting decision remains with the human underwriter, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

announcements.subject: Acquisition

This acquisition is a strategic move to comply with the Electricity Rules 2005, which require a minimum 26% shareholding to qualify as a captive user for power supply from Neon's captive power plant in Punjab. Neon Hybren Private Limited is a step-down subsidiary of Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, being a subsidiary of Mahindra Susten Private Limited, which is in turn a subsidiary of Mahindra Holdings Limited. The Share Subscription and Shareholders Agreement (SSSHA) has been executed with Neon and MSPL. Upon completion, MSPL's shareholding in Neon will reduce from 100% to 74%, but Neon will continue to be a step-down subsidiary of Mahindra & Mahindra Limited.

announcements.subject: Updates
announcements.detail: Physicswallah Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release- PhysicsWallah and Vi announce strategic partnership to revolutionise digital learning for students in Rajasthan and UP'.
announcements.ai_summary: PhysicsWallah Limited announced a strategic partnership with Vi (Vodafone Idea) to revolutionize digital learning for students in Rajasthan and UP. Under this partnership, PhysicsWallah’s ‘Pi’ platform will be bundled with select Vi Edu+ prepaid plans. This offering aims to provide affordable and accessible digital learning, combining EdTech access with seamless mobile connectivity. The partnership is designed to offer a streamlined learning experience for Board Examinations and competitive examinations like JEE, NEET, and UPSC.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Coforge Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 08, 2026, titled "Coforge launches  Mod Squads    Outcome-based human-agent pods under a subscription pricing construct".
announcements.ai_summary: Coforge Limited has issued a press release dated April 08, 2026, announcing the launch of "Mod Squads." These are outcome-based human-agent pods offered under a subscription pricing construct, aiming to replace traditional Time & Material models with predictable costs and faster time-to-market. Enterprises can assemble custom AI-native teams tailored to specific industry and engineering workflows. Coforge is offering over 130 pre-built AI agents across industry-specific (e.g., fraud detection for banking, claims triaging for insurance) and engineering-focused (e.g., legacy code reverse engineering, QA automation) categories. These agents can be deployed on customer-hosted or Coforge-hosted Forge-X infrastructure.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Almondz Global Securities Limited has informed the Exchange regarding   Revised Clarification on Shareholding Pattern pursuant to NSE Observatio

announcements.subject: Disclosure of material issue
announcements.detail: PNC Infratech Limited has informed regarding Resolution Plan submitted by the Company under CIRP for Gwalior Bypass Project Ltd (Corporate Debtor) in 2020 - Plan not approved - Settlement reached by the Company with the erstwhile Promoter/Director of the Corporate Debtor - Rs. 20.00 Crore Compensation received by the Company towards costs incurred by it as part of settlement.
announcements.ai_summary: PNC Infratech Limited has announced a settlement regarding the Gwalior Bypass Project Ltd (Corporate Debtor) CIRP. The company's resolution plan, approved by the Committee of Creditors (CoC) in 2020, was not approved by the NCLT due to protracted legal proceedings involving Mr. Nakul Bharana, an erstwhile director. To resolve the matter, PNC Infratech entered into an amicable settlement with Mr. Bharana and received Rs. 20.00 Crore as compensation for costs incurred. The company has also issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) to Mr. Bharana on April 7, 2026. This settlement aims to finally resolve the dispute, which involved a performance bank guarantee of Rs. 29.51 Crores that had been valid for nearly six years.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Rajputana Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 08, 2026, titled "A defining Milestone: Debt-free Status Achieved".
announcements.ai_summary: Rajputana Stainless Limited has announced achieving debt-free status as of April 8, 2026, marking a significant milestone post-listing. The company has successfully repaid its entire outstanding debt amounting to Rs. 96.01 Crores. This repayment includes term loans, working capital facilities, and unsecured borrowings, aligning with the stated utilization of its IPO proceeds. This strategic move signifies a strengthened financial position for the company.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Max Healthcare Institute Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of controlling stake in 250 bed Kalinga Hospital Ltd.
announcements.ai_summary: Max Healthcare Institute Limited announced on April 8, 2026, its approval to acquire a controlling stake of approximately 58.39% in Kalinga Hospital Ltd. This acquisition pertains to a 250-bedded multi-specialty hospital located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, known as ‘Kalinga Hospital’. The company will enter into a share purchase agreement to facilitate this transaction. To support Kalinga Hospital Ltd.'s operational and developmental needs, Max Healthcare has approved providing loans up to ₹100 Crore for construction, renovation, and equipment. Additionally, the company will issue a corporate guarantee to a bank or financial institution for the refinancing of $5 million in External Commercial Borrowings of Kalinga Hospital Ltd.'s existing promoter. The acquisition is being financed by a Senior Secured Term Loan of up to ₹300 Crore.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Max Healthcare Institute Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 08, 2026, titled "Max Healthcare forays in Bhubaneswar, Odisha; to acquire controlling stake in 250 bed Kalinga Hospital".
announcements.ai_summary: Max Healthcare Institute Limited has issued a press release on April 8, 2026, announcing its foray into Bhubaneswar, Odisha, through the acquisition of a controlling stake in Kalinga Hospital Ltd. This 250-bed multi-specialty hospital will operate under the name ‘Kalinga Hospital’. The company's board has approved the share purchase agreement for this acquisition, which represents approximately 58.39% of Kalinga Hospital Ltd. To support the hospital's growth, Max Healthcare will provide loans up to ₹100 Crore for construction, renovation, and equipment upgrades. Furthermore, a corporate guarantee will be issued for $5 million in External Commercial Borrowings related to the refinancing of the existing promoter's debt. The acquisition will be financed through a Senior Secured Term Loan of up to ₹300 Crore.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Bartronics India Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Tejas Networks Ltd. has announced that it has won the Golden Peacock Innovative Product/Service Award 2026 for its WavePlexus™ portfolio of Radio Access Network (RAN) products. This award is administered by the Institute of Directors and is considered a benchmark for corporate innovation and governance. The company also received certification for meeting the rigorous standards of the Golden Peacock Excellence Model, demonstrating a commitment to sustainability-driven excellence. The judging panel for the award was chaired by former Chief Justice of India, Hon’ble Justice Uday U. Lalit, along with other distinguished members. The WavePlexus™ portfolio consists of modular, energy-efficient 4G and 5G radio and baseband products, including advanced 32TR and 64TR Massive MIMO solutions, which comply with both 3GPP and O-RAN standards. These products are deployed in carrier-grade networks globally and are designed for world-class performance, lower power consumption, and reduced total cost of ownership.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Oberoi Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of Hotel Horizon Private Limited Private Limited under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 - Update
announcements.ai_summary: Oberoi Realty Limited, along with its consortium partners Shree Naman Developers Private Limited and JM Financial Properties and Holdings Limited, has completed the implementation of the Resolution Plan for Hotel Horizon Private Limited (HHPL) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. On May 7, 2026, the consortium made the payment of Rs. 919.25 Crore, which includes an equity subscription of Rs. 1 Crore for 100% ownership of HHPL. Oberoi Realty Limited now holds a 49.999% shareholding in HHPL, having infused Rs. 460 Crore, comprising Rs. 49,99,900 in equity shares of Rs. 100 each at par and the balance as an unsecured loan. Effective May 7, 2026, the Monitoring Committee has ceased to exist, and the Board of Directors of HHPL has been reconstituted with representatives from the consortium, granting the consortium management and control of HHPL.

announcements.subject: Updates

announcements.ai_summary: UCO Bank has announced an update on its benchmark rates, effective from May 10, 2026. The Asset Liability Management Committee (ALCO) has reviewed and decided on revisions to these rates. The MCLR rates for Overnight, One month, Three month, Six month, and One year remain unchanged at 7.90%, 8.15%, 8.40%, 8.65%, and 8.75% respectively. However, the TBLR (3 month) rate has been revised from 5.35% to 5.30%, while TBLR (6 month) and TBLR (12 month) remain at 5.50% and 5.60% respectively. The UCO G-Sec Rate (1 year) has been revised to 5.74% from 5.72%, and the 10-year G-Sec Rate YTM % p.a. is now 7.21% from 7.24%. Other benchmark rates such as Repo Linked Rate, Base Rate, and BPLR remain unchanged.

announcements.ai_summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited has initiated litigation proceedings against Jiostar India Private Limited concerning infringement of its music copyrights. The company has filed a Commercial Suit in the Hon’ble Delhi High Court, alleging unauthorized use of its copyrighted sound recordings by Jiostar on their digital platforms and satellite channels after the expiry of a license agreement. Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited is seeking damages amounting to approximately Rs. 28,75,00,000/- for infringing instances identified before the suit filing, with the potential for this amount to increase if further infringements are discovered during the legal proceedings.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Update on acquisition of 100% equity stake of Kandla GHA Transmission Limited
announcements.ai_summary: On May 7, 2026, Reliance Industries Limited provided an update regarding the acquisition of Kandla GHA Transmission Limited (KGTL). Further to a previous disclosure on April 25, 2025, where the Board approved acquiring 100% equity stake in KGTL from PFC Consulting Limited (“PFC”) for a consideration not exceeding Rs. 20 crore, the company has received a letter dated May 6, 2026, from PFC. This letter informs Reliance Industries Limited of the annulment of the existing bidding process. Consequently, Reliance Industries Limited will not be acquiring any stake in KGTL. The letter from PFC was received on May 6, 2026, at 3:08 p.m. (IST).

announcements.subject: Disruption of Operations
announcements.detail: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Disruption of Operations- Intimation regarding a fire incident
announcements.ai_summary: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited has reported a significant fire incident at its manufacturing facility located in Bawal Industrial Area, Rewari, Haryana, which occurred in the late hours of May 06, 2026. The fire has been largely brought under control, and there were no reports of loss of human life or serious injury, as all personnel were safely evacuated. The exact cause of the fire is under investigation, and the company is cooperating with authorities. The company is currently assessing the extent of damage and its impact on operations, noting that the affected assets are adequately insured. Further updates will be provided as material developments occur.

announcements.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.detail: Vardhman Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding approval for expanding the capacity of Garment Unit.
announcements.ai_summary: On May 7, 2026, the Board of Directors of Vardhman Textiles Limited approved a capacity expansion for its Garment Unit located in Punjab. The existing capacity is 2.20 million men's shirts per annum, with a utilization rate of approximately 95%. The proposed expansion will increase the production capacity of shirts to 4.50 million shirts per annum by the end of the Financial Year 2026-27. This expansion requires an investment of approximately Rs. 125 crore, which will be financed through internal accruals and debts. The rationale behind this expansion is to broaden the company's product portfolio, attract high-value buyers, secure new order volumes, build long-term relationships with premium international brands, and optimize cost and capacity utilization. The Board meeting commenced at 10:00 a.m. and concluded at 12:45 p.m.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Bharti Airtel Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 07, 2026, titled "Airtel Secure Workforce   India s first, fully-managed and unified Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) security solution for protecting enterprises with a hybrid workforce".
announcements.ai_summary: Bharti Airtel Limited announced on May 07, 2026, the launch of "Airtel Secure Workforce," India's first fully-managed and unified Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) security solution. This platform is designed to protect enterprises with a hybrid workforce by securing users, data, and devices across networks and applications. The solution is compliance-ready, including adherence to India's DPDP Act, and aims to provide robust security while enabling enterprises to achieve up to a 30% cost optimization in their security spends. Airtel Business, the B2B arm of Bharti Airtel, will leverage its pan-India network and 24x7 managed services expertise to offer this comprehensive security platform.

announcements.subject: Action(s) initiated or orders passed
announcements.detail: TeamLease   Appeal filed today with Hon ble High Court of Gujarat, pursuant to Receipt of Order from Employees  Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
announcements.ai_summary: TeamLease Services Limited has filed an appeal with the Hon'ble High Court of Gujarat on May 06, 2026, challenging an order received from the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO). This appeal is filed pursuant to the receipt of an order under Para 26B of the Employees’ Provident Fund Scheme, 1952. The company is making this disclosure as per Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and Clause 20 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III. The company clarifies that the order was received prior to the SEBI amendment on June 14, 2023, which mandated intimations upon receipt of demand orders or notices, and this disclosure is being made due to the subsequent filing of the appeal.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Emami Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 07, 2026, titled "Emami Limited Acquires Majority Stake in Vedix and SkinKraft, Strengthening Play in Personalised BPC Segment".
announcements.ai_summary: Emami Limited has issued a press release dated May 7, 2026, announcing its agreement to acquire a 60% stake in IncNut Digital Pvt. Ltd. (IncNut) for Rs. 321 crore, with potential performance-linked adjustments over 24 months. Emami also plans to acquire the remaining stake in IncNut Digital within the next four and a half years through two tranches, with the consideration based on an agreed future performance matrix. IncNut is known for its personalized beauty and personal care brands, Vedix and SkinKraft, which utilize data-driven personalization and Ayurvedic principles or dermatology-led approaches. This acquisition is a strategic move to enhance Emami's position in the rapidly growing beauty and personal care market.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Announcement under Regulation 30(LODR) - Press Release
announcements.ai_summary: Satin Creditcare Network Limited has successfully raised INR 200 crore through subordinated Tier II capital with a tenure of 7 years, as announced in a press release on May 7, 2026. This capital infusion is intended to reinforce the company's capital base and support sustained growth across its businesses, including expanding high-impact lending segments like Income Generating Loans (IGL) and Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) financing. The long-tenor subordinated structure enhances SCNL’s capital adequacy and provides a prudent buffer for expansion, enabling efficient deployment of growth capital across its core and emerging platforms. The company views this as a strategic approach to capital management, aligning long-term funding with growth requirements while maintaining flexibility for future capital actions and value creation objectives.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 07, 2026, titled "IHCL ACCELERATES PORTFOLIO EXPANSION; REACHES 628 HOTELS MARKS A YEAR OF INORGANIC & SUSTAINED ORGANIC GROWTH WITH 373 IN OPERATIONS AND A PIPELINE OF 255 HOTELS".
announcements.ai_summary: The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) announced on April 07, 2026, that it has reached a portfolio of 628 hotels, marking a year of significant inorganic and sustained organic growth. The company currently has 373 hotels in operation and a pipeline of 255 hotels. IHCL's Executive Vice President - Real Estate & Development, Ms. Suma Venkatesh, highlighted a record of 250 signings through inorganic and organic growth, expanding its brandscape and presence in the midscale segment. This includes the onboarding of Claridges Collection, acquisition of a controlling stake in Atmantan, and Brij hospitality. Ginger has expanded its portfolio to over 250 hotels across 150+ locations. IHCL also signed 19 hotels under the Taj brand, including one in Cairo and a 500-key hotel in Patna. The company opened over 30 hotels this fiscal year, entering new markets and strengthening its presence in existing ones, bringing the total operating hotels to 373 with over 33,000 rooms. IHCL is on track to achieve its goal of a 700-hotel portfolio under its "Accelerate 2030" strategy.

announcements.detail: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited has informed the Exchange about Sale or disposal
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary Arvind Skyline Private Limited (ASPL), has acquired 4,900 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each for Rs. 49,000, representing 49% of the paid-up share capital of Oxford Navrang Realtors Pvt. Ltd. (ONRPL). This acquisition was finalized on April 6th, 2026. Following these transactions on April 6th, 2026, Arvind SmartSpaces Limited will retain an 87% equity share capital in ASPL. The company has also announced a significant high-rise project in Mumbai with a top-line potential of approximately Rs. 2,400 Cr.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary Arvind Skyline Private Limited (ASPL), has acquired a 49% stake in Oxford Navrang Realtors Pvt. Ltd. (ONRPL) for a total consideration of ₹49,000. announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Press release dated April 07, 2026, titled "Press Release of Birla Estates Private Limited a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: Birla Estates Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited, has achieved bookings exceeding ₹1,600 crores for its luxury project, Birla Arika Phase 2 in Gurugram. Nearly 97% of the residences, which amounts to 152 out of 156 units, were sold within a month of its launch on April 07, 2026. The project is a luxury residential development located in Central Gurugram. The strong performance is attributed to buyer confidence in the brand's luxury offerings and a shift towards spacious residences with expansive landscaped areas and lifestyle amenities. The project is envisioned as a low-density community featuring four exclusive clubs.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: EFC (I) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 07, 2026, titled "EFC ACHIEVES OVER 90 PERCENT OCCUPANCY IN RECORD TIME AT SPRINT BUSINESS CENTER WAKADEWADI, PUNE, A FULLY OWNED ASSET OF THE COMPANY.".
announcements.ai_summary: Summary: EFC (I) Limited has announced a significant operational milestone with its fully owned asset, Sprint Business Center in Wakadewadi, Pune, achieving over 90% occupancy in record time. This premium A-Grade commercial workspace, spread over 49,556 sq. ft., has been leased to large enterprise and multinational clients. This rapid stabilization of occupancy highlights strong market absorption for premium office infrastructure, EFC's brand credibility, and efficient leasing capabilities, strengthening recurring revenue visibility from owned assets.

announcements.subject: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.detail: Arisinfra Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about the Shutdown of its unit at Rehana Jattan, Phagwara (Pb) for about 10 days from 15/05/2026 for Annual maintenance.
announcements.ai_summary: Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Limited has informed the exchange about a planned shutdown of its manufacturing unit located at Rehana Jattan, Phagwara (Pb.). The unit is scheduled for annual maintenance and will be out of operation for approximately 10 days, commencing from May 15, 2026. This facility is responsible for manufacturing Maize Starch, Dextrose Monohydrate, Sorbitol, Dextrose Anhydrous, and bye-products. The unit accounts for about 35% of the company's total maize grind capacity and 40% of its sales.

announcements.subject: Capacity addition
announcements.detail: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
announcements.ai_summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited's Board of Directors, in a meeting held on May 06, 2026, approved a significant capacity expansion. The company will be adding a New Lamination Line (SCF) with a capacity of 1200 LSF/P.A. at its facility in Waluj, Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar, Maharashtra. The project cost for this expansion is estimated at Rs. 191 Crores plus applicable taxes. The new capacity is expected to be added within 14 months. This expansion is part of the company's strategy to enhance its production capabilities in specialty films. The existing capacity of the company is 4200 LSF/P.A., which is currently at optimum utilization.

announcements.subject: Acquisition
announcements.detail: KPIT Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of strategic stake in Cymotive Technologies LTD ("Cymotive"), a leading automotive cybersecurity specialist headquartered in Israel.
announcements.ai_summary: KPIT Technologies Limited's Board of Directors, in their meeting on May 6, 2026, approved the acquisition of a strategic stake in Cymotive Technologies LTD. Cymotive is a leading automotive cybersecurity specialist based in Israel, founded by senior Israeli cybersecurity leaders and CAR/AD, the automotive software company of the Volkswagen Group. Cymotive specializes in end-to-end vehicle lifecycle cybersecurity, including secure architecture, threat modeling, intrusion detection, continuous monitoring, and regulatory compliance. This acquisition is expected to strengthen KPIT's capabilities in automotive cybersecurity, a critical area for the company, and enhance its value proposition to global OEMs by enabling an integrated approach to embedding cybersecurity into automotive systems.

announcements.subject: General Updates
announcements.detail: Vishal Mega Mart Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
announcements.ai_summary: The subsidiary of Vishal Mega Mart Limited, Airplaza Retail Holdings Private Limited, has received an order from the Court of Additional District Magistrate, Rampur. This order imposes a penalty of Rs. 2,00,000/- on the subsidiary. The penalty stems from a violation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, where a sample of 'Turmeric Powder' collected from the subsidiary's Rampur store on April 03, 2025, was found not to be in confirmation with the relevant provisions of the law. Specifically, Rs. 80,000/- has been imposed on the Store Manager and Rs. 1,20,000/- on the subsidiary. The company has been informed of this order on May 05, 2026.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 06, 2026, titled "USFDA inspection concludes at Zydus' Biologics Injectable plant, Ahmedabad".
announcements.ai_summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has announced the conclusion of a USFDA GMP surveillance inspection at its Unit 9 facility, located at Zydus Biotech Park, Changodar, Ahmedabad. The inspection took place from April 27, 2026, to May 5, 2026. The inspection concluded with seven observations, and importantly, there were no data integrity-related observations. The company stated that it will work closely with the USFDA to address these observations expeditiously. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Nandani Creation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 06, 2026, titled company with its  Brand  Jaipur Kurti  accelerates Expansion with Signing of Two Prime Franchisee Stores in key commercial hubs of India- Karol Bagh and Rohini, Delhi. ".
announcements.ai_summary: Nandani Creation Limited, through its brand "Jaipur Kurti," is expanding its retail presence by signing agreements for two new franchisee stores in Karol Bagh and Rohini, Delhi. These stores are scheduled to open in May 2026 and will offer the latest collections for women's wear brands "Jaipur Kurti" and "Amaiva." The company aims to strengthen its direct retail and sales channel network and provide an omnichannel experience to customers. The franchise partner for these locations has a proven retail background, successfully operating over 12 Patanjali stores. This expansion signifies Nandani Creation's commitment to strategic growth through experienced partners and prime retail locations, enhancing accessibility for its customer base.

announcements.subject: Monthly Business Updates
announcements.detail: Shyam Metalics And Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of April 2026
announcements.ai_summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited has released its consolidated sales data for April 2026. For Stainless Steel, sales volumes increased by 10.89% year-on-year to 7,928 MT, with average realisations rising by 25.30% to Rs. 1,70,214 per MT. Month-on-month, sales volumes decreased by 24.63%, while realisations increased by 11.52%. For Aluminium Foil, sales volumes saw a year-on-year increase of 19.63% to 1,885 MT, and average realisations grew by 22.29% to Rs. 4,50,891 per MT. Month-on-month, aluminium foil sales volumes declined by 12.72%, with realisations increasing by 5.82%.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Easy Trip Planners Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 06, 2026, titled "EaseMyTrip Observed Double-Digit Growth in Airport Service Adoption; Duty-Free and Meet & Greet Emerge as Key Preferences".
announcements.ai_summary: The press release from Easy Trip Planners Limited, dated May 06, 2026, highlights double-digit growth in airport service adoption, with duty-free shopping and meet & greet services emerging as key preferences. Nearly 60% of travelers using the duty-free service purchase liquor, followed by 30% for perfumes and 10% for chocolates. This duty-free service, developed with Adani Digital Labs, is available at major international airports including Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Lucknow, Amritsar, Mangaluru, and Thiruvananthapuram. Meet & Greet services are also seeing strong adoption, particularly in Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, with increasing use by younger travelers aged 25-30. The company's investor relations website will host this information.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 06, 2026, titled "Vibhor Steel Tubes Secures CRISIL  BBB+/Stable/A2  Rating for Rs 100 crore Bank Facilities".
announcements.ai_summary: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited has announced a press release regarding its bank facilities. CRISIL Ratings has assigned a 'BBB+/Stable' long-term rating and a 'Crisil A2' short-term rating to the company's bank loan facilities aggregating to Rs 100 crore. These ratings reflect the company's established market position in the steel tubes and pipes segment, consistent operational performance, and prudent financial management. The 'Stable' outlook indicates CRISIL's expectation of continued demand benefit from infrastructure, construction, and industrial sectors, alongside a balanced capital structure. The assigned ratings are expected to enhance the company's credibility with lenders and stakeholders, providing greater financial flexibility for expansion plans and working capital needs.

announcements.subject: Press Release
announcements.detail: Zen Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 05, 2026, titled "On Operation Sindoor's Anniversary, Zen Technologies Unveils India's First AI-Powered Fully Integrated Anti-Drone System".
announcements.ai_summary: Zen Technologies Limited has announced the unveiling of India's first AI-Powered Fully Integrated Anti-Drone System on the anniversary of 'Operation Sindoor'. This modular system, designed and developed indigenously, offers vehicle-mounted, man-portable, and fixed configurations with both soft and hard kill solutions for drone threats. The system features full-spectrum frequency dominance (70 MHz – 12 GHz), an extended surveillance capability of over 15 km with tracking of 100+ drones, and a layered neutralization architecture including RF jamming, GNSS jamming/spoofing, RCWS integration, air defence guns, and kamikaze interceptors. It also incorporates a high-sensitivity indigenous radar with a range of up to 20 km. The system's core is an intelligent Data Fusion & Command Centre that uses advanced algorithms for threat classification and response. This launch represents a significant step in India's defence self-reliance efforts.

This stoppage is attributed to demands from local laborers for full-time wages and benefits, despite an existing agreement from August 18th, 2020, which acknowledged an oversupply of personnel and limited their workdays to 4-5 per month with HPC wages. The company has taken several actions in response, including mailing letters to the SSP Dhanbad and DIG (CISF), BCCL, lodging an FIR at Baghmara Police Station, and informing relevant authorities at BCCL headquarters.

announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Coking Coal Limited has provided its provisional monthly production performance for March 2026 and the period April 2025–March 2026. In March 2026, the company produced 4.42 million tonnes of raw coal, a 2.0% increase compared to 4.33 million tonnes in the same period last year. For the full fiscal year (April 2025–March 2026), raw coal production stood at 35.52 million tonnes, a decrease of 12.3% from 40.50 million tonnes in the previous year. Coking coal production for March 2026 was 4.22 million tonnes (up 3.6% year-on-year), and for the full year, it was 33.70 million tonnes (down 13.4% year-on-year). Opencast mines produced 4.31 million tonnes of raw coal in March 2026 (up 2.9% year-on-year) and 34.71 million tonnes for the full year (down 11.8% year-on-year). Production of washed coking coal in March 2026 was 0.17 million tonnes (up 17.5% year-on-year), and for the full year, it was 1.60 million tonnes (down 3.2% year-on-year). Overburden removal in March 2026 was 12.21 million cubic meters (down 24.3% year-on-year), and for the full year, it was 163.12 million cubic meters (down 10.5% year-on-year). Offtake of raw coal in March 2026 was 2.66 million tonnes (down 24.4% year-on-year), and for the full year, it was 33.05 million tonnes (down 13.6% year-on-year).

announcements.detail: Bharat Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 01, 2026, titled "BEL achieves record turnover of Rs.26,750 Crores.".
announcements.ai_summary: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) has announced a record turnover of approximately Rs. 26,750 Crores for the Financial Year 2025-26. This represents a growth of 16.2% compared to the previous year's turnover of Rs. 23,024 Crores. The company's export sales also saw significant growth, reaching around US $141.9 Million in FY 2025-26, an increase of 33.65% from the previous year's export turnover of US $106.17 Million. These figures are provisional and unaudited.
